tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༈bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos sde smad cha chog khrigs skor bzhugs so/ /ka)bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/bsang mchod dgyes pa'i dga' sto
༈bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos sde smad cha chog khrigs skor bzhugs so/ /ka)bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/bsang mchod dgyes pa'i dga' sto

tei:div.tei:p: bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos sde smad cha chog khrigs skor bzhugs so// ka) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ bsang mchod dgyes pa'i dga' ston ro brgya'i bcud myong*/ kha) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal/ ga) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ bka' gter srung ma'i gsol mchod dkyus gcig tu bkod pa bdud dpung byad ma rtsad brlag gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog char la ldeb/ nga) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ smad las drag po'i srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim dkyus gcig tu bkod pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i sgyogs chen/ ca) rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs kun khyab bdag cha) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ las byang phrin las rgyun khyer chog khrigs/ ja) yang phur las byang chung ba'i brgyud 'debs/ nya) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi rgyun khyer snying po rab gsal/ ta) smon lam khyab bdag dpal ldan/ tha) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang phur srung nyer bzhi'i gtor 'bul mnga' gsol bka' gter thun mong gcig dril/ da) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi spros med bsnyen pa'i zin thun 'phral mkho'i nyer spyod/ na) yang phur sgrub khog phrin las kun 'grub/ pa) stong thun? btsan rgod me 'od gdong rol pa bco brgyad kyi gsol mchod bstan dgra thal 'byin/ dbang chog chog khrigs/ gnyis dbang chog phyogs bsdus dang gsol kha chog khrigs zur gsal du yod pa shes par bya'o/ rgyal kun thugs mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ bar chad bdud bcom badz+ra ku mā ra/ /mchog thun kun stsol khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha/ /rtsa gsum yongs 'dus zab chos bla na med/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/

/lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ ༄༅/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ bsang mchod dgyes pa'i dga' ston ro brgya'i bcud myong bzhugs so/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rim dgu yi/ /yang rtse bla med yang dag rdzogs pa che/ /nyi ma shar ltar nyi zla kha sbyor rgyud/ /gwa'u dmar nag dkyil 'khor lha la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ bsangs mchod spro na drag po'i g.yu shug gam/ yang na shing gang rung mer sbar te/ dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar ja chang phud/ 'bru sna dar zab gang 'byor mchod byas nas/ rnga rol gdangs dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do/ hūm̐: gsang chen lhun grub e dkyil pad nyi'i steng*/ /dregs byed bdud bzhi nyon mongs bam chen gdan/ /rdo rje khros pa zhe sdang 'dul byed pa/ /dbyings rig 'gyur med khrag 'thung dpal chen rje/ /bcom ldan lha mchog phur bu khro rgyal che/ /baiḍūr rdul brtsegs gyad 'dor sgeg cing dpa'/ /theg dgu'i khro zhal bzhad gshe rngam gtum brjid/ /bco brgyad phyag na 'bar ba'i mtshon dbal 'khrug /rdo rje'i sgro gshog rlabs bskyod stong gsum 'gengs/ /tshogs brgyad gnas dag brkyang bskum gzi 'bar zhing*/ /gtum chen rgyas 'debs khro mo pang du 'khyud/ /mi bzad 'bar ba'i gar dgur rgyan kun rdzogs/ /sras bzhi khro bcu za gsod phra thabs dang*/ /dbang phyug sgo ma re ti shwa na bzhi/ /skyes bu sa bdag bdud btsan ging dang ni/ /yang dag che mchog zhi khro'i phyag mtshan bcas/ /har len 'bar ba btsan rgod 'khor bcas rnams/

/glog dmar shugs kyis gnas 'dir drag tu byon/ /spyi sges ru tra nyer 'tshe'i bam gdan bzhugs/ /dmod pa'i las dang bar chad rab bsgral phyir/ /sgo gsum dwang bas bstod kyang phyag kyang 'tshal/ /drag shing dud pa'i ljon pa las byung ba'i/ /sdang byed byad ma'i ya 'gal zlum po'i nang*/ /bstan dgra spyi yi dbang lnga'i ge sar rgyas/ /ma rungs bdud dgra'i tshil chen rta bdun 'od/ /gdug byed mkhris pa'i dri chab tsit+ta'i dpal/ /rtsa lag khrag gis sbags pa'i zhal bshos dang*/ /gri rgod thod rnga rkang gling drag tu ldir/ /mtshan ldan bhan+dha rtsa brgyad a mṛ 'od/ /bum ril dgra bo'i snying khrag rba rlabs 'khrugs/ /lcags snod e dkyil bha ling dbal zur ldan/ /spyi sges bstan dgra'i tshogs kyi sha zan brgyan/ /rus pa'i rtsang dmar bha su'i zhags pas dkris/ /rkang klad kyis byugs ri rab ltos dang mnyam/ /gzhan yang bya gcan ri g.yung chu gnas dang*/ /bza' bca' btung ba srid rgu'i longs spyod dang*/ /go mtshon g.yul chas sngags chas spyan gzigs tshogs/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ /'dod yon mchod pa gser ri ro mtsho'i chab/ /phye mar gangs ri ja chang 'o zho'i rgyun/ /'dzad med gaṅgā'i rlabs cher bskyod pa 'dis/ /rab 'byams yi dam rgyal kun ma lus kyi/ /phrin las gcig 'dus lha mchog he ru kaḥ snying rjes dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad gyad chen po/ /rig pa'i ngo bo gzhom med rdo rje'i mtshon/ /skye 'gag yongs bral gzhon nu khro gar can/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal dpa' gtum gsang ba'i bdag /phur pa'i lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsangs/ /bcom ldan yang dag zhi khro rab 'byams dang*/ /bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bsangs/ khyod nyid bsang dang mchod pa'i yon tan gyis/ /'phral yun bar chad ma lus 'dul slad du/ khro rgyal khyod kyi gzugs sku'i gar bsgyur bzhin/

/dam bca' deng dgongs dus bab 'dir dmigs pa'i/ /bdag gzhan gdul byar gyur pa'i sems can kun/ /mchog dang thun mong 'di phyi gtan gyi don/ /gang byas lam du bgrod dka'i bar chad dang*/ /'khrul snang bdud bzhis nyer 'tshe g.yul rgyal mdzod/ /sngon tshe pad+mas bal yul yang le shod/ /yang dag bde chen snying po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /klu gyong gnod sbyin glog sprin la sogs dang*/ /bal bod lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul kheng log tshe/ khro rgyal khyod kyis rtags mtshan dngos bstan nas/ /nus pa'i dbal zer ma bzod dam du bzhag /de phyir slob dpon rdo rje'i sku brnyes bzhin/ /deng 'dir bdag cag phur pa'i mkhan po la/ /'phral yun bar chad bstan nas gzhom gyur te/ /mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod/ /gsang sngags rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ /g.ya' gang dben gnas sgrub phug thams cad du/ khro rgyal khyod nyid sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan gyis/ /mi ro bslang zhing mthu chen mi dgu bsgral/ /gzhan yang lha 'dre dam btags brtul zhugs kun/ /pad 'byung nyid dang mnyam pa khyed kyi mthu/ /lha gzhan gang gi tshad rdo bor mdzad pa'i/ /mgul khug mar grags spa ma grags pa bzhin/ /deng 'dir bdag cag phur pa'i mkhan po la/ /'phral yun bar chad bstan nas gzhom gyur te/ /mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod/ da lta rjes 'jug khyod nyid sgrub mdzad la/ /chos dang nor gyi char 'bebs sangs rgyas thob/ /'di phyir bar chad 'tshe ba'i bdud bsgral zhing*/ /phrin las gang brtsam 'grub pa'i rtsal shugs can/ /phur pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes grags pa'i/ /mtsho rgyal lung zin ci ltar khyod nyid kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams myur bsgrubs shing*/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus thams cad kun/ /'bad med lhun 'byung dpal du smin pa dang*/ /deng 'dir bdag cag phur pa'i mkhan po la/ /'phral yun bar chad bstan nas gzhom gyur te/

/mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod/ ces pa 'di bzhin bsang zhig dgos zhes dus phyis kyang gnubs lo'i ring lugs 'di yi brgyud 'dzin thos byung yon tan gyi sdong po brtan cing bsam byung yon tan gyi lo 'dab rgyas la/ bsgoms byung yon tan gyi 'bras bu smin pa sngags btsun puṇ+yai zhes pas gnad lung rigs kyi 'chad rtsom ldan pa'i tshig gis kyang bskul ba'i ngor/ sngags kyi btsun gzugs snyoms las pa dred po 'tshang can rgyal ming gis gnas chen gze rgyal gyi shar ljongs be'u tshang zhes par/ gar dbang rin po che lo ha badz+ra gyi zab gter zhi khro'i thun mtshams shig la dgong mo zhing skyong dam can 'gyu ba'i dus su rten 'brel dge mtshan bcas blun tshig rmongs bzo kho na bris pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ byin rlabs kun 'dus bla ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dngos grub bdag nyid yang dag he ru kaḥ /phrin las stobs 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /gnyis med rang ṛg bla mar gus btud nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub bde blag 'grub pa'i thabs/ /bar chad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i gnad/ /mkhas grub rig 'dzin bye ba'i dgongs pa'i mthil/ /yang phur phrin las bklag chog 'di na spel/ de yang bla med yang phur zhes bya ba'i tshul yang*/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde gshegs snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: zhes gsal ba ltar/ gu ru nyid bal yul yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar chad kyi rnam pa byung bas bal po ji la ji sa dang ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du gser phye bre bdun dang bcas brdzangs pas bid+yot+ta ma'i rgyud 'bum sde las phur pa'i glegs bam mi khur gnyis tsam dang khyad par hūm̐ ka ra'i yang phur gong khug ma nyi zla kha sbyor 'di nyid phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnams su gsal ba ltar gu ru pad+ma nyid kyis kyang thugs dam lhag pa'i lha 'di kho na yin la zhal gsungs las/

dngos grub che ba yang dag dang*/ bdud dang bar chad 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa med par gsungs nas yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa mdzad pa yongs su grags kyang da bar sa steng du dngos su thon pa ni nyung bar snang ngo*/ de lta bu'i bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa la'ang bsgrub gzhi ngos bzung ba dang sgrub thabs bshad pa'o/ dang po ni gter gzhung las/ e ma hoḥ mkha' ltar kun tu khyab pa yi: dbyings las ma g.yos ngo bo nyid: rig pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: stong la ma 'gag ci yang 'char: phyag mtshan sa bon kun kyang grub: sgyu ma'i zhal phyag ye nas rdzogs: dbyings dang ye shes yab yum tshul: ma 'gag rtsal dang sras 'khor shar: nyid zhi gsal la me ltar 'bar: mtha' dang dbus med khyab cing mnyam: stong nyid snying po so sor rtogs: thig le chen po bya rtsol rdzogs: bskyed pas gsal la stong ste rdzogs: zung 'jug ngang gis sku gsum ston: rang bzhin shugs kyis kun snang gzhom: ye shes drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: kun rtog ma rig 'khrul 'khor bcom: 'khor lo lnga dang dkyil 'khor gsal: gsang ba mkha' 'gror rgya bsdams so: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rig pa rdo rje gzhon nu sku gsum lhun grub kyi tshul du sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa de lam rkyen la brten nas mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa yin no/ gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos bshad pa la'ang*/ de la spyir phur pa phrin las rol pa'i lam rim thams cad thal 'byin rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrub ste/ khyab gdal ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su btab nas don dam ye shes chen po'i khro bo sgrub/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa 'gro drug sems can la btab nas phung khams rdo rje'i 'khor lor sgrub/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la btab nas sras mchog sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub/

mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa brnag pa'i dgra bgegs la btab nas srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa yin la/ bye brag skabs 'dir sgrub lugs dang po gnyis srog tu bzhag /phyi ma bskyed rim srid pa phur bu stod las la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur bu smad las la brten nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba gnyis las dang po'o/ de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni gzhung las/ dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: mthing nag sa la dal kyang bcag: las thig cha tshang spyi mthun gdab: sku 'bag lha tshogs rten rnams bkram: phyi nang mchod pa tshang bar bsags: rang nyid bde ba'i stan du 'khod: phrin las drag po'i phyogs su bsgyur: zhes pa ltar/ bdag bskyed rtsa ba yang phur gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gzhi sngo nag khebs ldan khar dbus stegs mtho bar sku thang bkram pa'i mdun yang phur gtso gtor sku tsaka dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon gang bder rab phur pa lha grangs/ ma 'byor kyang gtso phur tshad ldan byug bdug brab gsum byas pa sgrub thod 'bru nag gis bkang ba'i dbus sam phur gdan la bkod/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /de 'og thugs dam bskul gtor gtso 'khor dgu/ chad mdo gtso 'khor lnga/ brtan ma gtso 'khor bcu gnyis/ phur srung bcu drug dang dbang phyug las gtor/ rang lugs chos skyong drag po sde lnga dang bka' gter srung ma btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad sogs kyi rten gtor legs par bshams pa'i mdun zhi drag gi nyer spyod mchod pa/ mchod gsol gyi gtor 'bul gang 'os/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs tshogs 'khor yo byad sogs 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang sngon dngos rjes gsum mo/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang thub bstod rnam thar gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs chos spyod ltar rgyas bsdus blo yis dpag la/ de nas skyabs yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/

mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mdun gyi nam mkha' chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong : ka dag bde chen 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: kun gzhi dbyings rig 'gyur med pho brang nas: longs sku'i bdag nyid rdor sems yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: zang thal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i pho brang nas: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: skye med sna tshogs rol rtsal pho brang nas: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: klong yangs 'gag med khyab brdal pho brang nas: rig 'dzin shrī singha yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: rab yangs mkhyen brtse gzhal 'das pho brang nas: rig 'dzin pra bha hastī yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: zab dbyings rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas: gsang ba'i yum chen go byi dhe ma la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: snyan brgyud nam mkha' yangs pa'i pho brang nas: mtshungs bral pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab rgyud lung man ngag pho brang nas: gnubs ban bud+dha dzñā na yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas:

mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig ma 'gag brda bzhi'i pho brang nas: gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: snying po bla med kun 'dus pho brang nas: yang dag ye shes rol pa yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku bzhi phrin las lhun grub pho brang nas: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sa bcu'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: khro bcu phra thabs yab yum 'khor bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas: phyi nang dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pho brang nas: bstan pa'i chos skyong dam can gter bdag la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: de ltar gsol 'debs bden tshig gdung ba'i mod: skyabs yul rgyal ba brgyud kun ma lus kyi: thugs rje gzi byin nus pas bdag skyongs la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad dbyings su sol: mi mthun bdud srin dgra las rgyal ba dang : mtshan ma'i bgegs tshogs ma lus kun zhi zhing : rnam pa kun tu he ru ka pa nyid: go 'phang mchog la bdag nyid rab gzhol nas: skye dang gtan srid 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du: phrin las rnam bzhis gzhan don lhur blangs mthus: spobs pa'i ting 'dzin rtag tu brtan nas su: 'dzad med byang chub lta ba'i chu rgyun gyis: sred pa pre ta'i srad bu rab zhi zhing :
nam yang bdag 'dzin mun pa'i 'jigs grol te: lhan skyes kun bzang dgongs pa gsal rdzogs shog:

ces gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam pa ru gyur/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga rnams la thim pas sku gsum gyi dbang thob/ tshig don gyi ngo 'phrod/ nges pa'i don nyams su myangs nas dbang bzhi rdzogs rdo rje bzhi yi dkyil 'khor yongs su grub par bsam mo/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la thun mong dang thun min gnyis/ dang po la'ang gsum las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur bu gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par bsams la thal sbyar bcas/ na moḥ dran rig ngo bo gcig la kun rdzogs pa'i: gdod nas lhun grub rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs: dbyer med sna tshogs zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang : kun nas klong yangs chen por skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ 'khor 'das chos rnams smra brjod blo las 'das: de don ma rtogs rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs rnams: dran shes bag yod lam la 'god bya'i phyir: nges don rtogs par mi dmigs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs nas chen por bsngo/ lan gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam mo/ gnyis pa thun min la'ang 'gal spong dang*/ mthun sgrub gnyis/ dang po la'ang bdun las/ dang po las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mthing nag phur bu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa dkar gtor ni 'dod yon kun khyab ltar btang*/ gsum pa bgegs gtor byin brlab ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid yang dag badz+ra ku mā ra'i: rang bzhin thugs las 'od zer pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med khyab par 'phros: sgrub la mi dbang bgegs tshogs gang yin pa: gtor ma len phyir skad cig 'dir mchis shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra ya ma hā kro ti bh+yo dza dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lnga pa gtor ma bsngo zhing bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rang byung he ru kaḥ nga yi bka' las bgegs tshogs 'da' ma byed: gtor ma khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: rtsal chen las kyi pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: me 'od mtshon cha drag po'i thog ser gyis: brdung zhing phye mar bcom par gdon mi za: de bas gnod byed 'byung po phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ drug pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las khro bcu phra thabs 'phros: steng 'og phyogs bcur khengs shing mu mtha' khyab: mtshams gcod khro tshogs drag sngags 'u ru ru: gzi brjid me char tshwa tshwa si li li: glags lta bgegs srin 'byung po mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ sarba da ha a mu ka bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

bdun pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen yab yum sras bzhi khro bcu yi: thugs las spros pa'i rno dbal mtshon cha'i tshogs: phyi rol gur khang dum bu rim dgu 'khrigs: drwa mig rnams su spu gri'i so 'thab 'khor: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i mkha' ltar gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsakra ka ra ti ka tsakra khaḍ+ga yaṃ tsakra raṃ dz+wa la ya tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: gnyis pa la'ang drug /dang po phyi yi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi snod stong gsum gling bzhi khengs pa yi: mchod sprin lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon: yongs su 'gengs pa'i phyi mchod sna tshogs 'di: zag med bde skyed dgos 'dod lhun grub gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: rlung me thod sgyed steng du bhan+dha'i snod: yangs shing rgya che sman gtor rak+tas bkang : bcud g.yo mdangs ldan mkha' ltar rgyas pa 'di: byin gyis brlabs pas bla med rdzas chen gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gsum pa gsang mchod byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: dung dmar shes rab bhan+dha'i snod nang du: bde stong dpa' bo yab yum sbyor ba yi: mkha' lam bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs ltem gyis gang : gsang ba'i dam rdzas ye nas rnam par dag: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: ༈ bzhi pa byin 'bebs bya ba'i rim pa ni/ gzhung las/ gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: gar dang ging pa dbyangs snyan len pa'i rigs: khyad par rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa: mdzes shing yid du mchis pa sna tshogs spro: rdo rje'i rta ring len tshe brda gar 'cham: dri zhim spos bsregs spyan gzigs du ma bkram:

tshangs pa'i khyim ltar dwangs pa'i mdangs phyung la: bde chen thugs rje'i byin chen 'di ltar 'bebs: gsungs pa bzhin/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ spos bdug gdung ba'i dbyangs rol mo sna tshogs kyis bskul bar bya'o/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang byung pho brang nas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum sangs rgyas dang : bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skur bskyod la: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ka dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur bas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang nas: gsal byed mi bskyod rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sna tshogs ma 'gag blo bral pho brang nas: bla med yang dag rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ci yang ma 'gag sa le'i pho brang nas: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mkha' spyod zab lam ye shes pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+kis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang byung lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: gsang bdag lag na rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: klong chen dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig:

byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma la ya yi ri bo'i gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin shrī singhas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bid+yot+ta ma la yi gnas mchog nas: grub chen pra bha hastīs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dpal gyi mchims phu dge'u gong gnas mchog nas: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mon kha rdo rje rdzong phug gnas mchog nas: mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rgyal bas lung bstan byā tshal gnas mchog nas: slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka ras byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bka' bab rgyud lung gsang mdzod bod la bsgyur: gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying pos byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rgyud gcig lung gnyis brda bzhi'i bka' bab pa: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: zab rgya sgo 'phar gter gyi pho brang nas/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes byin phob cig /byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: /gsang sngags ma nges gang 'dul pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes byin phob cig /byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lung rigs rgya mtsho'i nges don gcig tu sdud: drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rngam brjid rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang nas: yang dag he ru ka yis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang byung rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang nas:

zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro 'dul pho brang nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nus byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: grol lam gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug 'khor lo rgyas 'debs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las pho brang nas: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rtsal chen sgyu ma'i nyams 'gyur pho brang nas: khro bcu yab yum rnams kyis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang bzhin ngang las spros pa'i pho brang nas: phur 'debs phra thabs nyi shus byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: las bzhi thogs med sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: dbyings phyug sgo ma'i tshogs kyis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: srid pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis pho brang nas: las byed ging bdud nyer bzhis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mngon spyod thogs med sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: gter bdag gter srung rnams kyis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phur: khro bo'i lha tshogs 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: dpa' bo 'bum gyis gar byed shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis glu len kyu ru ru: ging pa pho mos rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: ging mo rnams kyis bshugs sgra ti ri ri: rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'u ru ru: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: chos skyong srung ma'i las byed tshubs se tshub: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir: byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib:

thabs mkhas kun mkhyen nyid kyi dpal yon gyis: srid zhi'i gnas gol la sogs spangs mdzad pa: rgyal ba ye shes lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la dbang mchog bskur: nyams rtogs rig pa ye shes rtsal chen skyed: mi rtog rdo rje lta bu'i gnas lugs stsol: gang yang ma 'gag cir snang lam 'khyer ba'i: kun bzang ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa dang : rtsa rlung bde drod rang 'bar dngos grub stsol: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur du gsol: gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur du gsol: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol: shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang thob nas: ka dag kun grol rang dbyings der rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te ka ru ṇa tsit+ta hrī dha ya ma ma kun+ta sha ra ṇa a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas rol mo yun ring brdung zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin phab par bsam/ byin 'bebs rtags dkyil 'khor la bkrag mdangs rgyas/ mchod pa'i bcud mi nyams shing rol mo dang dbyangs sngar las sgra che ba lha sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa sogs 'byung*/ rnal 'byor pa la byin 'bebs rtags nyams 'bar zhing ba spu g.yo ba sogs 'phar ba gar 'khrab snyam bgyi ba sogs bzhad gad kyi nyams ston pa ting nge 'dzin gsal ba bskyed rim la ngar 'byin pa sogs khyad par can dang ri 'bir ba/ sa g.yo ba 'ja' 'od 'khyil zhing me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i ltas 'byung*/ de ltar ma byung bar yang yang bskyar la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo/ des nges par 'byung ngo zhes so/ lnga pa brda sgo dbye zhing rang rig lha zhal mjal la dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: grangs med bag chags brtsegs pa phung po'i sgo: ma rig blang dor 'thib po bsal du gsol:

ye nas 'du 'bral med pa rtsa gsum lha: dran rig rtsal las shar ba'i rang mdangs te: gnyis su ma grub lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: nga bdag a 'thas sems can snying re rje: re dogs bral lo ro gcig ngang du bshags: shes sgrib dag pas kun kyang stong pa nyid: cho 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems: gnas lugs ngo bo gcig la kun kyang rdzogs: de don rtogs pas rjes shes bag yod kyis: ma 'gag 'od gsal dkyil 'khor srog ltar bzung : g.yo med mkha' ltar tsit+ta'i klong du bsgrub: gdod ma 'khrul med ka dag mi gtong ngo : oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ sarba dharma shud+dhe hoḥ oṃ dharma badz+ra hrī dha hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa tsit+ta gu h+ya hūm̐: drug pa bshags pa ni/ om̐/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang : thugs rje'i nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa'i lha/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/

/byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzungs chen bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mor 'khyil ba la/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*/ /ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang*/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bla med go 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' ka dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal/ /yun du mi btang 'da' bar mi bgyid cing*/ /don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*/ /gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*/ /shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te/ sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ /skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya zhes/ /bka' las byung zhing de ltar mi rtogs te/ /gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang*/ /mngon shes med pas skyon can ma lcogs te/

/nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*/ /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*/ /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs/ /nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gis/ /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams/ /rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de/ /mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pa la/ /rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na/ /nongs pa mchis na rab gnong bzod par gsol/

zhes dri med rgyal po bshags pa'i rgyud las/ ye shes lha dang 'khon bcugs bshags pa'i le'u bzhi pa khol du phyung ba'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed bzlas gnyis/ dang po la'ang*/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi gzhi bzung ba/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ ye shes pa drangs shing dam tshig rten la dbab pa/ dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ba'o/ dang po ting 'dzin gsum gyi gzhi bzung ba la/ dang po ka dag gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: stong gsal ma 'gag kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab: ye nas rang byung ka dag lhun gyis grub: 'od gsal snying po bde chen 'dus ma byas: klong yangs rdo rje gzhon nus de ltar smra: oṃ dharma swa bhā badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod pa'i chos thams cad ye nas stong zhing bdag med pa nam mkha' ltar yin pa la yin par shes pa'i ngang dmigs bsam spros pa dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ gnyis pa dran rig ma 'gag lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos sku blo 'das de bzhin las: dran rig klong las zang thal 'gyu: ma 'gag rang rtsal cho 'phrul gyis: sna tshogs kun rgyu'i sa bon ston: om̐ dharma dhā tu hūm̐: zhes stong nyid kyi rang rtsal snying rje chen po mkha' khyab tu bsgom pa'o/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rgyu yi cho 'phrul sa bon las: pho brang sku dang zhal phyag rdzogs: ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: chu zla'i ngo bo ci bzhin snang : oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na sa twa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de ltar stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i cho 'phrul las rgyu yi sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba zhig bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ 'di skyed byed grub pa'i rgyu dang*/ snga ma'i 'bras bu yin pa'i cha nas 'bras bu'i ting nge 'dzin brjod do/ gnyis pa dam tshig gi 'khor lo rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang brten pa lha yi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sgong skyes sbyong bar rgyas pa chen po'i bskyed rim la/

dang po yum lnga'i mkha' klong bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: 'byung lnga bskal par brtsegs pa yi: rgyu nyid dbyings la rang byung du: rtsal dang sa bon so sor shar: ma bcos rang bzhin lhun grub bsgom: om̐ sarba dharma hūm̐: zhes rgyu nyid las rang byung du shar ba'i 'byung lnga'i sa bon las yum lnga'i mkha' klong du rgyu yi rig pa hūm̐ yig las rang rtsal rang bzhin lhun grub kyi gzhal yas khang gsal ba'o/ gnyis pa rgyu yi he ru ka bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin pho brang rdzogs pa'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sbyor: zung 'jug sras dang khro tshogs spros: sa bon phyag mtshan so sor shar: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ / zhes brjod pas gzhal yas khang bsgoms pa de yi dbus su gdan dang rgyu yi he ru ka dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gsal ba'i thugs ka nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ rnams chad pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag ris gtams pa'i lte bar nam mkha'i dbyings nas bh+rūm̐ yig kha dog lnga ldan babs/ de gnas 'gyur ba las khro bo rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: e las drag po nam mkha' mthing : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram btegs: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: kham̐ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khrugs: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi nag: keṃ las ri rab dur khrod 'jigs: bh+rūm̐ las ye shes gzhal yas khang : thod pa'i sku mkhar gru bzhi rngam: phrin las bzhi yi sgo dang bcas: srin po'i bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs: 'dod snam ging mos gar stabs bsgyur: khro chu khol ma'i so phag bsdams: thod tshal sna tshogs drwa ba 'phyangs: dug sbrul nag po'i sham bu bskyod: mda' yab keng rus gar stabs bsgyur:

kha bad mu tig thod pa'i phreng : klu brgyad ka ba lha brgyad gdung : gza' dang rgyu skar dral lcam tshags: ka zhu 'brug la ka gdan sbal: nyi zla 'bar ba'i mthongs skar ldan: zham chu dmar chen rak+ta 'khyil: mi lpags stag lpags bla re bres: don snying rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phyangs: thog steng g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rta babs chos 'khor tsit+ta'i tog: bha su'i zhags pa phyogs bzhir dpyangs: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa dang : me ri smug nag phyogs bcur 'khrigs: rab 'jigs pho brang chen por bsgom: bzhi pa gdan bskyed pa ni/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: zhes brjod pas pho brang gi dbus 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang rtsibs bzhi'i lte bar/ pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ sngar bskyed pa'i rgyu yi he ru ka yab yum gdan la babs/ sa ma ya hoḥ yab kyis brda/ sa ma ya satwaṃ: yum gyis lan/ rā ga ya hoḥ yab kyis brda/ rā ga ya mi: yum gyis lan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yab yum dga' ba bzhis mnyam par sbyor ba mdzad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis 'od zer spros/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis 'od zer tshur bsdus don gnyis byas shing mkha' gsang nas sras dang khro tshogs spros/ mthar bdag gtso bo yab yum 'od du zhu nas sa bon hūm̐ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal chen yab yum gyi skur gyur/ yum las 'od zer spros pa dang*/ gzhan sras 'khor rnams kyis thugs rjes dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bskul ba'i rkyen gyis 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa skur bzhengs pa la/ gzhan dkyil 'khor kun kyang bstims nas gnyis med nga rgyal brtan par bya ba ni/ hūm̐ ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsakra kro ti satwaṃ: lnga pa 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa dngos la rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum las/ dang po bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐:

de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: de steng hūm̐ las skyes pa yi: yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nyer gcig dbu la zhe gnyis phyag: rtsa zhal lnga po mthing la rngam: dang po g.yas gnyis dkar dang ser: g.yon gnyis dmar zhing rab tu ljang : de steng g.yas gnyis dkar dang mthing : g.yon gnyis dmar dang smug nag gtum: de steng g.yas gsum dkar ljang sngo: g.yon gsum dmar smug shin tu nag: de steng zhi zhal dkar dmar snum: phyag g.yas nyer gcig dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba'i lha tshogs yab yum gsal: phyag g.yon nyer gcig dkyil 'khor du: khrag 'thung lha tshogs yab yum gsal: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: bco brgyad zhabs kyis dor stabs bgrad: sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: yum mchog kro ti shwa rī mthing : dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: phyag g.yas dgu la rdo rje gdengs: g.yon dgu bhan dmar yab la stob: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum yab la 'khril: yab yum gzi brjid dpal 'bar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka kro ti shwa rī baṃ: phur pa myang 'das chen po'i rgyud las phur pa dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad bshad/ rtsa rgyud las zhal gsum phyag drug par bshad/ kī la ya 'bru bcu gnyis pa las zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bshad pa bzhin/ 'di ga'i phrin las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dgongs pa yang de yin par snang ngo*/ myang 'das chen po'i rgyud las/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i yab ni che mchog he ru kaḥdang yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma yin par gsungs pa'i don la'ang 'byor snyam/ hūm̐: dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka ru: pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rtsa zhal mthing dmar shin tu nag: g.yas gsum dkar ser ljang nag 'khrugs: g.yon gsum dmar smug sngo zhing 'bar:

zhal dgu rngam stabs 'jigs la khro: phyag g.yas dgu la 'jigs pa'i mtshon: rdo rje gri gug ral gri dang : dbyug to dgra satwa tho ba dang : beng dang gsal shing 'dzin pa'o: g.yon pa'i phyag dgu rim pa bzhin: me dpung bhan+dha lcags kyu dang : lcags sgrog tsit+ta zhags pa nag: kha ṭ+wāṃ sog le 'dzin pa'o: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug gtum pa mo: g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen gri: g.yon gsum tshe bum bhan+dha dung : yab kyi mgul 'khyud rus rgyan gsol: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum sked la 'khril: bskal pa'i me dpung klong du 'gying : thugs kar hūm̐ bh+yo sngags kyis bskor: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje be con 'khor: g.yon gsum bhan+dha par bu dung : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: gri thod mgul 'khyud zung 'jug dang : khro 'dzum rgyan drug brkyang bskum bzhugs: thugs kar srog yig sngags kyis bskor: oṃ badz+ra rid+dhi driṣ+ṭa pradzñā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: de yi thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar: zhabs gnyis mthil sprad bzhengs pa'i stabs: rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs su bsgom: oṃ saṃ bha badz+ra ma hā dzñā na hūm̐: gnyis pa phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ yab yum sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang la dkyil 'khor bkod cing*/ gzhan sras bdag bya ba'i dgongs pa lha gsal phyir 'don gyi don/ gtso bo yab yum sbyor mtshams nas hūm̐ bzhi dang bam̐ bzhi byung*/ yum gyi bha gar rdzogs/ yab kyi phyag gis blangs nas phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bzhag cing dbang bskur bas phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med pa sras mchog rigs bzhir gsal bar gyur/

hūm̐: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: shar du badz+ra kī la ya: dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje tho ba ral gri dang : bhan+dha zhags pa phur bu bsnams: lho ru rat+na kī la ya: ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: gri gug dgra satwa lcags sgrog dang : dung dmar tsit+ta phur bu bsnams: nub tu pad+ma kī la ya: dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo be con rgyu zhags dang : thong gshol dril bu phur bu bsnams: byang du karma kī la ya: ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: spu gri kha ṭ+wāṃ rgya gram dang : me dpung mdung thung phur bu bsnams: kun kyang dur khrod chas brgyad dang : rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal dang ldan: lnga ldan me dpung klong du 'gying : hūm̐: sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen bzhi: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs sogs khro zhing rngam: dkar ser dmar ljang rgyan drug ldan: gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum zhabs bzhi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: oṃ ma hā kro ta tsa tur kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsum pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: zhes brjod pas dpal chen yab yum bde stong mnyam par rol ba'i thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos pa las sbyor mtshams nas hūm̐ yig sbrel ma bcu thig le dkar dmar bcu bcu ste bzhi bcu phyi rol gdan 'khor lo rtsibs bcu nyi zla baṃ gyi steng phyogs kyi dam sri dang bcas pa'i gdan la babs pas khro bo yab yum bcu mngal skyes tshul dang*/ g.yas g.yon za gsod phra thabs nyi shu sgong skyes tshul du gsal bar gyur pa ni/ hūm̐: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bcu ru:

nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan steng du: g.yas bskor tshul gyis rim pa bzhin: khro bo hūm̐ kar sku mdog mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: mda' gzhu 'gengs shing gri thod 'dzin: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje sgra 'byin be con thod: phra thabs phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: khro chen rnam rgyal sku mdog dkar: g.yas mthing g.yon dmar dbus dkar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo dgra satwa tri shūl dbyug: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje mda' snyems gri bhan+dha: phra thabs stag dang bya rgod mgo: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngo: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: gri gug rdo rje me dbyug bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje sder mo lcags kyu thod: phra thabs g.yag dang bya rog mgo: khro chen gshin rje gshed po ser: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser nag: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: thod dbyug rgyu zhags dgra satwa gri: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: dur khrod bdag mo dbyug tho me: phra thabs shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo: khro bo chen po mi g.yo mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: ral gri beng dang lcags sgrog zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gtun khung lcags tho bhan: phra thabs gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: khro bo chen po rta mgrin dmar: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: spu gri dbyug pa bhan+dha zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gtum mo spu gri bhan: phra thabs byi la pu shud mgo: khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar zhing smug: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje tho ba bhan+dha dbyug: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril:

rdo rje bde bskul tho ba bhan: phra thabs spyang ki khra yi mgo: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rgya gram ral gri dril bu zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje rlung bskyod dgra satwa bhan: phra thabs seṅge pha waṃ mgo: khro chen khams gsum rgyal ba mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje be con zhags pa sgrog: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gsod byed gri gug bhan: phra thabs dom dang sre mong mgo: khro bo stobs chen sku mdog smug: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: be con 'khor lo rnga yab zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje las bskyod kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan: phra thabs dred dang byi la'i mgo: khro bcu shin tu khros pa'i gzugs: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs gyad kyi 'gros: bdud dgra dam sri'i snying khar brdzis: yum rnams khro mo'i rgyan drug spras: phyag gnyis rang rtags mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sked la 'khril: thugs kar srog yig sngags kyis bskor: gzi brjid ye shes lnga ldan gsal: sprul pa khra thabs phra men tshogs: g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dzin: thams cad me dpung klong du bsgom: oṃ dzñā na badz+ra kro ta he ru ka dā sha baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

zhar byung phur srung dam can gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ rtsigs pa'i nang khyams la dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang*/ phyi rol sgo bzhi la sgo skyong ma bzhi drod skyes tshul dang bar khyams la phur srung rnams g.yas su bswe mo bzhi/ g.yon du shwa na bzhi/ mdun du re ti bzhi/ phyi rol dur khrod du shar lho byang gsum la bswe lcags dung gi skyes bu bcu gnyis rnams phra thabs tshul du rim gyis gsal bar gyur/ hūm̐: phyi rol shar lho nub byang du: 'dab drug dbus bdun lte ba ru: g.yas bskor tshul gyis rim pa bzhin: dkar mo g.yag mgo rdo rje bsnams: dkar ser sbrul gdong pad+ma bsnams: dkar ljang gzig gdong tri shūl bsnams: sre gdong dkar sngo 'khor lo bsnams: dkar dmar dred gdong mdung thung bsnams: dkar mo dom gdong rgyu zhags bsnams: dkar mo khu byug lcags kyu bsnams: hūm̐: ser mo pha waṃ spu gri bsnams: dmar mo chu srin bum pa bsnams: dmar ser sdig gdong pad+ma bsnams: dkar ser khra mgo rdo rje bsnams: ser ljang wa gdong dbyug tho bsnams: ser nag stag gdong thod khrag bsnams: ser mo ra gdong zhags pa bsnams: hūm̐: dmar ljang rgod mgo be con bsnams: dmar mo rta gdong khog chen bsnams: dmar skya khyung gdong dbyug tho bsnams: dmar mo khyi gdong rdo rje bsnams: dmar mo pu shud mda' gzhu 'gengs: dmar mo shwa mgo bum pa bsnams: dmar mo seng gdong lcags sgrog bsnams: hūm̐: ljang sngon spyang gdong ba dan 'phyar: dmar ljang skyin mgo gsal shing bsnams: ljang nag phag gdong mche zhags bsnams: ljang nag chu glang bam ro za: sna chen glang chen bam ro bsnams: ljang sngon sbrul gdong sbrul zhags bsnams: ljang mo sbrul gdong dril bu bsnams: thams cad 'jigs pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: rngam dang dgyes tshul gshe bar bsgom: oṃ kau rī shwa rī de wi dā ya aṣ+ṭa hṛ da ya baṃ bh+yoḥ hūm̐:

phyi rol sgo bzhi skyong mdzad ma: pu shud skya ga srin bya dang : khra mgo la sogs phra men ma: dkar ser dmar ljang myur mgyogs ldan: phyag na lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams pa'o: oṃ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan pa: bar khyams 'khor yug rim pa bzhin: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi ni: mthing nag lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon: dmar nag zangs wa rkang gsum zhon: ser nag 'phar ba lce brgyad zhon: sngo nag g.yu khyi mgo gsum zhon: kun kyang gcer mo g.yang gzhi gyon: dpal gyi phur bu dgra la 'debs: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan re ti bzhi: mthing nag drel rta rkang gsum zhon: mi lpags gos gyon phur pa 'dril: ser nag gser sha yu mo zhon: rma bya'i thul gyon gser zor 'dzin: dmar nag chu glang sngon po zhon: gtsod gyon khram bam lcags kyu bsnams: ljang nag rnga mong sngo nag zhon: chu dar gos gsol khram bam bsnams: hūm̐: bka' nyan sa bdag chen mo bzhi: ya byin lcags phur ral pa can: mthing nag mthing ber bdud rta zhon: de byin gser phur ral pa can: ser nag gser ber gza' rta zhon: bswe byin zangs phur ral pa can: dmar nag ber gsol btsan rta zhon: phag byin mchong phur ral pa can: ljang nag ber gsol klu rta zhon: thams cad phyag na phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: skyes bu chen po ging chen bzhi: srin po gshin rje bdud dang ni: gnod sbyin la sogs 'jigs pa'i gzugs: dkar ser dmar ljang phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: bdud po dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: dung gser g.yu mchong phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: shel ging dmu gza' dgra lha dang : skyes bu la sogs srog bdag bzhi: thams cad phyag na ral gri thogs: kun kyang khro tshul 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mi bzad rngam pa'i skur ston gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de ltar gtso 'khor gyi rnam par bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ bskyed gzhi rang gi lus rdo rje phur pas go mtshams med par phyur bur gtams par bsam pa nye bsnyen zhes bya'o/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs bkra lam gyis gsal ba la ye shes pa dbyings nas spyan 'dren par bskul ba ni/ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: de nas spos sna sha chen bsreg /rol mo gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas/ drug pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren zhing dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgrub pa chen po dbang bskur ba ni/ dzñā na pañtsa sarba sa ma ti a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya satwaṃ dhā tu gar+bhe āḥ rang gi thugs ka nas byung ba'i bum 'dzin rig mas bum pa ye shes lnga yi ngo bo bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bdun pa dam ye dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar bsre zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje brag dmar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgyad pa dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ba gsum las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen he ru kaḥ

rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul drwa bas sa gsum g.yo: 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la: ye shes rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya baṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ gnyis pa mchod pa la/ dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: rkang tshil zhun mar dmar chen dri chab gtams: sha khrag gtor chen rol mo sna tshogs 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang sman mchog lnga: legs par sbyar ba'i rdzas chen bla med 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ༈ gsum pa bdud rtsi lag mchod bzhugs pa/ hūm̐/ dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di/ /rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin brgyud bcas dang*/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun bzang yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ longs sku'i bdag nyid rdor sems yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ rig 'dzin shrī singha yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ rig 'dzin pra bha hastī yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gnubs ban bud+dha dzñā na yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/

ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gzhan yang rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ 'di'i yan gu h+yas kha skong byas pa'o/ bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gsal byed he ru ka pa'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ yum mchog nyid zhi kun bzang zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ dpal chen kī la rigs bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ye shes khro bcu yab yum zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ phur 'debs sras 'khor nyi shu'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ sgo skyong gdong mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gdug pa'i sa bdag mched bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/

ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ srog bdag bdud po sde bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ shwa na btsan rgod sde bzhi'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ bka' nyan btsan rgod bco brgyad zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ khyad par bka' srung dregs pa sde lnga'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gter srung dregs sde sa ya'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ las byed sprul pa yang sprul zhal du ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ nyid sprul grangs 'das bcas pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ bla ma sangs rgyas rang grol gyis bskul bas/ rtsa gsum gling pas sbyar ba'o// // bzhi pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong nyid mkha' la bde stong legs sbyar te: zung 'jug srub cing rlung gis bskul ba las: dung dmar snod du dkar dmar 'khyil ba 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: lnga pa spyan gzigs gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi snod yangs pa gling bzhi nyi zla'i snod: bha ling gtor chen sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod sprin bkod pa 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ba liṃ ta māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: oṃ bi shwa a wa lo ki te ma hā me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa swā hā: gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub bde chen yangs pa'i klong : gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod dbus: mi shigs rdo rje brag dmar khri steng du:

yang dag che mchog bla med he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag chos dbyings rang bzhin 'bar: nyer gcig zhal rnams khros pas sa gsum sngangs: zhe gnyis sdigs mdzub sor rtse'i dkyil 'khor du: zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od zer thag 'tsher: sgro gshog brgyangs pas 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas rdzogs gar dgus sa bcu g.yo: bco brgyad zhabs kyis srid pa'i 'khor lo bcom: sku la skyes pa'i ye shes me dpung 'bar: dpal chen 'jigs byed he ru ka la bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog kro ti shwa rī ma: mthing nag dbu dgu khros pas log 'dren gzhom: bco brgyad phyag mtshan ban bon phur kha zlog: dur khrod chas rdzogs ma sring dbang du sdud: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum bde chen yab la 'khril: dbyings kyi yum chen rdo rje gtum chen ma: brda yi drag sngags mi bzad phyogs bcur sgrog: las kyi dbang phyug dpa' mo che la bstod: hūm̐: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog rdo rje las: skyes pa'i dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa 'jigs byed skur ston pa: zhal dgu khros pas snang srid sngangs shing 'dar: g.yas dgu'i mtshon chas pho rgyud zil gyis gnon: g.yon dgu'i mtshon chas mo rgyud dbang du sdud: rtsal sgro gzengs pas 'dre rgod phye mar gtor: dur khrod chas brgyad bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: zhabs brgyad gyad kyis gling bzhi ri rab gnon: gar dgu'i chas ldan me dpung klong na bzhugs: dpal chen phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yum chen khro mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid don dang ldan: zhal gsum khros pas ma rungs 'byung po 'dul: phyag drug mtshon chas log rtog rtsad nas gcod: rgyan drug chas ldan ma sring pho nyar 'gyed: yab la zhal sbyor skye med skur ston pa: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: thugs kar sems dpa' gsal byed rdo rje ni: mthing nag skur ston chos nyid skye med klong : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dpa' stobs mkhan: gsang ba khro mo zung 'jug bla med ngang : gnas lugs mi 'gyur sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje mthing : spyi bor thal sbyar chos dbyings zang thal ngang : zhabs gnyis mthil sbyor ngan song srid sgo khegs: mi 'gyur mkha' la rdo rje 'dril ba'i gzugs: rig pa rdo rje he ru ka la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rol nyi zla ti ra baṃ gyi steng : dpal chen sras mchog khro rgyal chen po bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: dur khrod chas brgyad ma rungs lha srin 'dul: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam par ston: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog bar snang g.yo: rigs bzhi yum 'khyud sku smad dbal dang ldan: stobs ldan khro bo yab yum bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sa bcu'i dbang phyug khro rgyal chen po bcu: sku mdog sna tshogs shin tu mi bzad pa: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms: sgro gshog rtse la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: las kyi yum chen drag mo rang 'dra sbyor: za gsod 'jigs pa'i phra thabs sprul pa 'gyed: khro bcu yab yum sprul par phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo ma mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mgo brnyan sna tshogs sprul pa cir yang ston: shin tu mi bzad gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur can: phrin las bzhi ldan ma sring tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: ye shes sgo skyong bka' yi bya ra mkhan: las kyi ma mo 'jigs pa'i gdong can bzhi: rgyan drug gsol zhing rang rtags phyag mtshan bsnams: las bzhi bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: 'jigs pa'i ma mo shwa na chen mo bzhi: snang srid bdag mo re ti chen mo bzhi:

las byed chen mo myur mgyogs sa bdag bzhi: skyes bu chen po sgrol ba'i ging chen bzhi: 'bar ba chen po gsod byed bdud po bzhi: bshan pa za byed chen po srog bdag bzhi: bka' yi las byed dregs pa nyer bzhi'i tshogs: mi sdug gzugs 'chang ha ha'i gad mo sgrog: myur mgyogs las la mngags pa'i mthu bo che: las mkhan pho nya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing bskul ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam tha tshig gnyan po'i dam dgongs la: log 'dren bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang : sgrub la 'dod don mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

rtsa ba'i gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor dzap kyi dgongs pa bsnyen sgrub gnyis la'ang yan lag bzhi tshang dgos par gsungs pa ltar na chos nyid dang sbyar te bzla ba bsnyen pa/ lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba nye bsnyen/ sham bu dang sbyar ba sgrub pa/ tshogs sgrub dang 'brel ba'am/ phrin las sna tshogs pa can sgrub pa chen po zhes bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhir sbyar nas gsungs pa dang*/ yang na phur pa'i dgos chos su chos nyid dang sbyar ba/ lha dang sbyar ba/ /ngan sngags dang sbyar ba zhes gsum du'ang gsungs te/ 'dir phyi ma ltar na rgyud myang 'das las/ phur ni skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ /pa ni 'gags pa med pa'i don/ /phur ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /pa ni rig pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis su med pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /sems kyi sems nyid phur pa yin/ /chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ /gsal bar bsgom na bskyed pa yin/ /gnyis su med na sbyor ba yin/ /lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa yin/ /nyams 'og chud na bsgral ba yin/ /gsungs pa bzhin chos nyid kyi lta ba ma bral ba gal che ste/ gzhung spyi'i dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer dang mtshungs so/ lha dang sbyar ba ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom/ rang gi mdun du thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya la rten byas te phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ste dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rdzogs pa dang yang na gtso bo kho na la gsal snang 'don kyang rung ste/ rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa gsum la bslab la gsal snang thon par bya ba dang*/ skyo tshe chos nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa res mos bya/ 'di gzhung spyi'i bskyed pa lha yi gzer dang mtshungs la gzhan yang rlung bum can dang bar rlung la sbyar ba sogs 'byin 'jug rlung gi bzlas pa la slob cing bde stong la sems 'dzin pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa'i dod thob tsam yin/

ngan sngags dang sbyar ba ni 'og tu 'chad par bya'o/ gong ltar byas pas skyo tshe ngag bzlas bya bar gsungs pa bzhin/ bzlas pa dngos la/ ༈ dang po dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dgongs shig dgongs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: bskul lo bskul lo dzap kyis thugs dam bskul: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang : khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas phrin las bskul: sgrub pa'i lha tshogs bkrag mdangs ya la la: ma bsgoms lha tshogs gsal stong lams se lam: rol pa'i lha tshogs thig le shigs se shig: zhi ba'i sngags phreng 'ja' 'od spungs se spung : drag po'i sngags phreng tshwa tshwa si li li: gzhan gyi sngags rnams bung ba'i sgra dbyangs ltar: rgyun chad med par 'byin 'jug rlung gis bzla: sku gsum snying po rang shar ci bzhin du: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kye: gnyis pa dzap dmigs la/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nyer gcig dbu la zhe gnyis phyag: dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka ru: pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: de yi thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar: zhabs gnyis mthil sprad bzhengs pa'i stabs: rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs su bsgom: gter gzhung gi tshig don ma bcos par bzhag pa'o/ de nas man ngag gi dgongs pa ni/ de yi thugs kar pad nyi'-i steng*/ /gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /srog gi go ru hūm̐ mthing nag /'bar ba chen po'i gzi byin rdzogs/ /mtha' bskor rtsa ba'i snying po ni/

/zla ba la ni skar phreng ltar/ /gsal snang g.yo med brtan byas la/ /ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzla/ skabs 'dir yid bzlas gtso bor bya la sku dang thugs srog la dmigs pa'i rten tsam byas nas sems 'dzin pa gtso te phur pa'i rgyud las chos nyid dang sbyar nas bzla ba bung ba tshang zhig lta bu'o/ lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad skor lta bu/ ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes gsungs la sbyar tshul gzhan ltar na 'di ni dang po chos nyid dang sbyar nas bzla ba bung ba tshang zhig lta bu'i dgongs pa'i don no/ de la gsal brtan thob pa'i tshe/ slar yang de las 'od zer ni/ /nam mkha' gang bar rab tu 'phros/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi/ /rnam par byin 'od rang la thim/ /dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi dag /mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs/ yang phur rtsa bsnyen ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta yab che mchog yang dag he ru ka pad+ma kro ti shwa rī yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa'i rgyud las/ rtsa bsnyen 'bru dgu'am mkha' 'gro'i 'phyongs sngags 'bru gsum bsnan pas bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba lags sau/ ༈ gnyis pa/ yang bdag nyid rtsa ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas pa'i thugs srog sngags phreng las sngags phreng 'od zer gyi tshul du byung*/ mdun gyi rdzas dkyil dang gnyis su med pa'i gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal du zhugs/ sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ rim par bdag mdun rten brten pa dang bcas pa gsal bar byas nas rang la thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par mos la/ slar yang thugs srog sngags phreng las/ /sngags phreng lu gu'i rgyud du 'phros/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa'i zhal nas zhugs/

/ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas thon/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i ngag lam nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ye shes pa'i/ /zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /lte ba nas ni rang la brgyud/ /bdag mdun rten dang brten pa kun/ /gsal bar byas shing tshur 'dus pas/ /dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi ye shes mngon gyur dmigs/ zhes bsnyen sgrub chig sgril gtso bor bya ba ni/ lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad bskor lta bu'i dgongs pa'o/ gsum pa ni/ slar yang bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas sku dang thugs srog sngags phreng las/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ khams gsum sems can la phog pas sgrib pa sbyangs te thar pa la bkod/ dam can srung ma la phog pas thugs dam bskul/ yang bdag mdun lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal nas 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs shing 'od zer me dpung tshwa tshwa 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs byad mar phog pas bya sgro mer bshur ba bzhin bsregs gtor rjes med du byas par bsams la/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /sngags phreng mgar gyi me tshwa ltar/ /'khor ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod par byas/ /dam can srung ma las la bskul/ /dgra gdon dregs pa thal bar brlag khams gsum log rtog zer gyis mnan/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyangs/ /phyi snod 'jigs rten khro bo'i zhing*/ /bcud rnams lha yi da lar rdzogs/ /kun gyi zhal dang sngags phreng las/ /'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba bzhin/ /sngags kyi rang sgra cher sgrogs pas/ /snod bcud thams cad 'ur chem ldir/ /'od zer me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs/ /dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong rnams/ /bya sgro me la bshur ba bzhin/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag par 'gyur/

zhes pa 'di sham bu dang sbyar ba'i las sngags gtso bo bya ba ni/ sgrub pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces snga ma'i thog sarba bigh+nān 'bru lnga bsnan pa las sngags te phur pa spyi dang mtshungs la/ khyad par trig nan ni gzhung 'di nyid kyi sham bu dang sbyar ba ni sgrub pa zhes gsungs pas snga ma ni bsnyen sgrub gcig dril dang*/ phyi ma ni sgrub pa yin pa shes par bya'o/ yang phur rgyud las/ oṃ rdo rje gzhon nu badz+ra 'khor lo rgyas 'deb kī li khro bo bcu kī la khro mo bcu ya sras mchog sarba thams cad 'dus bi gh+nā na dgra bgegs gnon pa trig nan tshar bcad cing shin tu mnan pa baṃ lcags sgrog gis bcing pa hūm̐ thugs kyi snying po phaṭḥ sprul pa 'gyed pa dzaḥ dngos grub 'gugs pa hūm̐ dngos grub thams cad bdag la sdud pa āḥ dngos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa/ zhes sngags 'grel dang bcas te bshad pa ltar na phyi ma'i 'phyongs gsum po 'di man ngag gud sbas yin pa ches gsal lo/ 'di ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin pa ma zad spyi ltar na 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer dang yang mtshungs pa shes par bya'o/ bsnyen tshad ni yang phur gzhung las/ gtso bo la bye ba/ 'khor rnams la khri re re bya'o/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum so sor bsgrub skabs bsnyen rkyang la bsnyen pa kho na la 'bad cing bsnyen pa grub pa dang mchod bstod sogs bsdu rim la 'jug pa las sngags gzhan rnams mi dgos la thun rjes ma rnams la las byang 'bring po sogs rgyun khyer gyi sgrub pa sogs tshul gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir sgrub mchod nyin chog lta bur thun khong gcig la rtsa bsnyen stong phrag re tsam la las bsnyen de yi phyed chog par rtsis nas/

stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhan rnams bskyed pa'i rim pa ltar bzhag pa yin no/ gsal byed sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra rid+dhi driṣ+ṭa pradzñā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang dag sngags ni/ oṃ saṃ bha badz+ra ma hā dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdun gyi sras mchog la dmigs la/ hūm̐ sgrub bya/ rigs bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kro ta tsa tur kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro bo bcu yi sngags ni/ oṃ dzñā na badz+ra kro ta he ru ka dā sha baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dbang phyug nyer brgyad sngags ni/ oṃ kau rī shwa rī de wi dā sha ya aṣ+ṭa hṛ da ya baṃ bh+yoḥ sgo ma bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shwa na ma mo bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ ma tri shwa na tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ re ti bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ rak+mo re ma ti tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ sa bdag ma mo bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ ma tri bhū mi pā ti ka li tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ ging bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ yak+sha ya ma rak+sha pra ma ghṛ wa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdud chen bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ du pra ma rak+sha ma hā tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ srog bdag btsan bzhi yi sngags ni/ oṃ ha tri shu la tsa tri tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ rigs bzhi dang khro bcu yan la brgya re/ sgo ma dang dbang phyug la lnga bcu re phyin chad dam can rnams la nyer gcig re bya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum bzla/ stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs rdzogs pa dang*/ skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: smad las gzhan yod na gsol kha nas rim gyis 'jug

/bsnyen sgrub kho na'i skabs gong gsal ltar bsnyen pa grub ma thag 'dir 'jug tshul skabs phyed par bya yi kun 'go gcig 'gebs gal che zhu/ rjes chog ni/ dang po mchod bstod bya ba la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces mchod cing bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /bgyis pa dang ni ci bsags pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum bya/ gsum pa bsnyen sgrub kho na'i skabs thugs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor 'og tu 'byung ba bzhin bya la bsngo smon sogs kyis mtha' rgyas par bya ba spyi ltar shes dgos so/ gsum pa brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ bzhi pa bdag bskyed bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams rim gyis gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de dwangs ma'i thugs srog hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐/ gyen rdzogs nā da'i thig le yal nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ skad cig gis rang rig byang chub sems kyi sprin las dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang ldan zhing dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rang gi mdangs las shar ba'i khams gsum yang lha yi dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la zhes brjod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes pas/ lus la rdo rje'i go chas zhu lub tu g.yogs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ rang byung snying po dpal yon las 'khrungs pa'i: bla med byang chub rgya mtsho dge bcu mchog: snying po'i dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed pa'i phyir: mtha' yas ma gyur mchog gnyis thob phyir bsngo: drug pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ chos dbyings ye shes snying po'i gzi byin gyis: dngos rlom rmongs pa'i ma rig tshogs gzhom ste: don gnyis shes rab drwa ba'i rtsal rdzogs nas: kun nas kun kyang mchog tu reg gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas legs par gdab/

༈ khyab bdag dpal ldan karma he ru ka'i/ /zab mo'i phrin las nyams su blangs pa'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor lus thob cing*/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /theg mchog gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga legs nod cing*/ /a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gseng lam nas/ /tshe gcig nyid la myur du grol bar shog /srid pa phur bu'i lhun grub rgya mdud du/ /rin chen thod pa gzhal med khang gi dbus/ /rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu phra thabs kyi/ /gsal snang bskyed rim 'ja' ltar rnam bkra zhing*/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems kyis ma bslad par/ /rtogs na he ru ka las gzhan med phyir/ /rang nyid dpal chen phur bur nges rnyed nas/ /nga rgyal brtan pas bgegs dpung 'joms par shog /zhi bas mi thul ma rungs dgra dang bgegs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas/ /tshe khrus dgongs pas rnam shes rang sems dang*/ /bsres nas bde ba chen por rnam grol shog /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo ka nas dag /dag pa'i ngang du lha sku 'ja' ltar shar/ /shar ba las grol sprul skus 'gro don mdzad/ /theg mchog chos kyis 'gro don lhun grub shog / gzhan yang bsngo smon ci rigs gdab par bya'o/ de dag gis bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ bskyed rim srid pa phur bu'i phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa las stod las kyi byang bu chog khrigs su bgyis pa re zhig grub bo/ ༈ rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod sogs spro bar bya na/ dang po dkyil 'khor bsham bkod dang tshogs 'khor yo byad 'du bya ba sogs spyi ltar ro/ de nas dngos gzhi gsol 'debs nas bzung las kyi gzhung bsrangs la bzlas pa bya/ mchod bstod dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya rten snying lan gsum bzla/ thun gtor 'bul ba rnams grub nas/ rang lugs gsol kha rnams gtor 'bul bar mthar chags su btang*/

spro bar mos na na rag bshags pa dang*/ bsdu na ye shes sku mchog sogs sman gtor rak+ta'i skong ba tsam grub pa dang*/ bsgral ba zur du bcad la tshogs phud rim pa gsum du bshams/ tshogs kyi mgor rang lugs su gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan drangs pa'i bar btang*/ de nas tshogs dngos la 'jug pa ni/ las rdor pas/ phyag sngon du 'tshal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis brlab pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes chu chang gis bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gdod nas rang byung stong pa'i dbyings: snang tshul tsam du spros bsgyur gyis: sbyangs spel yi ge 'bru drug 'phros: dal la phog pas dngos 'dzin sbyangs: oṃ dharma dhā tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ā hūm̐: gnyis pa/ hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis nyes skyon bsregs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs mchod dbyings dang mnyam: rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza sarba me gha ya hūm̐: gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la: thugs mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ༈ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren cung spros par 'dod na/ hūm̐/ 'og min ka dag bde chen pho brang nas/ /yang dag ye shes rol pa'i lha tshogs la/ /rab 'jigs stobs ldan khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /shar phyogs me long sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la/ /zhi ba thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /lho phyogs mnyam nyid thugs kyi pho brang nas/ /dpal chen gtso bo khro rgyal hūm̐ kar la/ khro bcu phra thabs rab 'jigs 'khor gyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

/nub phyogs sor rtog rang gsal pho brang nas/ /dpal gyi bka' nyan bshan pa'i ging chen la/ /za byed phur skyong nyer bzhi'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /byang phyogs bya grub kun grol pho brang nas/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa me 'od gdong can la/ /gter rgya bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang phrin las sna tshogs pho brang nas/ /mthu ldan sprul pa nyid sprul 'khor bcas la/ /yang sprul bka' srung ma lus tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bzhi pa tshogs mchod pa ni phud gtegs la/ hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phyi nang khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ saṃ bha ro pa tsit+ta kro ta kro ti ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ dā+e shwa ma hā dā sha dharma pā la ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi snga ma'i 'phros 'dir bya/ ༈ lnga pa bskang ba ni/ bskang rdzas gzhung bzhin spyi mthun legs par bsham: rol mo bya zhing rkang gling drag tu gtser: dri bzang spos dang sha chen dud pa bdug: bag dro lhun chags dgyes pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis: bskang mchod cho ga'i rim par 'jug brtsam bya: sa ma ya: dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab cing spel ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: 'byung lnga yongs gyur lhun grub dal gyi dbus: gling bzhi'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: rmad byung sna tshogs bkram pa'i mchod sprin mchog: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas bla med gyur:
