oṃ sarba dharma maṇ+ḍal pū dza hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ dharma dhā tu ma hā me gha āḥhūm̐: oṃ swa bhā dzñā na sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa shrī ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa bskang bar 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min gsang chen lhun grub dur khrod du: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir dgyes shing gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs drag po'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs: 'jigs byed gar dgu'i skur ston tshogs la bstod: phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spyan gzigs 'bul: dpal chen lha tshogs bstod cing thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen yang dag bla med he ru kaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dud sprin gtibs: rkang mar tshil gyi sgron me nyi ltar gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: tsit+ta'i dpal bshos lhun po'i dbyings dang mnyam: rkang gling rol mo'i sgra chen 'brug ltar sgrog: dpal chen lha tshogs dgyes par bskyed pa yi: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang :

bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas: gzugs mdzes gar mo 'bum ni lang ling 'phyo: glu dbyangs sgeg mo'i pi waṃ phyogs bcur sgrog: thabs shes byang sems bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: bsgral mchod sha khrag klad rus khyon yangs khengs: ga ṇa tshogs kyi 'khor lo ye re re: sman mchod dza gad bdud rtsi chi li li: dmar chen mchod pa'i 'od zer ta la la: bcud g.yo zhag gi kyu mo lings se ling : gsang mchod nang gi mchod pa rgya mtsho 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha lcang lo ru: dmar chen gtor ma dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: sku 'bag bla 'khor srog rten gnyan po gzugs: rten dar g.yab dar ru mtshon mkha' la gzengs: g.yang gzhi rgyan dang bla bre du ma bris:

don snying 'phan dang lda ldi sna tshogs 'phyangs: g.yul las rgyal ba'i go mtshon du ma bshams: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med klong du bskang : mchod du med de du ma ro gcig mchod: sbyor du med de bde gshegs ye shes sbyor: sgrol du med de gnyis 'dzin dbyings su sgrol: bshags su med de ye grol chen por bshags: 'khor 'das dbyings rig chen po'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ye nas rang byung blo 'das ka dag phyir: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : zung 'jug ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i phyir: gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : ma bcos lhun grub yon tan kun 'byung phyir: dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'od gsal dbyings las 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: rdo rje gzhon nu'i yab yum thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul drwa ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i phyir: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang :

sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon phyir: ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag phyir: phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes thabs mkhas sna tshogs cir yang ston: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : tshad med bzhi ldan 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir: sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi gnas su dag pa'i phyir: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i skye gnas rnam bzhi'i sgo gcod phyir: re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : rigs drug lam rim gzhi ru 'dren pa'i phyir: sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi ma rig gnas su mthar byed pa: 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med lhun grub phyir: bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : kun nas thams cad chos sku'i rol rtsal phyir: sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: chos sku khyab gdal chen po'i klong du bskang : longs sku zangs thal chen po'i klong du bskang : sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol klong du bskang : lta ba ye grol chen po'i klong du bskang : sgom pa mi dmigs chen po'i klong du bskang : spyod pa mtha' bral chen po'i klong du bskang : kun gzhi ma bcos spros bral klong du bskang : lam rnams shar grol 'gag med thugs dam bskang : 'bras bu skye med ka dag klong du bskang : ngo bo gsal la 'dzin med klong du bskang : rang bzhin stong la bdag med klong du bskang : thugs rje 'khor 'das ro gcig klong du bskang : zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang : khro bo'i lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang : gnyis med lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang :

dam tshig nyams chag thams cad skongs gyur cig: kun rtog ma rig bag sgrib byang gyur cig: tshe rabs bsags pa'i las sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu bla med sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs spyan gzigs lha mo'i gar: nang mchod sman raka gsang mchod sbyor sgrol tshogs: bla med bde ba chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: drug pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dam 'gal dbang gyur te: bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa grangs nyung g.yeng ba shor: mchod rdzas phud lhag 'dres dang 'bag pa dang : nya stong lo zla dus kyi mchod pa chag: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig g.yel ba dang : bskang dang sbyor sgrol gnad du ma bsnun sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bshags pa bsdus pa ni/ hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:

ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang*/ bdun pa bsgral ba ni tshogs tha ma lcags snod du bzhag la/ bsgral bya 'gugs pa ni/ na mo: rtsa brgyud dkyil 'khor mchog gsum rgya mtsho yi: bslu med phyag rgya sngags kyi bden stobs kyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra gnod byed gang yin pa: rang dbang med par liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ ru tra a mu ka mā ra ya dza dzaḥ brgyad pa bsgral ba ni tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas/ hūm̐: dpal chen stobs ldan badz+ra kī la ya: nus mthu rtsal 'byin stong gsum me 'od 'khrugs: thugs las sprul pa'i bshan pa phur bu'i tshogs: dbyings nas bsgril zhing thog ltar dgra la phob: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs ru tra tshin+dha mā ra bh+yoḥ badz+ra duṣ+ṭa ru tra nṛ tri thum rbad ya: dgu pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: rngam pa'i zhal phyes dgyes pa'i ljags dmar rkyongs: dgra bgegs sha khrag 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hi: bcu pa dngos grub tshogs la rol pa ni/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: don gnyis bla med dngos grub stsol: slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ 'di ni rang byung ye shes mchog: spang blang dgag sgrub bral bar rol: a la la hoḥ bcu gcig pa/ lhag ma 'bul ba ni: ༈ de tshe las rdor pas lhag ma gral mthar bkod nas phyag sngon du song bas lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa la thugs gtad par zhu zhes gsol ba dang*/ 'dus pa byings nas/ om̐ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa:

ma sring ging sman bdud dang bran g.yog tshogs: rngam tshul 'jigs pa'i gcer bu sna tshogs kyis: mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon cing stong khams nyul: zas su gdug pa'i sha khrag snying la za: las su dgra bgegs srog dang dbugs la rngam: rig 'dzin dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: chos mdzad sgrub la bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ya she ṣa bi shwa kha kha khā hi: ༈ smon lam ni/ yang dag phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces dang gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'gugs la/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: mthu stobs dpa' bo'i rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi mtha': ma rungs gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar nas: gsang sngags bstan la bdud kyis 'tshe lags pas: khro rgyal chen po'i mngon spyod mi mdzad na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin yi chad mi 'gyur ram: gsang sngags gnyan la 'bras bu cang med dam: yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas ma dgyes sam: phyag rgya sngags kyi nus pa nyams lags sam: rig 'dzin gong mas thugs kyis mi khrel lam: de bas dpal chen lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: log 'dren bar gcod rtsom pa'i 'byung po la: dpal chen mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar phob: bsgral zhing bzhes nas ming shul med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yo:

dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dbang po lnga la kha kha khā hi: ༈ mjug tu chos skyong gi gtor 'bul nyung bsdus re dang mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pas gtor ma phul/ gnyis pa chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang chen lhun grub dur khrod du: thog ma'i mgon po yang dag rdo rje dang : rigs kyi yum chen gsang ba mkha' 'gro gnyis: 'od gsal dang po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi dpa' bo ma sring ḍāk+ki yis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og rngam klong me ri 'bar ba ru: yang dag khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ra: dbyings phyug yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis: yang phur snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: khro bcu phra thabs phur skyong srung ma yis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bid+yot+ta ma'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po seṅge sgra sgrogs dang : gsang ba'i yum chen rdo rje drag mo gnyis: yang phur 'bum sde'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug laṅka gnas nyul ma tshogs kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : rigs kyi yum chen ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: yang phur gwa'u'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gnod sbyin btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun gyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: lho rgyud mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas:

rig 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa dang : yum chen a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma gnyis: yang phur gwa'u'i zab gter bton pa'i tshe: byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod spun bdun gyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa ru: gsang rgya rtags bdun shog ser phab pa'i tshe: phur pas zhal gzigs drag sngags dngos su gsungs: gter srung btsan rgod mdun du byon pa'i tshe: sa g.yos ri 'bir stong gsum 'ur gyis khengs: ci bcol thogs med sgrub par khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki ni dharma pā la k+ṣe tra pā la ma hā shu la tsa tri saṃ bha ye i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma'i gtor ma bshal chus bran la brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: bran g.yog mang po yang 'khor 'bum dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i dar zab rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rkang gling rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: la la sgeg mo la la dgyes pa mo: la la gar mo la la gtum pa mo: la la rngam byed la la ha ha dgod: la las g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhan+dha thogs: la las mi ro za zhing rgyu ma 'dren: la las mgo snying nang rol thogs te rgyug: la la gcer mo khrag gi ral pa bsigs: la las klad khrag 'thung zhing mtshan ma bsgrad: la las khrag rkyal la las nad rkyal thogs: la las lcags phur la las zangs phur 'debs: la las gcan gzan zhon zhing ku sgra sgrog: la las 'jig rten khyon rnams bla tshe rku: la las dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: la las cho 'phrul sna tshogs dgra la 'gyed: la las byad ma nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston pa yi:

rnal 'byor chen mo phra men bcu gnyis ma: 'khor ni ma nges 'bum phrag bcu drug 'gyed: dbyings la 'gyu ba'i rnal 'byor bcu gnyis ma: 'og tu 'gyu ba'i sa bdag bcu gnyis ma: srid par 'gyu ba'i skye mched bcu gnyis ma: tshogs khang 'grim pa'i nyul le bcu gnyis ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ma: dus la gnas tshe lo skor bcu gnyis ma: sgrub mchog skyong tshe sngags srung bcu gnyis ma: don la ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro yang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: cha lugs sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'gyed: bka' yi gnyer gtad ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ḍāk+ki dā sha dā ya: rak+sha li dā sha dā ya: ma tri dā sha dā ya: yo gi dā sha dā ya: du pra ma li dā sha dā ya: yak+ṣa li dā sha dā ya: maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭha pa la dā sha dā ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni/ ༈ gtor gzhong kha sbub la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa rang rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rngam byed rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: ru tra dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ro ṣa na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ru tra a mu ka bi gh+nā na mā ra ya bh+yoḥbh+yoḥnan nan: ༈ gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol: trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mtha' btsan shog: lnga pa nyin tha ma la dngos grub blang ba ni/

hūm̐: yang gsang 'dus pa bla med dkyil 'khor lha: thugs rje skur bzhengs rig 'dzin bdag cag la: bum gsang shes rab ye shes dbang bskur dang : 'chi med rig 'dzin gzi byin mthu dang stobs: snyan grags mnga' thang longs spyod chos dang srid: yid la bsam pa'i 'dod rgu mchog thun rnams: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ swā āḥhrīḥ mūm̐ mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na badz+ra ku mā ra hṛ da ya sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ༈ rjes chog ni/ dang po/ mchod pa kha gso zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces mchod cing bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yi/ /bgyis pa dang ni ci bsags pa/ /de kun khyod kyi bzod mdzad gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ gsum pa brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ bzhi pa bdag bskyed bsdu ldang ni/ dang po cig car du bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ ma skyes stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' shar ltar: sgyu ma'i rnam rol cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: mi dmigs ka dag rang rig mkha' la bsdu: 'od gsal gshis lugs gnyug ma zang thal āḥ a a āḥ zhes rang byung 'od gsal rdo rje snying po lhun grub gdod ma'i gshis lugs su mnyam par bzhag /rdzogs chen ye grol la mnyam bzhag rjes thob med kyang*/ lam rim gyis pa rnams la cung zad spro na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams rim gyis gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de dwangs ma'i thugs srog hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs nā da'i thig le yal nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ skad cig gis rang rig byang chub sems kyi sprin las dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang ldan zhing dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rang gi mdangs las shar ba'i khams gsum yang lha yi dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la zhes brjod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes pas/ lus la rdo rje'i go chas zhu lub tu g.yogs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ rang byung snying po dpal yon las 'khrungs pa'i: bla med byang chub rgya mtsho dge bcu'i tshogs: snying po'i dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed pa'i phyir:

mtha' yas ma gyur mchog gnyis 'thob phyir bsngo: drug pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ chos dbyings ye shes snying po'i gzi byin gyis: dngos rlom rmongs pa'i ma rig tshogs gzhom ste: don gnyis shes rab drwa ba'i rtsal rdzogs nas: kun nas kun kyang mchog tu reg gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas legs par gdab/ ༈ khyab bdag dpal ldan karma he ru ka'i/ /zab mo'i phrin las nyams su blangs pa'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor lus thob cing*/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /theg mchog gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga legs nod cing*/ /a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gseng lam nas/ /tshe gcig nyid la myur du grol bar shog /srid pa phur bu'i lhun grub rgya mdud du/ /rin chen thod pa gzhal med khang gi dbus/ /rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu phra thabs kyi/ /gsal snang bskyed rim 'ja' ltar rnam bkra zhing*/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems kyis ma bslad par/ /rtogs na he ru ka las gzhan med phyir/ /rang nyid dpal chen phur bur nges rnyed nas/ /nga rgyal brtan pas bgegs dpung 'joms par shog /zhi bas mi thul ma rungs dgra dang bgegs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas/ /tshe khrus dgongs pas rnam shes rang sems dang*/ /bsres nas bde ba chen por rnam grol shog /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo ka nas dag /dag pa'i ngang du lha sku 'ja' ltar shar/ /shar ba las grol sprul skus 'gro don mdzad/ /theg mchog chos kyis 'gro don lhun grub shog

bdun pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: byin rlabs chu bos bdag rgyud smin par shog: yi dam bkra shis yang phur he ru kaḥ dngos grub 'dod rgu'i gter la spyod par shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dbyings phyug rgyas 'debs ma: snyan brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing brtan par shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan nag po che: log 'dren tshar gcod phrin las 'grub gyur cig: gter srung bkra shis btsan rgod myur mgyogs bdun: zab chos skyong ba'i bya ra 'grub par mdzod: gter gnas bkra shis sha 'ug stag gi sgo: bod khams yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog: rol mo yun ring du bsgrags la me tog char du bsnyil bar bya'o/ de ltar o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi g.yul las rnam rgyal bya ba 'di yang bal yul yang le shod du gsang sngags phur pa gling gi lo gsum sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs skabs phur pa gling gi sgrub sde'i mtshams grwa ba rnams nas yang phur bsnyen sgrub dang de bzhin lo mjug gtor zlog rgyun 'dzugs sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i stod smad cho ga'i las khrigs shig gyis zhes yang yang bskul ba yid 'jag thog /'brong smad dgon 'dus spyi'i dgongs don bzhin 'brong bla karma longs spyod nas zhu bskul dang the wan gnam lcags chos tshogs nas kyang cis kyang myur du grub pa gyis zhes bskul ma byung ba bzhin gter gzhung dgongs pa gtso bor bton la bka' gter gyi man ngag gzhan dang yang mi 'gal bar gab pa bsal/ 'khrugs pa bsdebs te chu babs su bklag chog par bkod pa 'di yang mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas snga 'gyur bka' gter phur pa'i smin grol ma lus thob pa dang khyad par du rje'i rang gter gnyags lugs phur pa'i smin khrid rdzogs par bstsal ba dang 'brel 'di nyid lhag pa'i lha ru bstsal nas dbang rtags bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal zhes ming gi cod pan spyi bo'i rgyan du phebs pa'i skal bzang ldan yang don la blun pos rang bzos bslad pa'i cho ga dag yid gnyis kyi rgyur mchis na gter gzhung gser zhun lta bu zur du dpe skrun zhus yod pa bzhin so so'i thugs la 'thad pa'i rang lugs bzhin nyams bzhes gnang bar gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa lags so/

zhes pa'ang nog dang lkog shal med pa'i ba glang gnam lcags smyon pas nyi ma nub gling a mi ri ka zhes pa'i yul gyi char/ e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du/ rab byung bcu bdun pa chu lug lo zla 11tshes 10dpal slob dpon chen po pad+ma kā ras o rgyan rgyal khams chos bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa'i dus tshes dge ba'i nyin grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ smad las drag po'i srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim dkyus gcig tu bkod pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i sgyogs chen gnad la bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /dbyer med rang rig phur bur 'dud/ /srid pa thal 'byin rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rdzas kyi phur bu'i man ngag gnad/ /las mtha' gnam lcags rdo rje'i sgyogs/ /gnad la bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor dbye/ de yang yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ smad las drag po srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim dkyus gcig tu bkod pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i sgyogs chen gnad la bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor zhes khrigs chags su bsdeb pa la/ de la spyir phur pa phrin las rol pa'i lam rim thams cad thal 'byin rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrub ste/ khyab gdal ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su btab nas don dam ye shes chen po'i khro bo sgrub/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa 'gro drug sems can la btab nas phung khams rdo rje'i 'khor lor sgrub/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la btab nas sras mchog sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa brnag pa'i dgra bgegs la btab nas srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa yin la/ bye brag skabs 'dir sgrub lugs dang po gnyis srog tu bzhag

/phyi ma bskyed rim srid pa phur bu stod las la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur bu smad las la brten nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba gnyis gtsor 'don gyi dbang du byas pa las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar smad las srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim dkyus gcig tu bkod pa la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog mar lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan zhing bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi drod tshad brnyes pa'i slob dpon gyis mngon spyod dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su mar ngo'i dus kyi char gza' skar 'phrod sbyor drag cing rtsub pa'i dus su sbyor ba dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi lag len rnams zhib spros bdag bskyed rtsa ba yang phur gyi dkyil 'khor stod las las shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed bzlog pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rdul mtshon 'bring ras bris bsad pa ltar gzhi ma traṃ gyi mgo bo lho nub tu byas pa'i khog par chos 'byung mthing nag gi dbus su gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang rtsibs bzhi lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dbus su rdo rje sngon po rwa gdeng pa/ phyi rim la rdo ra me ri bcas bkod pa'i dbus su lcags kyi rkang gsum mam/ ri sna gsum gyi rdo la thod sgyed byas pas kyang rung ste/ steng du lcags slang che legs kyi nang du dbus su dpal bshos khru+u gang las ma chung ba nus na khro zhal du bcos pa dang ma nus na dmar nag khra bsdebs pa'i gtor chen gdong zhal/ mdun du yum gyi gtor ma gtso bo'i phyed cha la sleb pa/ kī la ya rigs bzhi yang de'i cha mtshungs khro bcu sogs de bzhin la rgyas pa lha grangs/ bsdus pa gtso 'khor bcu drug kyang*/ phra thabs dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs khrag kong khrag kyu grangs dang sbyar la/ phyi rtsang brgya tham pa'am/ drug cu rtsa gnyis/ khru gang ba rtse mo gru bzhi sked pa rgya mdud rtsa ba zur gsum can/

dbu rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig /phyag rtsang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ phyi rtsang la bha su ta dang sngo dmar skud pas dkris brgyab pa'i rtsang rtse sha dang liṅgas brgyan/ de la mdos rgyan thog mar gtor ma'i rtser dar mthing gi gdugs la kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gyi rgyan spras pa'i 'og tu srung bzlog 'khor lo dpe'u ris ltar bris pa srung ba mdun dang bzlog pa kha phyir byas pa rgyab sprod du sbyar/ mthing gi me long dang dar 'phan sngon po rtse gsum pa gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ de bzhin shar du zhi ba'i dar dkar po'i gdugs 'phan la rdo rje'i tog dang dang bcas pa/ lho ru rgyas pa'i dar ser po'i gdugs la rin po che'i tog /nub tu dbang gi dar dmar po'i gdugs la pad+ma kha 'bus kyi tog /byang du drag po'i dar ljang khu'i gdugs la ral gri'i tog /de thams cad la rang rang mthun pa'i me long 'phan dang cod pan/ phur pa lnga'am bzhis brgyan/ phyi rim ras yug nag po'i ru dar la sgab dkris tshul du bya/ bzlog pa'i 'og tu lcags hom gru gsum gyi nang du liṅga tshad ldan bris la ling khrus byas par dug khrag byugs shing shi ltebs su bcings la phung ras dang byad thag gis dril ba bcug /mtha' bskor du/ rim bzhin zor chen bcu ni/ nyungs zor/ dug zor/ khrag zor/ rdo zor/ mtshe zor/ me zor/ chu zor/ thod zor/ khram zor/ mda' gzhu'i zor te zor rnams g.yas su bskor/ mtshams su bsgral chas la/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog /dbye rdzas bya 'ug gi sgro dang*/ 'khor lo/ gri gug /dgra satwa tho ba sogs phyogs gang bder bzhag /byang shar nas brtsam g.yon bskor du drag mchod bskor bshams bya/ de'ang dug khrag gi mchod yon/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen bdug spos/ zhun chen mar me/ rak+ta'i dri chab/ sha rus dpal bshos sogs bsham/ g.yas su btsan rgod kyi zor chen la zor rdzas sna tshogs kyis bskor/ g.yon du srin mo za lam la/

gzhung las/ zor ltar 'phen na gtor ma bya: mdos ltar rdzong na ma mo bya: zhes pa'i dang po ltar na lcags snod dam ni dmar gtor gcig la 'khor brgyad bya la rtsang dmar nyi shus legs par brgyan pa dang*/ byung na bud med khros ma'i gzugs la lag tu gtor zor thogs pa bya'o/ 'khor ni sngar dang mtshungs so/ thun rdzas la/ yungs thun/ dug thun/ khrag thun/ rdo thun/ mtshe thun/ tsher mda'/ me thun/ chu thun/ rnams dang*/ gzhan bzlog mchod gtor chung liṅga sha dum bcas bsham/ de dag bca' bsham gyi rim pa'o/ de bzhin slob dpon gyi mdun g.yas nas brtsams te/ bum pa/ ḍā ma ru/ yungs gzeb/ nas gzeb/ dar dmar nag rdor dril/ las phur/ nang mchod bcas bkod pa smin gling lugs ltar ro/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la smad las gyi gong gnon stod las bya ba dang smad las dngos gnyis las/ dang po brgyud 'debs nas brtsam las byang sngon 'gro thun mong skyabs sems nas thun min 'gal spong cha lag dkar bgegs srung 'khor bsgom pa'i bar dang*/ mthun sgrub mchod brlab byin 'bebs dang*/ brda sgo phyag dang dam bca' bcas sngon du 'gro la/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum gyis gzhi bzung ba/ dam tshig gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dbab dang bstim pa/ dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod pa'i bar bya'o/ de nas bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ dzap bskul mdun bskyed nas blangs la bsnyen dmigs zhal shes ltar rtsa ba che mchog dang phur snying stong rtsa las ma nyung ba dang*/ stong tshig brjod/ hūm̐ sgrub bya/ sras dang khro bcu la brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams nyer gcig dang bcu re bzlas/ de nas smad las skabs srung bzlog bsad gsum thun gsum du kha phral ba 'di z-in bris mthong ba don gsal dang skyid smyon rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i dgongs pa bzhin rnying ma spyi mthun 'thad che bas 'dir yang de bzhin snga thun la srung dmigs ni/

hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐ : bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: lan nyer gcig srung dmigs brtan po bya'o/ mchod bstod bya/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pa d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces mchod cing bstod/ thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: skabs 'dir lugs 'gar dbang len bya srol zhig 'dug kyang 'di nyid spyi mthun nyin tha ma'i dbang len skabs kho nar nges la gzhan du 'dir bya srol la dpyad par bya ba'i gnas te/ gzhung tshig dngos las kyang*/ deng sang skya rengs dang po dbyings nas shar: rdo rje srin po bde ba'i nam langs nye: zhes dngos su gsal ba'i phyir ro/ 'di'i mtshams rang lugs gsol ka spyi dang bye brag rnams bya ba yin pas gsol ka rgyas 'bring gang lcogs bya/ bye brag gzhung 'di'i sgos srung ni phur srung bcu drug dang btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad 'di yin pas nges par du bya dgos/

dbang phyug las bskul 'di snga rabs kyi zin bris mang che bar bskul pa kho nar ngos bzung nas bsad las pho nya 'gyed pa'i skabs spros pa byed na sbyar bar bshad la 'ga' zhig gsol kha ru ngos bzung nas phur srung g-i mgor 'don pa'ang 'dug na gang ltar yang rung bar snyam mo/ chos skyong rnams gang dgos song nas/ gzhung gi gsol kha tshang ma rdzogs mtshams/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bar mthar chags btang*/ gtor ma phul mthar rol mo gzim 'khyugs rol chen brdung*/ snga thun grol lo/ ༈ nyin gung mdun bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ skabs su mchod pa kha gso/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes dang gsum pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta ba la te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ gtor mdos la sman raka bran zhing bdun bskyed kyi rten bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid ye shes rol pa'i ting 'dzin dang bcas nas/ bskyed sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra yo gi ni ma ma ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni tsakra iṣ+ṭi sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas rten dang brten pa gsal gdab par byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ : de yongs su gyur pa las: mdun du drag po'i sa gzhi smug nag rang bzhin gyi me ri dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa de yi dbus su dur khrod kyi gling chen por bam gsar rnying ri ltar du spungs pa klung thams cad dmar chen gyi rgya mtsho rba rlabs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa:

de yi dbus su bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las: drag po'i gzhal yas khang rmang thams cad rdo rje'i rgya gram dang khro chu khol ma las grub pa: lte ba'i gnas su thod mkhar dmar nag gru bzhi pa sgo rdzogs ldan zhing : bhan+dha skam rlon gyi rtsig pa ri rab ltar mtho ba: pha gu khro chu las grub pa: 'dod snam lha gnas su khyab par ma mo rnams kyis gar bsgyur ba: rgyu ma'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa la: mi yi glo snying mkhal ma mchin pa mgo dang lag pa'i lda ldi 'phyang ba: shar bu rnams gcan gzan khrag 'thung gi pags pa du ma la byas pa: mda' yab thod tshal phreng ba dang ldan zhing : klu chen gyi ka ba: zhing lpags kyi ka rgyan: lha chen gyi gdung ma: gza' chen gyi ka zhu: sa bdag gi ka gdan: rgyu skar gyi dral lcam phub ste nang thams cad mi lpags stag lpags kyi yol ba bres pa: zham chu dmar chen rlabs su 'khyil pa: steng thams cad ti ra'i rlid bu'i rgyal mtshan la tsit+ta'i tog gis spras shing pho brang gi rtse mor chos 'khor rnams su lha drag po'i nga ro sgrog pa nyi zla'i tog tu he ru ka za byed kyis gar bsgyur ba'o: phyi rol thams cad me ri rlung nag 'tshubs shing sprin nag po'i 'ur sgra 'byin pa'i nang nas gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs pa: bdud dang srin po sha za gnod sbyin dang ma mo sogs 'byung po'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis 'jigs pa'i gad mo dang rngam pa'i bshugs glu sgrog pa'o: pho brang gi dbus su ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la ru tra ti ra baṃ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa hūm̐ kro ta ya kro ti ya āt+ma ko3 haṃ:

zhes pas pho brang bskyed chog rdzogs nas lha bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: sogs las byang rgyas pa dang yang na phrin las 'bring po gang yang rung bar 'jug /rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na/ skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: bar du gzhung bsrang*/ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni/ sha chen gyi gsur btang*/ rkang chen gyi gling bu bus/ rol mo sna tshogs bgyis nas rngam pa'i gdangs dang bcas te 'di ltar bgyid do/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa'i pho brang chen po nas: rigs bdag sems dpa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: rngam yangs bde chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: drag po e yi chos 'byung pho brang nas: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcur rang rtsal rol pa'i pho brang nas: khro bcu yab yum phur 'debs gshegs su gsol: drag po'i pho brang gnyer ba'i las mdzad ma: sgo skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: za gsod dbugs la rngam pa'i pho brang nas: pho nya ging bdud nyer bzhi gshegs su gsol: phyag brnyan sna tshogs ma nges bsgyur ba'i tshogs: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po'i phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: ma rungs bdud sde gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod e yi pho brang dbus: khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas: byad ma mi ro rta ro'i gdan: bdud srin bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor du: dpal chen lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar stabs kyis: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyag 'tshal bstod:

sngags chas 'dzin cing phyi phyag 'tshal: rgyan drug ldan pas nang phyag 'tshal: zag med sbyor bas gsang phyag 'tshal: yang dag mnyam bzhag phyag 'tshal bgyid: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: oṃ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung bhan+dha rin chen snod mchog tu: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmar chen gtams: lbu ba lang long 'phyo zhing phyur ba 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: lcang lo bsigs pa'i ya kha'i snod mchog tu: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mig dang rna ba sna: lce dang snying bcas spungs pa'i me tog tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: hom yangs 'bar ba'i me thab gru gsum du: sha chen sna tshogs gu gul bsregs pa yi: ngad ldan dud pa bun ltar g.yo ba'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: khro chu las grub sra mkhregs kong bu ru: tshil chen rkang mar bzhus pa'i mar khus gtams: nyi ltar gsal zhing 'bar ba'i sgron me 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: drag po'i snod mchog yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dgra bgegs klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs pas gtams: kha ba'i ngad ldan mkhris pas legs bsgyur 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: lcags zangs la sogs gtor gzhong khyon chen nang : 'bru nag ngar phye'i dpal gtor rgyan gyis spras: lhun mtho bcud dang ldan pa'i zhal zas 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnga bo che dang thod rnga rkang gling sgra:

gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag rnam pa lnga: g.yo zhing 'bir ba 'brug ltar grags pa'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings dang mnyam: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag ri ltar spungs: sbyor sgrol la sogs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nam mkha'i mtha' klas yongs su khyab pa yi: spyan gzigs la sogs lho bun lta bur gtibs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mthun rdzas 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra rak+ta ko la puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta go ro tsa na rak+ta bha ling+ta ye pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa las byang rgyas bsdus gang yin ltar bya/ skabs su dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dgongs shig dgongs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: bskul lo bskul lo 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang : khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas phrin las bskul: sgrub pa'i lha tshogs bkrag mdangs ya la la: ma bsgoms lha tshogs gsal stong lams se lam: rol pa'i lha tshogs thig le shigs se shig: zhi ba'i sngags phreng 'ja' 'od spungs se spung : drag po'i sngags phreng tshwa tshwa si li li: gzhan gyi sngags rnams bung ba'i sgra dbyangs ltar: rgyun chad med par 'byin 'jug rlung gis bzla: sku gsum snying po rang shar ci bzhin du: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kyeḥ rtsa bsnyen gnyis stong re tsam song nas stong tshig 'bul/

hūm̐ sgrub gzhung ltar bya zhing sras dang khro bcu brgya re phur srung rnams bcu re tsam song ba dang*/ gung la bsad dmigs ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying gsum re dang mchod bstod bya/ skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: gong gsal rnams bdag mdun so sor phyes nas bsgrub lugs yin no/ ༈ skabs 'gar spros pa skyung ba'i dbang du byas nas bdag mdun dus gcig tu bsgrub na/ rtsa ba'i bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bskyed pa yan song nas mdun bskyed pho brang bskyed pa la 'jug hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: sogs? skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: bar gcig gis 'thus par byas la gzhung gi spyan 'dren dang mdun bskyed spyan 'dren nas mchod pa'i bar phan tshun sbrel bar byed/ bstod pa nas dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: sogs 'di man chad gong ltar bya bas 'thus so/ zhes pa'ang bdag mdun sbrel ba'i phyag srol bshad zin no/ ༈ de nas na raka skong bshags mthar gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug nas/ las byang tshogs la 'jug /tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ tshogs mchod/ rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig bcad dang*/

skong bshags grub nas yig brgya gsum bya/ zin bris 'gar tshogs bsgral kyang dgos tshul bshad kyang ar+ya dh+wa dzas/ dkyil 'khor gcig la gdab las gnyis mi bya ba zhal shes yin gsungs pa ltar mi dgos pa shes par bya'o/ bsad las la 'jug pa ni/ gzhung las/ las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: dar nag gzengs shing dpal chas bsham: bzlog par dug khrag rak+tas bran: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: gdong la khrag zhag thig les brgyan: drag po'i rnga ni chems 'gros brdung : gri rkang gling bu drag tu 'bud: bskyed pa'i lha srung 'khor bcas rnams: go gyon mtshon thogs dmag dpung bskyed: rbad pas las kun 'grub par bsam: gsungs pa ltar zhwa nag gyon/ rol mo drag rdung dang bcas gtor chung dang liṅga bshams la/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: yang dag dpal chen khro bo khrag 'thung tshogs: bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal deng 'dir phyungs: mdzes 'dzum bzhad gshe dpa' ba'i mdangs ston la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku'i rang mdangs drag po 'gyed pa'i tshe: skye med hūm̐ sgra drag po 'u ru ru: ka dag zang thal glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dran rig ma 'gag so ma hri li li: byin rlabs nus rtsal thog rgod sha ra ra: stong nyid mtshon cha drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes lnga ldan me ri wa la la: stobs bcu thugs rje'i tshwa tshwa si li li: rol rtsal sgyu ma'i pho nya sha ra ra: dug lnga sgrol ba'i ging chen nyi li li: rigs drug sa bon bsregs pa'i me zhags 'khyugs: rang rtsal rol pa'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rigs drug sa bon sreg pa'i dus la bab: skye gnas sgo bzhi gcod pa'i dus la bab: las ngan duḥkha sbyong ba'i dus la bab:

khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i dus la bab: sdig can btsan thabs 'pho ba'i dus la bab: sems can ngan song gnas su shor ra re: tha mal 'jig rten dbang du gtong ra re: bskul lo rbad do 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: mtha' med sems can drongs mdzod las la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: kun bzang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ sems dpa' sems ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ thub drug sgo bzhi lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ye shes khro bcu'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ kau sing ma mo'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ dbyings phyug sgo ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ce spyang srung ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bzlog drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha tra tsa tur dā sha kro ta he ru ka pañtsa dā sha ya ma tri sa ma ya duḥkha mā ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog: ces bskul gyi gtor ma 'bul/ de nas phur pa'i bskul gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras: khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbyings phyug bcas: sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed: rngam gtum gshe zhing mi bzad skur ston pa: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen drag po las la sku bskyod tshe: sku mdog mun nag dud sprin chi li li: dbu skra dug rlangs sngo dmar phyu ru ru: 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gad mo 'u ru ru: mtshon cha'i rtse la glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dur khrod chas la me yi ser ba 'dril: khro bo'i dmag tshogs thog mda' sha ra ra: khro mo'i dmag tshogs tshwa tshwa si li li: las mkhan myur mgyogs bshan pa khyugs se khyug: bya gcan sha za srog len zhungs se zhung : gzhan yang 'khor tshogs sprul pa 'bum dang bcas:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra sgos dgra 'joms pa'i dus la bab: ban bon byad zor bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma rungs dmag tshogs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: sdig can dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra gtong ra re: bskul lo mthu rtsal skyed cig dgra la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa phra men khra thabs dgra la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis dgra la bh+yoḥ ging chen bdud po sde brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra pra bha swa ra ma hā karma tso dā na kī la rak+sha lak+ṣa sri ka nā na a mu ka ru tra mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces bskul zhing gtor ma 'bul: yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul te: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: ci bcol las kun mdzad par bsam: zhes pa ltar thugs dam bskul ba sngon la song nas/ bsad las brtsam pa dngos la bcu gsum yod la/ gzhung las/ dgra bgegs bsad dang 'debs pa'i tshe: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: dar mdung mtshon cha sna tshogs gzengs: mdun du gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs bla dwags ming rus gzugs: spu gri 'khor lo so 'thab bzhag: dar nag mun pa nag pos bkab: bsgral ba'i mtshon cha gzhung bzhin thogs: gsungs pa bzhin/ rnal 'byor pa'am slob dpon drag po dmod pa'i chas zhes zhwa nag dang phod kha gyon/

mdun du bsgral chas sna tshogs dang*/ lcags hom gyi nang du dgra ling mgo bo lho nub tu byas la bkod/ dang po gzu dpang gser skyems btang ba la/ gser skyems du 'bru sna blugs la slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul ba g.yab dar rdor dril bcas/ dang po gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang : longs sku ye shes lnga ldan 'khor tshogs la: 'jig rten ma rungs dregs pas phrag dog skyes: dug lnga log rtog sbyor zhing bsnyad btsal bas: rnam dag dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags mnyam bzhag skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: mi rtog ye shes snying po don ma chung : ye bzhugs gdod ma'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas shāka thub kyis: bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las: ma rungs lhas byin nag po phrag dog skyes: sna tshogs bar chad brtsams shing bsnyad btsal bas: ye shes bdud rtsi gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags ngur smrig chas kyis rab brgyan nas: grangs med chos 'khor bskor ba don ma chung : sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis mkhyen par gsol: byang sems 'phags tshogs gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pad+ma 'byung gnas la: klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' bas: mu stegs bon blon rnams kyis phrag dog skyes: mi mthun dmod pa bor te bsnyad btsal bas: rmad byung bla med gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtshos brgyan: 'ja' lus skye 'chi spangs pa don ma chung :

bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams kyis mkhyen par gsol: brda brgyud drang srong grub thob gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: zab gsang snying po a ti bla med la: sde snod lung rigs kun gyi bcud 'dus pa: nyan thos bshad 'byams dred por chags sdang skyes: mi dge'i lung 'dren sdang sems bsnyad btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags ma bsgoms tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam: gsang sngags thos tsam 'gro 'dren don ma chung : chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mkhyen par gsol: dbyings kyi yum chen gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal bas lung bstan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: gsang mdzod bla med brda bzhi'i klong rdol ba: don med chags sdang can gyis phrag dog skyes: kun slong ci rigs 'brub cing bsnyad btsal bas: sku lnga dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags 'phags pa'i gdung gsob dkyil 'khor 'dzin: zab lam mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud don ma chung : lugs gnyis rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rjes 'jug rnal 'byor la: bslu med las 'bras bzang po smin pa'i tshe: log 'dren bar chad kun gyis chags sdang skyes: 'khrugs rtsod tshe bsod bcom zhing bsnyad btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags rgyu 'bras dkon mchog dpang du btsugs: phan sems dge tshogs rgya mtsho don ma chung : dkar phyogs dge ba'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyis gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'tsho chos rgyal la: longs spyod mnga' 'bangs 'khor gyis bskor rgyas par: bdud rigs sdig to can gyis phrag dog skyes: dmag 'dren g.yul gshom phung ba'i dgra btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags dge bcu'i khrims la srol btod nas:

mnga' 'bangs snying rjes skyong ba don ma chung : 'di phyi las kyi bdag por mkhyen par gsol: chos 'khor gnyan gyi srung mas gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: phyi nang skyong ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po rtsad nas chod: phyi rgyud lha dang srung ma thams cad kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: dgra bo kho rang lha bdud gshed du phob: mā ra ya yi phrin las dus la bab:

gnyis pa bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu dang phur ba sras mchog dngos su gsal ba ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che: sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu shin tu rngam: bco brgyad mtshon chas log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i gar dgu ldan: sgro gshog rtse la mtshon cha si li li: zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs pang du 'khyud: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: ba spu'i bu gar mtshon thogs dmag dpung 'gyed: hūm̐ sgra drag pos pho nya sprin ltar gtibs: rngam gshe rgod pas shan pa rdul ltar 'tshubs: las la chas pa'i srog bdag chu ltar khol: gzir mdzad gnam lcags phur bu 'dril ba yis: dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa'i srog snying phral: 'jigs byed stobs ldan khrag 'thung sku ru gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya yak+ṣa kā la ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdun du hom bskyed la nang du gzas po dgra bgegs dngos gsal ba ni/ phaṭḥ bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i mdun du: yi ge na nag po las spros pa'i smyo 'bog dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa: de yi dbus su kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom bskal par brtsegs pa'i mun nag ltar dum bu gcig tu 'khrigs pa: de yi nang du nṛ tri dmar nag las skyes pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma de nyid: lus sngo nag bam bzhin ham pa shi mig can bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bkyigs shing bshan pa srog gcod bzhi yis 'dzin pa kho yi spyi bor gnam lcags kyi spu gri ngar ma las grub pa'i 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas klad khrag thams cad phye mar dkrugs pa: spu gri'i so la yi ge raṃ dmar nag 'phros pas: rtsa srog tsit+ta'i lam du zhugs pas bla snying dwangs ma'i sbubs su tshud pas rlung gi spu gri dmar nag gnyis su gyur nas las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor te:

bla srog rnam shes kyi rten rnams khrag skyo ltar dkrugs: slar yang 'khor lo de las spros pa'i rtsibs ldan grangs med kyis dgra bo'i phung po khyab par 'khor te dbang po lnga yi rten rnams brlag cing bcom ste dum bur gtub pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: oṃ raṃ haṃ shaṃ kā la rak+sha ma tri du na khaḍ+ga tsakra ya a mu ka nṛ tri trig nan e hur thuṃ rbad myog: gsum pa phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon rnams 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni/ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang : chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum rje 'bangs grub thob bka' bab rgya mtsho bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : che mchog bla med yang dag he ru ka yab yum rigs bzhi: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis: 'bar ba khrag 'thung drug cu: bka' nyan ce spyang ma mo 'bum phrag sa ya la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras bzhi: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu: za byed kyi pha bcu: gsod byed kyi ma bcu: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: sgo ma rigs bzhi: ma mo rigs bzhi: bdud mo rigs bzhi: srin mo rigs bzhi: las mkhan rigs bzhi: srog bdag bdud bzhi: bshan pa btsan bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : ༈ khyad par du yang le shod kyi btsan rgod ber ma chen po: bid+yot+ta ma'i btsan rgod har len chen po: byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog: sha 'ug brag gi btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab:

sham bha la yi btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan: ti se gangs kyi lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs: mchims phu brag gi btsan rgod bshan pa mig dmar: yang rdzong brag gi btsan rgod rgya stag kha che: mkha' spyod tsā ri'i lho btsan gha ya dha ra: gzho stod ti sgro'i btsan rgod sog ra chen po: zangs ri'i btsan rgod drag po zla skyong : sham po'i btsan rgod myur len har ting : sbas lung btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung : gze rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba: sku rgyal shen ne'i zangs btsan beg rtse: rong chen gangs ri'i btsan rgod bshan pa rlung dmar: gtsug lag dkor skyong btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa: yul ri dben gnas btsan rgod shel ging smug po la sogs pa bshan pa srog bdag rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : 'di lan rjes ma kho nar bya srol yod/ ༈ khyad par chos skyong dam can srung ma rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa khyed rnams kyi bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sgos dgra: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba: ma nyes do bsdo kha yog 'gel ba: khyad par nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen: tshe rabs las la grub pa'i bdud: smon lam ngan pas 'brel ba'i dgra: bsam ngan gdug rtsub 'chang ba'i 'dre: khyad par dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: snga dgra yid la bsam zhing : da dgra thad du langs pa: mthu bu lon bzhin du bsnyag pa: gdong la langs shing 'gras ya btsugs pa: longs spyod za lam du dug gtong ba: 'gro lam bsam ngan gyi rtsang 'dzugs pa: gdong nas skra ltar g.yeng ba: zur nas khyi ltar zug pa: rgyab nas gshed bzhin 'brang ba: ngo bstod lkog nas smad pa:

shag ngan sna 'dren byed pa: phu yi chos g.yag 'phrog pa: mda' yi zhing khang bcom pa: ri rgya rlung rgya 'don pa la sogs pa rnams dang : mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: phod btsugs pa: do bsdo ba: 'gras btsal ba: ya bo bzung ba: khyad par bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: bran g.yog dam nyams bdud rigs: nyos pa'i chung ma snying ngan: gsos pa'i le'u lha log: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan la sogs pa lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rigs sum brgya drug cu: nad bdag rkyen ngan sna 'dren dang bcas pa: gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo gang yin pa de: las byed pho nya rnams kyis lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungs: zhags pa can gyis ske nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis myos su chug: las rlung drag po'i rta la skyon: mun nag 'jigs pas mdun nas bsus: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis mgul nas khrid la rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bo dza dzaḥ oṃ rat+na pā sha dgra bo baṃ baṃ: oṃ pad+ma s+pho ṭa dgra bo myog myog: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe dgra bo chom chom: oṃ pra we sha ya phaṭ dgra bo phyes phyes: oṃ a be sha ya dgra bo bkug stims: mā ra nṛ tri bhan+dha rbad bh+yo: lan gsum bya/ bzhi pa pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na srog bdag ma mo che: mthing nag gdug pa'i kha rlangs can: myur mgyogs lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon: dgra bo'i srog len zhungs se zhung : lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos:

rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri nā ga dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na dbugs len ma mo che: dmar nag khrag gi bu yug can: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum zhon: mi snyan skad sgrogs tse re re: lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri shu la dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na bla 'khyer dus bdag ma: ser nag na bun thu lu lu: za byed 'phar ba lce brgyad zhon: cho nge ngu zug di ri ri: lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri du ya dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na mdangs 'phrog tshe len ma: sngo nag mun rum phyu ru ru: srog gzan g.yu khyi mgo gsum zhon: mi sdug 'dre zug congs se cong : lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri ya ma dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

lnga pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ bya 'ug gi sgro zung thogs la/ hūm̐: mthing nag dpal ldan re ma ti: ser nag dpal ldan re ma dzaḥ dmar nag dpal ldan re ma dzuḥ ljang nag dpal ldan re ma bh+yoḥ srog bdag ma bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes: dgra lha lus lha srog lha phyes: srung lha skyes lha yul lha phyes: ban bon skyabs dang mchod lha phyes: dgra bo'i mgon skyabs thams cad phyes: rdzas ngan dud pas myos par gyis: dug mda' nag pos 'bigs par gyis: spu gri dmar pos g.yas nas phyes: chu gri sngon pos g.yon nas phyes: rlung gri ljang gus rgyab nas phyes: sa gri 'thib pos dbang po phyes: phyes shig rmug 'thibs 'khrugs par gyis: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo rak+mo rak+sha ma tri ya ru tra bhan+dha pra be sha ya phaṭḥ drug pa bdud dang sprad pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ya byin lcags phur ral pa can: de byin gser phur ral pa can: bswe byin zangs phur ral pa can: phag byin mchong phur ral pa can: bshan pa ma bzhi'i dus la bab: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di: 'chi bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: srog bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: las kyi bdud dang da sprod cig: rkyen dbang bdud dang da sprod cig: log pa'i bdud dang da sprod cig: lag dmar bdud dang da sprod cig: dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di: bdud dang sprod cig myur du sgrol: oṃ ma tri ya tri rak+sha mā ra ma du dgra bo baṃ log hu ti ya mā ra rbad bh+yoḥ bdun pa spu gris bskor ba ni 'khor lo'i rgya dang bcas la/ hūm̐: rak+sha ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: ya ma ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: pra ma ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: yak+sha ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: khyed rnams las kyi pho nya ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs spyi gtsug tu: spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo bskor: dgra bo'i klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs: 'khor lo lnga yi 'du byed gtor: dbang po rnam lnga'i khrag rtsa myog:

srog rten phung po smyo 'bog dkrugs: g.yas su bskor zhing pho rgyud chod: g.yon du bskor zhing mo rgyud chod: khyab par bskor la rigs rgyud chod: phye mar gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ya dgra bo pi ta se shrī ro hab sha thum ling myog ling rbad tsakra kā ya bhan+dha bhan+dha mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ brgyad pa dgra bo byad du bcug pa ni: hūm̐: shar bdud dkar po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i lha srung byad du chug: lho bdud ser po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i nor rdzas byad du chug: nub bdud dmar po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rgyud byad du chug: byang bdud nag po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i bla rten byad du chug: shar lho'i btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo'i yul mkhar byad du chug: lho nub btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo'i dbang thang byad du chug: nub byang btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo khram khas byad du chug: byang shar btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo mnan gtad byad du chug: bdud btsan bshan pa'i dus la bab: byad du chug cig mā ra ya: oṃ du pra ma ya dgra bo ka khor+dha mā ra ya nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: oṃ ya ma ya dgra bo a pa ta nan: oṃ ru tra ka wa satwaṃ bha ya nan: dgu pa bsgral ba ni/ phur bu sras mchog dngos su gsal zhing*/ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen ku mā ra: 'jigs byed khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rang bzhin thugs las spros pa yis: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: stod ni khro rgyal 'bar ba'i gzugs: rngam pa'i zhal gsum me ltar 'bar: phyag drug mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : las mkhan dmag tshogs nyi li li: sku smad gnam lcags ngar ma yi: phur gsham rngam stabs hri li li: khro chu'i tshwa tshwa thu lu lu: srog bdag las la rngam pa yi: bshan pa phur bu stobs ldan pa: dgra bgegs snying la kī la ya: klad rgya'i mgo la kī la ya: lta byed mig la kī la ya: nyan byed rna bar kī la ya:

dri tshor sna la kī la ya: ro 'dzin lce la kī la ya: snyob byed lag par kī la ya: 'gro byed rkang par kī la ya: reg bya lus la kī la ya: don snying lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes sgo dgur kī la ya: zhe sdang pho la kī la ya: 'dod chags mo la kī la ya: gti mug rigs rgyud kī la ya: yul mkhar khyim la kī la ya: nor rdzas phyugs la kī la ya: dgra bgegs sgrol cig kī la ya: dkar nag mtshams su kī la ya: 'du byed rnam shes rten dang phrol: dug gsum bsgral nas skye med ngang : ming rjes shul yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ yak+sha kī la ru tra mā ra mā ra: bhan+dha myog thum rbad: ha la ha la mā ra ya bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ skabs 'dir drag sngags so lnga dbyangs dang bcas phur bskor bya tshul ni/ spyi bor lan gsum/ sked par lan gsum/ g.yas su 'dril zhing phyam rngam dang bcas 'debs pa lan gsum/ de bzhin g.yon du dril zhing phyam rngam dang bcas 'debs pa lan gsum/ mdun 'dril ba lan gsum/ mthar phur bu gnas gsum dbang blang ngo*/ bcu pa tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lag sor rigs lnga yab yum gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas phur bu sras mchog tu gsal zhing dmigs bya'i snying khar btab pas tshe bsod stobs nus thams cad thig le'i rnam par rang la bstim pa tshe lung*/ kho'i kun gzhi bag chags gyi rten nṛ yi rnam pa'i phur rtse'i hūm̐ gis bsdus la phur bu'i khong seng rgyud rgya mdud kyi rtser thon pas blo bur gyi dri ma rtsad nas sbyangs pa khrus lung*/ rnam shes kyi dwangs ma āḥyig dkar po'i rnam par gyur de nyid phaṭḥbarjod pas mda' 'phang ba bzhin 'og min du song zhing dpal chen po thugs kar 'dres par bsam la slob dpon gyis/

hoḥ skye med ye shes lnga ldan dbal phur gyis: mtshan 'dzin dug gsum phung po bsgral ba yi: rlung rig ngo bo rnam shes a dkar de: mi dmigs ka dag chos sku'i klong du 'phros: ye grol mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngang du bzhag pa gnas lung gi dgongs pa dang ldan pa'i phur pa gdab ste kun gzhi rtsad nas bcad las nyon gyi 'phrul 'khor bshig par bsam/ bcu gcig pa thun brdeg pa ni/ hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po sha rī raṃ: lha rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: zi ra gnam lcags thog chen gyis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ta ti la dgra bo mā ra ya an+dha bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dug thun nag po rlung ltar 'tshubs: gshin rje yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: myos byed dug mda' nag po yis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ ya ma ha la ka la dgra bo mā ra bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs: ma mo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: khrag nad dmar yams chu ltar khol: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ ma tri rak+ta ya dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: srog bdud yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: pha lam khro chu myur 'bebs 'dis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ du pra ma she la du ya mā ra dgra bgegs bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: ke tshe shang tshe glog ltar 'khyugs: shel ging yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: reg chod srog gzer smyo 'bog 'dis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ she la ra tsa khaḍ+ga bhan+dha mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: tsher mda' drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: btsan rgod yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: gzir mda' drag po sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ shu la tsa tri ka khor+dha mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: me thun drag po lhabs se lhab: gnod sbyin yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku:

bsregs dang tsha ngar 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ rak+sha raṃ dz+wa la mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: chu thun mdze nad thibs se thib: klu bdud yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: sngo nag sbos 'gas rlangs thabs 'phyur: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ nā ga ra mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bcu gnyis pa gtub pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni badz+ra he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na gri gug lcags kyu bsnams: lcags kyus zungs la gri gug gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yo: dgra bgegs bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni rat+na he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams: zhags pas chings la ral gris gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ rat+na kro ti he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na dgra satwa lcags sgrog bsnams: lcags sgrog sdoms la dgra satwas gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ pad+ma kro ta he ru ka kī la ya ham̐'u bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni karma he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na dril bu phur pa bsnams: dril bus myos la phur pas dkrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ karma kro ta he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs mā ra mā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni khro bcu yab yum sku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: phyag na rdo rje hom gtun bsnams: rdo rjes hom du phye mar rdungs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ta kro ti dā sha ya baṃ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du tri dz+wa la ya dgra bgegs kyi srog la rbad rbad: dbugs la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad:

khrag la rbad rbad: skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: 'du ba drug la rbad rbad: gzugs phung brgyad la rbad rbad: rgyu lam dgu la rbad rbad: mā ra ya: mā ra du: mā ra nan: mā ra baṃ: mā ra trig: mā ra myog: mā ra thum: mā ra rbad rbad: bcu gsum pa zhal du 'bul ba ni hom gzar du bzhag la bdud rtsis bran/ hūm̐: las byed 'bar ba pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: phyag na rngam yangs drag po'i hom thogs te: dgra bgegs sha khrag bdud rtsir bsgyur bas bkang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: gti mug bsgral ba'i sha mchod bla na med: 'dod chags bsgral ba'i khrag mchod rmad du byung : zhe sdang bsgral ba'i rus mchod ngo mtshar che: phrag dog bsgral ba'i mchod sprin a la la: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: dam can gter srung rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: pho nya sprul pa yang sprul zhal phyes shig: hūm̐: klong yangs gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes shig: rngam gzengs gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: myur mgyogs glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: dug gsum dgra bgegs sha khrag zhal du bstab: lhag med bzhes shig ye shes chen por rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa: tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na: bha su ta i daṃ ba ling+ta pū dza la kha kha khā hi: zhes bsgral mchod bdud rtsis bran bzlog gtor la stob cing lhag med bzhes par bsam/ lag len dang zin bris 'gar tshogs rol dang lhag 'bul rjes su+u byed pa snang yang 'dir zin bris mthong ba don gsal ltar byas na rnying lugs spyir 'thad pas de ltar byas so/ ༈ dngos grub tshogs la rol pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: don gnyis bla med dngos grub stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni rang byung ye shes mchog: spang blang dgag sgrub bral bar rol: a la la hoḥ tshogs la rol zhing lhag zhus dang lhag ma byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas lhag ma 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: ma sring ging sman bdud dang bran g.yog tshogs: rngam tshul 'jigs pa'i gcer bu sna tshogs kyis: mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon cing stong khams nyul: zas su gdug pa'i sha khrag snying la za: las su dgra bgegs srog dang dbugs la rngam: rig 'dzin dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: chos mdzad sgrub la bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ya she ṣa bi shwa kha kha khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rol mo brdung dar nag g.yab/ gtor ma bshams la/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: mthu stobs dpa' bo'i rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi mtha': ma rungs gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar nas: gsang sngags bstan la bdud kyis 'tshe lags pas: khro rgyal chen po'i mngon spyod mi mdzad na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin yi chad mi 'gyur ram: gsang sngags gnyan la 'bras bu cang med dam: yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas ma dgyes sam: phyag rgya sngags kyi nus pa nyams lags sam: rig 'dzin gong mas thugs kyis mi khrel lam: de bas dpal chen lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: log 'dren bar gcod rtsom pa'i 'byung po la: dpal chen mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar phob: bsgral zhing bzhes nas ming shul med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yo: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dbang po lnga la kha kha khā hi: bzlog gzhung bya ba'i go rim la'ang*/ rang lugs la go rim mi 'dra gsum du byung ste/ z-in bris mthong ba don gsal las dar bzlog dang po/ sngags 'chang kun blo'i zin bris su rtsang bzlog dang po mdzad/

rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes ni/ yang bzlog dang po mdzad pas/ de las ches 'thad pa ni phyi ma nyid yin la ci'i phyir zhe na yang bzlog dang reg chod sbrel ma ni/ zlog gzhung dngos yin la/ rtsang bzlog ni/ pho nya las byed gyi bzlog pa yin te/ pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ dar bzlog ni dkyil 'khor mdos rgyan gyi bzlog pa yin pas de gnyis bzlog gzhung gi cha lag yin pas na/ gtso 'khor gyi go rim dang gzhung dang yan lag 'gal 'dzol ma song ba'i phyir 'dir yang phyi ma nyid 'thad pa dang ldan par mthong nas de ltar bkod do/ de la gzhung las/ yang bzlog bya ba'i rim pa ni: gri lag la sogs g.yab pa'i rdzas: 'bru nag la sogs gtor ba'i thun: rol mo la sogs rngam pa'i rdzas: dmod pa drag sngags las su shes: dpa' bo rdo rje ting 'dzin bskyed: dgra bo'i g.yul ngo bzlog par bsam: zhes pa bzhin yo byad rnams 'du bya la/ gtor chung sha dum liṅga bcas bshams la/ bzlog gtor bran/ dar nag g.yab/ drag rol dang bcas te/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: yang dag che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: sku mdog mthing nag mi bzad rab tu 'bar: khros pa'i zhal gyis srid gsum sngangs shing 'dar: rno dbal mtshon chas gdon tshogs dum bur gtub: dur khrod chas brgyad rtsal chen lhun gyis grub: rdo rje'i sgro ldan log 'dren thul gyis gzhom: 'jigs byed gar gyis snang srid g.yo zhing 'gul: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso mo pang du 'khyud: yab yum sku la ye shes me ri 'bar: ba spu'i gseb nas khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: 'jigs pa'i gad mo hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: drag sngags rbad bskul rdzu 'phrul glog ltar 'khyug: ye shes 'jig rten khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nya las la 'gyed: bzlog pa'i mtshon cha ngan sngags sha ra ra:

deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dgra bgegs bsgral zhing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: mdun du drag po'i lcags snod du gtor chung liṅga sha dum bcas bshams la/ rgyas pa phur so gar 'dug 'di bzhin bsgral nas mchod/ thog mar hom bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: las mkhan pho nyas bzung ste mi shor bar: mnan cing bsdams nas myos pa'i rang bzhin gyur: de nas 'gugs bstim ni: phaṭḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: dpal chen che mchog lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: byad ma dgra bgegs log 'dren gnod byed rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: rno dbal 'debs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sgrol cing gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dzi bī nṛ tri mā ra tshin+dha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtub la bzlog par stob cing*/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen yang dag che mchog he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed stobs ldan badz+ra kī la ya: zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bka' sdod dam can chos skyong ma lus kun: dbang drag rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : gsang chen khro bo rol pa ru: ye shes 'jig rten 'khrugs pa'i tshe: dpal chen yang dag he ru kas: gsang sngags 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rig sngags 'dus pa'i gtor chen bshams: gzungs sngags 'dus pa'i zor chen bsgril: ye shes pho nya rtsang gis brgyan: ngan sngags dmod pa'i zor 'phang tshe: 'jig rten lha rnams srog snying blangs: ma rungs dregs pa rdul du brlags:

sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ras: byin rlabs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: nus mthu 'dus pa'i gtor chen bshams: man ngag stobs kyis zor chen bsgril: rdzu 'phrul thogs med rtsang gis brgyan: reg chod rtsal gyis zor 'phang tshe: lha min g.yul dang dpung tshogs bcom: 'byung po'i gdon tshogs phye mar brlags: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub tu: chos rgyal mu stegs 'thab pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje yis: bskyed rim dri med dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rdzogs rim gnyug ma'i gtor chen bshams: gnyis med gcig 'dus zor chen bsgril: rol rtsal zang thal rtsang gis brgyan: rdo rje thog 'bebs zor kyang 'phangs: mu stegs dmag tshogs khrag bskyugs gum: zhang zhung phyi pa'i bstan pa nub: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang du: phyi nang bden gnyis rtsod pa'i tshe: slob dpon seṅge sgra sgrogs kyis: snying rje khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: thogs med mthu yi gtor chen bshams: dmod pa reg chod zor chen bsgril: las stobs rlung gi rtsang phur brgyan: 'byung lnga go ldog zor 'phang tshe: gnam lcags thog lhungs mu stegs brlags: nam yang mi ldang rgya yis btab: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog par mdzod: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: yang phur 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bden gnyis rdzas kyi gtor chen bshams: sna tshogs dug gi zor chen bsgril:

drag po las mkhan rtsang gis brgyan: deng 'dir log 'dren bgegs la 'phen: rbad pa'i lha srung las la chos: dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs kyis: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: dmag dpung bskyed la zor sna drongs: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: che mchog yang dag zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi gtor zlog ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam pa'i gtum zhal bgrad: zhe gnyis phyag gis zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: dbyings kyi yum chen kro ti shwa rī 'khyud: rab tu 'bar ba'i me dpung dbus su 'gyings: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang yab yum rigs lnga'i tshogs: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i dar dang cod pan 'dzin: 'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: kun tu bzang po chos dbyings ye shes sku: ma rig 'khrul pa'i gti mug bzlog tu gsol: dbyings phyug bzang mo dus gsum skyed pa'i yum: nga bdag gces 'dzin ru tra bzlog tu gsol: rdor sems yab yum zhe sdang bag chags zlog: rin 'byung yab yum nga rgyal shes bya zlog: snang mtha' yab yum 'dod chags srid pa zlog: don grub yab yum phrag dog khong khro zlog: hūm̐: zhi ba yab yum rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis: dug lnga bsgral ba'i khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: ngan 'gror ltung ba'i skye sgo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: byang chub sems dpa' sa snying yab yum brgyad: zhi ba'i tshul dgu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la:
