deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: byang chub sems dpa' sa snying yab yum gyis: ma dag skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' byams pa yab yum gyis: sdug bsngal nad kyis mnar ba bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' kun bzang yab yum gyis: sdug bsngal tshe ring rgan pa bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sem dpa' nam snying yab yum gyis: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal yab yum gyis: ma dag mngal du skye ba bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' spyan gzigs yab yum gyis: sgo ngar skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' sgrib sel yab yum gyis: drod gsher skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' phyag rdor yab yum gyis: mi min 'byung por skye ba'i sdug bsngal zlog: hūm̐: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad brgyad: nyon mongs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: ma dag srid par 'khyams pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: brgya byin la sogs sbyong byed thub pa drug: bslab gsum rnam dag byang sems chas kyis brgyan: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa brgya byin chen po yis: lha ru skye ba'i 'pho ltung sdug bsngal zlog: bcom ldan thub pa thag bzang chen po yis: lha min skye ba'i 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zlog: bcom ldan thub pa shākya seṅge yis: mi ru skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa seṅge rab brtan gyis: dud 'gror skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa kha 'bar sgrom bu yis: yi dwags skye ba'i bkres skom bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa chos kyi rgyal po yis:

dmyal bar skye ba'i btso bsreg sdug bsngal zlog: hūm̐: sdug bsngal skyob pa'i bcom ldan thub pa drug: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: gnas ngan len pa'i skye sgo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rnam par smin sogs rig 'dzin chen po lnga: sgeg bzhad dgyes la mdzes pa'i cha lugs ldan: dag pa rang byung gnas nas skur bzhengs la: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: lha bu bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: phung po bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: nyon mongs bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: 'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bar chad bzlog pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs rigs lnga'i tshogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem yid 'ong lang tsho ldan: mkha' spyod klong nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: chos dbyings sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: me long rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: srog lus dbang thang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: mnyam nyid rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: sor rtog pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: tshe chos snyan grags nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: bya grub las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams pa bzlog tu gsol:

hūm̐: ma sring mkha' 'gro rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis: mkha' dbyings rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi mthun sna tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: badz+ra he ru ka sogs khro bo bzhi: bzhad gshe rngam pa'i dpal gyi chas brgyad brgyan: dur khrod klong yangs 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan rat+na khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: mu stegs zhang zhung byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan pad+ma khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: sde brgyad pho nya'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan karma khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po rigs bzhi 'khor bcas kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: kau rī ma sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: sna tshogs rgyan ldan sgeg pa'i gar stabs can: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: kau rī ma mo tsau ri ma mo yis: dri za grul bum gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: pra mo ha dang bai ta nag mo yis: gshin rje me lha'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: puk+ka sī dang ghasma ljang nag gis: srin po klu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang sme sha mthing nag gis: rlung lha bgegs kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: añdza rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: siṃ ha la sogs phra men brgyad rnams kyis: rngam pa'i skur ston dur khrod bdag mo'i tshul: rab tu rgyu ba me dpung klong nas bzhengs:

dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: siṃ ha smug nag byā gṛ dmar mo yis: gza' dang the'u rang gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: sri la nag mo shwa na mthing nag gis: lha dang lha min gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: kri ta dkar ser kaṅka dmar nag gis: rgyal po gshin rje'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: khā kha nag mo hu lu mthing skya yis: btsan dang klu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: du na rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sgo skyong khro bo khro mo chen po'i tshogs: rngam gshe gtum dang 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: phyogs bzhi rang rang gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed po yab yum gyis: ma mo gnod sbyin gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gyis: bdud dang srin po'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: stag gdong dkar mo phag gdong ser mo yis: gnam thel bar thel sa thel bzlog tu gsol: seng gdong dmar mo sbrul gdong ljang gu yis: gson 'dre pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: khu byug dkar mo ra gdong ser mo yis: 'byung po mi min gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: seng gdong dmar mo sbrul gdong ljang gu yis: sman mo sha za'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sgo skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa yis: pad+ma rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nad gdon bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs skyong 'dul byed srid pa chen po'i bdag: rab khros 'jigs pa'i chas kyis dpa' bar brgyan: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐: dri za 'dul byed me lha 'dul byed kyis: shar dang shar lho'i dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje 'dul byed srin po 'dul byed kyis: lho dang lho nub dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: klu rnams 'dul byed rlung lha 'dul byed kyis: nub dang nub byang dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: gnod sbyin 'dul byed dbang ldan 'dul byed kyis: byang dang byang shar dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: lha rnams 'dul byed sa bdag 'dul byed kyis: steng dang 'og gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: phyogs skyong 'dul byed chen po 'khor bcas kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: gnod byed dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ce spyang chen mo ma mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mi bzad gar bsgyur rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: myur mgyogs rtsal shugs klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: ce spyang seng gdong ce spyang stag gdong gis: lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang gzig mgo ce spyang dom mgo yis: klu dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang spyang mgo ce spyang kang mgo yis: btsan dang rgyal po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang dur bya ce spyang dred mgo yis: bdud dang ma mo 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams kyis: gza' dang gnod sbyin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: hūm̐: ce spyang chen mo ma mo 'khor bcas kyis: byad ma bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi kha rlangs bzlog tu gsol:

rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi bzlog pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra: sku mdog mthing nag rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog 'od kyis 'gengs: dur khrod chas brgyad snang srid zil gyis gnon: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum byad ma ru tra brdzis: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: khro bo rol pa'i gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: phyag bzlog zhal rgyun bzhugs so// // hūm̐/ dpal chen che mchog yab kyi thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan steng du/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /mthing nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad 'bar/ /rtsa zhal mthing dmar shin tu nag po ni/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid g.yo 'gul sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yas gsum dkar nag ljang nag 'khrugs pa ni/ /steng gi lha rnams ma lus dbang du sdud/ /lha yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yon zhal dmar smug sngo zhing 'bar ba ni/ /'og gi sa bdag klu gnyan dbang du sdud/ /klu gnyan dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ /snang srid pho rgyud dbang du sdud par byed/ /pho rgyud byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gnyis pas gri gug 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /lha min dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /lha min byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gsum pas ral gri bsam chod bsnams pa ni/ /bar snang gnyan gyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud/ /gnyan gyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bzhi pas dbyug tho rngam brjid bsnams pa ni/ /ma mo'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /ma mo'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog lnga pas dgra satwa ha chen bsnams pa ni/

/ging chen dmag tshogs ma lus dbang du sdud/ /ging chen byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /drug pas gnam lcags thog chen bsnams pa ni/ /gza' yi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /gza' bdud byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bdun pas tsan dan beng chen bsnams pa ni/ /mgon po'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /mgon po'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog brgyad pas gsal shing rab 'jigs bsnams pa ni/ /the'u rang dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /the'u rang byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung bsnams pa ni/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud par byed/ /ma mo'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gnyis pas bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams pa ni/ /snang srid ma mo dbang du sdud par byed/ ma mo'i khrag nad sdang ba'i dgra la zlog gsum pas 'gugs byed lcags kyu bsnams pa ni/ /bdud kyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /bdud kyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bzhi pas sdom byed lcags sgrog bsnams pa ni/ /btsan gyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /btsan gyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /lnga pas tsit+ta snying sgrom bsnams pa ni/ /sa bdag klu gnyan dbang du sdud par byed/ /klu yi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /drug pas zhags pa nag po bsnams pa ni/ /rgyal po'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /rgyal po'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bdun pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ /gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /gnod sbyin byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /brgyad pas sog le ngar chen bsnams pa ni/ /bgegs kyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /bgegs kyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba ni/ khams gsum srid gsum g.yo zhing 'gul bar byed/ /snang srid byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa ni/

/gdong sder rwa mchu lto 'gros ltas ngan bsgral/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa ni/ /gza' dang rgyu skar dbang du sdud par byed/ /gza' skar byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid pa ni/ /dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du sdud par byed/ /ru tra'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khyud/ /snang srid ma mo dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i sun kha dgra la zlog hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la/ /rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces pa 'di'ang gter gzhung nas kher thub cig mi 'dug pas gsang sngags dar rgyas kyi ngor/ gnubs sprul rtsa gsum gling pas so// hūm̐: khrag 'thung chen po rigs bzhi he ru kaḥ dpal gyi chas ldan hūm̐ dang phaṭ sgra sgrogs: dur khrod lhun grub bde chen gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: shar gyi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: pho rgyud khro bo'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: lho yi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: nub kyi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: yi dam yongs kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: byang gi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: chos skyong dam can dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rigs bzhi khro bo khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dam nyams bsgral ba'i klad khrag 'di bzhes la: snang srid yongs kyi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen khro bcu 'bar ba lha yi tshogs: dur khrod chas ldan sha khrag snying la dgyes: rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal rang rang gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: khro bo chen po hūm̐ kar yab yum gyis: rgya gar yi ge'i dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen rnam par rgyal ba yab yum gyis: rgya nag bsgyur gto byed pa dgra la zlog: khro chen dbyug pa sngon po yab yum gyis: zhang zhung ju thig dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen gshin rje gshed po yab yum gyis: me nyag tsa dur 'bod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen mi g.yo mgon po yab yum gyis: sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: khro chen rta mgrin rgyal po yab yum gyis: stag gzig zor mda' zug pa dgra la zlog: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gyis: snang srid dal kha dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po yab yum gyis: li yi spar sme gdan bgos dgra la zlog: khro chen khams gsum rgyal ba yab yum gyis: ban bon sngags pa'i zor mda' dgra la zlog: khro bo chen po stobs chen yab yum gyis: skyes pa'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor zlog: hūm̐: ye shes khro bcu 'khor dang bcas pa yis: log 'dren bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: snang srid yongs kyi byad zor bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: phra men chen mo khra thabs phur 'debs tshogs: za byed gsod byed rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'byung ba 'khrug pa yul lha'i ltas: phur 'debs phag mgo can gyis zlog: gnam la sprin dmar lo nyes ltas: phur 'debs rmigs bu mgo yis zlog: sa gzhi g.yo 'gul dus 'khrugs ltas: phur 'debs stag mgo can gyis zlog: bya dkar sder 'dzing ye 'drog ltas: phur 'debs bya rgod mgo yis zlog: glag nag sder 'dzing ya bdud ltas: phur 'debs g.yag mgos bzlog tu gsol: dur byas bshugs glu dur sri'i ltas:

phur 'debs bya rog mgo yis zlog: sreg pa khyim zhugs 'dre srin ltas: phur 'debs shwa ba mgo yis zlog: chu glang rkan sgra ma bdud ltas: phur 'debs 'ug pa mgo yis zlog: 'ug pa nyin dgod srin po'i ltas: phur 'debs gzig mgo can gyis zlog: lcung khra khyim zhugs gnyan gyi ltas: phur 'debs khwa ta mgo yis zlog: bya rog sha 'thab god kha'i ltas: phur 'debs byi la mgo yis zlog: shwa pho ru 'dzing gnam lha'i ltas: phur 'debs pu shud mgo yis zlog: khang par bya than khyim phung ltas: phur 'debs spyang ki mgo yis zlog: brag dmar gla ro brag srin ltas: phur 'debs chen mo khra mgos zlog: spang dkar dgo ro gangs btsan ltas: phur 'debs seṅge mgo yis zlog: kha sha 'thab rgyug btsan rgod ltas: phur 'debs pha waṃ mgo yis zlog: gtsod pho ru 'dzing 'brog srin ltas: phur 'debs dom mgo can gyis zlog: srod la wa brgyal mo 'dre'i ltas: phur 'debs sre mong mgo yis zlog: sre mong byi ro chung sri'i ltas: phur 'debs chen mo dred mgos zlog: khu ling khyim zhugs shi chad ltas: phur 'debs byi la mgo yis zlog: hūm̐: phur 'debs chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa yis: ltas ngan bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: mi rung sna tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad tshogs: mi bzad gtum zhing gdug pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: rtsub 'gyur me ri 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nya mo rnga 'dzing klu bdud ltas: srin mo g.yag gdong ma yis zlog: sbal pa sder 'dzing sa bdag ltas: tshangs pa sbrul gdong ma yis zlog: sbal sbrul 'thab pa gnyan gyi ltas: lha chen gzig gdong ma yis zlog: sbrul gyi byi za klu srin ltas: rtog 'dod sre mong gdong gis zlog: bal khur byi tshang ma bdud ltas:

gzhon nu dred gdong ma yis zlog: stag dong sbrang tshang pho lha'i ltas: brgya byin dom mgo ma yis zlog: srod la bya 'tsher shi bla'i ltas: rdo rje pha waṃ gdong gis zlog: tho rangs khyi ngu grong rgyun ltas: zhi ba chu srin gdong gis zlog: khang pa tshag sgra dpe dkar ltas: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ma yis zlog: sgo them khyis slog the'u rang ltas: zla ba khra gdong ma yis zlog: gong shing chag pa na tsha'i ltas: be con wa gdong ma yis zlog: chon thag rgyug pa btsan shwa'i ltas: srin mo stag gdong ma yis zlog: khyim nang 'od 'khyil brgya byin ltas: za ba rgod mgo ma yis zlog: sprel gyis gla zhon dge bsnyen ltas: dga' ba rta gdong ma yis zlog: rta drel rngog 'cha' mtshon 'khrugs ltas: stobs chen khyung gdong ma yis zlog: gnam rdo lhung ba dmu yi ltas: srin mo khyi gdong ma yis zlog: 'o bshigs mar med sman mo'i ltas: 'dod pa pu shud gdong gis zlog: 'o ma khrag babs gshin rje'i ltas: nor srung shwa mgo ma yis zlog: yos 'thag ram phye sde brgyad ltas: rlung lha spyang gdong ma yis zlog: 'od khyim 'khyil ba byad kha'i ltas: mi mo skyin mgo ma yis zlog: me 'bud ran 'khor mgar nag ltas: phag mo phag gdong ma yis zlog: sbra la gzugs brnyan god kha'i ltas: dga' byed glang chen gdong gis zlog: rtsigs par bung tshang sgo stong ltas: ba glang gdong gis bzlog tu gsol: gzugs med ku sgra yul 'dre'i ltas: chu lha sbrul gdong ljang gus zlog: hūm̐: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor bcas kyis: ma rungs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan brgyad cu bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐/ dpal chen pho brang sgo skyong las byed bzhi/ /rang rtags phyag rgya rngam pa'i skur ston ma/ /las bzhi lhun grub gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/

hūm̐/ shar sgo skyong byed pu shud mgo can gyis/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /lho sgo skyong byed skya ga'i mgo can gyis/ /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /nub sgo skyong byed srin bya'i mgo can gyis/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /byang sgo skyong byed khra yi mgo can gyis/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog hūm̐/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgo ma rigs bzhi yis/ /sgab 'dre bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la/ /skal med the tshom log lta bdud rigs zlog/ // hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan ma mo bcu gnyis tshogs: za gsod dbugs la rngam zhing nga ro sgrogs: shin tu 'jigs pa'i dug rlangs dbus nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes shig: deng 'dir zlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thog ser 'bebs rmis byad kha'i ltas: shwa na mthing nag ma mos zlog: ri nyil rmis pa yul lha'i ltas: shwa na dmar nag ma mos zlog: btson la 'jug rmis mthu yi ltas: shwa na ser nag ma mos zlog: bud med ngu rmis ma mo'i ltas: shwa na sngo nag ma mos zlog: nag mo ded rmis srin mo'i ltas: mthing nag re ma ti yis zlog: drel zhon rmis pa lha mo'i ltas: ser nag re ma dza yis zlog: bong zhon rmis pa ma mo'i ltas: dmar nag re ma dzu yis zlog: lha khang mang rmis ber nag ltas: ljang nag re ma bh+yo yis zlog: gcer bu byis pa the'u rang ltas: ma mo ya byin ma yis zlog: mun nag 'thib rmis grib kyi ltas: ma mo de byin ma yis zlog: mya ngan mang rmis na ba'i ltas: ma mo bswe byin ma yis zlog: thur du 'gro rmis ngan 'gro'i ltas: ma mo phag byin ma yis zlog: hūm̐: bka' skyong ma mo bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: ma rungs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: rmis ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan ging chen bcu gnyis tshogs:

sha khrag srog la rngam zhing stong khams nyul: me rlung khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dud 'gro mgo gsum klu bdud ltas: ging chen dkar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro zo lag ma mo'i ltas: ging chen ser pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro rgyu bshal btsan 'gong ltas: ging chen dmar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro rkang brgyad gnod sbyin ltas: ging chen nag pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro kha bzhi brag btsan ltas: shar bdud dkar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mig dgu gza' yi ltas: lho bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro lto sbyor gshin rje'i ltas: nub bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro 'phrag ral byad kha'i ltas: byang bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: bya mchu ltag kha gnod sbyin than: shar btsan bshan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro sgal 'byar phung bdud than: lho btsan shan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mig med dmu yi than: nub btsan bshan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mche can srin po'i than: byang btsan shan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro chad lhag mi sdug than: yang 'khor sprul pas bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sde dpon bshan pa myur mgyogs bcu gnyis tshogs: than ltas bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: than dang ltas ngan sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ༈

gnyis pa rtsang bzlog gtong ba ni/ mdos la rak+tas bran la sha chen gyi dud pa bdug: rol mo 'ur rdung dang mā ra ya yi rngam stabs bya: rkang gling gtong : rang nyid dpal chen gyi nga rgyal dang bcas rngam bzlog bya'o: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dur khrod e yi klong : rab 'jigs bshan pa 'tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: baṃ ri keng rus khrag mtsho'i gdan la bzhugs: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: myur mgyogs las la bskul phyir gnas nas bzhengs: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gnyis pa rtsang gi 'byung khungs bstan pa ni: hūm̐: dang po rab 'jigs rtsang phur gang nas byung : las mkhan rtsang phur mu stegs yul nas byung : zhang zhung nag po rlung 'khor bya ba ru: gdug rtsub 'jig rten dregs pa 'tshogs pa yis: kha di ra dang ha ri dra zhes dang : tsan+da a nu bha wa la sogs pa: mu stegs shwa shwa ra yi bla shing skyes: nyin mo gdug pa'i na bun sngo dmar 'khrigs: mtshan mo me 'bar mi min 'byung po 'tshogs: skabs su 'gyu bas 'jig rten kun la 'tshe: mi rung bar gcod sna tshogs brtsams pa'i tshe: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ras: dam can the'u rang sde gsum las la bskul: gnam lcags dbal gyi dgra satwa kha che brdungs: mi gtsang khrag sna dgu yis ngar yang btab: bshan pa bdud kyi dmag tshogs pho nyar rbad: rigs ngan nag po shan pa gcer bu yis: gdug pa'i shing la satwa re phyogs bzhir brgyab: shar du yo bas mi sdug skad ngan sgrog: lho ru 'gyel bas 'o dod gnam du ldir: nub tu gshags pas rak+ta'i rlabs chen babs: byang du bzhogs pas ngan sngags rang sgra sgrog: dbus su bsgrigs shing rak+ta'i rtsi yang btab: lhag ma'i khrag de gling bzhir gtor ba las: mi sdug drag po'i shing sna dpag med gyur: drag po'i rtsang phur khrag 'thung phyag tu phul:

hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ras: mu stegs tha nag can gyi thod pa ru: drag rdzas dgu la dmar nag gtor ma bzos: rtse mor ru tra'i snying gi rgyal mtshan btsugs: mtha' rnams bshan pa phur bu rtsang gis bskor: las mkhan pho nya bzhugs par mnga' gsol nas: zlog sngags dmod pa reg chod btab pa'i tshe: mu stegs 'byung po'i dmag tshogs brgyal zhing reng : bsam chod bshan pa rtsang phur de nas byung : de ltar sngon gyi rtsang phur rtags mngon bzhin: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: rkyen ngan bar chad rtsang gis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rno dbal gdug pa drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: rtse mor dmar nag me ri wa la la: sked pa rgya mdud rlung dmar 'u ru ru: rtsa bar bskal pa'i mun nag thibs se thib: khro bo khro mo rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: ma rungs ban bon byad kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtse gnam lcags zur gsum gyen du gzengs: sked pa gru bzhi thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs: rtsa bar rak+ta'i rba rlabs chi li li: chos skyong dam can tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: chag che nyam nga rtsang gis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtse gti mug sprin nag kyi li li: sked par nga rgyal ser ba sha ra ra: rtsa bar gnam lcags thog rgod zi ra 'khyugs: las mkhan srog la rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: pha rol dmag dpung g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser shwa na ma mo sprin ltar gtibs: sked par re ti ma mo glog ltar 'khyugs: rtsa bar ya byin de byin rlung ltar 'tshubs: srog bdag ma mo 'tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: dmag 'khrugs lo nyes yams nad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser sgrol ging gri thogs zengs se zeng :

sked par srog bdud zhags pa na ra ra: rtsa bar btsan rgod bshan pa rengs se reng : pho nya las la 'tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser srin byas ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : sked par 'dre byas gshog 'gyur lings se ling : rtsa bar bdud byas skad ngan congs se cong : dgra la than ltas 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: mi rung than ltas sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser rnga mong khyung zhon nyi li li: sked par wa la sprel zhon zhums se zhum: rtsa bar 'dre mo bong zhon tshubs se tshub: dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: shar gyi rtsang phur a nu bha wa'i shing : dgra bgegs zhi ba'i rtsang phur 'tshub ma ris: ma rungs gdug pa zhi bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su bh+yo bzlog rbad bskul sngags kyis brgyan: mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: shar dang shar lho'i dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: lho yi rtsang phur ha ri dra la'i shing : mthu rtsal rgyas pa'i rtsang phur gar stabs 'gros: nus stobs gzi brjid rgyas par mnga' gsol nas: logs su khram bh+yo raṃ bh+yo sngags kyis brgyan: shwa khram char ltar 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: lho dang lho nub dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: nub kyi rtsang phur kha di ra yi shing : snang srid dbang sdud rtsang phur srin mo 'gros: las bskul byad ma tshar gcod mnga' gsol nas: logs su ma bh+yo dza thun sngags kyis brgyan: yams nad me ltar 'bar ba'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: nub dang nub byang dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog:

hūm̐: byang gi rtsang phur tsan+da dan+ḍa'i shing : dgra bgegs tshar gcod rtsang phur phur bu'i 'gros: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su e thun rbad bh+yo'i sngags kyis brgyan: spu gri dmar nag 'khor lo'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: byang dang byang shar dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: dbus kyi rtsang phur dz+wa la ka la'i shing : srung zlog rtsang phur mig mang drwa ba ris: dug lnga bdud bzhi bcom par mnga' gsol nas: logs su ya bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭ sngags kyis brgyan: drag sngags me dpung 'bar ba'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: steng 'og phyogs mtshams dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: lcags ri'i rtsang phur dzī bī tshin+dha'i shing : dgra bgegs dpung 'joms rtsang phur dmag g.yos tshul: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog par mnga' gsol nas: logs su thun bh+yo raṃ bh+yo sngags kyis brgyan: gzer nad snying rlung drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: mtha' 'khob bdud rigs dmag dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: zor bzlog rtsang phur ya ma tsit+ta'i shing : brlag bcom bsregs gtor rtsang phur spu gri ris: gnag pa'i byad ma sgrol bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su nṛ tri mā ra'i sngags kyis brgyan: gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: drag po'i pho nya bshan pa rtsang gi dmag: rno dbal mtshon cha sna tshogs zengs se zeng : gnam lcags rdo rje'i go khrab si li li: rdzu 'phrul rlung rta 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: dgra bo'i snying gzir zor rdzas sha ra ra: dgra la cho 'phrul ltas ngan nyi li li: chos shig rtsang phur bshan pa dmag la chos: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dpung tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang phur drag pos dgra sha ljib ljib za:

rtsang phur dgra bo'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur dgra bo'i rus 'cha' krigs se krig: rtsang phur myur mgyogs gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur bshan pa las byed khyugs se khyug: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu sgrub dgra la zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hom sbar dgra la zlog: zor kha rlung kha thams cad dgra la zlog: gtad khram ngag mnan thams cad dgra la zlog: mi kha phung sbyor thams cad dgra la zlog: tshe zad za 'grangs thebs pa dgra la zlog: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna dgra la zlog: mi rung than ltas sna dgu dgra la zlog: rkyen kha glo bur langs pa dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: spar sme dbang thang nyams pa dgra la zlog: dur sgo gshed sgo ral ba dgra la zlog: gri kha mtshon kha langs pa dgra la zlog: bsod nams sa bcud nyams pa dgra la zlog: lo skag zla skag zhag skag dgra la zlog: nad skag 'chi bdag ngan pa dgra la zlog: tshes grangs gza' skar ngan pa dgra la zlog: ma rungs bkra mi shis pa dgra la zlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya: ma tri rak+sha ya ma sha trum a mu ka tsit+ta nan: ru tra mā ra dzi bī tshin+dha tshin+dha bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: man+t+ra du nan bh+yo zlog: yaṇ+ṭa du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ti du nan bh+yo zlog: ru tra du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya du nan bh+yo zlog: rbad tshal pa sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: myog ti rmug ti sa ma ya zlog: smi sha ku ru sa ma ya zlog: tsit+ta rbad 'gas sa ma ya zlog: badz+ra ya tri ya tri zlog: ni lam bha ra zlog: dri mi hā re zlog: ma rtsa du tri zlog: sha ri hā ri zlog: khrag ti ya ma zlog: tsit+ta thum ril zlog: nā ga kha ra zlog: ya ma gzer nan zlog:

rak+sha trig nan zlog: yak+sha taṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra e thum zlog: ra tsa du ru zlog: khaṃ maṃ baṃ shag zlog: dmod pa'i rig sngags thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo zlog: sarba a mu kā tad+ya thā mā ra ya: e hur thum rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces spu gri nyer bdun gyi sngags kyang mang du bzlas te thal mo brdab kyang rung*/ ༈ gsum pa mdos rgyan dar tshon sna lnga'i bzlog pa ni/ bzlog pa'i mdun du rin chen brdar phye'i gser skyems kyis skabs su mchod/ dang po ye nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: ma 'gag dbyings kyi pho brang nas: skye med rang byung shar ba'i lha: gnyis med zhi ba rdo rje dbyings: rab khros khro bo ma lus dang : sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs 'dus bcas: kun kyang chos sku'i rol rtsal phyir: mngon spyod phrin las bsgrub pa'i slad: rang bzhin dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: phrin las dgongs phyir gshegs su gsol: mdzes pa'i rdzas dang dgyes pa'i phud: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: spyan gzigs dar gyis thugs dam bskul: brtan dang g.yo bas khyab pa yis: rang bzhin bsdus pa'i phrin las bcol: deng 'dir srid pa'i 'byung ba rnams: dmod de las su bskul bar 'tshal: de nas gser skyems sbreng ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas mkha' dbyings lhun gyis grub: chags med chags bral dang po'i don: stong gsal sgyu 'phrul rtsal snang las: ye shes rol pa'i 'khor lor shar: snang srid khams lnga so sor grub: kha dog brjod du ma nges kyang : kha dog dar tshon sna lnga bzhin: srid pa dang po nas gzhal ba'i: grangs med rnams kyi 'du tshan las: gcig brten gnyis su chags pa'i tshul: de yi brda la brten pa yi: deng 'dir phrin las dus la bab: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: zhi gar khro bo rol pa'i tshogs: rang bzhin mngon spyod mdzad du gsol: hūm̐:

yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ gnyis med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: rgyas 'debs yum dang khro bo bcu: phur 'debs nyi shu la sogs te: pho nya ging bdud nyer bzhi rnams: dgyes pa'i rdzas dang bzlog pa'i las: sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul ba dang : mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs su gsol: hūm̐: dang po ci yang mi snang rung : gnyis snang phra mor 'dzin pa la: las dang ye shes dbang gyur nas: kha dog rnam par grub pa ltar: dpe yi las su brda mtshon las: snang srid thig le'i rol rtsal shar: ma 'gag de bzhin cir snang ba: yang dag sngon gyi dgongs pa las: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: gzhi ni ma skyes mdog mi 'gyur: de yi mtshon pa'i las byed phyir: dpal chen pho brang rtse mo ru: mthing nag dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: sngon tshe chos dbyings ngang gis lha: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mthing nag dar gyi gdugs phub pas: zhi ba'i lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: ka dag ye shes sgom pa la: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags bdud: nyon mongs 'khri bas bcings pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: dge bcu'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: rtse la dug gsum gcod pa'i mtshon: 'bar ba'i stobs bcu khro bo'i lha: dgyes pa khrag 'thung 'khor bcas kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rtse gsum mtshon cha gzengs pa yis: khrag 'thung lha tshogs mnyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: smon lam log pa'i 'dre bdud rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: kun slong bdag 'dzin zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: mthing nag dar gyi cod pan brgyan: dbus kyi lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: rang byung ye shes sgrub pa la: dug lnga'i mun pa gtibs pa rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog:

rang rig mngon gyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang shar gyi rtse mo ru: dkar po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: dngul gyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe me long ngang gis lha: shar phyogs zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'jigs brgyad zhi bar brtsam pa la: ma rig lha yi bdud rnams dang : nyon mongs zhe sdang las gyur pa: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: mi mthun bgegs tshogs zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang lho yi rtse mo ru: ser po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: gser gyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe mnyam nyid ngang gis lha: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rin chen mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: tshe bsod rgyas par brtsam pa la: bdag 'dzin phung po'i bdud rnams dang : nyon mongs nga rgyal las gyur pa: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: tshe bsod bar gcod zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang nub kyi rtse mo ru: dmar po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: zangs kyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe sor rtog ngang gis lha: nub phyogs dbang gi lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pad+mas mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: dbang gi las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dbang sdud las kun brtsam pa la: bag chags nyon mongs bdud rnams dang : 'dod pa de la chags pa rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: bdag 'dzin 'ching brgyad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang byang gi rtse mo ru: ljang gu dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: mthing gi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe bya grub ngang gis lha: byang phyogs drag po'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

ral gris mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: drag po'i las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dgra bgegs bsgral bar brtsam pa la: 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde tshogs dang : sdang sems phrag dog 'dzin pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: bstan dgra sgos dgra zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: rang byung kha dog lnga yi dar: dang po chos kyi dbyings su grub: nyon mongs zhi bar brtsam pa la: ye shes lnga yi kha dog shar: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa yis: de la srid pa'i gos dar grub: tshangs pa lha yi rgyan spyod bzhin: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du: legs par bkra bas mdzes pa 'dis: dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: ma rungs bdud srin bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen khro bo'i pho brang gi: rtse mor kha ṭ+wāṃ brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs bar chod bzlog tu gsol: mthing nag dar gyi rgyal mtshan gyis: bar phyogs dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: ye shes gsal ba'i me long gis: 'og phyogs bgegs srin bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan rtse gsum 'chang ba yis: mtshams kyi byur 'dre bzlog tu gsol: a nu bha wa'i srog shing gis: ma rungs sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang shar phyogs kyi: rtse mor rdo rjes mtshan pa yis: dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs dkar pos brgyan pa yis: grul bum gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan dkar po rtse gsum gyis: lha yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dz+wa la ka yi srog shing gis: btsan gyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang lho phyogs kyi: rtse mor rin chen mtshan pa yis: me lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs ser pos brgyan pa yis: gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan ser po rtse gsum gyis: rgyal po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ha ri dra yi srog shing gis: srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol:

hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang nub phyogs kyi: rtse mor pad+mas mtshan pa yis: klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs dmar pos brgyan pa yis: ma mo'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan dmar po rtse gsum gyis: rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: kha di ra yi srog shing gis: gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang byang phyogs kyi: rtse mor ral gris mtshan pa yis: gza' yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs ljang gus brgyan pa yis: dbang ldan gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan ljang gu rtse gsum gyis: bdud kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: tsan+da dan+ḍa'i srog shing gis: bgegs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dkar po dngul gyi me long gis: shar phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ser po gser gyi me long gis: lho phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dmar po zangs kyi me long gis: nub phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: sngon po mthing gi me long gis: byang phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bzlog go bsgyur ro phrin las mdzod: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: bar nas bdud kyis 'bod pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: mtshams nas gri sri langs pa zlog: lo dgra gshed bzhi langs pa zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skag dang phung sri langs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: mi rung bkra mi shis pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog: god kha gyod byur ngan pa zlog: than ltas rmi lam ngan pa zlog: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du na e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces gser skyems yongs rdzogs lhag med gong gi mtshams nas 'bul bar bya: ༈ yang phur gtor zlog grangs mang gsog skabs rgyas pa mi lcogs par 'di ltar bya ste/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbang phyug bcas/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs/ /phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra mu stegs ngan sngags dang*/ /ban bon byad zor mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la log 'dren zhing bcu'i rigs/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /lo zla spar sme rlung rta'i skag chen sogs/ /dus min 'chi ba'i skag rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /dar sri phung sri na sri 'chi sri dang*/ /god sri dgra gyod sri rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /nad rims dal yams rmi ltas pra rtags ngan/ /mi 'dod than ltas thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bar mtshams nas/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ e ka du nan zlog ya ma du nan zlog rā dza rbad nan zlog yak+sha rbad nan zlog ma tri bh+yo nan zlog du ru du nan ya zlog ha la tsakra ya zlog rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yoḥya zlog bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog /bzlog bzlog / ces stong bzlog grangs bsog cheda.ā yu'i ming gis so/ ༈ stong bzlog grangs gsog bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhi med rtsa bral don gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rang byung rig pa yang dag he ru kaḥ rig rtsal dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /bsal bzhag bral ba'i dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /mtshan 'dzin rnam rtog bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes/

/gnyis snang 'khrul pa ka dag dbyings su zlog /dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ye shes lnga ru bsgyur/ /rig pa phur bu chos zad gdod ma'i klong*/ /ye grol chos sku'i gtan srid zin gyur cig / bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis nub phyogs a ri'i khul gsang sngags gling du bgyis pa'o// hūm̐/ sku gsum phur bu'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dug gsum bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /srid gsum 'khrul pa ka dag dbyings su zlog khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprug las mdzod cig / ces pa'ang gu h+yas so/ grangs bsags zin pa dang dmar nag gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs te/ mtha' nas rim bzhin zor bskor re re bzhin mthar 'don tshig rdzogs pa dang slob dpon nas 'phen pa phyag len yin/ hūm̐ dzaḥ pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'khor tshogs pho nya'i rbod gtong yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu gtad yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hom sbar yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: rgya gar rgya nag bsgyur gto rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yi byad zor yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi gnod pa yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha rtsub pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: byad kha phur kha bskrad gzir rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: na sri 'chi sri dur sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: god sri phung sri gyod sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog:

gleng gzhi'i mi kha gtam ngan rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: tshe nyams dbang thang rgud pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: dgra sgo gyod sgo bye ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: gri sri mtshon sri langs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: ma nyes las kyi kha yog rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: lo bcud 'bras bu nyams pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'gong po'i za kha rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: god 'dre dbul sri bse rag rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: chung sri rmug 'dre lan chags rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: sgab 'dre rgyal 'gong 'byung po rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi min 'byung po'i cho 'phrul rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: rmi ltas pra rtags ngan pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: na tsha 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi min 'byung po'i cho 'phrul rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: pho nyas bla tshe rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: than dang ltas ngan thams cad kyang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: bar chod glo bur ye 'drog rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi rung mi 'dod thams cad kyang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ro mā ra ya: ru tra nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thuṃ bh+yoḥ ru tra ya ma tsit+ta srog la rbad: ru tra mā ra bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭḥ ru tra gzer thuṃ bi gh+nā na trig nan zlog: ru tra kha thaṃ myog nan tri tri zlog: ru tra hur thuṃ sham lang pur thuṃ zlog: ru tra thun dza dzī bi rbad nan zlog: ru tra shag 'gas hu lu khroṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra kā wāka tsit+ta myag thuṃ zlog: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog mā ra ya rbad nan nan: zhes zlog sngags lan dgu las ma nyung bar bzlas shing thal mo brdab:

hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnam nas thog rgod lhung ba zlog: sa nas dug gzer langs pa zlog: bar nas dgra sdang 'gyu ba zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa zlog: mtshams nas byur 'dre langs pa zlog: mi kha phung sbyor ngan pa zlog: phug gi lha la gnod pa zlog: bar gyi mi la gnod pa zlog: sgo yi nor la gnod pa zlog: mchan gyi bu la gnod pa zlog: gtan gyi grogs la gnod pa zlog: yul mkhar zhing la gnod pa zlog: srid dang g.yang la gnod pa zlog: mi 'dod rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha ngan pa zlog: sme ba klung rta nyams pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du nan zlog: ya ma du nan zlog: ra tsa du nan zlog: yak+sha rbad nan zlog: ma tri bh+yo nan zlog: du ru du nan ya zlog: ha la tsakra ya zlog: rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: bzlog bzlog: ces zlog sngags lan gsum mam bdun bklag go khyad par byad stems than dang ltas ngan la sogs gang byung la dmigs gtad bcas te bzlog pa bya'o/ phyi thun la zlog dmigs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru ka: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog:

ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas la chos skyong gi phrin bcol bya/ chad tho 'bul/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro brdung*/ mchod bstod bya/ bshags pa brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang*/ bkra shis brjod/ bsngo smon sogs rgyun gyi go rim yin no/ ༈ de nas nyin tha ma gtor rdzong nyin par/ bzlog pa yan gong ltar song nas bzlog pa'i mtshams su/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: ces bzlog mchod rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces bstod/ yul phyogs 'gar bzlog dbang zhu srol yod pa ltar bya na skabs 'dir byas na legs par mngon/ de'ang rtsa sngags sham dngos grub sngags sbyar bas chog par sems so/ skabs 'dir mdun bskyed lha tshogs thugs dam drag tu bskul pa bya ba ni/ drag rol brdung*/ dar nag g.yab/ gtor ma bshams la/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi mtha': ma rungs gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar nas: gsang sngags bstan la bdud kyi 'tshe lags pas: khro rgyal chen pos mngon spyod mi mdzad na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin yi chad mi 'gyur ram: gsang sngags gnyan la 'bras bu cang med dam: yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas ma dgyes sam: phyag rgya sngags kyi nus pa nyams lags sam: rig 'dzin gong mas thugs kyis mi khrel lam:

de bas dpal chen lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: log 'dren bar chad rtsom pa'i 'byung po la: dpal chen mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar phob: bsgral zhing bzhes nas ming shul med par mdzod: hūm̐: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ sems dpa' sems ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ thub drug sgo bzhi'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ye shes khro bcu'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ kau sing ma mo'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug sgo ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ce spyang la sogs srung ma las la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bzlog drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi las la bh+yoḥ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa'i phra men khra thabs las la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad las la bh+yoḥ sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi las la bh+yoḥ pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis las la bh+yoḥ ging chen bdud po sde brgyad las la bh+yoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra pra bha swa ra ma hā karma tso dā na kī la rak+sha lak+ṣa sri ka nā na a mu ka ru tra mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gser skyems gtong ba'i rim pa ni: shin tu gtsang ba'i gzhi steng du: sngon mo nas 'bras tshom bu bkod: de dbus rin chen snod mchog dang : dza gad gser skyems legs par bsham: rmad byung zan gyi ril bu bsgril: gtsang ma'i phud phor nang du spung : dkar gtor bsngo zhing gser skyems bya: gsungs pas rang lugs gsang ba zil gnon dkar gtor dang sde brgyad gser skyems btang la rngam pa'i rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: nga ni yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nga ni khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ra: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung : nga ni 'jam dpal rdo rje grub pa rtsal: nga ni drag po gnam lcags thog rgod rtsal: nga yi bka' la snang srid kun gyis nyon: don gnyis dkon mchog bka' la legs par soms: ye shes dbyings kyis mi khyab gang yang med: rnam shes rlung gis mi zin gang yang med: sgra gcan zom du mi gnas gang yang med: rang bzhin 'byung lngas ma bsdus gang yang med: tshogs drug 'dod yon mi zhen gang yang med: chos sku'i zil gyis mi non gang yang med: thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi zin gang yang med: ka dag snying pos mi gsal gang yang med: 'khor 'das sangs rgyas mi dmigs gang yang med: rnam rtog chos skur ma skyes gang yang med: lha 'dre sems su ma grub gang yang med: bsdu bya stong par ma gyur gang yang med: bzang ngan rgyu 'bras ma gtogs gang yang med: cho 'phrul bden par gnas pa gang yang med: sde brgyad mtshan mar grub pa gang yang med: steng 'og phyogs bcu ris su phyes pa med: ye shes 'jig rten gnas la nges pa med: kun rdzob thugs rje'i las la mtha' dbus med: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i mkha' la yangs dog med: zhi khro'i lha tshogs don la skye 'chi med: yang dag che mchog bka' la 'gyur ldog med: dmod pa'i las kyi zor 'di phyir mi ldog: de bas ye shes 'jig rten tshogs rnams kun: chos nyid rgyu 'bras bden pa'i tshig la nyon: deng nas tha mal zhen pa bcom pa'i phyir: rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i zor chen 'di: phyogs med phyogs bcur bar mtshams dgra la 'phen: gzugs med lha 'dre kun la 'phog srid pas: rtog med dbu chum 'dzin med zhabs skums shig: mdun du yod pa g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzur: gal te zor 'phros sku la reg srid na: bdag ni ma nyes dam nyams dgra bo nyes:

dgra bgegs ma sdang bdag gis zor 'phen ci: de bas ngan lan dam nyams dgra la phob: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir myur mgyogs zor sna dgra la drongs: mthu ldan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: thogs med drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: steng phyogs mkha' spyod 'og phyogs sa spyod la: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dpal chen dbyings kyi lha tshogs ma lus kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs dang ni shar lho'i mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: dri za me lha la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho phyogs dang ni lho nub mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: gshin rje srin po la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub phyogs dang ni nub byang mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: klu dbang rlung lha la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs dang ni byang shar mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: gnod sbyin dbang ldan la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐: lo zla zhag dus chu tshod la: gnas pa'i gza' skar 'gyu ba dang : sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus pa: gdong la gnas pa'i dregs can rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: g.yas g.yon phyogs su sku bzur 'tshal: bdag ni ma lan snyan gsan tshig: gal te lan par byung gyur na: la yog dam nyams dgra la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces gser skyems phyogs bcur gtong : de nas sgo dbye ba ni: phyogs kyi sgo chas thogs la gser skyems mchod cing : hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang shar phyogs gling : bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod sa gzhi khrag mtsho 'khyil: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: srin mo zangs mche pu shud mgo: lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dngul sgo dkar po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang lho phyogs gling : srin po'i thod pa brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod mun pa sprin ltar gtibs: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: gshin rje ma mo skya ga'i mgo: zhags pas mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang nub phyogs gling : ru tra'i bhan+dha brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod me ri smug nag 'khrigs: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: bshan pa ma mo srin bya'i mgo: lcags sgrog mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang byang phyogs gling : 'byung po'i bhan+dha brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: las kyi ma mo khra yi mgo: dril bus mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs lcags sgo nag po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod:

de nas nang sgo dbye/ za lam srin mo'i bzlog pa ni: dang po byin gyis lan gsum brlab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ stong pa'i ngang las gnam lcags 'khor yug steng : de dbus dmar chen gtor ma khro mo'i mkhar: phyi ni mtshon cha nang ni thod pa'i dal: de dbus ma mo 'khor bcas gsal bar gyur: oṃ rak+mo ma tri bh+yo bh+yo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sa mā ya dzaḥ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo 'khor dang bcas pas rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ces gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs te rak+tas bran: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: zangs ri zangs thang dmar po rngam la 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sha za srog bdud las kyi ma mo chen po bzhugs pa ni: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i gzugs 'chang ma mo 'bum gyis bskor: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin zhing zangs mche dmar po gtsigs: mdos zor stong gi sna 'dren mdzad cing dgra dpung phye mar rlog: srog bdag stong gi gtso mos dgra la dmag dpung zor sna drongs: deng 'dir ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo shugs 'chang rdo rje mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang rin chen mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang pad+ma mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang las kyi mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes:

deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+mo ma tri rak+sha ya dgra la zlog: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang mtshams bzhi mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+mo ma tri rak+sha ya dgra la zlog: de nas zor btegs la bzlog pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad kun: bkug cing bsgral nas lhag ma med par bzhes: zor mda' dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la rgyob: dus la bab bo ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: phyogs skyong yongs kyi sun ma zlog: ma mo yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sha za sman mo'i sun ma zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur ro mā ra ya: ma tri ma mo ya tri zlog: zor ltar 'phen na: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: steng 'og phyogs bcu yi: dgra bgegs cham la phob: khro bo khro mo yi: drag sngags dgra la zlog: snang srid sde brgyad kyi: byad kha dgra la zlog: phyogs skyong bcu po yi: bsam sbyor dgra la zlog: ban bon sngags pa yi: phur kha dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug lo nyes kyi: chad pa dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba yi: phur kha dgra la zlog: lo zla zhag dus kyi: skag rigs dgra la zlog: mi kha dmod tshig gi: sdang sems dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan tshogs: bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

zor bh+yo ya: rbad bh+yo yaḥ raṃ bh+yo ya: dā bh+yo ya: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma mo dgra la chos: sha za dgra la chos: zor mda' dgra la ya: dgra srog myur du chod: raṃ zor ya: bh+yo zor ya: rbad zor ya: mā ra ya bzlog ya: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: 'di nyid snang srid kun gyi bdag mo phyir: bzlog pa kun la 'di nyid gtso: sa bdag brgya la gdong thug kyang : ma mo 'di yis bzlog par 'gyur: de bas zor sna kun la gces: ces so/ glud rabs gang rigs kyis yas bsngo sku glud 'bul ba sogs yod na 'dir bya/ hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba lha yi tshogs: ye shes 'jig rten ma lus kun: mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: dmag dpung bskyed phyir nam mkhar bzhugs: dar gdugs blang*/ sku chings dkrol/ srung bzlog 'khor lo kha bsgyur bya/ rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: zor dpung dgra la drang du gsol: oṃ sarba swa bha e kham ga gā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: skabs 'dir mdos zhal bsgyur/ gtor ma'i lha sprul gzhi ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar btegs la rgyab rten gyi tshul du bzhugs par mos pa dang*/ dam tshig gi gtor ma zor chen du bsgrub pa'am tha ma gtor ma mtshon cha'i ngo bo ru bsgyur ba yin la/ de yang sprul pa dam tshig gi 'khor lo yongs su gyur pa las/ gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu phra phyag sras mchog sgo ma bka' srung sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thams cad khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas srid gsum brlag pa'i nus ldan du brlabs pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig btsan rgod kyi zor bsgrub 'di zor spyi'i byin rlabs su 'don pa yod de/ de ni bye brag las spyir min pa shes dgos so/ gzhung gi zor sgrub dngos ni/

g.yul bzlog dregs dpung gnam lcags thog mda' yi: mtha' bskor dmod pa drag po'i zor rdzas ni: 'phang ba'i kong zor tshe yungs dmar nag rtsang : dug khrag rbab rdo dang ni tsit+ta'i zor: skyer phur thod zor dug mda' gshin rje'i khram: mda' mdung ral gri lcags sgrog tho ba sogs: ke tshe shang tshe kong bu kha khyer la: byad thag sna lngas dkris la zur du bsham: dug khrag sbreng zhing rtsa sngags bklag: gsungs pa bzhin zor rdzas rnams snod gcig tu bsdus la dug khrag gis bran la sngags kyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ spu gri'i drag sngags so bdun dang : oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sarba bi gh+nā na sogs rtsa sngags sham bu bcas: de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha kī la ya: mā ra ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bh+yoḥ drag po khros pa'i ngang las bzhengs pa'i mtshon: srid pa las kyi zor rdzas zor thun la: mtshon 'khrugs yams nad 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can: bsam gcod reg gcod gdeng gcod dregs pa'i mtshon: gang la btab kyang thogs med sgrub rdzas 'di: rig 'dzin grub thob bla ma rgya mtsho dang : yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs bcas: chos skyong dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sde dpon gyis: zor rdzas gdug pa'i mtshon char byin gyis rlobs: drag rtsal thogs med rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: do nub drag po'i zor rdzas bsgral chas 'di: gang la phog kyang myur du sgrol mdzad pa'i: dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri 'byung gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya: ma tri rak+sha ya ma sha trum a mu ka tsit+ta nan: ru tra mā ra dzi bī tshin+dha tshin+dha bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: man+t+ra du nan bh+yo zlog: yaṇ+ṭa du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ti du nan bh+yo zlog: ru tra du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya du nan bh+yo zlog: rbad tshal pa sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: myog ti rmug ti sa ma ya zlog:

smi sha ku ru sa ma ya zlog: tsi tri ru tri sa ma ya zlog: tsit+ta rbad 'gas sa ma ya zlog: badz+ra ya tri ya tri zlog: ni lam bha ra zlog: dri mi hā re zlog: ma rtsa du tri zlog: sha ri hā ri zlog: khrag ti ya ma zlog: tsit+ta thum ril zlog: nā ga kha ra zlog: ya ma gzer nan zlog: rak+sha trig nan zlog: yak+sha taṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra e thum zlog: ra tsa du ru zlog: khaṃ maṃ baṃ shag zlog: dmod pa'i rig sngags thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo zlog: sarba a mu kā tad+ya thā mā ra ya: e hur thum rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de dag zor rdzas nus ldan du bsgrub pa yin no/ 'ga' zhig btsan rgod kyi zor sgrub ni zor spyi'i byin rlabs su 'dod pa yod de/ de ni bye brag las spyir min pa shes dgos so/ gsol ka rnams dmag thabs zhes mjug nas yar 'don rjes rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i mthar gtor ma phul/ chad mdo'i tha tshig bsgrag la gtor ma dmag lto'i tshul du bzlog gtor la stob/ yang lugs 'gar zor du bsgrubs zin pa'i rjes su'ang bzlog dbang zhu lugs su snang yang 'di ni shin tu dpyad par bya dgos pa'i gnas te phan gnod ci 'gyur cha ma mchis so/ de nas zor las bya ba ni: rnal 'byor zhwa gos dmod pa'i chas: gdong la khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan: g.yab dar ru dar sna tshogs gzengs: rol mo rnga gshang bon thabs brdung : bskyed rdzogs dmigs pa brtan par bya: gong gnon sngags bsnyen sgrub pa gtso: gsungs pa bzhin rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal lam bskyed rdzogs dmigs pa brtan po'i ngang nas/ hūm̐ sgrub lhug 'don mthar/ rkang gling tshar gsum btang*/ ru dar gyis sna drangs zhwa gos gzab 'chor gyis ser sbreng rngam stabs dang rol mos bsu la sna sel dkar gtor dang zor rdzas gtor chen rnams rim bzhin brdzangs la dmag thabs ltar rdo rje slob dpon rting bdas nas byon dgos la/ bzlog pa phul sar slebs dus/

thog mar 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems rdor slob kyis thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung*/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo red cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed ky-i bgegs/ dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig

/tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum/ re re bzhin g.yab dar lan gsum gsum mthar 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbye 'bebs rgya dang*/ slar yang lan gcig g.yugs pa rnams 'gugs pa thams cad spyi ltar ro/ zor bskul ni/ gser skyems sbrengs la/ hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin che mchog ku mā ra: dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir dam nyams dgra la zor 'phen na: sgrub pa'i lha srung gnyan pos rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mas gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla mas rgyab rten mdzod: gang zag snyan brgyud bla mas dpung grogs mdzod: bka' lung shog ser brgyud pas nus mthu phyungs: bka' bab lung bstan brgyud pas byin rlabs 'bungs: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis dmag dpung bskyed: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis ru mtshon phyor: dam can gter bdag rnams kyis mtshon char phob: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis zor sna drongs: srog bdag bshan pa 'bum gyis bla rten phrol: dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmod pa'i zor thun drag pos sgrol bar mdzod:

de nas dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ me rlung thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: sha za ma mo shar gyi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: g.yag gdong sbrul gdong gzig gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ sre gdong dred gdong dom gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ dkar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying du zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: lho yi ma mo'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ bam ri khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: khrag 'thung ma mo lho yi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: pha waṃ chu srin sdig gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ khra mgo wa gdong stag gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ ser mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying du zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: nub kyi ma mo'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ dur khrod me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: srog gcod ma mo nub kyi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: rgod mgo rta mgo khyung gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ khyi mgo pu shud shwa gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ dmar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: byang gi ma mo'i zor thogs la:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang nas: dbugs len ma mo byang gi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: spyang gdong skyin mgo phag gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ glang chen chu glang sbrul gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ ljang mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas ma mo bcu gnyis kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo: dur khrod chen po rab rgyu'i pho brang nas: gnas kyi srin mo 'bar ba bcu gnyis tshogs: gcer bu mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: dmar nag ral pa stong khams yengs se yeng : yams nad dug gi kha phru chi li li: dam nyams dgra la zor mda' sha ra ra: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo ma mo dgra la chos: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi dgra la chos: re ti ya ma mched bzhi dgra la chos: myur mgyogs sa bdag ma bzhi las la chos: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma gdugs pa'i snying la mā ra ya: bh+yo bh+yo rak+mo tri ma tri du na rak+sha ya ma thun bh+yoḥ e hur thum rbad ya: de nas ging bdud bshan pa bcu gnyis kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: 'chi bdag 'khrugs pa gshin rje'i pho brang nas: phur 'debs chen po las mkhan bcu gnyis tshogs: rngam phyir dgra bo'i srog len nyi li li: gtum phyir ru mtshon sna tshogs lhabs se lhab: spu gri mtshon cha dgra la thog ltar 'bebs: bshan pa 'bum gyi las byed khyugs se khyug: sde dpon las byed bcu gnyis dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra shor ra re: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ bdud po las byed sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ bshan pa gri thogs sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ

byad ma dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ du pra ma ya ma ra tsa tri shu la rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas zor sna dgu 'phen pa ni: nyungs zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen rnam par rgyal: yungs dkar zor mda' dgra la 'phen: myur mgyogs ser ba hri li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ti bi dza yā hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra ti la ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas dug zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen dbyug sngon can: dug gi zor mda' dgra la 'phen: smyo 'bog dug rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ni laṃ daṇ+ṭa mu ka ra hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra ha la dgra bo srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas khrag zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen gshin rje'i gshed: khrag zor dmar po dgra la 'phen: gzer nad lhog yams chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra rak+ta dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas rdo zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen mi g.yo mgon: rdo zor drag po dgra la 'phen: gzir 'debs rbab rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra she la dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas mtshe zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: mtshe mda' drag po dgra la 'phen: ke tshe shang tshe tshubs se tshub: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra khaḍ+ga ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas me zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal: me zor dbal kha dgra la 'phen: sreg byed me sgra 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs srog la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas chu zor thogs la:

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: dug chu'i zor mda' dgra la 'phen: nad yams dal kha chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra na ra ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas thod zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen khams gsum rgyal: thod zor skya bo dgra la 'phen: bhan+dha ya kha shams se sham: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra bhan+dha ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas khram zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen stobs po che: khram zor nag po dgra la 'phen: 'chi bdag las la sha ra ra: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra sha truṃ ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas mda' zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni khro chen hūm̐ ka ra: gzhu ni rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: mda' ni phra thabs sprul pa'i sras: rbad do dgra bo'i srog la ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra kro ti baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra nā ra ṇa mā ra ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: zhes dgra bgegs dpung tshogs thams cad rdul du brlags par bsgom: dmigs pa rnams ni spyi gzhung ltar bya/ zor rnams rim par 'phang*/ btsan rgod kyi zor chen spu gri 'bar ba yang skabs 'dir bya bar gsungs mod/ 'on kyang gar thod thod du mi bya ba gzhung las bkag rgya cher mdzad na rgyun du ma byas na legs par sems nas 'dir ma bkod la dgos gal yod na gzhung nas blangs la zor rdzas byin rlabs gong du byas la las zor 'dir 'phangs/ de nas dgongs gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni: las zor bya'am gtor chen brdeg: rnga rdung dung bus rak+ta bran: g.yab pa'i dar nag dang bcas shing : me chu gang rung dag la 'phang : dgra dpung zhal du bzhes par bsam: bzlog med dbyings su stims shig hoḥ zhes pa'i rim gyis gtor chen me hom du rdzongs pa la bzlog gtor btegs la dgongs gsol gyi rim pa 'di ltar bya'o/

hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ gsan du gsol lo: hoḥ gzigs su gsol lo: hoḥ 'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: dpal chen yang dag zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs gsan du gsol lo: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: bka' sdod chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs gsan du gsol lo: mthu ldan las la chas pa'i pho brang nas: dam can gter bdag pho nya dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi srung ma mthu me dpung las tsha ba: stobs thog rgod las myur ba: rtsal spu gri las rno ba: 'bebs dug mda' las gzir ba: gting rgya mtsho las zab pa: tshad ri bo las mtho ba: grangs rtsi shing las mang ba: bang glog dmar las mgyogs pa: rngam gshin rje las drag pa khyed rnams dgongs su gsol: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dmod pa ni: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: bstan pa'i chos skyong la phod btsugs pa: ya bo bzung ba: do bsdo ba: 'gras btsal ba: kha 'o ma las 'jam zhing snying tsher ma las rtsub pa: bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog snying rengs: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: nyos pa'i chung ma snying rangs: bsrungs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan: bskyabs pa'i le'u lha log: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: rang srog phung ba'i nor rdzas: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bo: bsam ngan log par shom nas mdun sgug rgyab 'ded byed pa: khyad par du yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs:

bar du gcod pa'i rkyen: tshe la rku zhing srog la 'jab pa: bla la 'khyer zhing yid la rlom pa: che sri chung sri rgan sri: nad bdag yams bdag: khyad par dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: byad zor 'debs par byed pa'i gdug sems can: ngo log rgyab ston byed cing bka' la mi brtsi zhing dam la mi gnas pa rnams: mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: dma' mnar med dmyal khams yan chad gang du gnas kyang : che btsan khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i dgra bo thams cad bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: gsol zhig rol cig: ces me dpung du 'phangs sam gtor 'bul tshul du stabs so/ de nas gal che na yang bzlog tshar gcig btang bar gsungs kyang rgyun du 'di yis mthus/ hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnam nas thog rgod lhung ba zlog: sa nas dug gzer langs pa zlog: bar nas dgra sdang 'gyu ba zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa zlog: mtshams nas byur 'dre langs pa zlog: mi kha phung sbyor ngan pa zlog: phug gi lha la gnod pa zlog: bar gyi mi la gnod pa zlog: sgo yi nor la gnod pa zlog: mchan gyi bu la gnod pa zlog: gtan gyi grogs la gnod pa zlog: yul mkhar zhing la gnod pa zlog: srid dang g.yang la gnod pa zlog: mi 'dod rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha ngan pa zlog: sme ba klung rta nyams pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du nan zlog: ya ma du nan zlog: ra tsa du nan zlog: yak+sha rbad nan zlog: ma tri bh+yo nan zlog:

du ru du ru ya zlog: ha la tsakra ya zlog: rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: bzlog bzlog: ces zlog sngags lan gsum mam bdun bklag go khyad par du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo khros 'khrug rngam pas zor rdzas nad mtshon dug gi char phab pas dgra dpung bsad/ bgegs dpung bcom/ slar mi ldog pa'i rgyas btab par mos la lta ba'i klong du bzhag par bya'o/ srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ kha nang du bskor la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rū ྃ: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: slar kha phyir bskor nas bsad bzlog ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: bzlog dmigs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru ka: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces bzlog sngags dmigs rim bcas thal mo brdab/

der tho zhig gi ngor khroṃ yig bris pa kha phyir bstan bslangs nas 'di ltar brjod do/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'byung po phyir 'brang khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: phyin chad ldang bar ma gyur cig: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing slob dpon dang po byas te sgo drung du slebs pa dang*/ bzlog gzhong sbub/ bshal chu brtan mar blugs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: bran g.yog mang po yang 'khor 'bum dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i dar zab rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rkang gling rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: la la sgeg mo la la dgyes pa mo: la la gar mo la la gtum pa mo: la la rngam byed la la ha ha dgod: la las g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhan+dha thogs: la las mi ro za zhing rgyu ma 'dren: la las mgo snying nang rol thogs te rgyugs: la las gcer mo khrag gi ral pa bsigs: la las klad khrag 'thung zhing mtshan ma bsgrad: la las khrag rkyal la las nad rkyal thogs: la las lcags phur la las zangs phur 'debs: la las gcan gzan zhon zhing ku sgra sgrogs: la las 'jig rten khyo rnams bla tshe rku: la las dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: la las cho 'phrul sna tshogs dgra la 'gyed: la las byad ma nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston pa yi: rnal 'byor chen mo phra men bcu gnyis ma: 'khor ni ma nges 'bum phrag bcu drug 'gyed: dbyings la 'gyu ba'i rnal 'byor bcu gnyis ma: 'og tu 'gyu ba'i sa bdag bcu gnyis ma: srid par 'gyu ba'i skye mched bcu gnyis ma: tshogs khang 'grim pa'i nyul le bcu gnyis ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ma: dus la gnas tshe lo skor bcu gnyis ma: sgrub mchog skyong tshe sngags srung bcu gnyis ma: don la ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro yang :
