thabs kyi cho 'phrul gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: cha lugs sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'gyed: bka' yi gnyer gtad ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ḍāk+ki dā sha dā ya: rak+sha li dā sha dā ya: ma tri dā sha dā ya: yo gi dā sha dā ya: du pra ma li dā sha dā ya: yak+sha li dā sha dā ya: maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭha pa la dā sha dā ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi:

'gugs pa bya/ gtor gzhong sbub/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan la/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rngam byed rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: ru tra dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ro ṣa na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ru tra a mu ka bi gh+nā na mā ra ya bh+yoḥbh+yoḥnan nan: zhes gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol: trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mtha' btsan shog: de nas nang du bzhes skyems sogs phul/ de nas nang du log ste phye mar bkra shis 'bras la rol zhing*/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs kyis bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod nams mnga' thang snyan grags gdul bya phrin las thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: dza ya dza ya maṅga laṃ sarba sid+dhi ku ru ye swā hā: de nas rgyal dbyangs la/ hūm̐: pho brang lhun grub 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs skur bsgoms te: bdud dang rkyen ngan g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: 'dre gdon bgegs kyi g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: byad kha rbod gtong g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: bar chad rkyen ngan g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo: lha rgyal lo rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes zer nas nang du log go /bkra shis sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab pa ni/

bsod nams stobs chen 'di yi mthus/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas? 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min? sogs/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ skad cig gis bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs srog hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tshe'i rang bzhin nṛḥdang āḥdang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du bkrag me re re snod bcud thams cad zhu zhing khengs pa 'ub 'ub bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim par gyur/ zhes mos la/ oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ : g.yu bh+rūm̐ : g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐ : ā yur+dzñā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐ : zhes brgya rtsa bzlas la mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: sku ni nam mkha'i rdul bag med: sku mdog dmar 'tsher 'od zer 'bar: longs spyod mtshan dpe'i rgyan rnams rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: bum pa 'chi med tshe chus bkang : gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar 'khril: phyag g.yas tshe mda' yab la 'khyud: g.yon pas tshe bum snyan thad 'dzin: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: yab yum phyag gi tshe bum dang : gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas: tshe yi 'od zer 'phro 'du gsal: bkrag dang mdangs kyi dpal du shar: phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud bsdus: bkra shis bum pa'i nang du bskyil: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur: skye shi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'gyur ba med pa'i don rtogs shog: ces bskul bas/ gong gi sngags nyer gcig bzlas mthar/ hūm̐: rdo rje tshe yi pho brang dbus: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dzñā na āḥyu sid+dhi hrīḥ tshe bum 'brang rgyas sogs rdzas yod na mched lcam rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ā yuḥṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ kā ya ā yu ṣe om̐: wāk+ka ā yu ṣe āḥ tsit+ta ā yu ṣe hūm̐: zhes dang gzhung ltar dngos grub bskul la dzpa dbyangs dang bcas sku gsung thugs rten dang sgrub gtor rnams gnas gsum du gtugs la dngos grub bstim zhing dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi blud/ lus mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ ngag grags stong kī la ya'i rang sgra/ yid gsal stong gnyug ma'i rang babs su 'jog tu bcug ste me tog 'thor/ rjes kyi bya ba mar me'i smon lam dang*/ mchod bstod bshags pa brtan bzhugs bsdu rim dang bkra shis bsngo smon rgya yis gdab pa sogs las byang ltar du shes par bya'o/ las kyi mtha' sdud mnan pa sogs las sbyor gzhan spro bar mos na zur du blta bar bya'o/ de dag gis nyin tha ma'i gtor rdzongs kyi rim pa rdzogs so/ de ltar bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi /smad las drag po'i srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim rtsa ba gter gzhung le tshan bcu gsum dkyus gcig tu bklag chog par bkod la sngar gyi zin bris rnams dang bla ma'i man ngag go bstun bka' gter gyi gzhung chen po rnams dang yang mi 'gal bar byas la go rim 'khrugs bsdebs phran bu dang yig chung sogs man ngag gsal byed kyis brgyan pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i sgyogs chen gnad la bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba 'di yang ma hā gu ru rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyis yang phur bsgrubs pa'i gnas bal yul yang le shod du gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs dang yang phur gtor zlog lo ltar rgyun 'dzugs skabs gcung gnam lcags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs bzang po sogs phur pa gling gi sgrub sde nas yang yang bskul ba dang*/ 'brong pa ri smad dgon 'dus spyi'i dgongs don bzhin 'brong bla karma longs spyod nas cho ga nar 'don chog pa zhig gnang rogs zhes bskul ma byung ba'i khar nye ba'i char the wan gnam lcags chos tshogs nas cis kyang myur du grub par gyis zhes bskul ma byung bar dus mtshungs/

snying po'i sgrub la brtson pa'i rdo bla o rgyan gsang sngags kyis mdzub gnon byas pa'i ma dpe rnams glog klad drwa rgya'i rgyud bskur gtong byung bas/ ri lugs zin bris mthong ba don gsal dang*/ kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 'don zin dang*/ sgo chen dgon pa'i lugs srol bla ma thugs mchog nas zin bris su btab pa zhig bcas khag gsum tsam lag tu son zhing gzhan yang lung zin ar+ya dh+wa dzas kī la ya'i zin bris dang*/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug nges pa don gyi pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi stod las dang smad las phyogs bsgrigs sogs rang lugs yig cha rnams las phyi ma nyid gtsor du bton zhing gzhan dang yang dpyad bsdur gang thub byas pa dang*/ khyad par du rang re gsang chain snga 'gyur bka' bab kyi chu bo ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs shing bka' gter rgya mtsho zab gnad pha mthar son pa rdo rje 'chang mkhyen brtse rin po che'i zhal snga nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po sogs smin grol bdud rtsi'i bgo skal thob cing dpal zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling du rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan 'gan spyi bor bskur nas bgrang bya phyogs kyi grangs la tshad med bsnan pa'i dus ring la snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi phyag bzhes mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len man ngag nyams myong gis zur brgyan nas gab pa bsal/ 'khrugs pa bsdebs te rang gi pha phor gtsang zhen kho nar ma yin par gsang chen snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba spyi dang yang mi 'gal bar brgyan pa 'di bzhin/ ring lugs 'di nyid kyi 'dzin skyong spel ba'i byed po ru pad+ma'i lung gis zin pa zab gter chos bdag ar+ya dh+wa dza'i skye phreng lnga par 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi blo gros nas ngos 'dzin thob cing*/ snga 'gyur bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che dang mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis nas da res gnam lcags bstan pa'i srog rtsa chad mthud kyi byed po khyod bka' bab yin zhes bka' bzang spyi bo'i rgyan du phebs pa de kho na khungs su bcol nas dam pa'i thugs bskyed mthus bstan la phan par re ba tsam las/

rang la skyes sbyangs yon tan phra mos ma gos pas 'gal nor chu bo'i gnyer ma bzhin yod nges pas slad nas mkhyen yon mnga' ba rnams kyis dag bcos gnang bar gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa lags so/ zhes pa'ang rgyal khams phyogs med nyul ba'i sprang ban gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin 'bod pas/ 'dzam gling nyi ma nub phyogs a mi ri ka zhes sum rtsen sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i yul gyi char/ e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa shing pho khyi yi lo dang spyi lo 1694lor sku 'khrungs nas lo308/ yang me sprel lor yum chen a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i zab gter gyi rgya grogs dngos su mdzad nas yab yum lhan cig rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas mig 'phrul bsgyur ba ltar mon sha 'ug stag sgor phebs pa dang*/ sa g.yo ri 'gul stong gsum 'ur ba'i sgra dang bcas gter srung btsan rgod chen po dngos su byon nas bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi shog ser dang gnam lcags phur pa khru gang ba bcas phul ba bzhes nas mi lo286'das pa rab byung bcu bdun pa chu rta lo zla ba 10tshes 29dang phyi lo 2003zla ba1tshes 1 la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang chos brgyud 'di yi bstan pa'i srog shing gnam sprul 'phags pa rgya mtshos dbus bstan pa 'di 'dzin gang la su bzhugs sku tshe brtan zhing bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // slar smras pa/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag srol ma nyams pa/ /'brel ba bzhi ldan gsang sngags snga 'gyur lugs/ /de yang rgyud dang sgrub thabs 'brel ba dang*/ /sgrub thabs rnams kyang chog khrigs dang 'brel la/ /chog khrigs mthong brgyud phyag len dang 'brel ba/ /phyag bzhes de'ang bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /zhal rgyun man ngag dang ni 'brel ba ste/

/de ltar 'brel ba bzhi dang ldan par gces/ /'on kyang pad+ma'i bka' srol gter chen rer/ khyad 'phags dag snang phyag srol mang yod cing*/ /de kun byin rlabs nye brgyud mchog gsungs phyir/ /blo ldan su zhig de la cis mi gus/ /'on kyang bla ma re la phyag srol re/ /yul tshan re la byed srol mang 'dug na/ /de rnams rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes dang*/ /mthun na tshad ldan yin par smos med kyang*/ khungs med lung med gsang ba spyi lugs dang*/ /mi mthun 'gal 'dus phung po mthong bzhin du/ /da dung rang gi pha phor gtsang zhen las/ /yang dag lung rigs nor bu ke ta kas/ /dag zhing gtsang bar bgyis na 'os su che/ /so zur gnubs kyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa/ /o rgyan smin grol gling gi lugs srol 'di/ /yin zhes gangs ljongs yongs la rlung ltar grags/ /des na so zur gnubs kyi phyag bzhes des/ /ma chog snga 'gyur bstan la ci zhig yod/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyis/ /gter brgya'i zab chos mdzod chen bka' bsdus skabs/ /smin grol phyag bzhes smin lugs kyis bkab mdzad/ /des na de yis mi 'thus mi srid snyam/ /de slad rang lugs phyag bzhes thor bu 'ga'/ /rnyed pa so sor 'dra min mang 'dug pas/ /phal cher mthun pa bsdus shing khyad par du/ /rang lugs yin nges skyid smyon thugs mchog rjes/ /phyogs bsgrigs bla ma drag po'i stod smad khrigs/ /smin gling spyi 'gros gzugs dang me long bzhin/ /gcig tu babs la yid ches tshad mas grub/ /de phyir drin can bla ma'i drin lan dang*/ /bstan pa mi nub yun du 'phel ba'i slad/ /'khos pa zhen kyang gzhan la phan pa'i blos/ /'bad pa lags kyang rang blo dman pa yis/ /bslad cing 'gal bar gyur na chos kyi spyan/ /ldan pa rnams kyi mdun sar nongs pas bshags/ /de bzhin chos bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags kyis tshangs par stsaul/

/'di bgyid lhag bsam dkar ba'i dge rtsa gang*/ /mchis na ma rgan 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ /des kyang rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /zab gter ring lugs mi nyams srid pa 'di/ /ji srid bar du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /'gro kun smin dang grol ba'i dpal thob shog /gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying pos bsdus pa'i 'gro/ /lam rgyud yo ga gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /'bras bu sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe 'di nyid du thob pa'i bkra shis shog/ // ༈ rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ rigs kun khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ka /dgongs brgyud rdor sems brda brgyud dga' rab rdor/ /snyan brgyud ston pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /tshig gi brgyud pa shrī singha la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /don gyi brgyud pa pra chen hastī'i zhabs/ gter rgya'i brgyud pa go byi de ma lcam/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur brgyud pa pad+ma 'byung*/ /dam rdzas shog ser brgyud pa mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ smon lam lung bstan bud+dha dzñā na'i mtshan/ /zab mo gter gyi brgyud pa rtsa gsum gling*/ /smin grol bka' gtad brgyud pa tra ya sogs/ /chos bdag lung bstan dzñā na dh+wa dza la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /yang dag rdo rje gsal byed he ru ka /che mchog yab yum badz+ra ku mā ra/ /'khor lo rgyal 'debs kī la rigs bzhi dang*/ khro bcu yab yum phra thabs 'khor bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad sgo skyong chen mo bzhi/ /shwa na sa bdag re ti ging bdud sogs/ /bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs sprul 'khor bcas/ /snang srid phur pa'i dkyil 'khor rol pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rdzas kyi phur bus ma rig gdon bgegs bskrad/

/thugs rje'i phur bus rigs drug gnas nas sgrol/ /byang sems phur bus zung 'jug mkha' dbyings sbyor/ /chos dbyings phur bus phyir mi ldog pa'i sar/ /sku gsum phur bus khams gsum bsgral nus shog / de skad rang gis ngag 'don bya ba'i ched du ku mā ri'i sa ma dhi la gnas pa dad pa'i tshul ldan au ḍi ming gis bris pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las byang phrin las rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: dpal chen yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yang zab sgrub pa snying gi thig le las: gsang ba'i las byang yid bzhin nor bu bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: bdud rigs sems can dmu rgod rnam rtog rags: de yi rkyen gyis dug lnga'i chos shig dar: gsang sngags chos kyi sgrom bu bun ltar gtor: sdug bsngal rnam smin las dbang zad mtha' med: sems can skyabs med dbul phongs a tsa ma: gang phyir pad 'byung nga yi smon lam gyis: gnubs kyi lo tsā bud+dha dzñā na 'di: skye ba du mar sems can 'gro don byed: lan gcig

yul gyi stod dag la: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags nas: bod 'bangs skyob pa'i gter kha dpag med 'byin: ma 'ongs de dus zab chos 'di 'byung ste: 'brel tshad byang chub thob par lung yang bstan: bka' yi rgya 'di ma mo gsum gyis srungs: gter min bdud rigs lag tu ma sprod par: pad 'byung nga yi thugs sras de dang sprod: gnas chen sha 'ug stag sgoṛ atsha rgya: sgra gcan me rlung gwa'u dmar nag rgya: dang po thun mong sngon 'gror bcu bzhi dang : dngos gzhir nyer gcig rjes la bcu bzhi'o: dang po rgyud dang dbyer med sngon 'gro ni: dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum: kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hoḥ 'khor 'das mnyam yang phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs par de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'gyed pa pho nya'i tshogs: bar med khyab pas bgegs tshogs ma lus kun: a 'thas gzhom phyir gtor ma len par khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnyis 'dzin ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: snying rje'i sbyin yul ma rig bgegs kyi tshogs: rtog med de bzhin gtor mas tshims par dengs: ci ste mi 'gro zhen pas bcings srid na: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra bidh+wa dzñā na mā ra sarba bi gh+nā na tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ ham̐'u: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag: ye nas ma bcos gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin rlung lnga srung ba'i gur: so 'thab 'khrigs pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tra ya maṇ+ḍa la yaṃ pañtsa sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: drug pa phyi mchod byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: phyi mchod kun bzang mchod sprin gyur:

oṃ sarba puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang mchod byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong snod yangs mchog: nyi zla zhu ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ a haṃ pū dza hoḥ brgyad pa sman mchod byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: 'dus byas rnam dag stong pa'i snod: phung khams skye mched bdud rtsi spel: oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: dgu pa rak+ta byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i mtshon bsnun ma rig bsgral: rgyud drug dmar chen sna tshogs gyur: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa āḥhūm̐: bcu pa gtor ma byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: kun gzhi lhun grub bhan+dha ru: rnam thar bcu gnyis gtor mar gyur: oṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hūm̐: bcu gcig pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa ba gsum gyi brgyud pa yis: sku lnga ye shes byin phob cig: oṃ a be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭha ham̐'u: bcu gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: rang rig lta ba'i zhal mjal phyir: rnam dag thugs kyi brda sgo dbye: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gsum pa brda bshags ni/ hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis su med: de don ma rtogs gol bar bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bcu bzhi pa bsgrub par dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas lugs rig pa'i gzungs thag gis: rang rtsal dkyil 'khor mi gtong bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong chen kun tu khyab: ngo bo lhun grub blo 'das ngang : oṃ dharma swa bhā hoḥ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin ma grub rtsal chen gyis: sgyu ma'i rlung gis cho 'phrul 'gyed: oṃ swa bhā dharma hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: kun tu sgyu ma'i snying po yis: mkha' ltar bdag med sa bon shar: oṃ hūm̐ baṃ dharma hri da ya hūm̐: bzhi pa de las klong lnga yum gyi mkha' klong gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i 'byung lnga la:

sor rtog yi ge rim par shar: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ : lnga pa rgyu'i he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: gdan steng yab yum sbyor ba'i sras: 'khor tshogs zhal phyag ma 'dres rdzogs: oṃ pad+ma sūr+ya ti ra bam̐: maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐ swa bhā haṃ swā hā: drug pa 'bras bu rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ las rlung : ram̐ las me ri kham̐ las chu: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ rus ri: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rdzogs: dbus su mdzes tog phyi rol gur: mtshan tshang drag po'i pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bdun pa brten pa bdag rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du las: che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: bco brgyad phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin: gri gug ral gri dbyug to dang : rdo rje tho ba gsal shing khyung : 'khor lo nor bu bcas pa g.yas: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ thong gshol rnga: lcags sgrog rgyu ma dril bu zhags: phur pa dang bcas g.yon du bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs brgyad khro rol gyad kyi 'gros: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: gri thod drug bcas mgul 'khyud stob: sku las skyes pa'i me ri 'bar: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka ru: nī laṃ mchod rten sngon po'i dbus: bum pa'i gzhal yas lte ba'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : ma hā badz+ra ku mā ra: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: mthing dkar dmar ba'i rngam zhal brjid: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas:

zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : rdo rje thod khrag stobs te 'khril: thugs kar sems dpa' srog yig bcas: mi bzad 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ sras sogs khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bkod pa ni/ hūm̐: yab yum rdo rje pad+ma'i tog: bu ga'i yi ge dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zung 'jug bde stong rol pa las: hūm̐ bzhi baṃ bzhi sras su shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs te khrag 'thung bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad dbal: rtse dgu rtse lnga me kha ṭ+wāṃ: phyag gi mtha' gnyis phur pa bsgril: rigs bzhi yum 'khril sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgur gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: yab yum gsang ba'i bu ga nas: hūm̐ yig baṃ yig phyogs bcur 'phros: khro bcu yab yum mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phra thabs gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti dā sha ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'khor tshogs bka' sdod kyi dkyil 'khor phra thabs tshul du bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: slar yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bar ba'i gar: phur skyong nyer bzhi mi bzad tshogs: yang 'khor sprul sogs so sor gsal: oṃ ma ti kro ti ghṛ wa lak+ṣi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ brgyad pa dbang bskur byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: ye shes phur pa bskyed pa'i lha: gsal rdzogs mi g.yo brtan pa'i phyir: deng 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag dpal chen phur pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir:

thugs rjes brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ bcu pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin brtan pa'i rgyud rtsal lha: bzhugs mdzad dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs can: gdod nas ma bcos rang byung ba: rol pa'i khrag 'thung che la 'dud: oṃ sarba tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na maḥsarba hāṃ sa pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gcig pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang po'i 'bras bu tshim byed pa: lha mo sna tshogs phyi mchod 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi mchog: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa khā hi: bcu gsum pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rig ma bcu drug mi phyed sbyor: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mchog: dug lnga rnam dag sman mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bco lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das rgyud drug bsgral ba yi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bcu drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phung po lnga nyid ye shes su: bsgyur ba'i ba ling mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu bdun pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: nyams chag bskang dang bshags phyir 'bul: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ bco brgyad pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yul bskang bya mi dmigs pa: kho na de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: oṃ sarba dharma swa bhā wa pū dza hoḥ bcu dgu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: che btsan yang dag he ru kaḥ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: bco brgyad mtshon chas dug lnga gzhom: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' la bgrad:

dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' bar 'gro: dor stabs zhabs kyis ri rab brdzis: sbyor ba'i yum chen shwa rī ma: bde stong zung 'jug gri thod bsnams: rgyan drug rol pa'i gar stabs can: dpal chen yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: thugs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa po: khro bo'i zhal rab gdangs shing rngam: phyag mtshan drug gis rig sngags gcod: rdo rje sgro gzengs me char 'bebs: dgyes pa'i dur khrod chas dang ldan: dor stabs 'gying zhing dpa' rab 'chang : 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rtsa 'jib ma: khams kun g.yo ba'i zhal mnga' ma: zung 'jug thabs shes 'khyud pa mo: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sgra 'byin ma: drug gis sbyor ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde chen g.yo zhing g.yo ba mo: thugs mchog yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mchog: sems dpa' rdo rje'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol ba: las bzhi'i phrin las dpal yon gyis: mi zad lta ba'i gar 'gyed pa: rigs bzhi'i sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa chen po khyon gyi rtse: khyab cing sgeg bzhad ston pa po: sa bcu'i lam ni rab bgrod pa: yab yum khro bcur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zer gyis snang tshul cho 'phrul gyis: khyon ltar lta ba yangs shing 'geng : 'bebs pa rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: phra thabs phur 'debs phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nyer bzhi sa yi rim pa bdun: shes rab gcig la thabs drug gi: skur ston gar sgyur nyi shu brgyad: dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: skye mched gnas gsum gzhir dag pa'i: rol rtsal za byed mche ba dmar: las su grub pa'i ma mo'i tshogs: ma sring bcu gnyis khyod la bstod: hūm̐: las mdzad mā ra ya yi tshul: sna tshogs sde dpon gtso dang 'khor: za gsod dbugs la rngam byed tshogs: bcu gnyis sde dpon khyod la bstod: hūm̐:

ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje yi: rtsal gyis sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: srid gsum 'geng ba'i las byed pa: yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: nyi shu pa dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings mthing nag e klong nas: khrag 'thung rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dang : yang dag he ru ka yi gtso 'khor bcas: gdul dka' 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs shig: snang srid 'khor 'das gzugs can gzugs med dang : kun bzang thugs dang 'jag ma'i srin bu yan: snang gzugs thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad kī li'i drag sngags sgra: dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ting nge 'dzin: yin min ngos bzung bral ba'i dbyings chen por: the tshom zad pas bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: re dogs bral ba'i chos nyid klong du bzla: bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag nyid che mchog thugs ka ru/ /nī lam mchod rten sngon po yi/ /bum dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu brjid/ /de yi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi/ /rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag /mtha' skor khrag 'thung snying po'i bskor/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus/ /'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib sbyang*/ /snod bcud khro bo rol pa yi/ /lha sngags ye shes 'byams klas gyur/ yang dag gi rtsa bsnyen/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phur pa'i bsnyen pa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ spyi dril gyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti kī li kī la ya sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ sgrub ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kham nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: khro gtum tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: g.yas gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i ban bon 'joms: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis:

sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog snying phral: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po rdul du rlog: sgro gshog spu gri brgyangs pa yis: snang srid kun gyi cho 'phrul zlog: 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad kyis: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gyis: dam sri 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham gyis: stong khams ru tra'i srog dbugs phral: sku la me dpung 'khrigs pa yis: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bsreg: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: khro rgyal stobs ldan kī la ya: bdud 'dul dpal gyi sku ru shar: dbang sdud zil gnon lhun gyis grub: bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: grags stong ngang du ci nus bzlas: sa ma ya: thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod:

nyer gcig pa dngos grub len pa ni/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: srog ltar mi gtong bsgrubs lags na: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: oṃ sarba gar+bha sid+dhi hūm̐: gsum rjes tshogs kyi rim pa la bcu las/ dang po tshogs byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshogs rdzas nyid: dngos 'dzin mi dmigs stong par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren no: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor byin chen phob: sgrub la dbang bskur mchog thun stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa mchod skong bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang la thugs dam bskang : shes sgrib ka dag klong du bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bzhi pa tshogs bsgral ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ lnga pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan bye ba 'bum: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhal du bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: drug pa bskul ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra la zor gyi las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen ma la mchims phu ru: rgyal kun 'dus pa yab yum gyis:

yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gter srung khas blangs chad mdo bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan gar mkhan mas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum ru tra mnan pa'i bro: khro bo khro mos chem chem brdungs: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: bcu pa dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags dpal: brtan g.yo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: gnyis pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar song nas/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: mi dmigs dkyil 'khor ka dag dbyings: rang bzhin ye shes klong du ho: a a āḥ sa mi dmigs par mnyam par bzhag oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ slar ldang la go bgo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/

zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /bzhi pa bsngo smon ni/ rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtsho nyid: mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: bde dge mchog gsum 'dus pa yi: thugs rje'i smon lam der 'grub shog: ye dharmā sogs/ lnga pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong dgu'i gter chen gyis: zab rgyas 'gro kun smin mdzad pa: deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o/ bar skabs kyi yig chung rnams mchan bu'i tshul du bkral la go rim 'don srol ltar 'khrugs bsdebs byed po gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin no/ sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: snying thig yid bzhin nor bu bzhag: yang gsang shog dril mgul khug ma: mthong thos dran reg byang chub thob: mig ltar gces la snying ltar chongs: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya 'di la bya ra gyis: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so/ yang phur las byang chung ba'i brgyud 'debs ni/ chos dbyings mkha' la gzugs sku sgyu ma'i gar/ /ma 'gag lhun grub gang 'dul gdul bya'i dpal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje sems dpa' cher/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /las kyi dbang mo dga' rab rdo rje'i zhabs/ /shrī singha 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ /rdo rje gro lod rdo rje be con la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ba su dha ra sangs rgyas ye shes che/ /zab gter bka' bab gnam lcags rtsa gsum gling*/ /lung zin chos bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /pad+ma'i bka' srol yang phur dkyil 'khor lha/ /snang stong dbyer med zhi dang khro bo'i gar/

/mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bskyed rdzogs lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /snang grags rig stong ye shes 'khor lor sad/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur dpal chen he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir mngon 'gyur shog / cais pa'ang dus zhabs kyi gter ming 'dzin pa bdud 'dul pad rgyal gling pas nyer mkho'i dbang gis sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi /rgyun khyer snying po rab gsal ces bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang yang dag kī la ya gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su len par 'dod pa'i dang po sbyor ba spros bcas las byang rgyas 'bring ltar las/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ mdun bskyed bshams bkod sogs spros pa med kyang*/ phyi nang mchod tshogs spyi ltar bshams kyang tshogs rdzogs phyir ci 'byor bshams la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur bu gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par bsams la thal sbyar bcas/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs nas chen por bsngo/ lan gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam mo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi gter gzhung ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: oṃ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes dang gsum pa byin brlab ni: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su:

hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs pho brang 'bar ba'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i dbus: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur pa bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed me dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: zhes dang yang phur sbrags ma ltar na: dpal chen thugs kar tsit+ta ni: mthing nag zur brgyad lte ba ru: yang dag don gyi ye shes sems/ he ru ka dpal bde ba che: sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor: nyag gcig zhal dang thabs shes phyag: zung 'jug bde chen dbyings phyug sbyor: dur khrod dpal gyi chas kun rdzogs: rdo rje rtse lnga dung khrag bsnams: snang stong shin tu phra ba'i sku: tsit+ta zur brgyad gau ri brgyad: bde stong sku ni yungs 'bru tsam: de yi thugs kar ye shes sems: rdor sems dkar gsal longs sku'i chas: rdo rje dril bsnams phyed skyil bzhugs: tshon gang 'od kyi phung po ni: rin chen zur brgyad dbus na bzhugs: kun gyi spyi mgrin thugs ka ru: oṃ dkar a dmar hūm̐ mthing kaḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa'i: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur: zhes dang*/ hūm̐: dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: yang dag ye shes dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces mchod cing bstod/ de yi thugs kar tsit+ta ni: mthing smug mchong gi gur ltar mdzes: lte bar nyi steng rdo rje ni: rtse dgu nas kyi 'bru tsam sgreng : rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ mthing 'bar: mtha' bskor khrag 'thung snying po las: sngags phreng mtshams su gsung rdo rje: rta mgrin dmar pos bar chad srung : 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas: dpal chen gsang gsum gnyis med gyur: ces dmigs pa'i don yid la gzhol nas: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yaḥsarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang dag go /yang phur sbrags mar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen pa'i 'gros ltar bsnyen sgrub chig dril gyi dgongs pa dang : las sbyor gyi khyad par gter gzhung ltar bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐ : bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes srung dmigs dang srung sngags ci nus mthar/ bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor:

bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: zhes bsad sngags dang*/ zlog dmigs ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru ka: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas la gzhi bsnyen skabs bsnyen sgrub chig dril bcu cha tsam mam/ rgyun khyer skabs srung sngags bdun dang*/ 'og ma gnyis gsum re'i dmigs pa bcas sbyar ba shin tu zab par snang ngo*/ mthar bdag bskyed nyer bsdu ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lha ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ smon lam rgyas gdab/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thun bar gtor 'bul bya bar 'dod na/ gtor rdzas bdud rtsis bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ bdag nyid dpal chen thugs las spros pa yi/ /yaṃ raṃ keṃ las rlung me thod sgyed steng*/ /a las bhan+dha chos dbyings mnyam pa'i nang*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyor steng gi mkhar/ /'bru gsum gnas pa'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med pa'i/

/'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla med byang chub sgrub pa por/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud 'dul ba'i/ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ /chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ phyi mchod 'dod yon rgya mtsho dang*/ khyad par sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor los mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ sogs sman raka dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ri i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ho/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po badz+ra ku mā ra phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dam can srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs

sogs phrin las mdzod cig / cais 'dod don gsol/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i klong*/ /yang dag thugs mchog badz+ra he ru ka /chos kyi dbyings su gnyis med sbyor ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ cais bstod la/ hūm̐/ khyad par phrin las glog ltar myur ba yi/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis/ /gnyis med sprul pa sras mchog khro bcu'i sprin/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad phur srung bcu drug dang*/ /'bar ba'i pho nya gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /sngon tshe he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig sa ma ya/ /phyi nang gsang mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon tshogs/ thugs kyis gang bzhed de ltar shar ba'i mchod/ rig dang ma rig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags/ gnas skabs bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ bar chad kun sel phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs/ mthar thug bla med byang chub ma thob par/ ma yi bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin/ las kyi 'bras bu ma lus mchis par mdzod/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing chos skyong gsol kha gzhan rnams kyang 'dir 'dzud/ spro bar mos na gsham gsal tshogs mchod kyang sbyar la mchod bstod gshegs/ mthar yig rgyas nongs pa bshags shing*/ mgron thabs ye shes pa brtan par bzhugs sam dbyings su gshegs/ 'jig rten pa badz+ra muḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs shing rjes kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang zab chos 'di nyid kyi brgyud 'dzin sgo chen rgyal sprul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin mchog nas lha rdzas rin po che rgyal srid grangs ldan gyi skyes bcas bskul ngor/ gter gzhung rgyun khyer sor bzhag la/

cung zad 'jug bde'i ched du/ dil mkhyen rin po che'i gnyags phur rgyun khyer dang thog mtha'i ngag 'don kha skong bcas dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ gter chen nyid kyis byin brlabs kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa ka ma rā dza dī pas sbyar bas 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /bla med yang phur ga'u dmar nag las/ las byang 'bring po phrin las rgyun khyer smad las gtor zlog dang bcas pa bklag chog tu spel ba bdud 'dul zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma yang phur dbyer med la/ /'dud nas stod smad cho ga'-i khrigs/ /gong 'og gter kha phyogs bsdebs pa/ /gter chen bka' bzhin 'dir gsal bya/ de'ang gnubs chen rnam 'phrul o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter yang phur phrin las 'bring po dang*/ gang de'i zab gter mjug skyong ba po rigs bdag bdud 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi smad las khro chu'i zhun thigs gong 'og phyogs bsdeb bya tshul gter chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'dir 'god par bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi stod las bdag bskyed rtsa ba yang phur gtso gtor/ gtso phur/ phur srung gsol spungs/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ dkar bgegs sogs stod las bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor zhi drag mchod pa sman raka bcas dang*/ de las stegs dma' bar mdun bskyed bzlog pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rdul tshon 'bring ras bris tha ma 'bru nag gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su lcags kyi rkang gsum mam/ ri sna gsum gyi rdo la thod sgyed byas pas kyang rung ste/ steng du lcags slang che legs kyi nang du dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khar dpal bshos khru+u gang las ma chung ba nus na khro zhal du bcos pa dang ma nus na gtor chen gdong zhal/ rtse mor me ri drag rgyan/

de steng srung 'khor nang*/ bzlog 'khor phyi ru byas pa'i rgyab sprod can/ de steng sku 'khor/ bya khyung dang bcas pa'i steng gtor gdugs nag po kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi tog can mdun du yum gyi gtor ma khrag kong*/ kī la rigs bzhi dmar gtor bzhi/ de bzhin khro bcu dang phra thabs nyi shu go rim ltar dmar gtor bcu dang g.yas g.yon khrag kyu re re/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad khrag kong grangs dang sbyar la/ phyag rtsang drug dang dbu rtsang gsum/ phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa gnyis/ sgo ma bzhi phyogs rtsang bcas dang phyi rtsang la bha su ta dang sngo dmar skud pas dkṛ ba sogs spyi 'gros ltar bya/ 'og tu lcags hom nang liṅga bris pa khrus lteb lag len bzhin byas pa'am/ zan ling gang rung*/ drag mchod g.yon du bskor zhing g.yas g.yon sman raka bcas bsham/ phyi rol zor rdzas sna dgu spungs zor ram/ spro na thun zor dang*/ khram zor/ khrag zor/ thod zor/ yungs zor/ mda' zor/ rdo zor/ dug zor gtor zor bcas dang*/ mda' gzhu gri ring sogs gang 'dzoms kyis bskor/ zur du bzlog mchod 'bru nag gtor chung liṅga sha dum brgya rtsa bsgral chas sogs dang*/ rdor slob mdun g.yas nas rim bzhin las bum ḍā ma ru nas bzed yungs bzed dar dmar nag rdor dril las phur nang mchod bcas 'du bya'o/ dngos gzhi la/ stod las sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ smad las drag po srung zlog gi rim pa/ rjes chog bcas gsum mo/ dang po la'ang sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang thub bstod rnam thar gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs chos spyod ltar rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song ste de nas rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ rigs kun khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ka /dgongs brgyud rdor sems brda brgyud dga' rab rdor/ /snyan brgyud ston pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/

/tshig gi brgyud pa shrī singha la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /don gyi brgyud pa pra chen hastī'i zhabs/ /gter rgya'i brgyud pa go byi de ma lcam/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur brgyud pa pad+ma 'byung*/ /dam rdzas shog ser brgyud pa mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /smon lam lung bstan bud+dha dzñā na'i mtshan/ /zab mo gter gyi brgyud pa rtsa gsum gling*/ /smin grol bka' gtad brgyud pa tra ya sing*/ /chos bdag lung bstan dzñā na dh+wa dza la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ khyad par brgyud gsum kun 'dus rigs kyi bdag /'khor lo'i mgon po gter chen pad rgyal gling*/ /lung zin chos bdag brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /yang dag rdo rje gsal byed he ru ka /che mchog yab yum badz+ra ku mā ra/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs kī la rigs bzhi dang*/ khro bcu yab yum phra thabs 'khor bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad sgo skyong chen mo bzhi/ /shwa na sa bdag re ti ging bdud sogs/ /bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs sprul 'khor bcas/ /snang srid phur pa'i dkyil 'khor rol pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rdzas kyi phur bus ma rig gdon bgegs bskrad/ /thugs rje'i phur bus rigs drug gnas nas sgrol/ /byang sems phur bus zung 'jug mkha' dbyings sbyor/ /chos dbyings phur bus phyir mi ldog pa'i sar/ /sku gsum phur bus khams gsum bsgral nus shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs/ spro na byin rlabs cha bdun sku dgongs ltar dang mthar brgya brdung rol mo bcas bya/ dang po thun mong sngon 'gro la bco lnga las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro bar tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/

rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur bu gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par bsams la skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum: kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hoḥ 'khor 'das mnyam yang phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs par de bzhin sems bskyed do: tshogs bsags ni/ thal sbyar bcas/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam mo/ dkar gtor ni gter kha gong 'og rgyas bsdus gang rung ltar btang*/ gsum pa bgegs gtor byin rlob ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa bgegs dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'gyed pa pho nya'i tshogs: bar med khyab pas bgegs tshogs ma lus kun: a 'thas gzhom phyir gtor ma len par khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ

gnyis 'dzin ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lnga pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: snying rje'i sbyin yul ma rig bgegs kyi tshogs: rtog med de bzhin gtor mas tshims par dengs: ci ste mi 'gro zhen pas bcings srid na: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra bidh+wa dzñā na ku mā ra sarba bigh+nān tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ drug pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ ham̐'u: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag: ye nas ma bcos gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin rlung lnga srung ba'i gur: so 'thab 'khrigs pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tra ya maṇ+ḍa la yaṃ pañtsa sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bdun pa phyi mchod byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: phyi mchod kun bzang mchod sprin gyur: oṃ sarba puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa nang mchod byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong snod yangs mchog: nyi zla zhu ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ a haṃ pū dza hoḥ dgu pa sman mchod byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: 'dus byas rnam dag stong pa'i snod: phung khams skye mched bdud rtsi spel: oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bcu pa rak+ta byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i mtshon bsnun ma rig bsgral: rgyud drug dmar chen sna tshogs gyur: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa gtor ma byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: kun gzhi lhun grub bhan+dha ru: rnam thar bcu gnyis gtor mar gyur: oṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hūm̐: spro na phur bu rnams byugs bdug brab gsum bya srol 'dug /bcu gnyis pa byin dbab pa ni/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par

bsam la/ spos bdug gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis bskul bar bya'o/ hūm̐: rtsa ba gsum gyi brgyud pa yis: sku lnga ye shes byin phob cig: thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i: dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ a be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭha ham̐'u: bcu gsum pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: rang rig lta ba'i zhal mjal phyir: rnam dag thugs kyi brda sgo dbye: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu bzhi pa brda bshags ni/ hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis su med: de don ma rtogs gol bar bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bco lnga pa bsgrub par dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas lugs rig pa'i gzungs thag gis: rang rtsal dkyil 'khor mi gtong bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong chen kun tu khyab: ngo bo lhun grub blo 'das ngang : oṃ dharma swa bhā hoḥ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin ma grub rtsal chen gyis: sgyu ma'i rlung gis cho 'phrul 'gyed: oṃ swa bhā dharma hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: kun tu rgyu ba'-i snying po yis: mkha' ltar bdag med sa bon shar: oṃ hūm̐ baṃ dharma hṛ da ya hūm̐: bzhi pa de las klong lnga yum gyi mkha' klong gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i 'byung lnga la: sor rtog yi ge rim par shar: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: lnga pa rgyu'i he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: gdan steng yab yum sbyor ba'i sras: 'khor tshogs zhal phyag ma 'dres rdzogs: oṃ pad+ma sūr+ya ti ra bam̐: maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐ swa bhā haṃ swā hā: drug pa 'bras bu rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ las rlung : ram̐ las me ri kham̐ las chu:

sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ rus ri: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rdzogs: dbus su mdzes tog phyi rol gur: mtshan tshang drag po'i pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bdun pa brten pa dkyil 'khor gsum las/ dang po bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du las: che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: bco brgyad phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin: gri gug ral gri dbyug to dang : rdo rje tho ba gsal shing khyung : 'khor lo nor bu bcas pa g.yas: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ thong gshol rnga: lcags sgrog rgyu ma dril bu zhags: phur pa dang bcas g.yon du bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs brgyad khro rol gyad kyi 'gros: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: gri thod drug bcas mgul 'khyud stob: sku las skyes pa'i me ri 'bar: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka ru: nī laṃ mchod rten sngon po'i dbus: bum pa'i gzhal yas lte ba'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : ma hā badz+ra ku mā ra: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: mthing dkar dmar ba'i rngam zhal brjid: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : rdo rje thod khrag stob te 'khril: thugs kar sems dpa' srog yig bcas: mi bzad 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

gnyis pa sras sogs khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bkod pa ni/ hūm̐: yab yum rdo rje pad+ma'i tog: bu ga'i yi ge dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zung 'jug bde stong rol pa las: hūm̐ bzhi baṃ bzhi sras su shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs te khrag 'thung bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad dbal: rtse dgu rtse lnga me kha ṭ+wāṃ: phyag gi mtha' gnyis phur pa bsgril: rigs bzhi yum 'khril sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgur gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: yab yum gsang ba'i bu ga nas: hūm̐ yig baṃ yig phyogs bcur 'phros: khro bcu yab yum mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phra thabs gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti dā sha ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsum pa 'khor tshogs bka' sdod kyi dkyil 'khor phra thabs tshul du bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: slar yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bar ba'i gar: phur skyong nyer bzhi mi bzad tshogs: yang 'khor sprul sogs so sor gsal: oṃ ma ti kro ti ghṛ wa lak+ṣi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ brgyad pa dbang bskur byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: ye shes phur pa bskyed pa'i lha: gsal rdzogs mi g.yo brtan pa'i phyir: deng 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag dpal chen phur pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ bcu pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin brtan pa'i rgyud rtsal lha: bzhugs mdzad dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs can: gdod nas ma bcos rang byung ba: rol pa'i khrag 'thung che la 'dud:

oṃ sarba tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na maḥsarba hāṃ sa pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gcig pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang po'i 'bras bu tshim byed pa: lha mo sna tshogs phyi mchod 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi mchog: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa khā hi: bcu gsum pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rig ma bcu drug mi phyed sbyor: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mchog: dug lnga rnam dag sman mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/ kun bzang yab yum che mchog he ru kaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu phra thabs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad sgo skyong chen mo bzhi/ /shwa na sa bdag re ti ging bdud la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ 'bar ba'i pho nya gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /rol pa bco brgyad bka' gter srung ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ bco lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das rgyud drug bsgral ba yi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bcu drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phung po lnga nyid ye shes su: bsgyur ba'i ba ling mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu bdun pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: nyams chag bskang dang bshags phyir 'bul: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ

bco brgyad pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yul bskang bya mi dmigs pa: kho na de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: oṃ sarba dharma swa bhā wa pū dza hoḥ bcu dgu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: che btsan yang dag he ru kaḥ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: bco brgyad mtshon chas dug lnga gzhom: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' la bgrad: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' bar 'gro: dor stabs zhabs kyis ri rab brdzis: sbyor ba'i yum chen shwa rī ma: bde stong zung 'jug gri thod bsnams: rgyan drug rol pa'i gar stabs can: dpal chen yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: thugs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa po: khro bo'i zhal rab gdangs shing rngam: phyag mtshan drug gis rig sngags gcod: rdo rje sgro gzengs me char 'bebs: dgyes pa'i dur khrod chas dang ldan: dor stabs 'gying zhing dpa' rab 'chang : 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rtsa 'jib ma: khams kun g.yo ba'i zhal mnga' ma: zung 'jug thabs shes 'khyud pa mo: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sgra 'byin ma: drug gis sbyor ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde chen g.yo zhing g.yo ba mo: thugs mchog yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mchog: sems dpa' rdo rje'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol ba: las bzhi'i phrin las dpal yon gyis: mi zad lta ba'i gar 'gyed pa: rigs bzhi'i sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa chen po khyon gyi rtse: khyab cing sgeg bzhad ston pa po: sa bcu'i lam ni rab bgrod pa: yab yum khro bcur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zer gyis snang tshul cho 'phrul gyis: khyon ltar lta ba yangs shing 'geng : 'bebs pa rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: phra thabs phur 'debs phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nyer bzhi sa yi rim pa bdun: shes rab gcig la thabs drug gi: skur ston gar sgyur nyi shu brgyad:

dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: skye mched gnas gsum gzhir dag pa'i: rol rtsal za byed mche ba dmar: las su grub pa'i ma mo'i tshogs: ma sring bcu gnyis khyod la bstod: hūm̐: las mdzad mā ra ya yi tshul: sna tshogs sde dpon gtso dang 'khor: za gsod dbugs la rngam byed tshogs: bcu gnyis sde dpon khyod la bstod: hūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje yi: rtsal gyis sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: srid gsum 'geng ba'i las byed pa: yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: nyi shu pa dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings mthing nag e klong nas: khrag 'thung rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dang : yang dag he ru ka yi gtso 'khor bcas: gdul dka' 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs shig: snang srid 'khor 'das gzugs can gzugs med dang : kun bzang thugs dang 'jag ma'i srin bu yan: snang gzugs thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad kī li'i drag sngags sgra: dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ting nge 'dzin: yin min ngos bzung bral ba'i dbyings chen por: the tshom zad pas bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: re dogs bral ba'i chos nyid klong du bzla: bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag nyid che mchog thugs ka ru/ /nī lam mchod rten sngon po yi/ /bum dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu brjid/ /de yi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi/ /rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag /mtha' bskor khrag 'thung snying pos bskor/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus/ /'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /snod bcud khro bo rol pa yi/ /lha sngags ye shes 'byams klas gyur/ yang dag gi rtsa bsnyen/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phur pa'i bsnyen pa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ spyi dril gyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti kī li kī la ya sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ

gsang ba hūm̐ gi sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kham nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: khro gtum tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: g.yas gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i ban bon 'joms: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog snying phral: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po rdul du rlog: sgro gshog spu gri brgyangs pa yis: snang srid kun gyi cho 'phrul zlog: 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad kyis: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gyis: dam sri 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham gyis: stong khams ru tra'i srog dbugs phral: sku la me dpung 'khrigs pa yis: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bsreg: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: khro rgyal stobs ldan kī la ya: bdud 'dul dpal gyi sku ru shar: dbang sdud zil gnon lhun gyis grub: bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: grags stong ngang du ci nus bzlas: las sbyor gyi khyad par srung zlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes srung dmigs gtso bo bya la srung sngags rtsa ba'i bcu cha tsam bya/ smad las kyi skabs ma yin na gsham gsal bzlog bsad kyi dmigs pa'ang 'dir bya/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya dang rten snying brjod/ mchod bstod ni/

oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thun bar gtor 'bul bya bar 'dod na/ gtor rdzas bdud rtsis bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ bdag nyid dpal chen thugs las spros pa yi/ /yaṃ raṃ keṃ las rlung me thod sgyed steng*/ /a las bhan+dha chos dbyings mnyam pa'i nang*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyor steng gi mkhar/ /'bru gsum gnas pa'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med pa'i/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla med byang chub sgrub pa por/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud 'dul ba'i/ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ /chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ phyi mchod 'dod yon rgya mtsho dang*/ khyad par sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor los mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes sman raka dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/

ho/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po badz+ra ku mā ra phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dam can srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdong grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / cais 'dod don gsol/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i klong*/ /yang dag thugs mchog badz+ra he ru ka /chos kyi dbyings su gnyis med sbyor ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ cais bstod la/ hūm̐/ khyad par phrin las glog ltar myur ba yi/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis/ /gnyis med sprul pa sras mchog khro bcu'i sprin/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad phur srung bcu drug dang*/ /'bar ba'i pho nya gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /sngon tshe he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig sa ma ya/ /phyi nang gsang mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon tshogs/ thugs kyis gang bzhed de ltar shar ba'i mchod/ rig dang ma rig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags/ gnas skabs bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ bar chad kun sel phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs/

mthar thug bla med byang chub ma thob par/ ma yi bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin/ las kyi 'bras bu ma lus mchis par mdzod/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing rang lugs chos skyong gsol kha gzhan dang btsan gsol nas gzhi bdag bar spyi dang mtshungs so/ ༈ spyi yi sa bcad gnyis pa smad las drag po srung zlog gi rim pa mdun bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ bdag mdun dus gcig la 'jug pa dang*/ so sor dbye ba'i lugs srol gnyis so/ dang po ltar bdag mdun dus gcig la 'jug na brgyud 'debs nas bzung gzhung bsrangs nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi/ sa bon shar: oṃ hūm̐ baṃ dharma hṛ da ya hūm̐: bar bya la/ de nas bzlog gtor byin rlob ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang sogs nas ma ya lhan: zhes se gol gcig gis bdag mdun so sor me ri 'dab 'byar gyi tshul du ma yin par/ ye shes rtsal 'bar gyi tshul du bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i 'byung lnga la: sor rtog yi ge? nas spyan 'dren bzlas pa mchod bstod sogs bdag mdun cho ga gcig gis chog par bgyis pa yin no/ gnyis pa bdag mdun so sor dbye ba ni/ brgyud 'debs nas bzung gzhung ltar bdag bskyed bsnyen pa'i hūm̐ sgrub srung 'khor dang srung sngags gang mang bzla/ mchod bstod thun gtor gsol ka gtor 'bul bar song nas mdun bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ dang po mchod sngags kyi byin rlobs/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs: mdun gtor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: 'byung ba rim brtsegs dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil: keng rus gar bsgyur gcan gzan sna tshogs ngar: de dbus rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rngam stabs nag 'jigs me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: ru tra'i snying khar chos 'byung 'khor lo'i dbus: srid pa las kyi drag rdzas 'dus pa yi: dmar nag gtor ma dbal ldan ri rab tsam: drag po rtsang dang sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: rno dbal thog dang myur mgyogs rlung gi shugs: phyi ni gtor ma nang ni khro bo'i mkhar: ru tra'i snying las grub pa'i pho brang gyur: de dbus ti ra bam chen bsnol ba yi: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i nyi zla gdan du gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr+ya ti ra baṃ tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya lhan: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam sogs nas hūm̐ sgrub bar bdag bskyed dang mtshungs/ bsrung dmigs khyug tsam dang gtso bo bsad bzlog dmigs pa 'bog pa las bsad dmigs ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan:

zhes bsad sngags dang*/ zlog dmigs ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru ka: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas la sngar gyi srung ba'i bcu cha bsad bzlog dang thal rdeb bya/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: thun gtor 'bul/ de nas smad las dngos la 'jug pa la/ tshogs mchod kyi rim pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de la thog mar na raka skong bshags dang rig 'dzin srog sgrub rang lugs ltar song la tshogs mchod skong bshags bar bya/ tshogs bsgral mi dgos/ de nas smad las la 'jug pa ni/ slob dpon zhwa gos dang bcas drag po'i chas su zhugs la rol mo drag rdung dang dar nag g.yab/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i klong nyid las: ma 'gag gzugs sku ci yang 'char ba'i gar:

ma g.yel bzhengs shig rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs: drag po mngon spyod las kyi dpung mdzod cig: gnyis pa dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: lan gsum/ gsum pa bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral by-i'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bzhi pa bsgral bya hom khung bskyed pa ni: e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: rang mdun las kyi gshin rje'i hom khung du: nṛ tri yongs gyur dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: las kyi dbang gis phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon tshogs: sha rul sbrang ma 'khor bzhin 'du bar gyur: lnga pa rnam shes rten la 'gugs pa ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : khyad par yang phur lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: ma rungs sems can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur kun: srid pa gsum gyi gab khung gar gnas kyang : skad cig yud kyis dmigs rten 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs sarba nṛ triḥ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gsum sogs grangs rtags sbyar/ bkug nas thar med gnad du gzir ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab:

bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: khug cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ lcags kyus gzir: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: dbyer med chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: zhags pas chings: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho tra baṃ: lcags sgrog gis bsdam: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: myos par gyis shig badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dril bus myos: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: lha dang phrol cig pra be sha ya phaṭḥ sgro zung gis dbye: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: gnad du phob cig a be sha ya aḥ gu gul dang dug khrag gis dbab: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: rdul du rlogs shig badz+ra sha ru raṃ: yungs dkar gyis brab bo: drug pa bsgral bar thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub dur khrod chen po nas: 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: yang dag phur pa'i lha tshogs dus la bab: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: ma g.yel bzhengs shig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bdun pa gnad nas bskul zhing phur bu lhar gsal gdab: tshe khrus dgongs pas 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral:

hūm̐: nga ni rang byung don gyi he ru ka'i: lag gnyis rigs lnga'i sbyor mtshams hūm̐ yig las: sras mchog phur bus srid gsum thal bar 'byin: g.yas su 'dril bas pho rgyud las la 'gyed: g.yon du 'dril bas mo rgyud gnad nas bskul: steng du bskor bas bdag 'khor yongs su bsrung : sked la bskor bas nus mthu phyir mi ldog: mdun du 'dril bas dgra bgegs srog rtsa 'dren: btab pas lha yang rung ste thal bar brlag: hūm̐: chos dbyings 'bar ba gsum gyi 'od zer gyis: las ngan sgrib pa sbyongs shig kī la ya: rnam shes a yig dkar po'i rnam pa ru: chos kyi dbyings su drongs shig kī la ya: tshe bsod nṛ ljang bh+rūm̐ ser rnam pa ru: dwangs ma bdag la drongs shig kī la ya: khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags bshig pa'i phyir: rten gzhi sgrol cig badz+ra kī la ya: drag sngags so lnga brjod cing phur bu bskor zhing 'dril/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: phur bu gsum gzir bas sgrib pa sbyang : a s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ phur bus yar drangs 'khor ba gnas nas spar: nṛ bh+rūm̐ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: phur bu snying khar reg la dwangs ma bsdu: gnas lnga dang ni yan lag bzhir gdab pas: bag chags las kyi rten gzhi rtsad nas bshig: brgyad pa ral gris phung po dum bur gtub pa ni: hūm̐: rno ngar shes rab 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dis: ma rig phung khams bag chags dbyings su phral: drag po dpal gyi dam rdzas bla na med: stong gsum rab 'byams sha khrag dmar chen bskyil: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ dgu pa rdo rje tho bas phye mar brdung ba ni: hūm̐: shes rab e dbyings 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: thabs mchog bde chen rdo rjes gnyis med brdung :

a 'thas gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i lnga phung rdzas: bdag med chos kyi dbyings su gzhig par bya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bcu pa lha tshogs kyi zhal du bstab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phung khams sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: bstan srung dregs tshogs bcas pas lhag med rol: dgra bgegs thal bar brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: bcu gcig pa bsgral rdzas bam gyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bla na med: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams pa 'dis: rtsa gsum srung ma bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang : khyad par drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di: gang la dmigs pa'i dgra gdon dbyer med pa: dgyes par bzhes la lo zlar ma 'gyang bar: ma rungs rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang : dgra gdon rmang nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: thugs dam skong zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bsdus grangs bsags nas mthar tshogs la rol/ bcu gnyis pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya dang bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan bye ba 'bum: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhal du bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: yang phur 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ tshogs kyi sogs smon lam gdab/ gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcu gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra la zor gyi las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu bzhi pa/ las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: dar nag gzengs shing dpal chas bsham: bzlog par dug khrag rak+tas bran: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: gdong la khrag zhag thig les brgyan: drag po'i rnga ni chems 'gros brdung : gri rkang gling bu drag tu 'bud: bskyed pa'i lha srung 'khor bcas rnams: go gyon mtshon thogs dmag dpung bskyed: rbad pas las kun 'grub par bsam: gsungs pa ltar zhwa nag gyon/ rol mo drag rdung dang bcas gtor chung dang liṅga bshams la/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: yang dag dpal chen khro bo khrag 'thung tshogs: bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal deng 'dir phyungs: mdzes 'dzum bzhad gshe dpa' ba'i mdangs ston la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku'i rang mdangs drag po 'gyed pa'i tshe: skye med hūm̐ sgra drag po 'u ru ru: ka dag zang thal glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dran rig ma 'gag ser ba hri li li: byin rlabs nus rtsal thog rgod sha ra ra: stong nyid mtshon cha drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes lnga ldan me ri wa la la: stobs bcu thugs rje'i tshwa tshwa si li li: rol rtsal sgyu ma'i pho nya sha ra ra: dug lnga sgrol ba'i ging chen nyi li li: rigs drug sa bon bsregs pa'i me zhags 'khyugs: rang rtsal rol pa'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rigs drug sa bon sreg pa'i dus la bab: skye gnas sgo bzhi gcod pa'i dus la bab:
