las ngan duḥkha sbyong ba'i dus la bab: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i dus la bab: sdig can btsan thabs 'pho ba'i dus la bab: sems can ngan song gnas su shor ra re: tha mal 'jig rten dbang du gtong ra re: bskul lo rbad do 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: mtha' med sems can drongs mdzod las la bh+yoḥ mdun du drag po'i lcags snod du gtor chung liṅga sha dum bcas bshams la bsgral nas mchod/ thog mar hom bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: las mkhan pho nyas bzung ste mi shor bar: mnan cing bsdams nas myos pa'i rang bzhin gyur: de nas 'gugs bstim ni: phaṭḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: dpal chen che mchog lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: byad ma dgra bgegs log 'dren gnod byed rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: rno dbal 'debs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sgrol cing gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dzi bī nṛ tri mā ra tshin+dha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces gtub la bzlog par stob cing*/ bco lnga pa che mchog yang dag zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi gtor zlog ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam pa'i gtum zhal bgrad: zhe gnyis phyag gis zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: dbyings kyi yum chen kro ti shwa ri 'khyud: rab tu 'bar ba'i me dpung dbus su 'gyings: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis: ngan 'gror ltung ba'i skye sgo bzlog tu gsol: byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad yab yum gyis: ma dag srid par 'khyams pa bzlog tu gsol: brgya byin la sogs sbyong byed thub drug gis: gnas ngan len pa'i sdug sngal bzlog tu gsol: rnam par smin sogs rig 'dzin chen po lngas: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis: rtsa thig dbang thang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: khro rgyal chen po rigs bzhi 'khor bcas kyis: pha rol byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: kau rī ma sogs gnas kyi ma brgyad kyi: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: siṃ ha la sogs phra men brgyad rnams kyis: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: sgo skyong khro bo khro mo'i tshogs bcas kyis: nad gdon bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol/ phyogs skyong 'dul byed chen po 'khor bcas kyis: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: ce spyang ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi kha rlangs bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bzlog drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha tra tsa tur dā sha kro ta he ru ka pañtsa dā sha ya ma tri sa ma ya duḥkha mā ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog:

bcu drug pa phur pa'i bskul gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras: khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbyings phyug bcas: sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed: rngam gtum gshe zhing mi bzad skur ston pa: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen drag po las la sku bskyod tshe: sku mdog mun nag dud sprin chi li li: dbu skra dug rlangs sngo dmar phyu ru ru: 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gad mo 'u ru ru: mtshon cha'i rtse la glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dur khrod chas la me yi ser ba 'dril: khro bo'i dmag tshogs thog mda' sha ra ra: khro mo'i dmag tshogs tshwa tshwa si li li: las mkhan myur mgyogs bshan pa khyugs se khyug: bya gcan sha za srog len zhungs se zhung : gzhan yang 'khor tshogs sprul pa 'bum dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra sgos dgra 'joms pa'i dus la bab: ban bon byad zor bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma rungs dmag tshogs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: sdig can dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra gtong ra re: bskul lo mthu rtsal skyed cig dgra la bh+yo: bcu bdun pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi bzlog pa ni/ mdun du drag po'i lcags snod du gtor chung liṅga sha dum bcas bshams la/ thog mar hom bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: las mkhan pho nyas bzung ste mi shor bar: mnan cing bsdams nas myos pa'i rang bzhin gyur: de nas 'gugs bstim ni: phaṭḥ

mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: dpal chen che mchog lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: byad ma dgra bgegs log 'dren gnod byed rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: rno dbal 'debs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sgrol cing gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dzi bī nṛ tri mā ra tshin+dha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtub la bzlog par stob cing*/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra: sku mdog mthing nag rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo: dbu gsum phyag drug rab 'jigs mtshon cha gdengs/ rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog 'od kyis 'gengs: dur khrod chas brgyad snang srid zil gyis gnon: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum byad ma ru tra brdzis: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: khro bo rol pa'i gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbang phyug bcas/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs/ /phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐/ dpal chen che mchog yab kyi thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan steng du/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu che/ /dbu dgu rngam pas srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /steng 'og bar gsum gdon bgegs dgra la zlog /bco brgyad mtshon chas log 'dren zil gyis gnon/

/snang srid byad phur sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa yis/ /gdong sder rwa mchu lto 'gros ltas ngan zlog /rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis/ /gza' dang rgyu skar byad kha dgra la zlog /zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum sde brgyad dam la bzhag /sde brgyad 'byung po'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog /rgyas 'debs yum 'khyud ma mo bran du 'khol/ /snang srid ma mo'i sun kha dgra la zlog hūm̐: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: snang srid yongs kyi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: ye shes khro bcu yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: phyogs skyong bcu yi byad zor bzlog tu gsol: phra men za gsod phur 'debs nyi shu yis: mi rung cho 'phrul sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad gyis: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcigabazlog tu gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi sgo ma rigs bzhi yis/ /skal med the tshom log lta bdud rigs zlog /bka' skyong ma mo bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: dpal gyi bka' nyan ging chen bcu gnyis kyis: mi 'dod than ltas sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnam nas thog rgod lhung ba zlog: sa nas dug gzer langs pa zlog: bar nas dgra sdang 'gyu ba zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa zlog: mtshams nas byur 'dre langs pa zlog: mi kha phung sbyor ngan pa zlog: phug gi lha la gnod pa zlog: bar gyi mi la gnod pa zlog: sgo yi nor la gnod pa zlog: mchan gyi bu la gnod pa zlog: gtan gyi grogs la gnod pa zlog: yul mkhar zhing la gnod pa zlog: srid dang g.yang la gnod pa zlog: mi 'dod rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha ngan pa zlog: sme ba klung rta nyams pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog:

mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du nan zlog: ya ma du nan zlog: ra tsa du nan zlog: yak+sha rbad nan zlog: ma tri bh+yo nan zlog: du ru du ru ya zlog: ha la tsakra ya zlog: rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: bzlog bzlog: ces zlog sngags lan gsum mam bdun bklag go khyad par byad stems than dang ltas ngan la sogs gang byung la dmigs gtad bcas te bzlog pa bya'o/ ༈ yang phur gtor zlog grangs mang gsog skabs rgyas pa mi lcogs par 'di ltar bya ste/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbang phyug bcas/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs/ /phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra mu stegs ngan sngags dang*/ /ban bon byad zor mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la log 'dren zhing bcu'i rigs/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /lo zla spar sme rlung rta'i skag chen sogs/ /dus min 'chi ba'i skag rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /dar sri phung sri na sri 'chi sri dang*/ /god sri dgra gyod sri rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /nad rims dal yams rmi ltas pra rtags ngan/ /mi 'dod than ltas thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bar mtshams nas/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ e ka du nan zlog /ya ma du nan zlog /rā dza rbad nan zlog /yak+sha rbad nan zlog

/ma tri bh+yo nan zlog /du ru du nan ya zlog /ha la tsakra ya zlog /rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog /bzlog bzlog / ces stong bzlog grangs gsog ched ā yu'i ming gis so/ ༈ stong bzlog grangs gsog bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhi med rtsa bral don gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rang byung rig pa yang dag he ru kaḥ rig rtsal dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /bsal bzhag bral ba'i dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /mtshan 'dzin rnam rtog bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ /gnyis snang 'khrul pa ka dag dbyings su zlog /dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ye shes lnga ru sgyur/ /rig pa phur bu chos zad gdod ma'i klong*/ /ye grol chos sku'i bstan srid zin gyur cig zhes bsags/ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐/ sku gsum phur bu'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dug gsum bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /srid gsum 'khrul pa ka dag dbyings su zlog khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs las mdzod cig / ces pa'ang gu h+yas so/ brgya stong grang bsag grub nas/ bco brgyad pa bzlog dmigs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru ka: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas la chos skyong gi phrin bcol bya/ chad tho 'bul/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro brdung*/ mchod bstod bya/ bshags pa brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang*/

bkra shis brjod/ bsngo smon sogs rgyun gyi go rim yin no/ ༈ de nas nyin tha ma 'phang ba drag po'i g.yul 'gyed ces bya ba gtor rdzongs nyin par/ bzlog pa grangs gsog grub pa dang thal brdeb yan gong ltar song nas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: ces bzlog mchod rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces bstod/ yul 'gar bzlog dbang zhu srol ltar na/ dngos grub len pa ni/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: srog ltar mi gtong bsgrubs lags na: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: oṃ sarba gar+bha sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes brjod la zlog dbang zhu/ spro bar mos na srin mo za lam yang phur gzhung ltar 'dir bya/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs nam mkhar btegs la/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas: skabs der srung zlog 'khor lo kha bsgyur/ mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: drag sngags/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri: sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ ces grangs mang bzlas shing 'dus pa gral mthar nas brtsam zhal phu zhus pas thun zor gyi rdzas la sngags kyi rno ngar btags/ de ltar gtor chen drag po'i zor du bsgrubs la/ skabs 'dir gsol kha mthar dbyung*/ sde brgyad gser skyems sngon du 'gro la/ dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral by-i'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis dgug pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

de nas chad mdo'i gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : khyad par yang phur lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: ma rungs sems can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur kun/ srid pa gsum gyi khab bskung gar gnas kyang*/ skad cig yud kyis dmigs rten 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs sarba nṛ triḥ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen ma la mchims phu ru: rgyal kun 'dus pa yab yum gyis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gter srung khas blangs chad mdo bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes gtor ma dmag lto'i tshul du zor chen du stob/ zor lam bsal ba ni/ hoḥ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bslu med dkon mchog gsum: brgyud pa dgu ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par yang phur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : brgyud gsum dregs sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sde brgyad spyi dang de ring zor lam du: gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre ma lus rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes zor lam dgra la phyes: sgo bas sgo phyes 'phrang bas 'phrang sol cig: khyed rnams sku bzur rang rang dmag bsdus la: drag po las kyi g.yul ngo dgra la sprod: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas 'joms par mdzod: bgegs dpung phye mar thal ba rdul du rlog: lha tshogs thugs dam zor du bskul ba ni: hoḥ nyon cig bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: rdo rje'i thog chen ha la nag po che: me 'od mtshon thun dug rlangs nad sprin 'khrigs: gtor zor gnyan po sdang ba'i dgra la ya: gnam lcags thog char gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: zor gyi lam phyes rang rang dmag bsdus la: ma g.yel drag po zor gyi dpung la bzhengs: phyogs bcu'i bla ma dkon mchog dpang du bzhugs:

bdud 'dul khro rgyal rnams kyi mthu stobs bskyed: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis steng nas non: phyogs skyong sde brgyad dmag dpung mtha' nas bskor: klu srin sa bdag gdug pas 'og nas 'degs: ma mo dmag zor rgyal mos zor sna drongs: srin mo za lam ma yis sde brgyad kyi: rang rang keg bsgyur zor lam dgra la sgyur: sngon tshe dpal chen po yi bka' ma bcag: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam ma bral: drag po zor gyi dmag dpung dgra la bh+yoḥ thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rkang gling sngon du lan gsum btang*/ de nas zhwa gos sbreng 'chor rol mo dang bcas ru dar sgrengs/ gtor chen btegs/ ser sbreng gis mdun bsus la slob dpon gyis rting bdas nas 'phen sar 'byor ba dang slob dpon gyi phyag tu dar nag dang gser skyems phul la/ spro na 'cham stabs dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: lan gsum/ bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab khung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral by-i'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bsgral bya hom khung bskyed pa ni/ bca' 'ben hom tshang du liṅga mgo mjug ldog ste sbyar/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: rang mdun las kyi gshin rje'i hom khung du:

nṛ tri yongs gyur dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: las kyi dbang gis phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon tshogs: sha rul sbrang ma 'khor bzhin 'du bar gyur: rnam shes rten la 'gugs pa ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : khyad par yang phur lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: ma rungs sems can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur kun: srid pa gsum gyi gab khung gar gnas kyang : skad cig yud kyis dmigs rten 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥdagra bgegs sarba nṛ triḥ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes 'gug gzhug drag po lan gsum byas la 'ben du dmigs bya bkug cing lha tshogs thugs dam zor du bskul ba ni/ hoḥ nyon cig bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: rdo rje'i thog chen ha la nag po che: me 'od mtshon thun dug rlangs nad sprin 'khrigs: gtor zor gnyan po sdang ba'i dgra la ya: gnam lcags thog char gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: zor gyi lam phyes rang rang dmag bsdus la: ma g.yel drag po zor gyi dpung la bzhengs: phyogs bcu'i bla ma dkon mchog dpang du bzhugs: bdud 'dul khro rgyal rnams kyi mthu stobs bskyed: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis steng nas non: phyogs skyong sde brgyad dmag dpung mtha' nas bskor: klu srin sa bdag gdug pas 'og nas 'degs: ma mo dmag zor rgyal mos zor sna drongs: srin mo za lam ma yis sde brgyad kyi: rang rang keg bsgyur zor lam dgra la sgyur: sngon tshe dpal chen po yi bka' ma bcag: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam ma bral: drag po zor gyi dmag dpung dgra la bh+yoḥ thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: sde brgyad kyi thun zor so sor rdzas rnams kha phral ba zur gsal ltar ram/ zor thun 'dus pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: sde brgyad 'bum gyis thun zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya:

yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya: sarba rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ zhes zor dpung dang*/ rgyas par spro na sde brgyad so sor kha phral ba ni/ thun zor thogs la/ aḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: lha dmag 'bum gyis thun zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: aḥdhe wa rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ khram zor thogs la/ yaḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: gshin rje 'bum gyis khram zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: ya ma rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ khrag zor thogs la/ maḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: ma mo 'bum gyis khrag zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: ma mo rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ thod zor thogs la/ duḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: bdud dmag 'bum gyis thod zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: duḥpra ma rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ yungs zor thogs la/ ruḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: rgyal po 'bum gyis yungs zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: ruḥrā dza rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ mda' zor thogs la/ tsaḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: btsan dmag 'bum gyis mda' zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya:

yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: tsaḥshu la rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ spro na mda' gzhu dngos kyang 'phen/ rdo zor thogs la/ shaḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: gnod sbyin 'bum rdo zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: shaḥyak+sha rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ dug zor thogs la/ naḥbh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: klu dmag 'bum gyis dug zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: naḥn ga rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ gtor zor thogs la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: bka' sdod 'bum gyis gtor zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya: sarba rak+sha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la drag brdeg bya/ de nas dngos gzhi dpal gyi gtor chen btegs la/ hūm̐: nga ni rang byung don gyi he ru kaḥ drag po dpal gyi gtor zor gnyan po 'di: bstan dgra bdud sde'i dpung dang bcas la ya: dgra bgegs dpung tshogs thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces drag sngags kyi dmod brjod bzhin gtor chen me hom du 'phang la dgra bgegs dpung 'joms kyi rol mo drag tu brdung*/

yang na dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ slar yang drag rol dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbang phyug bcas/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs/ /phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra mu stegs ngan sngags dang*/ /ban bon byad zor mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la log 'dren zhing bcu'i rigs/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /lo zla spar sme rlung rta'i skag chen sogs/ /dus min 'chi ba'i skag rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /dar sri phung sri na sri 'chi sri dang*/ /god sri dgra gyod sri rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /nad rims dal yams rmi ltas pra rtags ngan/ /mi 'dod than ltas thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bar mtshams nas/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ e ka du nan zlog ya ma du nan zlog rā dza rbad nan zlog yak+sha rbad nan zlog ma tri bh+yo nan zlog du ru du nan ya zlog ha la tsakra ya zlog rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog /bzlog bzlog /ces bzlog pa tshar gcig bskyar la thal mo brdab/ dpon slob kun kha tshur bskor zhing srung gur sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā:

slar kha phyir bskor nas bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: zhes bsad sngags dang*/ de nas zlog dmigs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru kaḥ grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas bzlog bsad dmigs pa thal brdeb bcas grub nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag par bya ba gal che ste/ gzhung las/ rig stong skye med don gyi he ru kaḥ lta ba'i gdeng bskyed stong nyid ngang la gnas: sgom pa'i gzengs bstod snang srid phyag rgyar bzhengs: spyod pa'i 'phrang grol re dogs dbyings su zhig: gzhom zhig mtshan bral don gyi srung 'khor bsgom: bar chad g.yul rgyal don gnyis mtha' ru phyin: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ der tho zhig gi ngor khroṃ yig bris pa kha phyir bstan bslangs nas 'di ltar brjod do/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'byung po phyir 'brang khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: phyin chad ldang bar ma gyur cig: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing slob dpon dang po byas te sgo drung du slebs pa dang*/

bzlog gzhong sbub/ bshal chu gtor mar stob la brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan gar mkhan mas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: gtor gzhong kha sbub nas/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 'gugs pa drag po dang bcas rnal 'byor pa rnams lag bsnol la mtheb chung phan tshun sbrel zhing bro ra bskor nas rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum ru tra mnan pa'i bro: khro bo khro mos chem chem brdungs: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: zhes rta bro brdung*/ gtor gzhong kha yar bslangs te me tog 'thor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod/ /hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol/ /trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mtha' btsan shog:

de nas/ lha rgyal lo rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes zer nas phye mar gyi sgo srung 'dzugs/ nang du log la bzhes skyems sogs phul/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs srog sa bon la nṛ yig dmar ljang gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyi 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs bcud/ nang sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor dwangs ma thams cad dang*/ gsang ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes dwangs bcud/ khyad par rang gi bla tshe srog gsum 'khyams pa/ yar ba/ 'thor ba/ sde brgyad kyis brkus 'phrog bcom pa/ ban bon mthu bo ches byad du bcug pa sogs thams cad 'od zer thig le kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par bsdus nas rang gi sgo gsum dang*/ mdun gyi tshe rdzas la thim pas bla tshe nyams pa gsos/ yar ba bsdus/ snying dbus dwangs ma'i thig le bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes btags pa bzla/ thun mthar tshe 'gugs ni/ mda' dar g.yab ste/ hūm̐/ bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /thugs rje nus pa mthu dang dpung bskyed la/ /'od zer pho nya phyag mtshan 'phro 'du yis/ /bdag gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*/ /'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud dwangs ma kun/ /'od zer thig le yig 'bru'i rnam par bkug /bdag la bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas/ /'chi med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ā yur+dzñā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: āḥ spros pas srid zhi kun la khyab/ /bsdus pas thig le nyag gcig klong*/ /'pho 'gyur med par rgyas btab pas/ /ye shes chen po'i srog thob gyur/ dharma dhā tu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa āḥ

tshe bum 'brang rgyas sogs rdzas yod na mched lcam rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ā yuḥṣe kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ā yuḥṣe wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ā yu ṣe tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dang gzhung ltar dngos grub bskul la dzap dbyangs dang bcas sku gsung thugs rten dang sgrub gtor rnams gnas gsum du gtugs la dngos grub bstim zhing dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi blud/ lus mi shigs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ ngag grags stong kī la ya'i rang sgra/ yid gsal stong gnyug ma'i rang babs su 'jog tu bcug ste me tog 'thor/ rjes kyi bya ba/ mchod bstod bshags pa brtan bzhugs bsdu rim dang bkra shis bsngo smon rgya yis gdab pa sogs las byang ltar shes par bya'o/ las kyi mtha' sdud mnan pa sogs las sbyor gzhan spro bar mos na zur du blta bar bya'o/ de dag gis nyin tha ma'i gtor rdzongs kyi rim pa rdzogs so/ ༈ spyi yi sa bcad gsu+um pa rjes tshogs kyi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ spro na na raka skong bshags dang*/ bsdu na brjod med don bshags/ bka' gsang rmad byung ma sogs sngon du 'gro bas rig 'dzin srog sgrub rang lugs ltar bya/ dang po tshogs byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshogs rdzas nyid: dngos 'dzin mi dmigs stong par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren no: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor byin chen phob: sgrub la dbang bskur mchog thun stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phyi nang khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs spyan gzigs lha mo'i gar: nang mchod sman raka gsang mchod sbyor sgrol tshogs: bla med bde ba chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: ye nas rang byung blo 'das ka dag phyir: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : zung 'jug ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i phyir: gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : ma bcos lhun grub yon tan kun 'byung phyir: dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'od gsal dbyings las 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: rdo rje gzhon nu'i yab yum thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul drwa ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i phyir: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon phyir: ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag phyir: phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes thabs mkhas sna tshogs cir yang ston: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : tshad med bzhi ldan 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir: sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi gnas su dag pa'i phyir: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i skye gnas rnam bzhi'i sgo gcod phyir: re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : rigs drug lam rim gzhi ru 'dren pa'i phyir: sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi ma rig gnas su mthar byed pa: 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med lhun grub phyir: bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : kun nas thams cad chos sku'i rol rtsal phyir:

sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ lnga pa bshags pa bsdus pa ni/ hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang*/ drug pa tshogs bsgral ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan bye ba 'bum: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhal du bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: yang phur 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ tshogs kyi sogs smon lam gdab/ ces dang gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brgyad pa bskul ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra la zor gyi las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: mjug tu chos skyong gi gtor 'bul nyung bsdus gsham gsal dang mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pas gtor ma 'bul/

dgu pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen ma la mchims phu ru: rgyal kun 'dus pa yab yum gyis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gter srung khas blangs chad mdo bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan gar mkhan mas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: gtor gzhong kha sbub la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa rang rgya dang bcas/ bcu gcig pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum ru tra mnan pa'i bro: khro bo khro mos chem chem brdungs: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bslang skabs slob dpon gyis phyag 'bru gtor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod/ /hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol/ /trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthu btsan shog / bcu gnyis pa dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags dpal: brtan g.yo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter:

bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: gnyis pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar song nas/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: mi dmigs dkyil 'khor ka dag dbyings: rang bzhin ye shes klong du ho: a a āḥ sa mi dmigs par mnyam par bzhag oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ slar ldang la go bgo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /bzhi pa bsngo smon ni/ rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtsho nyid: mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: bde dge mchog gsum 'dus pa yi: thugs rje'i smon lam der 'grub shog: lnga pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ ye dharmā sogs/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong dgu'i gter chen gyis: zab rgyas 'gro kun smin mdzad pa: deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o/ de ltar bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ las byang 'bring po phrin las rgyun khyer smad las gtor zlog dang bcas pa bklag chog tu spel ba bdud 'dul zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams chos bzhin skyong ba'i dpal ldan lho 'brug chos kyi rgyal po'i khab shar phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi nang gses bkra shis g.yang rtse'i mchod rten chen po ru rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me mo yos/ phyi lo 1987lor gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa zung gi rnam 'phrul gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus dang gter kha gong ma'i smin grol 'bul gnang gyi sgo dbye'i thog mar steng khang du sku dgongs kyi sgrub chen dang 'og khang du yang phur sgrub mchod gtor zlog rdor sems bcas 'du tshogs mdzad de ma 'ongs ched/

srol 'dzugs gnang skabs gang nyid kyi zhal nas yang phur rgyas pa ni rgyas drag yi ge yang dbu med las med stabs 'brug pa rnams la khag po 'dug /des na las byang 'bring po dang smad las khro chu'i zhun thigs sbyar te gong 'og mthun sdeb byas na snyam ste ngas par skrun byas pa yin pas 'di ga 'drar 'dug ces kho bor bka' 'dri gnang song bas de bzhin byung na ma 'ongs par kun la phan par 'dug pas thugs rjes gzigs par zhu zhus pa'i nyin shas rjes/ 'di spros bcas dbyangs rol la sbyar na byin 'bebs dang tshogs mchod skong sogs tshig rkang zung re las med stabs mi bde bar 'dug pas des na gzhung nas kha skong lugs 'di ltar bgyis na zhes sogs bka' stsal dang*/ de bzhin chog khrigs gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa mdzad kyang rang re'i bsod nams kyis phangs nas chog sgrigs ma thub par lus/ 'on kyang da bar de bzhin zhal gsung ltar 'don srol dar khyab byung yang rgyas bsdus sogs mi 'dra ba ci rigs byung 'dug pas slad rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug lo phyi lo 2004lor bla ma skal ldan nas sbyin bdag mdzad de snying thig ya bzhi'i smin grol 'bog pa'i dus mnyam du btsan mkhar slob khang du 'brug bstan spyi'i sku rim la dmigs te yang phur gtor zlog skabs gter chen bla ma'i zhal slob sku dgongs tshogs sde'i dbu 'dzin rdor slob bsod nams rdo rje mchog dang tshe mtshams pa sgrub dpon bla ma ngag dbang rdo rje zung nas bzlog pa sogs cung zad rgyas spros go rim 'don chog mar gsar bsdeb thub na slob gsar rnams la ches phan thogs 'byung bar 'dug pas cis kyang grub pa gnang bar zhu zhes nan bskul dang lhag par sgrub dpon bla ma gang nyid nas 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub sogs mdzad rgyu'i khas len bcas zhus nan byung ngor/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid gyi smin grol zab gtad dang bcas bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal zhes bstsal ba'i skal bzang thob kyang don du rang nyams ma son pa'i byis pa mdo khams pa gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin zhes 'bod pas rtsa ba gter chen bdud 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i dgongs pa gzhir bzung thog bzlog gzhung gi bcud bsdus te cung zad spros pa bcas rab gnas chu lug lo'i zla ba 12tshes 9nyin btsan mkhar slob khang du zin bris btab nas slar yang bal yul yang le shod phur pa gling du grub par bgyis pa'i dge bas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// ༄༅/ /bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang phur srung nyer bzhi'i gtor 'bul mnga' gsol bka' gter thun mong gcig dril bzhugs so/ gu ru badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ phur srung mchod par snod gang rung gi nang du/ gtor ma gzhung bzhin rgyas par grub na rab yang na lha grangs kyi bshos bu sha khrag gis brgyan pa gser skyems la 'bru sna tshogs gnas skabs su ci 'byor bsham/ yang phur dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring gang 'os kyi rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i ting 'dzin gsal bzhin nas 'di skad do/

hūm̐ bh+yo/ rang nyid che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra/ /rab 'jigs zhal gsum phyag drug dpal chas rdzogs/ /yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis med 'khril/ /dam sri bdud dpung tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal/ /g.yas dkar sgeg pa gshin rje gshed po'i zhal/ /bswe mo mched bzhi'i klad khrag 'dren par byed/ /g.yon dmar dpa' ba rta mgrin rgyal po'i zhal/ /shwa na bzhi yi mgrin sogs gcod par byed/ /dbus mthing 'jigs rung bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i zhal/ /bdag nyid bzhi yi tsit+ta 'dren par byed/ de phyir dbang phyug phur skyong dam la 'dus/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dam mnos shing*/ /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung nas kyis/ /bal yul a su ra yi brag phug tu/ /yang phur gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor snying po grub pa'i tshe/ /bdud rtsi dbang rtags byin nas bka' bsgos ltar/ /chu mig byang chub ring dang bal bod mtshams/ /mon kha sha 'ug gter gnas la sogs su/ /yang phur sgrub pa'i grogs su khas blangs pa'i/ /dbang phyug phur srung lcam dral thams cad kyis/ /sngon gyi g.yar dam tha tshig dran mdzod la/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes las bzhi'i phrin las mdzod/ dbang phyug ma sring nyer brgyad gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dpal gyi bka' nyan dbang mo nyer brgyad ni/ /srin mo tshangs ma lha chen stag gdong dkar/ /gzhon nu rgyal byin rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi zla ba be con ser/ /srin mo za ba rin chen zhags pa bsrings/ /dga' ba stobs chen rdo rje 'dod pa dmar/ /nor srung rlung lha pad+ma lcags sgrog mdzad/ /gsod byed mi mo phag mo rgan byed ljang*/ /sna chen chu lha rgya gram dril 'dzin bran/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi ma sring mdza' bran mo/ /dkar ser dmar ljang bdud bzhi nyi shu brgyad/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /phra men dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/

/bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis gtor 'bul ni/ thog mar g.yas zhal gshin rje'i 'dul byar gyur pa'i bswe mo bzhi'am sa bdag ma bzhi ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ yang phur bstan srung ma sring bcu gnyis ni/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ /nam gyi tho rangs dam bcas bswe mo bzhi/ /bdud po bkrag med gza' rgod byi ti pa/ /btsan rje shu ba klu rgyal 'jog po yi/ /bu mo rnam bzhi bal phug nyi ma khu/ kha la rong dang mang yul la phreng dang*/ /snye nam sde'u gnas su mar khu dang*/ khrag zhag 'o ma'i mtsho la brten bcas pa'i/ /ya byin de byin bswe byin phag byin la/ /las byed myur mgyogs chen mo sa bdag bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / bdag nyid ma bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ni/ dbus zhal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'i re ti bzhi'am bdag nyid bzhi ni/ nam gyi gung la dam bcas bdag nyid bzhi/ /rgya mtsho'i klong las me 'bar rdzu 'phrul ston/ /bying byed 'brug la brten bca' re ma ti/ /bar snang g.yo la sa gzhi khams kun 'gul/ /'byung ba g.yo la brten bca' re ma dza/ /ri rab g.yo dang lhun po 'gul bar byed/ /srid pa'i rtse la brten bca' re ma tri/ /dbang chen bsgul zhing zhing rdul snyil bar byed/ /mchog rab khong seng brten bca' re ma bh+yo/ /snang srid bdag mo re ti mched bzhi la/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / g.yon zhal dmar po'i rta mgrin gyi gdul byar gyur pa shwa na bzhi ni/ nam gyi srod la dam bcas shwa na bzhi/

/srog bdag dbugs len bla 'khyer mdangs 'phrog ma/ /mthing kha dmar ser sngo nag srin mo'i gzugs/ /lcags spyang mgo dgu zangs wa rkang gsum dang*/ /gser 'phar lce brgyad g.yu khyi mgo gsum bzhon/ /gdug pa'i ma mo shwa na chen mo bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /phur srung dam can ma mo bcu gnyis la/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ging bdud shan pa bcu gnyis ni/ dang po bswe mo bzhi'i ming po dmag dpon bzhi'am dung gi skyes bu ging chen bzhi ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dpal gyi bka' nyan shan pa bcu gnyis ni/ /pra ma rā dza rak+sha srin po'i ging*/ /ya ma rā dza 'chi bdag gshin rje'i ging*/ /dā sha ghṛ wa bskos rje bdud kyi ging*/ /yak+sha ghṛ wa ha la gnod sbyin ging*/ /skyes bu chen po sgrol ba'i ging chen bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / bdag nyid ma bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ni/ shar bdud dkar po mche gtsigs lha bu'i bdud/ /lho bdud sngon po ral bsigs phung po'i bdud/ /nub bdud nag po gdug pa nyon mongs bdud/ /byang bdud ljang gu srog gcod 'chi bdag bdud/ /dung gser g.yu dang mchong phur dgra la brdeg /'bar ba chen po gsod byed bdud po bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / shwa na bzhi'i ming po bzhi bswe'i skyes bu bzhi ni/ shel ging dmu gza' dgra lha srog bdag bzhi/ /dmar po 'jigs gzugs shan+ta pu ri'i btsan/ /'brong rtse nag po rngam pa klu bdud che/ /ldang lha zangs rtse shel ging yongs kyi rje/

/rdo rje gnam lha ser mo de ni dmu/ /kun kyang khro tshul phyung rdeg ral gri phyar/ /shan pa za byed chen po srog bdag bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ging bdud shan pa myur mgyogs bcu gnyis la/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ bh+yo ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ma taṃ pa nya ka ra i nan bar+dha ti/ ma ma karma shrī kraṃ ka ra ye/ a tsit+ta yā/ dza ye bi dza yā/ a pa rā dzi te mā ra se na pra mar+dha na ye/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ ma tham ma tham badz+ra/ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa bha su kiṃ ni ri ti/ ma ra sa na pra mar la kha kha khā hi/ zhes bsngo zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol tshig ni/ hūm̐/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug mdo sngags rgyal ba'i bstan/ /mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyi srung ma ru/ /ring nas smon pa'i mthu grub ḍāk+ki'i tshogs/ /ye shes dang ni 'jig rten sna tshogs sprul/ /gdod nas rnam dag bde chen btsun mo'i klong*/ /dbyings yum kun tu bzang mor dbyer med bstod/ /gsang sngags drod nyul legs nyes stangs byed cing*/ /log 'dren srid gsum dgra bgegs srog 'phrog tshe/ /las dang 'jig rten sha za mkha' 'gror sprul/ /tshogs zhing bshad sgrub chos 'khor gnas skyong tshe/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams la gnas bya ra byed/ /dbang phyug mgo brnyan phur srung mi bsrun gzugs/ /spyi sgos ru tra skad cig nyid la bsgral/ /mtha' dmag dpung bzlog sbas gnas gter srung tshe/ /brtan ma skyong mas 'dzam gling bde skyid spel/

/sna tshogs gar gyis sngags bstan skyong la bstod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis phrin las bcol ba ni/ /ma ltar byams shing zhi ba'i las sgrub tshe/ /mi mthun nyes tshogs ba mor nyi shar bzhin/ /zhi ba'i bde legs ngang la gnas par mdzod/ /sring ltar gdung zhing rgyas pa'i las sgrub tshe/ /tshe bsod mnga' thang gser ri lhun po'i dpyid/ /rol mtsho spungs ltar 'phel rgyas brtan par mdzod/ /mdza' ltar brtse zhing dbang gi las sgrub tshe/ /brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs yid la 'khu ba'i nor/ khab len lcags bzhin sgrub la myur du stsol/ /bran ltar myur mgyogs drag po'i las sgrub tshe/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub spyi sgos bstan pa'i dgra/ /nor rdzas 'phrog bcom dgra rkun byad ma'i tshogs/ /gnod byed yid srub mda' lnga ldan pa'i lus/ /chos srung drag shul mgrin sngon dmag gi mes/ /dper na brag rir gnam lcags thog phog bzhin/ /bsam pa tsam gyis ming med tshar chod cig /sngon tshe bcom ldan rdo rje khros pa'i zhal/ /hūm̐ ka ra dang pad 'byung mtsho rgyal lcam/ /rjes 'brangs rgya mtsho dpal seng rgyud par bcas/ /bud+dha dzñā na lo ha badz+ra zhabs/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rnying ma ba/ /gnubs ston skye sprul rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab chos nyi zla lta bur mtha' rgyas mdzod/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /'dus pa'i grwa 'khor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas mdzod/ /dad pa'i nor ldan sbyin bdag tshe dpal skyed/ /longs spyod rnam thos bu la 'gran nus mdzod/ /de yang 'ching ba'i sgrog gis ma bcings par/ /tshogs rdzogs dge la gtong phod nus par mdzod/ khyad par sgrub sde 'di yi mchod gzhis la/ /log par shom pa'i dgra rkun rtsad brlag mdzod/ /theg dgu spyi dang khyad par rdzogs pa che'i/ /smin grol 'khor los sa gsum khyab par mdzod/ /de yi thugs rjes bstan pa'i 'gro ba kun/

/rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i tshe dpal 'byor ldan mdzod/ /'di nas byang chub bar gyi phrin las kun/ /rtag tu dbang phyug phur skyong rnams kyis mdzod/ /yid la re ba'i don gnyis gang mchis pa/ /gegs med bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par mdzod/ ces yang phur gyi phur srung dam can gsol mchod cha rkyen du/ bka' gter gong 'og du ma nas legs par bsgrigs te/ phur skyong bcu gnyis nam/ bcu drug nyer bzhi sogs rnam grangs du mar bzhed kyang*/ don du rang gzhung kho na la nyer bzhi gsungs bzhin/ dus skabs rnams su gsol mchod tshar grangs bsags pa sogs/ /spyi sgos dmigs bya 'ga' zhig la/ /phrin las bcol dgos pa 'ga' re byung ba la brten nas/ rang blo'i mos pas bskul bzhin/ 7 gter chen rin po che'i zhabs 'brangs tha shal pa au ḍi sha dha karma zhes pas rang gnas sngon brag sgrub sder thun mtshams su bkod pa'i mthus gong du smos pa'i phrin las thogs med 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi spros med bsnyen pa'i zin thun 'phral mkho'i nyer spyod bzhugs so/ bla ma dang dpal chen po badz+ra kī la ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi stod las la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub lag tu len pa la dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas thog mar rgyun khyer sngon du 'gro ba'i dkar gtor btang*/ bgegs gtor btang zhing srung 'khor bsgom/ phyi mtshams bcad/ de nas dgong thun nas dbu bzung dgos pas dang po thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sogs rang lugs chos spyod ltar gsol 'debs dang brgyud 'debs mthar/ skyabs sems song nas dkar bgegs mtshams gcod sngar song bas 'thus la mchod rlabs byin 'bebs ting 'dzin rnam gsum bar song*/ lha bskyed skabs bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom/

rang gi mdun du thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya la brten byas te phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor rang gi mdun du bsgom pa yin/ lha bskyed grub zin pa dang*/ yid kyi phur pa rdzas dkyil thams cad la dmigs pas khyab par byas nas bstod pa'i mthar lha yi gsal snang dang dag dran gtso bo bya/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stod las la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa/ dzap kyi dgongs pa bsnyen sgrub gnyis la'ang yan lag bzhi tshang dgos par gsungs pa ltar na chos nyid dang sbyar te bzla ba bsnyen pa/ lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba nye bsnyen/ sham bu dang sbyar ba sgrub pa/ tshogs sgrub dang 'brel ba'am/ phrin las sna tshogs pa can sgrub pa chen po zhes bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi la sbyar nas gsungs pa dang*/ yang phur pa'i dgos chos chos nyid dang sbyar ba/ lha dang sbyar ba/ /ngan sngags dang sbyar ba zhes gsum du'ang gsungs te/ phyi ma ltar na rgyud myang 'das las/ phur ni skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ /pa ni 'gags pa med pa'i don/ /phur ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /pa ni rig pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis su med pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /sems kyi sems nyid phur pa yin/ /chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ /gsal bar bsgom na bskyed pa yin/ /gnyis su med na sbyor ba yin/ /lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa yin/ /nyams 'og chud na bsgral ba yin/ gsungs pa bzhin chos nyid gyi lta ba ma bral ba gal che ste/ gzhung spyi'i dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer dang mtshungs so/ lha dang sbyar ba ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom/ rang gi mdun du thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya la brten byas te phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ste dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rdzogs pa dang yang na gtso bo kho na la gsal snang 'don kyang rung ste/

rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa gsum la bslab la gsal snang thon par bya ba dang*/ skyo tshe chos nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa res mos bya/ 'di gzhung spyi'i bskyed pa lha yi gzer dang mtshungs la gzhan yang rlung bum can dang bar rlung la sbyar ba sogs 'byin 'jug rlung gi bzlas pa la slob cing bde stong la sems 'dzin pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa'i dod thob tsamayin/ ngan sngags dang sbyar ba ni 'og tu 'chad par bya'o/ gong ltar byas pas skyo tshe ngag bzlas bya bar gsungs pa bzhin/ bzlas pa dngos la/ ༈ dang po dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dgongs shig sogs nas/ srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kye/ dzap dgongs dngos la/ dang po gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nyer gcig dbu la zhe gnyis phyag: dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka ru: pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: de yi thugs dkar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar: zhabs gnyis mthil sprad bzhengs pa'i stabs: rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs su bsgom: gter gzhung gi tshig don ma bcos par bzhag pa'o/ de nas man ngag gi dgongs pa ni/ de yi thugs kar pad nyi'-i steng*/ /gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /srog gi go ru hūm̐ mthing nag /'bar ba chen po'i gzi byin rdzogs/ /mtha' bskor rtsa ba'i snying po ni/ /zla ba la ni skar phreng ltar/ /gsal snang g.yo med brtan byas la/ /ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzla/ skabs 'dir yid bzlas gtso bor bya la sku dang thugs srog la dmigs pa'i rten tsam byas nas sems 'dzin pa gtso ste phur pa'i rgyud las chos nyid dang sbyar nas bzla ba bung ba tshang zhig lta bu'o/

lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad bskor lta bu'o/ ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes gsum las 'di ni dang po chos nyid dang sbyar nas bzla ba bung ba tshang zhig lta bu'i dgongs pa'i don no/ de la gsal brtan thob pa'i tshe/ slar yang de las 'od zer ni/ nam mkha' gang ba rab tu 'phros/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyang*/ /sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi/ /rnam par byin 'od rang la thim/ /dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi dag /mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs/ yang phur rtsa bsnyen ni/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ni 'di kho na yin te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta yab che mchog dang yang dag he ru ka pad+ma kro ti shwa rī yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa'i rgyud las/ rtsa bsnyen 'bru dgu'am mkha' 'gro'i 'phyongs sngags 'bru gsum bsnan pas bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba lags so/ de yang oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badz+ra shes rab yum yin no/ /kī ni ye shes khro bo la/ /li ni dbyings kyi khro mo bcu/ /kī ni thabs kyi mche ba can/ /la ni shes rab gshog pa can/ /ya ni sras mchog sprul pa ste/ /hūm̐ ni phyag brnyan sgo ma bzhi/ /baṃ ni dbang du sdud pa ste/ /hūm̐ ni brlag par byed pa'o/ /phaṭ kyis sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzad/ ces so/ bsnyen tshad ni yang phur gzhung las/ gtso bo la bye ba gcig gsungs so/ bsnyen pa grub pa dang mchod bstod sogs bshags pa dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams gsum re spro na thun gtor yang 'bul/ bsdu rim la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kyi dngos po sogs/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bsngo ba smon lam gang rung gis rgyas gdab/ thun rjes ma rnams la las byang 'bring po mchod pa byin rlabs tsam las gzhan mi dgos/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas bzung bstod pa bar mthar chags su btang*/ bzlas pa dngos dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings sogs snga ma dang mtshungs/ bsnyen pa grangs thems nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa yin yang bsnyen rkyang las mi spro na dngos grub blangs la bsnyen pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsa bsnyen gyi bcu char gsungs kyang gang nus la 'bad par bya'o/ ༈ gnyis pa/ bsnyen pa grangs thems nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa yin na dngos grub blangs mi dgos bsnyen pa grub pa'i sang nyin nas mchod gzhi gsar du bsham la gtso phur dang dbang bzhi bkod/

dngos gzhi sgrub mchod bsnyen skabs dang mtshungs la dmigs bsal ni/ bstod pa'i mjug tu rtsa bsnyen la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥdzaḥ dzap khang dbye la bdag mdun me ri 'dab 'byar tshul du gsal gdab/ dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dgongs shig sogs nas/ srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kye/ bsnyen pa'i dus ltar rtsa bsnyen khyug tsam song nas rtsa ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas pa'i thugs srog sngags phreng las sngags phreng 'od zer gyi tshul du byung*/ mdun gyi rdzas dkyil dang gnyis su med pa'i gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal du zhugs/ sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ rim par bdag mdun rten brten pa dang bcas pa gsal bar byas nas rang la thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par mos la/ slar yang thugs srog sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng lug gu'i rgyud du 'phros/ ting 'dzin sems dpa'i zhal nas zhugs/ /ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas thon/ dam tshig sems dpa'i ngag lam nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ye shes pa'i/ /zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /lte ba nas ni rang la brgyud/ /bdag mdun rten dang brten pa kun/ /gsal bar byas shing tshur 'dus pa'i/ /dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi ye shes mngon gyur dmigs/ sgrub pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces snga ma'i thog sarba bigh+nān 'bru lnga bsnan pa las sngags te phur pa spyi dang mtshungs la/ khyad par trig nan ni gzhung 'di nyid kyi sham bu dang sbyar ba ni sgrub pa zhes gsungs pas snga ma ni bsnyen sgrub gcig dril dang*/ phyi ma ni sgrub pa yin pa shes par bya'o/ yang phur rgyud las/

oṃ rdo rje gzhon nu badz+ra 'khor lo rgyas 'deb kī li khro bo bcu kī la khro mobacu ya sras mchog sarba thams cad 'dus bi gh+nā na dgra bgegs gnon pa trig nan tshar bcad cing shin tu mnan pa baṃ lcags sgrog gis bcing pa hūm̐ thugs kyi snying po phaṭḥ sprul pa 'gyed pa/ dzaḥ dngos grub 'gug pa hūm̐ dngos grub thams cad bdag la sdud pa āḥ dngos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa/ ces sngags 'grel dang bcas te bshad pa ltar na phyi ma'i 'phyongs gsum po 'di man ngag gud sbas yin pa ches gsal lo/ zhes dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad bskor lta bu'o/ gsum pa ni/ cha gnyis pa/ ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes pa'i dgongs pa ni/ yang slar yang bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas sku dang thugs srog sngags phreng las/ 'od zer phyogs bcu 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrib pa sbyangs te thar pa la bkod/ dam can srung ma la phogs pas thugs dam bskul/ yang bdag mdun lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal nas 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs shing 'od zer me dpung tshwa tshwa 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs byad mar phogs pas bya sgro mes bshur ba bzhin bsregs gtor rjes med du byas par bsam la/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /sngags phreng mgar gyi me tshwa ltar/ /'khor ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa byas/ /dam can srung ma las la bskul/ /dgra gdon dregs pa thal bar brlag khams gsum log rtog zer gyis mnan/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyang*/ /phyi snod 'jigs rten khro bo'i zhing*/ /bcud rnams lha yi da lar rdzogs/

/kun gyi zhal dang sngags phreng las/ /'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba bzhin/ /sngags kyis rang sgra cher sgrogs pas/ /snod bcud thams cad 'ur chem ldir/ /'od zer me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs/ /dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong rnams/ /bya sgro me la bshur ba bzhin/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag par 'gyur/ zhes sngar ltar bzlas par bya'o/ ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes phyi ma 'di ngan sngags dang sbyar ba yang yin pa ma zad spyi ltar na 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer dang yang mtshungs par shes par bya'o/ sgrub pa thems la nye ba'i skabs tha ma'i skabs 'phyongs gsum po yang btags la bzla/ dzaḥ dngos grub 'gug pa hūm̐ dngos grub thams cad bdag la sdud pa āḥ dngos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa/ ces sngags 'grel dang bcas te bshad pa ltar na phyi ma'i 'phyongs gsum po 'di man ngag gud sbas yin pa ches gsal lo/ sgrub pa grangs thems nas dngos grub blangs la bsnyen pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsa bsnyen gyi bcu cha sogs gong dang mtshungs la bsngo smon sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya ba spyi ltar shes dgos so/ bsnyen sgrub spros med kho na'i skabs 'jug bde'i ched gu h+yes byas so/ dogs dpyod ni/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las las rab rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa'i bzlas dmigs su/ gsal byed rdo rje he ru ka mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug yab yum kha sbyor gyi rnam pa'i spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje rigs bdag gi tshul du zhabs gnyis mthil sprad kyis bzhengs pa'i stabs su bsgoms la rigs bdag thugs kar sngags 'khor bar bsam/ zhes pa dang khyod mi mthun no zhe na/ de yin te/ gter gzhungs las/ de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: sogs de ma thag par/

de yi thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar: zhabs gnyis mthil sprad bzhengs pa'i stabs: rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs su bsgom: thugs ka zhes dngos su gsal la spyi bor ma bshad pa dang*/ dbang chen bskyed chog skabs/ yab kyi thugs kar gsal byed rdo rje/ de yi thugs kar yang dag rdo rje sems dpa' yi ge gsum dang bcas su gsal ba'o/ zhes gsungs la/ gzhan du phrin las rgyun khyer las/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i gzugs: ting 'dzin sems dpa' yin pa bshad kyi spyi bor yod tshul ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ yang 'ga' zhig hūm̐: 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje mthing : spyi bor thal sbyar chos dbyings zang thal ngang : zhabs gnyis mthil sbyor ngan song srid sgo khegs: mi 'gyur mkha' la rdo rje 'dril ba'i gzugs: rig pa rdo rje he ru ka la bstod: ces 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje mthing kha/ gnas spyi bor phyag thal sbyar zhabs gnyis mthil sbyor mkha' la rdo rje 'dril ba'i gzugs zhes na khyod nor te thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje mthing kha/ phyag spyi bor thal sbyar zhabs gnyis mthil sbyor mkha' la rdo rje 'dril ba'i gzugs zhes gsungs pa yin gyi spyi bo la yod pa'i don min no/ gal te las byang la thugs ka dang bstod pa la spyi bor bshad yod na gzhung nang 'gal 'du 'gyur ro/ de na 'di ni gzhung gis dgongs pa ma yin pa gong gsal de dag gis yongs su rtogs nus kyi man ngag gi dgongs pa 'dra yin min mkhas pa'i mchog rnams la de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan re gsung rgyu yod na da ni dus la bab 'dug kho bos ni ma shes pas rtog dpyod ma byas la 'dir bshad pa ni/ gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs kyi de la dgag sgrub gang yang ma byas so/ yang rig bdag rtsa sngags zhes brjod pa'i phyir rigs bdag yin na spyi bor dgos pa'i khyab bo zhe na ma khyab ste spyir yang dag ni ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' yin par yang dag gsang 'grel du gsungs la 'dir yang yang dag rdo rje sems pa ces dngos su gsungs la/

des na bla ma rdo rje sems pa ni rigs brgya rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rigs kun khyab bdag yin pas de ltar 'bod pas chog go / zhes pa'ang gu h+yas so// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi sgrub khog phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi sgrub khog phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal chen po yang dag badz+ra kī la ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ grangs med tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho 'khyil dbus su/ /lta bas mi mngon yid bzhin nor gyi mchog /skal bzang re skong bla ma dpal chen po/ /dbyer med rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ /e dbyings chos rnams 'byung ba'i dbang phyug ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen skyed mdzad ma/ /gus pas btud nas bdud dgra'i dpung tshan rnams/ /phrin las rdo rjes tshar gcod dngos grub stsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las stobs 'dus pa'i/ /rab 'byams dngos grub bde blag sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rgyud lung grub pa'i man ngag gcig bsdus pa/ /yang dag phur pa'i sgrub khog 'di na dbye/ 'dir grub pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad kyi gsang ba zab mo'i mdzod las gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams las che thang du bsngags shing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu 'grub par byed pa'i thabs bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i las kyi rim pa las/ spyi don chen po gsum ste/ gang bsgrub par bya ba'i gzhi/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i thabs/ gang zhig bsgrubs pa byas pa'i 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog gam mgon du rang byung gdod nas bzhugs pa'i dpal chen po 'bar ba'i ye shes yon tan ma bcos lhun gyis grub cing*/ glo bur dri ma'i tshogs kyis gdan la ma gos par bzhugs pa nyid do/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir sgrub pa chen po brgyad kyi nang gses phur pa phrin las rol pa'i lam rim thams cad thal 'byin rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sgrub ste/

khyab gdal ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su btab nas don dam ye shes chen po'i khro bo sgrub/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa 'gro drug sems can la btab nas phung khams rdo rje'i 'khor lor sgrub/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la btab nas sras mchog sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa brnag pa'i dgra bgegs la btab nas srid pa rdo rje phur bu sgrub pa yin la/ bye brag skabs 'dir sgrub lugs dang po gnyis srog tu bzhag /phyi ma gtsor ston gyi dbang du byas pa'i sgrub tshul lag len sil mar bstar ba la gnyis/ stod las la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ smad las la brten nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rim pa'o/ dang po la'ang gsum/ phyi spros bcas tshom bu tshogs sgrub/ nang spro bsdu dpa' bo gcig sgrub/ gsang ba spros med ting 'dzin sems kyi sgrub pa gsum du yod pa'i snga ma/ 'dir phyi spros bcas tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa la gnyis/ sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i rim pa dngos la 'jug pa'o/ dang po ni/ dgongs brgyud las/ slob dpon 'khor gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ sgrub pa'i rdzas dang dus nyid do/ ces pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga ste/ gang gis sgrub pa'i slob dpon thabs mkhas thugs rje dang ldan pa/ gang na lhan cig sgrub pa'i tshom bur 'brel ba'i 'khor dam tshig dang ldan pa/ gang du sgrub pa'i gnas bkra shis dge mtshan tshang ba/ gang la brten nas sgrub pa'i yo byad kyi rdzas thams cad tshogs pa/ gang gi tshe sgrub pa'i dus yar ngo'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang zhing*/ khyad par mgo phur 'dzoms pa'i yar ngo'i dus dge ba rnams te/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i las kyi gzhi bzung ba'o/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rim pa la gsum/ sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi las gzhung bsrang ba/

rjes sgrub pa'i mjug las kyi bsdu ba'o/ dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis/ phyi bshags dang sa yi cho ga'o/ dang po la gzhung dang phyag bzhes rnams su rgya cher 'byung yang*/ mdor bsdus/ sāts+tsha ci mang*/ srog bslu dang*/ nye'u 'don/ bya ston sprang sbyin sogs gtong*/ dge slong bzhi sde la dro drangs shing smon lam 'debs su gzhug /bon rtsis sman pa bzo bo bzhi sde 'jog lam 'phrang bcos/ gling bzhi spyi mdos/ rims nad bzlog mdos/ rgyal po gsol mchod/ dam glud/ lan chags brgya 'jal/ sde brgyad cha snyoms/ zhi bsang snang brgyad/ chu gtor/ skong chog gang rung dang 'brel ba'i phyag bshags/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ rnam 'joms khrus sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa gzab ste byas pas dngos gzhi la bar chad mi 'byung ba dang bsgrubs pa'i rtags thon zhing rjes bkra shis pa sogs dgos pa chen po yod do/ khyad par gzungs 'dus dang*/ brgyad stong pa la sogs rgyal ba'i bka' bsgrags shing*/ sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin dang*/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang kar gshegs pa/ byang du tog gzungs rnams bklag /dam sri'i mnan ling gcig /nyul le'i liṅga bcas bca' sgrub bya ba la dang po bca' ba ni/ gzhung las/ ro ras sam ni dug shog dang : ra dang gcan gzan sog pa'am: gang snyed dag la liṅga bris: de'i khog par sngags 'di bri: dug shog la dam sri'i liṅga spyi mthun yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying gar dzatriz-i kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ rutrayamadamasritriganān: wākathaṃ: gzirathumaḥ bhigananāḥ khathaṃ: yaṃching : rmug myog: rbadadril: tsunaparbadachingatritriṇitritephuranagamodzaḥ godasrichingaḥ rmugathuṃ: khathaṃnan: zhes dang*/ gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dusadrugadangabacurargyuba'inyulaledamasrirgyala'agonga'abyungapo'itshogasadangabacasapa'ilusangagayidagasumamathustobasathamasacadanonacig: bskalapastongagibaradumaldangazhig:

oṃlaṃhūm̐laṃsatwaṃbhayanan: zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ dza khram gyis bskor ba bris la dug khrag byugs pa snga tshags su bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i snga nyin rdo rje mtshams pa dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje phur pa'i gzhung bsrangs la/ ling khrus spyi ltar bya/ tshogs tha ma'i skabs su 'gugs gzhug brgya rtsa sogs dang sngags grangs mang po'i 'gugs bstim nan tan mthar/ phur bu sogs mtshon thun gyis brab la/ 'dzoms na dam sri'i mnan ling khyi mgo'am mnan thod sogs su brdzangs shing phung ras byad thag gis dkri ba sogs phyag bzhes ltar 'chug med tshags su tshud par bya'o/ deng sang sgrub chen lo ltar du rgyun gyi phyag bzhes bsdus par/ chu gtor/ zhi bsangs/ mdos glud phran tshig tsam gyis sna sel rigs 'thus par mdzad cing*/ mnan ling bri ba gong ltar/ snga nyin dgong mo slob dpon dang las rdor kho nas rgyun khyer dpa' bo lhan gcig sngon du 'gro bas sgo khang sogs phyi rol du phebs nas

lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ sa gtor/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ chu 'thor/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ me bskor/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ rlung g.yab/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ skam pas blangs la nam mkhar phyar ba gsum/ aḥnyer gcig brjod la mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /ling khrus grub pa dang dug khrag byug /so sor ltebs shing phung ras sam ras nag gis dril/ byad thag sngo dmar gyi bcing la hom du bzhag /'gugs pa bsdus tsam byas la thun brab/ mthar bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ phyi dang sogs smon lam bya ba tsam gyi 'thus/ rgyas bsdus gang byed yul dus dang bstun par rtsa ba'i don rnams ma chad par shin tu gnad che bas yan lag phra mo rnams spro bsdu rig pas dpag par bya'o/ gzhan du khrus sgrub sogs ma byas par dam sri mnan chog skabs liṅga hom dong nang du btings la/ 'gugs stim gzir mnan gyis don 'thus par mnan chas sogs mi mdzad pa'ang snang bas lag len rtsing ba'i skyon du nges so/ gnyis pa sa chog la bzhi/ brtag pa/ slong ba/ bzung zhing dbang du bya ba/ sbyong ba'o/ dang po lto 'phye dang rten 'brel brtag pa gnyis sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos shing*/ gsar pa la gal che yang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa la'ang snang ba dang mi snang ba las slong ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal po la sogs pas yul de bdag tu bzung ba yod na bden pa'i tshig gis dkrol zhing dgos pa'i rin bskyal la slad mar bar chad mi 'byung bar bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gang la'ang bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ bum gter bcud ldan/ dung phor du 'o ma rtsi sman sbyar ba/ bsang chu 'thor byed ku sha sogs 'du bya/ rdo rje slob dpon dang rgyal tshab pa'i mdun g.yon nas brtsam nas gzeb/ yungs thun/ g.yab dar ḍā ru/

rdor dril gdab phur nang mchod rnams bkod/ slob dpon la g.yab dar sna lnga gcig /nag po gcig /dmar po gcig /rgyal tshab dang rgyal theb bzhi la dmar nag gnyis re/ rgyal theb rnams la ḍā dril gdab phur nang mchod/ las rdor la g.yab dar sna lnga gcig /spos phor gu gul sbyar spos sogs 'du bya'o/ de nas gral phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dus pa rnams 'khod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs drag po'i pho brang dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i steng : rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur pa bsnams/ sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed me dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya tsam bzlas/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mthing nag phur bu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam zhing*/ de nas sa lha'i mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta

sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ de nas thams cad kyi rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sa la rdeg pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ ho hoḥ zhes khro bo'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo ba bsgrags pas/ sa yi lha mo bstan ma gser mdog rgyan can 'dod 'byung bum pa thogs pa rab tu mdzes pa sku phyed lte ba yan chad sa steng du thon pa 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du snang ba las sa bdag rje blon lha klu la sogs mdun du 'khod par mos nas dang po steng phyogs lha yi sa 'dul bar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ thams cad mtha' bskor rdo rje 'graus/ gser skyems bya zhing 'cham par bya/ me tog 'thor zhing 'di skad do/ hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs: gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: de nas dkar gtor btegs shing dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi phrin las bcol/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gtso: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: log 'dren dam sri dam la btags: hūm̐: nyon cig steng 'og la gnas pa'i: sum cu rtsa gsum man chad dang : na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi: lha srin gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang : sa 'di 'dzin gnas srung ba'i tshogs: 'byung po phra mo yan chad la: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po dang : 'dod yon longs spyod gtor ma 'bul: mnyes nas byang chub sems ldan mdzod: de ring pho brang sa 'di stsol:

khyed rnams ko long gdug sems dang : log sbyor 'tshe ba'i bsam pa spongs: ci ste sdang sems ldan gyur na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang bkral: na rag chen po dmyal bar ltung : de bas sngon gyi dam tshig srungs: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra bhū mi pa ti dza i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma dang sa bdag lto 'phye la sa slong ba ni/ gser skyems dang bum pa bcas bsngo zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis brlabs/ hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ nyon cig bstan ma sa bdag tshogs: de ring sa 'dul chen mo ste: khyed rnams gser skyems 'di bzhes la: pho brang 'bar ba'i sa stsol cig: dkyil 'khor sa 'di phul ba'i mthus: khyod kyang byang chub lam la 'god: lto 'phye sa 'dzin chen po yang : sdang sems 'tshe ba zhi gyur cig: ci ste dam la mi gnas shing : pho brang 'debs la bar gcod na: ting 'dzin khro rgyal thugs khros te: rdo rje gnam lcags bya khyung 'bebs: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha mo des dga' ba'i mdangs phyung ste gnang ba byin par gyur/ skyob pa shākya seṅge'i sras: khyod ni byang chub thugs dang ldan: bdag ni dge sems dbang dang ldan: 'gro ba'i don mdzod ci bder spyod: ces gsol te sa la thim par gyur/ zhi rol ring po'i 'og tu mchod pa rnams bsal/ 'di'i man chad kyi phyag len phal cher rdor slob nam rgyal tshab de dang mnyam yod na de nyid kyis bya dgos pas chos gos rdor dril bcas dkyil 'khor gyi sar byon nas gter bum phyag tu thogs te/ trām̐ las rin po che'i mchod sdong dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan bdun gyis brlabs/ sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas:

sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags: byang chub sems kyi gter bum 'di: dkyil 'khor bri phyir gter du 'bul: zhes brjod la/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su bzhugs shing*/ ye dharmā brjod la 'bru 'thor/ shis pa brjod/ 'byung ba khod snyoms kyi rus sbal bcas spod ldan yod na/ skabs 'dir phyag len ltar stegs bu'i 'og tu 'jog /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su byon la zhal shar phyogs su phyogs pas/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dpal chen rdo rje he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ rdo rje rtse gsum 'gros kyi dpyid gsum lho/ dbyar nub/ ston byang*/ dgun shar du gyu te/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes pa'i gad mo cher bsgrag /mig gnyis ram̐ las me yi rang bzhin khros pas sdang mig bltas pa tsam gyis bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par gyur/ de nas sa 'dul chen mo ni/ rdo rje rgya gram 'gros kyis blangs te/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: 'og min rdo rje'i pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang gis: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rngam stabs kyis: drag sngags me yis stong khams khengs: ma rig nyon mongs sa sri btul: dbyings phyug mi 'gyur sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: che mchog khrag 'thung khro rgyal gyis: bdud po mgo gsum btul ba'i tshe: drag sngags rdo rje'i char chen phab: bar gyi 'jig rten sa sri btul: gsang chen rmang btings sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: klu srin sa bdag kha rlangs las: rims nad sa sri 'dul ba'i tshe: sprul pa'i bya khyung me gshog kyis: klu srin ma rungs sa bdag 'joms: 'og gi ma rungs sa sri btul: rlung ri rdo rje'i sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul:
