slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: lha 'dre ma rungs dam la btags: bod khams gling bzhi'i sa sri btul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rmang gzhi btsugs: de ring gsang ba'i sa 'dzin no: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi 'gros stabs kyis: shar gyi sa sri dam la btags: shar phyogs zhi ba'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba shing gi sku mkhar tshugs: shar gyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: pad+ma gsung gi 'gros stabs kyis: lho yi sa sri dam la btags: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba me yi gsung mkhar tshugs: lho yi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yon tan ma mo'i 'gros stabs kyis: nub kyi sa sri dam la btags: nub phyogs dbang gi pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba chu yi yon tan mkhar: nub kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i 'gros stabs kyis: byang gi sa sri dam la btags: byang phyogs drag po'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba lcags kyi phrin las mkhar: byang gi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yang dag khrag 'thung 'gros stabs kyis: dbus kyi sa sri dam la btags: dbus phyogs che mchog pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba rlung gi thugs mkhar tshugs: dbus kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo phub: 'og tu rdo rje'i rgya gram btings: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod zhi rol bya/ rdo rje'i 'gros lag pa brkyangs pa phyogs gdeng 'gyings pa ste stangs stabs gsum gyis g.yas bskor gsum/ g.yon bskor gsum bya/ stangs stabs ma shes na bskor ba rkyang pas kyang rung ste bzung pa'o/ dbang du bya ba ni/ slob dpon stegs bu'i shar ngos nub tu phyogs pa dbang mchog phur bu phul/ dbus su phur gdan bkod/ bdag nyid skad cig gis badz+ra kī la ya stod zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu 'dril ba/ smad la lcags phur me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/

phur bu bsgril zhing*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum mthar stegs bu'i dbus su tho bas brdung*/ rgyal theb sogs kyis sngar byon pa'i phur bu rnams phyogs mtshams su dus gcig la gdab pa'i tshul bya/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i khro chung dang me'i 'od kyis sa gzhi khengs par gyur: bzhi pa ni 'o ma sman sbyar slob dpon gyis ku shas stegs bu la 'thor zhing byug pa'i tshul byas la/ bdag dpal chen po'i thugs ka'i yi ge bh+rūm̐ smug nag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: rgyal ba rnams la phog pas sras su dgongs: zhi khro'i lcam dral la phog pas spun dang grogs su dgongs: ma mo mkha' 'gro la phog pas rang rang gi rigs kyi gtso bor mthong : sems can rnams la phog pas sgrib pa sbyangs: sa gzhi la phog pas sa bdag gdug pa'i zhe sdang zhi nas dkon mchog la dad par gyur: 'od zer slar 'dus pa las dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi sra brtan bde ba'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ phyi bshags skabs 'dir gsungs kyang 'grub sla ba'i phyir gong du btang zin zhing skabs 'di nas brtsams sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar du dri med bshags rgyud nar mar klog mkhan bzhag /rdo rje mtshams pa dang dpon slob rnams kyis sgrub khang gi byang ngam nye logs su drag po'i sbyin sreg bya zhing khrus dang me thun chu thun sogs kyi chas tshags su tshud par bya'o/ sgrub chen dbang bskur dang 'brel ba'i slob ma rjes su bzung ba gtsor byed pa skabs 'dir lha tshogs sta gon gyi rim pa bya ba yin kyang*/ deng dus mos slob sgrub chen gyi 'dra 'bag tsam spyi la dngos grub bgo ba'i rjes 'brel byin rlabs kyi dbang bskur sbyin pa tsam las smin slob dbang sgrub chen mo'i srol cher mi 'byung zhing*/

sgrub rkyang tsam la ni sta gon nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ 'dir yang de'i lugs su byas te bsre bsnan mnga' gsol sogs rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar 'og tu 'then/ gsum pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ye shes kyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ lha dang dbyer med du byed pa'i sgrub pa'i rim pa/ dngos grub blang ba sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ dang po bsnyen pa'i las rim la bcu las/ dang po phyi mtshams gcod pa ni/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir mchod rten bzhi shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang nag po can gyi bum par rgyal chen bzhi'i sku nang gzhug rab gnas ldan pa/ de tsam ma lcogs na tho dkar la rgyal mtshan dang shing byang sku brnyan sngags dang 'dod gsol bris pa gzhug /mchod rten ma grub na sku rten gyi rtsa bar rab gnas dang ldan pa'i sāts+tshar bzhugs su gsol/ zlum gtor nyer spyod sogs mchod pa bshams/ slob dpon sngags chas dang bhan phur thogs/ mchod dpon rol chas sogs ser sbrengs gyis sgrub khang nas don te shar gyi tho mdun du 'khod la/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/

thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ bdag nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pi waṃ du gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i 'khor gyi bskor ba gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma shar phyogs pha ki na: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭā rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭā rāṣ+ṭā ya e h+ya hi ma hā rā dza i daṃ bha ling+ta gh+ri h+ṇa bha ling+ta nā nā kha dhe ghṛ h+ṇa khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul: hūm̐: dpal ldan rgyal po yul 'khor srung : dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: shar phyogs rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs: gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs 'byung po bdud kyi rigs: glags lta dam sri'i sgo mtshams chod: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ su ra wa rā dza i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: shar phyogs phyi yi 'byung po ha na ha na phaṭḥ

me tog 'thor zhing*/ ye dharmā? oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan par bya'o/ shar nas lho'i phyogs kyi bar 'khor dpag tu med pa bcas te bar mtshams med par bsrungs par bsam/ lho phyogs kyi tho rtsar 'khod la mchod gtor rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: bdag nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ral grir gyur: gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bi rū dha kā ya e h+ya hi ma hā ra dzā i daṃ ba ling+ta ghṛ h+ṇa ba ling+ta nā nā kha dhe ghṛ h+ṇa khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: dpal ldan rgyal po 'phags skyes po: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: lho phyogs rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs: gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs 'byung po bdud kyi rigs: glags lta dam sri'i sgo mtshams chod: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ ḍāk+ki na rā dza nī laṃ te i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: lho phyogs phyi yi 'byung po da ha da ha phaṭ: me tog 'thor zhing*/ ye dharmā dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan par bya'o/ lho nas nub kyi bar 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bar mtshams med par bsrungs par bsam/ nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: bdag nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ 'phros pas sbrul zhags su gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa la klu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ? nas swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā e h+ya hi ma hā rā dza i daṃ bha ling+ta ghṛ h+ṇa nā nā kha dhe ghṛ h+ṇa khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: dpal ldan rgyal po spyan ma'i bzang : dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar:

nub phyogs rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs: gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs 'byung po bdud kyi rigs: glags lta dam sri'i sgo mtshams chod: khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: oṃ pa pa tsi ma rā dza ra ta ne i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: nub phyogs phyi yi 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭḥ me tog 'thor zhing*/ ye dharmā? sogs su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan par bya'o/ nub nas byang gi bar 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bar mtshams med par bsrungs par bsam/ byang gi tho rtsar phyin la/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: bdag nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ne'u ler gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las rnam thos sras ljang gu ne'u le 'dzin pa la gnod sbyin gyis 'khor gyis bskor ba: gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ? nas swā hā

'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya e h+ya hi ma hā ra dza i daṃ bha ling+ta ghṛ h+ṇa bha ling+ta nā nā kha dhe ghṛ h+ṇa khā hi: hūm̐: dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: byang phyogs rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs: gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs 'byung po bdud kyi rigs: glags lta dam sri'i sgo mtshams chod: dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: oṃ ut+ta rā dza sid+dhi he i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: byang phyogs phyi yi 'byung po hu lu hu lu phaṭḥ me tog 'thor zhing*/ ye dharmā dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis brtan par bya'o/ byang nas shar gyi bar 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bar mtshams med par bsrungs par bsam mo/ gnyis pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po phur gdab skabs 'dir gsungs pa sgrub khang phyogs bcur phur bu gdab pa yin kyang deng sang phyag len mi bde zhing*/ bder 'dus las ma traṃ bsgral ba dang phur gdab gnyis ka nang mtshams su mdzad pa ltar/ deng sang dkyil 'khor mthar gdab pa nyid lag len bde zhing don dang mi 'gal ba yin pas de ltar 'og tu 'then nas/ dang po dam sri mnan pa ni/ snga tshags su byas pa'i liṅga brub khung du bkod nas/ thog mar 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems rdor slob kyis thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang :

sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung*/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo red cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig /tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum/ re re bzhin g.yab dar lan gsum gsum 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbye 'bebs rgya dang*/ slar yang lan gcig g.yug pa rnams 'gugs gzhug rjes mar g.yab dar lan gsum mthar 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbye 'bebs rgya dang*/ slar yang lan gcig g.yug pa rnams 'gugs pa thams cad rigs 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma sogs la phur skor 'cham rngam tshe khrus dgongs pas skyer phur gdab/ spu gri'i sngags kyis thun brab/ gu gul dud pas bdug dgra bgegs kyi mal du ya ma dam sri/ zhes bsgyur/ liṅga mtshon ltebs su bcags pa'am mnan thod dong du bcug ste/ hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog gsal ba'i mdun: gnam lcags khang sgrom gru gsum nang : lto 'phye gshin rje'i kha gdangs pa'i:

gre bar ya ma dam sri khug: nam yang ma shor sa ma ya: oṃ a ya ma dam sri aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum gyis drag tu bkug la/ sa chu me rnams kyis rgyas btab nas mi mngon par byas la slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan nas/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal he ru kaḥ stong gsum bsnyil ba'i rta bro rdung : ru tra mnan pa'i chem bro rdung : dam sri mnan pa'i rtsal bro rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: srid pa'i gnam lcags mchod rten ni: nag po bang rim stong dang ldan: de la snang srid dug rlangs gtibs: rang 'dra'i gnam lcags mchod rten steng : mthil sprad rtse mor ru trar bsnun: nam yang mi btang gnon par gyur: oṃ nān: āḥnān: hūm̐ nān: rbad nān: chum nān: rgya nān: thams cad kyi lag g.yas steng g.yon 'og byas la/ sum+bha ni sngags bzla bzhin pas lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas tshig ris dang mthun pa'i las bzhi'i bro rdung byas la/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: gti mug chos dbyings ngang nyid las: che mchog bud+dha he ru kaḥ zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra zlum po me rlung ngang : rdo rje gar stabs bde 'gros te: dngul lam dkar po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud rdo rjes mtshan: 'chang bzung zlum po chu srin dbal: zhi ba'i sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas 'jigs brgyad zhi: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs khyed la bstod: oṃ oṃ 'jigs brgyad mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: om̐ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa ghṛh+ṇa hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa pa ya ghṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: nga rgyal mnyam nyid ngang nyid las:

che mchog rat+na he ru kaḥ rgyas pa'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra gru bzhi lhun grub ngang : rin chen gar thabs sgrog 'gros te: gser ram ser po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud rin chen mtshan: 'chang bzung gru bzhi chu srin dbal: rgyas pa'i sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas 'byor drug rgyas: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med: rgyas mdzad lha tshogs khyod la bstod: swa swa tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: om̐ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa ghṛh+ṇa hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa pa ya ghṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: 'dod chags sor rtog ngang nyid las: che mchog pad+ma he ru kaḥ dbang gi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra zla gam bde stong ngang : pad+ma gar stabs bde 'gros te: zangs lam dmar po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud pad+mas mtshan: 'chang bzung zla gam chu srin dbal: dbang gi sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas khams gsum sdud: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: dbang sdud lha tshogs khyod la bstod: āḥ.āḥlha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: a wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa ghṛh+ṇa hūm̐ ghṛh+ṇa pa ya ghṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: phrag dog bya grub ngang nyid las: che mchog karma he ru kaḥ drag po'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra gru gsum bdud 'dul ngang*/ rgya gram gar stabs rtse 'gros te: lcags sam drag po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud rgya gram mtshan:

'chang bzung zur gsum chu srin dbal: drag po'i sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas bdud dgra zhi: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: sgrol bar ma gyur gang yang med: dgra 'dul lha tshogs khyod la bstod: hūm̐ hūm̐ bdud dang dam sri la sogs pa thams cad nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bdud thams cad brlag par gyur cig: hūm̐: mā ra ya phaṭḥ oṃ nān: āḥnān: hūm̐ nān: mā ra ya nān: rbad rbad:

gnyis pa sgo byang gdag pa ni/ ro ras la sogs par rta mgrin yab yum gyi sku bris la phur bu dang bcas te phyi sgor btags shing sgo yi ya them la zla ba/ ma them la nyi ma/ g.yas su g.yung dru+ung*/ g.yon du 'khor lo bris/ mdun du dmar gtor gru gsum mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas bshams la mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharmā swa bhā shud+dho3haṃ: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: sku rten/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal po dmar nag spu gri dang zhags pa bsnams shing yum chen rdo rje gtum mo dang mnyam par sbyor zhing khro bo rol pa'i cha lugs me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na gnas pa'o: ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs bstim/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces nyer gcig bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa bha ling+ta nā nā kha dan+tu ghṛ h+ṇa ghṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis rdor thal kha phye nas gtor ma phul zhing phrin las gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi sgo srung ba khro bo'i rgyal: dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar nag spu gri zhags pa bsnams:

yum chen rdo rje gtum mo sbyor: spu gri bhan dmar mgul nas 'khyud: g.yas su byi la'i mgo can dmar: g.yon du pu shud mgo can mthing : g.yas g.yon spu gri phur pa 'debs: gar dgu me dpung klong du 'gying : gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: phyi yi bar chad bdud rigs rnams: nang du ma gtong mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ro ṣa ni kro ti satwaṃ bh+yo bh+yoḥ phyi mtshams 'byung po rnams tshin+dha tshin+dha rbad nān: hūm̐: steng phyogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: 'og phyogs nyi ma'i sa gzhi brdal: g.yas su rlung gi g.yung drung la: g.yon du sa yi 'khor lo ste: 'byung bzhi kha sbyor srung ba'i gur: su yang bgrod par mi nus so: dam sri 'byung po mtshams chod cig: ces gsol bas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod cing me tog 'thor brtan bzhugs bya/ nang sgo'i ya them du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bkram la gong bzhin mchod gtor bshams te/ a mṛ ta sa bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin che snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi brlab/ sku rten/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang nag rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum bdud rtsi rlung 'byin ma dang mnyam par sbyor zhing khro bo'i chas can me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa'o: ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa bstim/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces lan nyer gcig bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pa d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li bha ling+ta nā nā kha dan+tu ghṛ h+ṇa ghṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyi rdor thal kha phye bas gtor ma phul la phrin las gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang nag rgya gram dril bu bsnams: yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma: dgra satwa bhan dmar 'dzin cing 'khyud: g.yas su seṅge'i mgo can ljang : g.yon du pha waṃ mgo can dmar: g.yas g.yon rgya gram phur pa bsgril: me ri smug nag klong du gsal: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: nang gi dngos grub longs spyod rnams: phyi ru ma gtong dam par srungs: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag sgrub pa po'i longs spyod mchod rdzas nang gi rten 'brel mi nyams par srungs shig: badz+ra rak+ṣa: zhes me tog 'thor/ brtan bzhugs bya/ ye dharmā sa brtan par bya/ skabs 'dir nang du 'jug pa'i skabs su rdo rje mtshams pa'am slob dpon nas rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya/ ging dkar nag chas su zhugs pas drag sngags bzla bzhin du me thun chu thun brdeg /de phyin chad nas tho dang thun gyi 'og tu ma tshud pa'i ngo gsar rigs sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar du nang du mi btang gdong mi sprad/ phyi nang mngag gzhug pa rnams la sngags btab cing yungs thun btags pa'i phur pa re bskur ba sked la 'chang nas ma bral bar bya/ 'thung chu sogs yo byad nang du mi len ka med yod na rdo rje mtshams pas thun brdeg cing bgegs bsgral la ging pa rnams kyis len/ chang bzi 'thab 'dzing sdom pa dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i log spyod/ khyad par bla ma mched lcam bsgrub bya'i lha sngags la log lta sogs rnam pa kun tu spangs te thams cad dad mos dang ting 'dzin rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas la dzapa rgyun chad med par bya'o/

gsum pa nang mtshams la dang po ma traṃ bsgral ba ni: khams sa la ma traṃ ru tra'i gzugs khro bo'i cha byed/ mdog thal skya gan rkyal du gnas pa bcos te dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir mgo bo lho nub rkang pa byang shar du bstan te bzhag la slob dpon sngags chas gsol khri'u khar nub nas shar du zhal phyogs par 'khod la/ rang lugs stong thun sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs/ hūm̐: bdag nyid badz+ra ku mā ra: rdo rje phur pa phyag na 'dril: sku la me 'od mtshon cha 'phro: ru tra bsgral ba'i gnyen por gsal: oṃ he ru ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ slob dpon gyis lcags kyu phyag rgya dang bcas la: ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ lan bdun brjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyus bkug par bsam/ hoḥ mdun du gzugs kyi liṅga la: stong khams ru tra 'byung po dang : ma dag log par 'dren pa yi: nyon mongs bdud bzhi ru tra khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya ru tra dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug ste gzugs la bstims nas/ rdo rje phur pa gdengs shing*/ hūm̐: nga ni stobs bcu khro bo'i rgyal: phyag na ri rab phur pa bsgril: las kyi ru tra'i snying la ya: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad sgrol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ ru tra'i tsit+ta raṃ rbad bh+yo tshal pa la shig shig: ces bdag rtog gi mtshan ma mi gnas pa'i dbyings su bsgral la slar snying khrag yi dam chos skyong gis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: ru tra'i snying khrag skom du bzhes: bla med mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes nam mkhar mchod/ bsgral ba dngos ni slob dpon gyis lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum bsgrengs pa kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi rgya snying gar bsnun pas tshul byas la/ gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig /ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs dang bral/ rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūm̐ yig dkar por gyur pa bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par

bsam/ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: zhes brjod cing de nas ging pa chas su zhugs pa rnams kyis lhu tshigs so sor phral te tshig ris dang mthun par phyogs so sor bzhag ste/ hūm̐: ru ṭa bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi la: dpal chen pho brang gzhi ru gsal: ru ṭa bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yas: shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod gsal: ru ṭa bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yon: lho phyogs gad rgyang dur khrod gsal/ ru ṭa bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yon: nub phyogs tshangs tshing dur khrod gsal/ ru ṭa bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yas: byang phyogs rab rgyu dur khrod gsal: ru ṭa bsgral ba'i ba'i mtshams bzhi 'di: ha ha rgod dang bsil ba tshal: rtams pa sgra sgrogs ki la'i gnas: nang rol phyi nang rim pa bzhin/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas brgyad gsal: snying dbus dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dal: yongs rdzogs gzi rjid mdangs ldan gsal: om̐ ma ha shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa arma ko3 haṃ: slob dpon shar du gnas pa'i/ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: thugs ka nas bh+rūm̐ 'phros khog pa la thim pas: khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang : dur khrod brgyad rwa ba me dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur: bh+rūm̐ brjod pas khog pa phur pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam/ thams cad kyi lag g.yas phyi dang g.yon nang du byas ba'i khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐ pra be sha phaṭaḥ ces lan bdun bzlas nas rgya bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar gyur: de nas slo dpon rdo rje'i 'gros gar gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ha/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor g.yas su lan gsum bskor/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur: zhes brjod/ gnyis pa phur gdab ni/ slob dpon khri'u khar shar nas nub tu phyogs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du 'bru'i snod du/ seng ldeng la sogs pa'i phur bu sor bcu gnyis pa tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa bcu'i mgul du kha dog lnga'i srad bus dkris shing rtse mor me tog dang yungs dkar gyi thum bu btags pa bcu bkod/

phur pa rnams gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brab/ rak+ta byugs pa rnams slob dpon gyis gong 'og tshig bstun la/ hūm̐: gu gul byin bskyed dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul: yungs dkar dbal bskyed rak+tas gzi byin bskyed: mi bzad khro rgyal 'dus pa'i stobs dang ldan: gzi brjid dpal dang nus pa ldan gyur cig: bsang sbyang*/ phur pa mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros/ phur bu la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bcu zhal gsum phyag drug dpal gyi chas bcu dang ldan par gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur/ slar thugs ka nas khro bo ṭāk+ki rā dza spros te phyogs skyong bcu bkug nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams so so phur gdan e khrom bcu phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re/ shar nub tu gnyis re bkod la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal rol pa'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i ye shes khro bo stong : ma nges phyag na me 'od 'khrugs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phur bu yis: khong du khro bo khro mo gsal: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka tsaṇ+ḍa kī la ya kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ lan bdun nam nyer gcig re bya/ zhes bzlas pas gzi byin bskyed cing de nas phyogs bcur phur bu btab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas kyis tho ba dang g.yon gyis phur bu bzung la/ steng gi phur pa phul la/ hūm̐: steng gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: hūm̐ dkar rdo rje sder mo sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo can 'gyed: steng nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: stangs stabs dang bcas dang po steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar du gdab la tho bas brdung*/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de bzhin phyogs mtshams gyi phur bu rnams shar nas shar lho sogs rim gyis/ byang shar bar g.yas bskor dang*/ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi nub tu gdab par bya la/ hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: rnam rgyal rdo rje snyems ma sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: stag dang bya rgod mgo can 'gyed: shar nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: gshin rje dur khrod bdag mo sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo can 'gyed: lho nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mo sbyor: rang 'dra'i sprul pa bye ba 'bum: byi la pu shud mgo can 'gyed: nub nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐:hūm̐:

byang gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: bdud rtsi rdo rje rlung 'byin sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: seṅge 'ug pa'i mgo can 'gyed: byang nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐:hūm̐: hūm̐:shar lho phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mo sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: bya rgod g.yag gi mgo can 'gyed: shar lho srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ nī laṃ daṇ+ḍa ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi

gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐:hūm̐: lho nub phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: mi g.yo rdo rje gtun khung sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo can 'gyed: lho nub srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ a tsa le ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐:hūm̐: nub byang phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: 'dod sbyin rdo rje mda' snyems sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: khra dang spyang ki'i mgo can 'gyed: nub byang srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ a pa rā dzi ta ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐:hūm̐: byang shar phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: rnam rgyal rdo rje gsod byed sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: dom dang sre mong mgo can 'gyed: byang shar srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ trai lokya bi dza ya ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'og gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: stobs chen rdo rje skul byed sbyor: rang 'dra'i khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: dred dang byi la mgo can 'gyed: 'og nas srung zhing gdon tshogs chom: oṃ ma hā bā la ma ma tsakra rak+ṣa: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi

gh+nā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥhūm̐: 'og phyogs phur bu nub kyi nub tu gdab/ phyogs bcur phur bu btab pas bgegs rnams kyis snying phug la/ g.yo 'gul med par 'od gsal ngang brgyal bar gyur par bsam zhing de las byung ba'i ye shes kyi me dpung phyogs thams cad du khyab pas bgegs rnams bsregs shing 'od zer las srung ba'i 'khor lo 'khrigs pas phyogs mtshams khyab par bsam mo/ mthar gcad bya gcod byed thams cad spros bral bde ba chen po las nam yang g.yo ba med par 'jog pa ni stong nyid rdo rjes gsang mtshams zhes bya'o/ de ltar phur gdab grub nas slob dpon stegs bu'i mdun du 'khod/ hūm̐: rdo rje rgya gram ral gri bsnol: gri gug spu gri tri shul dang : gnam lcags 'khor lo me rlung sbyor: lcags kyi phag rgod bya khyung 'bum: khro chu'i sdig pa dbyug tho dang : khro bo nag po phyi la gzigs: dug rlangs rlung 'khor reg gcod dang : skye med chos dbyings rang sgra sgrog: stong nyid bcu drug mi shigs rgya: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med gtams: tshwa tshwa drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: nam yang mi shigs pha laṃ ltar: srung ba'i gur khang chen por gyur: oṃ badz+ra bi shwa khaṅga ra ka ra ti ta bi pa tri shu la e haṃ lo ha tsakra raṃ yaṃ bha ra khroṃ ga ru ṭa pā paṃ dan+ta kro ta kā la ha saṃ tsakra par+shaṃ tshan+dha swa bhā wa he heṃ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa: ces pas srung ba rnams rim bzhin bkram ste dal du 'jug /bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'du bya ba la rnam pa lngar yod pa las/ dang po chag chag gdab pa ni/ ba byung bdud rtsi lnga myos byed dang sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i byang shar nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du khyams med par byug cing*/ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed:

deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhi chag chag 'debs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i tog: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i dal bcag ste: dpal chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: oṃ sarba dharma bh+rūm̐ mi hoḥ zhes pa he ru ka yab yum rjes chags kyis zhu ba'i byang sems rdo rje'i rdul bar mtshams med par gtams pas rang rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur par bsam mo: gnyis pa lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon no/ dang po ni stegs bu'i khar dri bzang dang ba byung gi chus brlan pa'i 'bru dkar ram/ me tog la sogs pa'i tshom bu lha grangs bzhin phyogs mtshams ma nor bar bkod la/ lha so so'i sngags mthar/ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags par brjod bzhin du bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/ hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: sogs mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar btang*/ thal mo sbyar zhing*/ hoḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu so sor smin: de ldog phyir na rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa stsal du gsol: zhes pas nongs par bshags shing*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba ni/ dril spos dang bcas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs: khyed rnams mchod dang slob ma la: phan phyir dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te byin gyis rlobs: zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyi dkyil 'khor la ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsams la/

oṃ badz+ra urtaṣ+ṭhi/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'od kyi klong du bzhugs par bsams la/ 'degs pa'i rgya byas la tshom bu bsdu'o/ gtso bum dang las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba slob dpon gyi mdun du bkod la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brabs la drag sngags hūm̐ bzhi bzlas rig bzang pha ma 'dzoms pa'i khye'u pho yis yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu blangs/ mo yis bum par blugs la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ: zhes brjod la rin po che sna lnga blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rat+na pañtsa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ snying po lnga las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri da ya pañtsa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dri lnga la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ghan+dhe bha dra hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ yungs dkar lha grangs mnyam pa 'bru dang sbyar ba'i thum po bcug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sha rī raṃ raṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ sman lnga blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mṛ ta pañtsa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga blugs la/ bdud rtsi chos sman gyis 'thus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dar sna'i mgul chings gsol la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa li ka hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ 'bras bu can gyi shing dang ku sha dang rma bya'i mdongs sgro/ dbu rgyan dang bcas pas kha brgyan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa bil+ma ma hā ma la saṃ bha wa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya satwaṃ: rdo rje dang bcas pas gzung thag btags la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma dh-i badz+ra tan+t+ra ma le sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ de nas spos kyis bdug cing dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'phrul stegs lta bur bzhag la/ oṃ hūm̐ḥs dza a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa nyer spyod bkram ste: hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: sogs/ zhes pas nam mkhar khyab par spel/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das chos rnams mi dmigs ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen bum pa ni:

dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang : tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du las: sogs/ bstod pa'i bar mthar chags su btang*/ de nas bum bzlas ni/ las rdor gyis me tog pad kor dang bcas pas 'thor la gzung thag slob dpon la phul/ des kyang tshul dang mthun par blangs la thugs ka'i thad du 'dzin pas/ rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng las: 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul du 'phros: snyoms 'jug byang sems bdud rtsi yis: bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur: zhes mos la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad tsam bzla'o/ thun mthar stong tshig gis mchod bstod khyug tsam byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul/ bum pa'i lha tshogs bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu bas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can du ltem gyis zhu bar bsam mo/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gnyis pa las bum ni: a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa bh+rūm̐ las rang byung gi gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te song bas bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa yongs su khengs par bsam mo/ gong gi tshul dang mthun par gzung thag blangs te/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod mthar mchod yon phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu bas bdud rtsi'i chur gyur par bsam mo/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni gsham du gsal/ gsum pa thig gdab pa ni/

srad bu kha dog lnga sbrel dal gyi nyis 'gyur las ma thung ba 'du byas la/ slob dpon nub/ gzungs ma'am der btags pa'i las rdor shar du gnas pa 'khod do/ ye shes chos sku'i thig nam mkhar gdab par mos la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ka dag dbyings kyi klong : rang byung rig pa'i rtsal shar te: mi 'gyur rdo rje spro ba'i lam: gsang ba dbyings kyi klong du thob: oṃ badz+ra saṃ skṛ ta gu h+ya dharma hoḥ zhes thig sna gtad la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na e maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: zhes lan brgyad brjod cing gnam thig btab pas/ sngags dang thig gi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad sad par bya/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar mos/ de nas slob dpon rdor dril dang bcas pa'i ngang nas gung mos thig skud bzung*/ 'og nas gyen du gcus te se gol gtog pa la/ nub shar lho byang tshangs thig gdab/ /me rlung srin dbang zur thig gnyis/ /me dbang rlung srin shar nub logs/ /rlung dbang me srin byang dang lho/ /logs te tshangs logs rgyab 'gros dang*/ /zur la de spangs g.yas kho nas/ /'gro ste thig chen brgyad po gdab/ /slob dpon nub nas srad bu bsdu/ de nas longs sku'i thig mgrin par gtad de/ hūm̐: rgyu rtsal ma 'gags lam gyis shar: gsal stong snying po lam gyi chos: shes rab drwa ba'i dbyings su sprod: longs sku'i de bzhin thig thob cig: oṃ badz+ra gi waṃ te hūm̐ āḥ snying gar tshad cing sprul sku'i 'khor lo gdab par bsam/ hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung de bzhin dbyings: 'khor lo lnga ldan dkyil 'khor gtso: rang byung bde chen kun+da'i rgyud: shes rab stong pa'i 'khor lo gdab: oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu bh+yaḥ de nas rang byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa ni/ bdag dang gzungs ma dpal chen po yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas lngar rigs lnga yab yum gyis mtshan par gyur: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes ldan dge ba'i grogs: gsang ba'i brda skad 'byin pa'i dbyangs:

gar sgyur skyed mdzad bde 'byin ma: rnam dag rdo rje'i thig thob cig: oṃ swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ dhā tu ghar+bha āḥ rigs lnga snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems sprin yum gyi mkhar skar mda' ltar sbrengs pas rgyal ba'i pho brang rang byung du bsams la thig chen brgyad po gnam thig ltar 'debs pa'am/ gsang zil gter gzhung las/ kho mo bdag 'dra mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don ched du: 'phrul thig bsdus pa'i lag len bstan: bud+dha dzñā nas legs par zungs: dang po zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: phrin las gang du 'jug pa ni: sa slong dal bcag dri bzang gis: chag chag btab nas thig gdab bo: thig skud dal gyi gnyis 'gyur tshad: shes rab gzhi la thabs kyis gdab: slob dpon nub nas shar du gyu: rig ma shar nas langs te bzhengs: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gdab: gnyis pa dbus nas cha bzhi snyoms: dbus ma'i tshangs thig legs par gdab: tshangs thig bgos pa'i gnyis cha'i mtshams: g.yas g.yon bya rog rjes rnams btsal: de la gcig btab thabs shes gnyis: bzhi cha snyoms pa tshad med bzhi: de nas gnyis gdab phar phyin drug: lo cha dang por rnam thar brgyad: gnyis pa stong nyid bcu drug la: gsum pa dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: des ni gzhung gi thig chen tshang : de nas sa bcad bgo ba ni: nub byang slob dpon dag gis gdab: shar lhor gsang ba'i rig mas gdab: dang po phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: gnyis pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag: lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: bdun pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: de yis thig chen rtsa gnyis rdzogs: dang po cha chen lte ba dang : gnyis pa pad+ma gsum 'khor lo: bzhi pa sgo mtshams blo yis dpag: tshad ni cha chen gcig tu 'dod: chos 'khor la ni cha phran bzhi: gnyis 'das gnyis dang bzhi 'das bzhi:

bskor nas klong gur ri mo 'byung : ka zur mun pa cha chung re: klong gur mun pa cha chung gsum: cha chung bzhi la kha rgyan bskor: mun pa'i bskor tshad sgo yi mtshams: ka rgyan steng na za ram tshags: gyen bskor sna tshogs rdo rje 'byung : pad+ma rdo rwa cha phran re: dur khrod me ri cha chen re: rtsig pa lnga ldan cha chung gcig: 'dod snam dmar po cha chung gnyis: pha gu ser po cha chung gcig: mun nag drwa dkar cha chung gnyis: sham bu sngon po cha chung gcig: mda' yab mchod rten cha chung gcig: ka ba phyogs mdog ka rgyan mdzes: khyams dang rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog: rta babs sa chu me rlung bzhi: ser sngo dmar ljang cha chung re: pad 'dab mdzes tshon cha chung gnyis re: chos 'khor ser po cha chung bzhi: char kheb nyi zla cha chung re: de ltar zhib tu rim par bstan: sa ma ya: bzhi pa tshon bkye ba ni: dang po tshon rnams ljang*/ dmar/ dkar/ ser/ sngo ba bcas re re bzhin la/ tām̐ pām̐ mām̐ lām̐ mūm̐: zhes bris la/ brtsegs mar bkod la/ hūm̐: 'byung lnga rang byung bsnol brtsegs thabs: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin ngang : 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar bstim:

zhes pas yum lnga'i ngo bor bsams la: slar yang tshon snod dbus dkar/ shar sngo lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu bzhag la/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā: lnga bris la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis reg ste: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems kha dog lnga ldan la/ rnam pa rin po che'i rdul tshon 'od 'bar bar bsams la 'bru lnga brgya rtsa brjod: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sogs kyi mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du? sogs kyis bstod/ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ hūm̐: zhes pas dbus kyi gur khang rim par mthing ljang dkar ser dmar po rnams blugs la bkang ste 'byung ba rim brtsegs su pho brang bzhengs par bsam/ slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs la re khā gcig drangs te/ hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags dang : gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ru lam gyis shar: kun tu gnas 'gyur sa bon bh+rūm̐ : oṃ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe haṃ: bka' brgyad gsang zil las/ da ni phran bu'i tshon sbyor bstan: gzhi ni si tā zhib bu la: rkyang shog gam ni skyer khu la: 'jang ba btung ba'i khu ba brdab/ dang po ras la zho chu spyad: de nas 'bri mog mar dang sbyar: de steng rdo zho blugs pa yi: de la mthing gi bzo bar bya: sngo skya'ang ni de bzhin no: nag po dur rdo zhib tu 'thag: ram dang ser po ljang gu ste: dmar po dang ni skag la bya: thal mdog snag tsha bye mar sbyar: cung zhig me la bsregs par bya: des ni bsgyur ba'i tshon kha bsgyur: sa ma ya: man ngag lugs su mos pa na: thig chen bzhi po gdab pa'i rjes: mtha' nas dbus su phyed lnga bgos: bgos pas gnyis mthar mda' yab gdab: nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: phyi ma phyed gdab phyi ma bgos: rta babs g.yas g.yon cha chen gnyis: dpangs su gsum re'i g.yas g.yon gyi: dang po phyed gdab phyi ma bgos:

gnyis pa bgo ba spang par bya: dang po'i bzhi cha bgo ba la: dkyil nas cha phran brtsegs par bya: gsum pa bzhi cha bgo bar bya: gzhung thig dag kyang bya rjes btsal: de ni 'phrul gyi lag len zhes: sa ma ya: de dag nyin dang po'i bya ba'o/ rdul tshon nyin gcig la bri mi thub na/ nyin gnyis pa bdag bskyed bzlas pas tshogs skong bsdus pa tsam mdzad pa'i phyag srol yod/ gal te rdul tshon mi 'grub pa'i ras bris kyi thig tshon gyi bya ba de dag bor te chag chag gdab pa tsam gyi rjes su rgyan 'god la 'jug pa yin kyang*/ gnas mdo rnying ma'i phyag bzhes khag gcig tu ras bris la'ang thig gi bya ba yan tshang bar bya/ ye thig rdzogs par gdab/ las thig thig chen brgyad tsam btab ste tshon gyi bya ba dor nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gting bar snang ngo*/ bzhi pa rgyan dgod pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi mchod gtor dpal gtor spyi khyab sman raka nyer spyod bcas logs gang bder bsham/ brgyud 'debs nas bsnyen pa stong tshig gi bar grub nas/ slob dpon gzhi mdun khṛ'i khar phebs te dkyil 'khor la phyogs pa'i mdun du/ gter gzhung sgrub khog chen po las 'byung ba dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung ltar sngar nas 'du bya ba'i phur khrom du tshad dbyibs sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing dar sngon dmar gyi cod pan can/ mgul du gdung ring bsrel/ thabs shes kyi yungs dkar thum bu btags pa/ dbu rgyan la 'bru lnga/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i thad la rang rang gi snying po rnams shog dril nang du gzhug pa'am phyi ru gser gyis bris pa gtso bo gcig /rigs kyi sras bzhi khro bo bcu/ khro mo bcu rnams la phur bu rai/ phra thabs nyi shu/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ phur srung nyer brgyad kyi rnam pa grangs mthun gyi rtsang phur sked par rgya mdud mgo mjug phur dbyibs/ rtse la liṅga dang sha dum 'dzer ba thod pa'i gdan bcas rnams/

gtso bo nas brtsam/ go rim bzhin lan stabs bde bar bsgrig /bdug pa'i rdzas gu gul me snod bcas/ byug pa'i rdzas mi rta khyi gsum gcan gzan khrag gang snyed/ re lcag /spyang tsher/ ri shwa/ bse zho/ btsan dug rnams thod pa'i snod du sbyar ba/ brab pa'i rdzas yungs dkar ma nyams par 'du byas te/ hūm̐: gu gul byin bskyed dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul: nyungs dkar dbal bskyed rak+tas gzi mdangs bskyed: mi bzad khro rgyal 'dus pa'i stobs dang ldan: gzi brjid dpal dang nus pa ldan gyur cig: gu gul gyis bdug la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li la ya: su ru su ru: pra su ru pra su ru: a dhi tiṣ+ṭha mug mug: ha la ha la: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tsit+ta myog mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yungs dkar gyis brab cing : oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma gu ta la ma gu ta la: pra ta la pra ta la: bhi shwa satwaṃ pa ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭḥ rak+ta phur rtser byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la rak+ṣa: dgra bgegs wā shaṃ ku ru mā ra ya phaṭḥ rdzas dud sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu'i gseb nas khro chung ser ltar 'phro zhing : thog ltar babs pas bar du gcod pa thams cad rdul phran bzhin du thal bar brlags: rnam shes dbang du sdud par gyur: de nas rdzas kyi phur pa ye shes lha sgrub cing sku gsung thugs khro rgyal yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phur pa thams cad sbams te dar mthing nag gis bcings pa phyag tu thogs dgos par gsungs kyang stabs mi bde bas phyag len du gtso bo dang sras bzhi ste lnga dar mthing nag gis sbam/ gzhan rnams rin po che'i 'bru nag gis bkang bar go rim ltar gzug pa'i phyi nas dar mthing nag gis dkris pa'i sne rnams sbam phur la sbrel/ dmigs pas khyab par byas te sku gsum du byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ:

lan gsum/ phur bu rnams stong nyid chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gsal ba'i rgya mdud gong ma la khro bcu yab yum/ 'chang zung la phra thabs nyi shu/ rgya mdud 'og ma la sgo ma bzhi/ dbal zur gsum la sras mchog /ngos gsum la srung ma dam can gyi tshogs lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ā dkar po/ g.yon pa'i mthil nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṃ dmar po gsal bar gyur/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la zla ba sen gang ba'i steng du rigs kyi yab lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la nyi ma sen gang ba'i steng du yum lnga gsal bar gyur/ sbam phur 'dril zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: mum̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ lam̐ tām̐: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: añdza li hoḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod la/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang*/ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkha' gsang nas byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ sras phur pa'i lha tshogs su rong gis 'khrungs te/ sku mdog phyag mtshan so so'i cha lugs gsal la ma 'dres par rdzogs pa la/ thams cad kyang stod zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ sras dam can phra thabs pho nya dang bcas pa skad cig la 'khrungs pa la/ rang bzhin gyi dbyings nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa mang po byon nas gnyis med du thim par gyur/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te gzi brjid nus pa bskyed pa ni/ yang sbam phur 'dril zhing*/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra sa twa ra tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku la mnyes mchod 'bul:

tshur 'dus thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la 'dus: spyi bor thim: gzi brjid dang ldan: srid gsum mya ngan 'das par sgrol nus par gyur: dbang rtags su rgya mdud gong mar oṃ dkar pos mtshan par gyur: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung : ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: gsung gi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya wāk+ka badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ phur pa las 'od zer dpag med 'phros: rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung la mchod pa 'bul: tshur 'dus gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la 'dus: ljags steng rgya gram gyi lte ba la zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar pos mtshan par gyur pa'i mthar kī la ya'i 'bru dgus bskor bar gyur: gsung rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs: khams gsum chos kyi dbyings su sgrol nus pa'i dbang dam pa dang ldan par gyur: dbang rtags su rgya mdud 'og mar āḥdamar pos mtshan par gyur: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: thugs kyi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsit+ta badz+ra hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs la mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus phur pa la thim: thugs rin po che margad gur phub pa lta bu'i nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan med pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar ṛn po che zur brgyad pa'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du rdo rje mthing ga nas tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ mth-ing nyungs 'bru tsam kī la ya ljang dmar spus bris pa tsam gyis bskor bar gyur: dbang rtags su rgya mdud kyi dkyil du hūm̐ mthing gis mtshan par gyur: ye shes lngar byin gyis brlab pa ni/

hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: ces bskul bas/ phur bu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā 'ba' zhig tu gyur: tshur 'dus phur pa'i spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka gsum du thim: gzhan yang thod pa dung khang dpral ba rna rtag g.yas g.yon ltag pa dang lngar 'dus shing thim pas dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur: de dag skad cig tu he ru ka rigs lngar gyur te ye shes lnga yi dbang yongs su rdzogs par gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a dar+sha dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sa ma ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pra te bik+ṣa ṇa dzñā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kṛt+yā nuṣ+ṭha dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje dang nus pa byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la thim par gyur: yongs rdzogs dbang mchog bskur ba ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad 'od du zhu: dkyil 'khor la thim: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas dbus su yal te: gdan khri gtso bo: de'ang ye shes sems dpa': de yang hūm̐: de yang zla tshes thig le: thig le spros med mtha' bral ma bcos rang gsal chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi ngang du rdzogs par gyur: skabs 'dir kī la ya yi 'dzab dbyangs bya ba'i tshe rgyal theb bzhi sogs las kyi slob dpon rgyan bkod rnams dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ rtags gsum gdab/ las rdor gcig gis dkyil 'khor gyi gnas so sor e khrom bkod/ las rdor gcig gis sha chen dang spos bsregs pa'i spos phor thogs/

rdo rje slob dpon gyis dril spos rig mas dar gyi sne mo thogs la/ rgyal tshab gzhan rnams kyis phur khrom dar gyis lcibs pa thogs pa dang phur khrom rdzogs nas bum pa tsakli gtor ma/ sku gsung thugs rten/ sa chog skabs kyi khro bcu'i phur pa/ sgab skor bcas/ maṇ+ḍal snod gcig tu bzhag pa sogs thogs zin pa dang*/ 'dus pa byings rnams kyang dbu zhwa bcas bzhengs la zhi rol ring po'i 'og rgyan 'god pa rnams dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor lan gsum/ mdun nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs pa re bcas grub nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun phyogs su 'khod de las slob kyis phur pa rnams rim bzhin 'god la/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: skye med chos kyi dbyings nyid las: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dpal: chos nyid sgyu mar rol pa'i gar: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i phyir: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes gtso phur dbus nas zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: zla gam e yi gdan la bzhugs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ma hā kro ta tsa tur kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sras bzhi yang phyogs bzhir zhal nang bstan du 'khod/ de nas khro bcu ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i/ shar stod la hūm̐ kar yab yum zhal sprod phra thabs gnyis dang bcas/ shar smad rnam rgyal yab yum nas brtsams/ nub smad du stobs po che yab yum gyi bar du so so'i phra thabs gnyis re dang bcas 'og gi tshig res mthun par bkod/

'di phyin chad sgo srung rnams ma gtogs pa thams cad zhal nang bstan kho nar bzhugs te/ hūm̐: steng phyogs hūm̐ kar sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: steng gi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: shar phyogs rnam rgyal snyems ma ni: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: shar gyi phyaugs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: shar phyogs dbyugs sngon sder mo ni: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: shar lho mtshams su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī laṃ dan+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshin rje dur khrod bdag: sprul pa shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo: lho yi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: lho nub mi g.yo gtun khung la: sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: lho nub mtshams su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa le hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: nub phyogs rta mgrin rdo rje gtum: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: nub byang 'dod rgyal mda' snyems ni: sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo: nub byang mtshams su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: byang phyogs bdud rtsi rlung 'byin ma: sprul pa seṅge pha waṃ mgo: byang gi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: byang shar khams gsum gsod byed ni: sprul pa dom dang sre mong mgo: byang shar mtshams su bzhugs su gsol:

om̐ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bī dza ya hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: 'og phyogs stobs chen skul byed ma: sprul pa dred dang byi ba'i mgo: 'og gi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

dbang phyug nyer brgyad la phur pa yod na zhal nang bstan dang*/ nang sgo bzhi la pu shud mgo can sogs sgo phur bzhi zhal phyir bstan/ khyams la dmar nag sde gsum bkod/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ g.yas su bswe yi lha mo bzhi/ g.yon du shwa na mu kha bzhi/ mdun du dpal ldan lha mo bzhi bcas la rtsang phur rnams zhal nang bstan/ phyi rol du ging chen sde bzhi/ bdud po sde bzhi/ srog bdag bzhi bcas zhal phyir bstan du bkod la/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: zla gam e yi gdan la bzhugs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: gru chad bzhi la brtan par bzhugs: tshad med rnam thar sgo bzhi ru: ye shes sgo skyong srung ma bzhugs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams su: shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag tshogs: bswe lcags dung gi skyes bu rnams: bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol: phyi rim khor yug chen mo la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad brtan ma dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya: dha ti ma ma shṛ gh+raṃ ka ra ya sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes 'god cing mtshams rnams su zhi rol bya'o/ de nas bum pa 'gul chings mthing ga can gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar brabs la/ sum+bha ni brjod/ dri bzang sbyar ba'i chu dang bum rdzas so lnga blugs la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe sid+dhi gar+bha ta na: rat+na ne tra: pañtsa shu lan+dha ri: badz+ra lak+ṣa pra ti oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum brjod la rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan bskon/ kha rgyan gzung rdor bcas lding khri bar ma'i dbus nas shar du phyogs par 'jog /tsakli rnams kyang lha gnas so so'i thad bstun dang phyag mtshan rnams bkod la/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : pho brang gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes bkod la gtso phur dang bum pa gzung thag sbrel ba'i sne mo gnyis su 'then la/ gcig rdor slob dang*/ gcig shos thun dpon nam rdo rje mtshams pa'i phyag tu sleb pa'i tshod tsam bya/ gzhung las/ khye'u pha ma 'dzoms pa yi: bkra shis sha mtshan legs pa gnyis: bum pa bre gsum shong tsam la: gu gul bdug cing bgegs bskrad nas: phrin las yi dam phyogs dag gi: chu mig mang ba'i chu sna rnams: khye'u pho yis blugs byas shing : khye'u mo yis bum pa rten: chu mig rnams su 'bru sna mchod: dri bzang skye bdun bum rdzas btab: sngags 'di bzlas shing bkram par bya: zhes dang*/ mchod rdzas gzhan 'bul tshig ni/ oṃ hūm̐ pū dzaḥ.a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bh+rūm̐ : bum pa mi dmigs chos sku'i mkha': bdud rtsi yi dam ngo bor gsal: de nas sku rten bkram zhing*/ om̐ dharma he ru ka sid+dhi dzaḥ hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog ngo bo nyid: gang 'dul der ston ngang du gsal: de nas gnam rgyan dang cod pan la sogs mang du bkram zhing*/ om̐ ma la dharma sid+dhi pra bha me gha hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs 'phan dar mkha' la bris: ngo mtshar rnam bkra bkod pa rgya cher gyur: de nas bhan+dha ril bu'am sman sgrub la/ om̐ ga la bā+ai ṣañdza āḥhūm̐: chos nyid sna tshogs rang byung ye shes rdzas: dug lnga sel ba'i dam rdzas mchog tu gsal: me long la sin+dhu ra byugs te: chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su hūm̐ rtsibs drug la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dza bris: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: me long dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: byad dang 'char sgo ma 'gags gsal: de nas dung chu dang sgro mdangs la: om̐ badz+ra dharma ha ri ni sa ta pra ra ṇi ta paṃ pra sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje dung dmar thabs shes tshul: ku sha sgro mdangs sku lnga gsal: de nas rigs lnga la: om̐ hrīḥswā āḥhāḥ

mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tam̐' he badz+ra hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo rigs kyi bdag: ye shes lnga yi ngo bor gsal: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: dharma pa ti swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: ye shes gsal ba lam me ba: ma 'gags zang thal de bzhin gsal: de nas phreng ba thogs la: om̐ kha li ta bha la pra dzñā hūm̐: hūm̐: gzungs sngags phreng ba skye ba'i mchog: sgra grags tshangs dbyangs de ltar gsal: snying po shog dril 'khor lo la: om̐ hrī dha ā dharma tsakra bh+yo haṃḥ hūm̐: theg pa chen po'i ngang tshul can: spro bsdu sngags zer rnam par gsal: de nas phyag mtshan rdo rje phur pa la: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hrīḥdha hūm̐: hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi phyag mtshan ldan: phrin las ngo bo so sor gsal: rgyal mtshan la/ om̐ ma ṇi tshan+dho rasmi hoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor legs par brgyan: tog bcas lha mi'i mdzes rgyan gyur: drwa ba la: oṃ dharma dhi shi gar+bha hūm̐ heṃ: hūm̐: chos sku drwa bas ma rig gzhom: khro bo'i stag sham khor yug gsal: ral gri la: om̐ khaḍ+ga bhañdza hoḥ hūm̐: shes rab ral gris nyon mongs bcom: dkyil 'khor bar chad srung bar bsam: mda' gzhu la: om̐ dharma na ṇa pa tsa hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang ldan: bden gnyis rgyu rkyen ngang la gsal: me long la: om̐ sa ma ya a dar+sha hoḥ hūm̐: mdzes rgyan gsal ldan drwa ba'i gzugs: dkyil 'khor sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur gsal: cod pan la: om̐ pra bha pañtsa mu ku ṭa hoḥ hūm̐: 'od zer dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: cod pan dam tshig lnga ldan gsal: phur pa bzhi la: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya pra be sha ya phaiṃ: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rang byung rig rtsal nyid: rtog med phur pas nga bdag bsgral: nyi zla cha bzhi la: om̐ sūr+ya tsan+d+ra pra bha hoḥ hūm̐: sna tshogs snang stong ye nas dag: pho brang phyi dang nang gsal lo: kha ṭ+wāṃ la: om̐ kā ya tra ma tri shu la hoḥ hūm̐:

dbyings nas sku gsum ngang gis rdzogs: rtse gsum sgo gsum bag chags bsal: bdud rtsi la: om̐ a mṛ ta pañtsa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ hūm̐: rang byung bdud rtsi bla med rdzas: rigs lnga yab yum ngo bor gsal: gtor ma la: oṃ bha ling+ta pha la hoḥ hūm̐: dam tshig dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten: bla med rdzas mchog kun 'byung gsal: rak+ta la: om̐ rak+ta dz+wa la hrīḥṭhaḥ hūm̐: dmar chen gsang ba'i rdzas mchog bcud: 'khor 'das bsgral ba'i rak+ta gsal: dbang po lnga la: oṃ a bhi pañtsa le hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i dbang po lnga: sku lnga lhun grub rdzas su gsal: phyi mchod la: om̐ badz+ra a haṃ pū dza sa mu dra āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon lha mo'i gar: brda rtags sbyor sgrol mnyes mchod gsal: tshogs rdzas la: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra hoḥ hūm̐: rnam dag bla med mchod pa'i rdzas: blang dor bral ba'i rdzas su gsal: ḍā ma ru la: om̐ ḍā ma ru la ka hoḥ hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi rgya rtags can: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: rdo rje la: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rtags las: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i gzung thag dam par gsal: dril bu la: hrīḥmu gu lan+ta ka hoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan par sgra sgrogs pa'i: grags stong rgyud bskul 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: gling bu la: om̐ badz+ra waṃ s+ya ni we hoḥ hūm̐: dbyangs snyan lha mo brda gar dgyes pa'i rdzas: bung ba bcud ltar sngags sgra'i rnam par gsal: rkang gling la: om̐ gha dhe shang kha sa hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor srung ba'i dam can 'bod pa'i rdzas: tser tser lhang lhang ngar ldan sgra ru gsal: rnga la: om̐ dharma shab+da pañtsa hoḥ hūm̐: chos sgra lnga ldan sgrog pa'i bzang mo ste: dbyings nas rgyud bskul rang bzhin brda ru gsal: rnga lcags la: om̐ badz+ra muṃ man+t+ra hoḥ hūm̐: rgyud bskul bde chen kun bzang rdo rje'i gzugs: bskul phyir spyod pa dgyes pa'i rdzas su gsal:

zangs dung la: om̐ badz+ra sa ma shaṃ kha hoḥ hūm̐: sgra grags 'ber chen ba spu cher g.yo ba: thugs dam byin 'bebs nyams 'phel rdzas su gsal: cha lang la: oṃ badz+ra shab+da ma hoḥ hūm̐: sgra chen rdzas 'chang bla med sbyor ba'i mdangs: chem chem g.yo zhing 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: bgrang phreng la: om̐ bhan+dha me la dha ri ta hoḥ hūm̐: drag sngags 'dren phyir bzung ba'i 'od zer can: brda rtags tshad 'dzin snang ngor bgyis te gsal: sgo 'byed phyag cha la: om̐ badz+ra aṃ ku sha pā sha s+pho ṭa ghan+dhe hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i phyag mtshan sgo ma bzhi: rang rtags ngo bo 'byed pa'i rdzas su gsal: steng sgo'i gnam rgyan la: om̐ badz+ra la la he ru hūm̐: hūm̐: stong nyid nam mkha'i bde stong brdal khyab phub: steng phyogs 'gyur med de bzhin ngang gis gsal: sa rgyan nam g.yang gzhi la: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ mi pa ti ru tsa tur hoḥ hūm̐: ye nas dbang chen sa gzhi phyal gyis khyab: g.yang gzhi gdan rigs rnams kyang de bzhin gsal: de nas gos kyi rigs la/ om̐ dharma la sha thi ka hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang rgyan rdzogs phun sum tshogs pa'i chas: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i rdzas su gsal: 'thung snod bhan+dha gang rigs la: om̐ sa ma bhan+dha ka ra hoḥ hūm̐: deng nas 'dod yon sna lnga'i longs spyod sogs: sgrub pa phyi nang bral ba'i ngang la gsal: sgrub pa'i grogs la: om̐ badz+ra ma hā u pa ka hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi nang sgrub pa'i grogs kyi mchog: khol dang gzungs sogs pho nya'i rnam par gsal: mchod pa spyi la: om̐ badz+ra ma hā me gha he pra tīts+tsha hūm̐: hūm̐: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor phyi nang la 'khod pa'i: rdzas dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs par gsal: ces dang dkyil 'khor du dgos pa'i cha lag rnams dang*/ phyi nang gi yo byad gang yin yang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum tsam gyis byin gyis ma brlab par mi bzhag /dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams/ lding khri gsum du bkod/

de nas bang rim steng ma'i dbus su sku gsung thugs rten sku gzugs/ g.yas su gsung rten sngags byang tshang ma gser gyis bris pa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam g.yon du thugs rten rang byung gi shel zur brgyad/ rgyab tu bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum gyi gtor chen de'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka rgyun bzhag mchog gi dam rdzas sbyar ba bkod la/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rgyal ba mchod cing dngos grub blang ba dang : dam can dgyes bskang phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bkod pa ni: bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang : dam tshig gter chen mchod sprin rgyan du che: sman raka gtor bcas rgyal ba'i thugs dam skong : gdugs dang bla bre ba dan rgyal mtshan dang : mda' dar gri dang tshon skud drwa ba sbrel: dar khang smad dkris dur khrod rdzas mchog bkram: mthun pa'i rdzas dang dgyes pa'i dkor cha sogs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru yongs rdzogs bskyed: ces pa rnams dbyangs dang mtshams su zhi rol bcas bya/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhing gi bla bre dang gdugs kyis phub cing khor yug rnams lda ldi/ ba dan rgyal mtshan/ phye phur dar gyi chun 'phyang sogs dang dpal gyi chas gos rgyan phreng rgyu ma dang don snying gi 'phyang 'phrul/ go mtshon spyan gzigs sogs sna tshogs kyis kun tu bzang po'i zhing lta bur mdzes shing brjid chags par byas nas/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dris dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' rim du byug cing*/ zur bzhi mda' dar dang tshon skud kyi drwa ba sbrel ba dang : ral gri la sogs pa'ang tshul bzhin du bkod pa'i bris dkyil gyi mtha' skor/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma dang gtor bsngos gtor ma rgyan spros gzab pa'i mthar/ sman raka dang phyi mchod rnams grangs mthun bkod/ shar du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ lhor 'dod yon lnga/

rin po che bdun/ tshe yi 'brang rgyas/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ tshe mda'/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sogs/ nub tu bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib myang ba'i dpal gyi gtor ma dang tshon gyi 'phur lding g.yo ba'i g.yas nas/ g.yas su chos skyong btsan gyi gtor ma/ chad mdo sman thod sgrub pa'i chos sman dang sbyar ba/ g.yon nas g.yon du dam can sgos kyi gtor spungs/ brtan ma/ rak+ta so lnga dang sbyar ba'i khrag thod rnams bsham/ byang du chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi gsol kha'i mthar/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen dang 'dre 'jigs kyi spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa la sogs pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag rus pa la sogs kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs kyi rol mo/ nub tu drag po'i brub khung du liṅga thun rdzas/ nub byang du dbang phyug phur srung sogs kyi gtor ma/ byang shar du dgra bgegs 'phang mnan chas sogs mtha' sdud kyi yo byad rnams 'god dgos pa yin kyang stod las kyi skabs su mdor bsdus kyis chog /srung ba'i phur bu bcu po'ang dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sngags gdab pa'i go rim las ma 'chug pa dang*/ ma traṃ yang de bzhin du bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du stong mchod sogs/ mchod rdzas bkod/ gang rgyas ci mdzes las dmigs bsal ma dgos kyang*/ phyag rgyun du stong mchod rgyas pa phyogs bzhir stegs bu bang rim bcu gcig re dang*/ 'bring sor bdun/ tha ma sor gsum ldan par byas pa'i steng na rim bzhin/ sman gtor/ rak+ta/ rig ma bcu drug dang rdzas rtags sna bdun sogs 'bur du gtod pa/ ma 'dzoms na ri mo bris pa/ mchod yon/ zhab bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ tshogs sha dum bcas/ thams cad kyi mthar mar me'i phreng ba bcas brgya rtsa re dang*/ phyogs bzhi'am/ mdun du zhal zas rgyan spros gzab pa bzhi'am gsum/ 'dzoms na phyogs bzhi la mar me rgyun 'bar lnga re/

phyi rol bar snang du 'phrul 'degs kyi mar me 'bar ba bzhi/ ma 'dzoms na zur logs che ba bcu gnyis su mar me che ba bcu gnyis/ mdun ngos su brje zhing gso rgyu'i chu gnyis nyer spyod/ tshogs kyi gdan yang zhing gi kheb/ sngon 'gro 'bul gtor phal cher bshams pa'i cog steng kheb gdan ched 'jog bde ba sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i rigs thams cad bkod cing 'du bya'o/ lnga pa tshogs sgrub kyi las la 'jug rung bya ba sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa ni/ las rdor gyi thod chang mar zil can dang*/ phud skyogs thogs la tshig bstun so sor drangs/ rgyal tshab pa'am/ rgyal theb kyis gtso bo'i zhwa chos bcas gral gsham du bzhengs te/ stong thun sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs snyan bor len tshul gyis/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po nyid: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dug lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas: ston pa'i sgron me mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes dang*/ rgyal tshab bzhi la/ hūm̐: bla med gdung 'tshob sku gsung thugs kyi sras: dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang dngos grub spel: dbang bskur phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa: rgyal tshab ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs:

yum la/ gnyis med bde skyed mtshan nyid rab tu bzang : kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdo rje las sar/ phrin las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad: rdo rje karma mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: ging tshogs par/ bar chod bgegs bsgral gzugs phung lha la stob: rdo rje ging mchog mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: mtshams par/ phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad srung : rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: spyan par/ dngos grub bgegs gnyis dus dang drod tshad mkhyen: rdo rje spyan par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: dus mtshams par/ phrin las skabs sbyar dus 'dzin nam tshod mkhas: rdo rje dus mtshams mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: phyag tshang par/ phud gtsang g.yos mkhas phyi nang bya byed mkhas: rdo rje phyag tshang mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: sgrub pa po byings la/ gsal dag dzap mkhas dad ldan brtson par bzhugs: gser phreng mched lcam mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdul phyags par/ kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod: rdul phyags skyes bu mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes pa'i tshig so sor dang bstun rdo rje rgyal po nas sbyin bdag gi bar du bdud rtsi'i skyems drangs shing mthar zhi rol ldir/ drug pa rtags gdab pa ni/ spro na stong thun sngon du 'gro ba'i dbyangs bor len tshul gyis/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sa gsum dag la dgod bya'i phyir: smin mtshams thal chen tshom bu'i mtshan mas gdab: /zhes rgyal tshab pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi smin mtshams dang nywa sul du thal chen tshom bus rtse gsum ris bkod/ slar slob dpon gyis rgyal tshab par de bzhin du gdab/ des 'gres te/ tshigs bcad rkang pa dang po gsum 'dra/ rkang pa tha ma'i gnas su/ lkog mar zhag gi zo ris mtshan mas gdab:

ces og ko dang brang la zhag chen zo ris zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs gdab/ 'bur bzhir khrag gi thig le'i mtshan mas gdab: ces dpral ba/ mkhur tshos gnyis/ ma ne ste 'bur bzhir khrag chen gyi thig le gdab/ rgyal theb rnams la rgyal tshab pas bkod/ mthar zhi rol ring po'i 'og oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā bhasma ma hā keṃ ni ri ti: ma hā rak+ta hūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags brjod bzhin du rgyal theb rnams kyis 'dus pa thams cad la rtags gdab bo/ des ni dpal gyi sras su gyur te mkha' 'gro ging gis skyob cing rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ 'dir khral dang las skal sogs zhib par gzhung 'di dang bka' dgongs sogs gzhung chen rnams las 'byung ba ltar dgos kyang deng sang phyag len dkyus la de tsam ma 'grub pas so so'i sgrigs lam dkyil 'khor khang pa'i spyod yul dang bstun par bya'o/ bdun pa brda sbyar ba ni/ gdod nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du tshad med bzhi'i 'jug pas zhugs par bsams la/ las byang ltar/ hūm̐: grangs med bag chags brtsegs pa phung po'i sgo: ma rig blang dor 'thib po phyes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ brda sgo dbye/ lha dang bla ma mched lcam thams cad la rang bzhin gnyis su med par rang rig pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i rtsa gsum lha: dran rig rtsal las shar ba'i rang mdangs te: gnyis su ma grub lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: rang rig 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ brda phyag 'tshal la/ brgyad pa slob ma bsre bsnan ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril yungs thun bdud rtsi sogs bkod/ las rdor gyis sgo yi phyi rol du/ mched gsar rnying thams cad khrus byas nas dbyung*/ ji ltar bltam pa tsam gyi ni/ lha rnams sogs/ slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor sbyin pa ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du:

'jug par khyed cag skal ldan la: sgrub la mi dbang gnod byed bgegs: 'thar zhing mtshams bcad phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nā na baṃ hūm̐ ging ka ra ging ka ra gnod byed thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ hūm̐ bzhi'i sham bur/ badz+ra badz+ra: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: ha na ha na: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces drag sngags rol mo/ yungs thun gu gul dud pas bgegs bskrad la/ mched rnying pa rnams nang du btang nas gral du 'khod/ slob dpon gyis bskul te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs sprin gtibs pa ltar 'khod par gyur par mos la thams cad kyis/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum rten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchaud pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcur 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i dge ba rnams: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: las byang ltar bdud rtsi byin rlabs bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rlung me thod sgyed steng du bhan+dha'i snod: yangs shing rgya che bdud rtsi sman gyis bkang : bcud g.yo mdangs ldan mkha' ltar rgyas pa 'di: byin gyis brlabs pas bla med rdzas chen gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ sman mchod ni: hūm̐: dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di/ sogs nas khā hi'i bar rkang thon 'bul/ sman gyi lhag ma la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas pa dam chur byin gyis brlab/ mched gsar pa rnams rnying pa la bsre zhing bsnan pa'i cho ga dngos ni/

rgyal theb gtso bo zhig sgo yi sar phyin nas/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu rnams dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'jug par spro na gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: zhes brda sbyar/ hoḥ rmad byung dag pa rab 'byams la: bdag cag don ldan ci'i mi dad: nges don dgongs phyir srog ltar bzung : mi 'da' dam tshig ldan lags so: zhes lan gsum zhu/ rgyal theb kyis/ sngon las tshogs gnyis mthar son pa'i: rgyal ba'i sras su 'os lags sam: rgyud ngan la sogs blo can gyi: 'jug pa'i skabs med phyir dengs shig: ces dris pas lan gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin du sgrub bo bgyid do: las dang skal par ldan lags so: rgyal theb kyis/ de ltar yin na 'os so/ rung ngo*/ legs so/ zhes brjod la nang du btang*/ phyag gsum 'tshal du gzhug /de dag gi gtso bo zhig la mig dar g.yogs/ me tog gtad pa/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas dor ba'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor mdun phyogs bskor bar mos la/ bskor ba gcig tsam bya/ rgyal theb kyis gral gsham nas phyag dang bcas 'di skad zhu'o/ hoḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i rigs can rnams: byang chub rdo rje'i lam la drangs: rdo rje rgyal po nyid la gtad: nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ slob dpon gyis/ kyaiḥ mi shes dri ma dang bral ba: ye shes mig gcig dri ma med: dag pa gsum ldan ye shes spyan: dri bral don gyi spyan dbye'o: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces mig dar bsal/ sngar brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi gsar pa rnams kyi lce la sbyin te/ bdud rtsi nyid ye shes sems dpa' ngo bor hūm̐ mthing nag rer gyur nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par gyur: hūm̐: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: nam yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: nyes na na rag spyod par 'gyur: de phyir tshul bzhin yang dag srungs: sa ma ya rak+ṣa si hūm̐:
