dam tshig gnas la tshul bzhin du slob bo snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dan+ta na ra kan: zhes bro bor gsar rnying gnyis gral 'dres te bzhugs pa thams cad kyi lce la bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐: gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i: bla med dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: rdo rje'i mched lcam spun grogs rnams: dus 'dir rtag spyod dam bsres nas: nam yang mi 'da' rdo rje'i mched: srog gi phyir yang dam bsrung ngo : gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod cing*/ spyi bor ā+oṃḥdakar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gsum dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāk+ka sid+dhi aḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: deng phyin chad mched gsar rnying thams cad skal pa mnyam pa yin pas gral gcig la 'dug pas chog pa yin no: zhes brda sbyar/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'du bral med pa'i gzung thag la: dam tshig srog gi bsdus pa'i mched dang lcam: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod do/ dam tshig bslab bya rgyas par bya/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ta prañdzā pa ri ta na da saṃ bha wa ti badz+ra dharma hri da ya san+to kha ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā: brjod cing dril bu bsil ba sogs rol mo sgra cher bsgrag go /dgu pa lha bskos la gdab pa ni/ gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang du 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar mos la/ 'dus pa rnams dbu zhwa bcas bzhengs la/ pad kor phyi nang du bsgyur cing*/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rol pa'i pho brang chen po nas/ /'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku/

/rigs bdag sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /rngam yangs bde chen 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /yang dag dpal chen zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /drag po e yi chos 'byung pho brang nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas/ /sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi yab yum rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ phyogs bcu rang rtsal rol pa'i pho brang nas/ khro bcu yab yum phra thabs phur 'debs rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /drag po'i pho brang gnyer pa'i las mdzad ma/ /sgo skyong rigs bzhi ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyang*/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /za gsod dbugs la rngam pa'i pho brang nas/ /pho nya ging bdud bka' nyan nyer bzhi rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /phyag gnyan sna tshogs ma nges bsgyur ba'i tshogs/ /chos dbyings rol pa chen po'i stong nyid las/ /ma 'gags thugs rje'i rang rtsal sna tshogs ston/ /dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod do/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phur khrom sogs sgrub rdzas so so la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ thal sbyar bcas/ oṃ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor du/ zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*/ thugs rje'i nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa'i lha/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/

/kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzungs chen bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mor 'khyil ba la/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*/ /ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang*/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bla med go 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' ka dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/

/spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal/ /yun du mi btang 'da' bar mi bgyid cing*/ /don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*/ /gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*/ /shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te/ sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ /skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya zhes/ /bka' las byung zhing de ltar mi rtogs te/ /gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang*/ /mngon shes med pas skyon can ma lcogs te/ /nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*/ /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*/ /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs/ /nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gis/ /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams/ /rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de/ /mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pa la/ /rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na/ /nongs pa mchis na rab gnong bzod par gsol/

zhes dri med rgyal po bshags pa'i rgyud las/ ye shes lha dang 'khon bcugs bshags pa'i le'u bzhi pa khul du phyung ba tshar gcig gi mjug /yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i tshe slob dpon gyis dril bu 'khrol zhing dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor la lhag chad kha bkang*/ bcu pa byin dbab pa ni/ slob dpon dang rgyal theb rnams sngags chas kyis dkyil 'khor mdun du g.yab dril thogs pa 'khod/ de'ang rig 'dzin byin 'bebs pa la/ g.yab dar sna lnga dang dmar po gcig /gzhung gi byin 'bebs la slob dpon gyis zhing lpags dang*/ gzhan rnams la g.yab dar nag po kho na g.yab/ las rdor gyis g.yab dar sna lnga'i g.yab mo dang*/ g.yon spos phor tshil chen gu gul sbyar spos kyi dud pa thogs nas mdun bsu/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi la rgyal mtshan thogs pa bzhi 'khod/ 'dus pa rnams kyang bzhengs la zhwa chos bstar te rol mo dbyangs dang bcas dang po ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas bla ma rig 'dzin mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang khyad par yang dag rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par snang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar til gyi gang bu kha phyes pa bzhin spyan drangs nas bdag sgrub pa po'i yo byad thams cad la thim pas dur khrod rol pa'i zhing khams rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bdag nyid du gyur: par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya satwaṃ: dbyangs rol mo'i 'gyur khug dang bcas te/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs 'og min chos dbyings nas: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: phyogs bcu dregs pa'i gdan steng nas: khro rgyal yab yum phra men bcas: sras dang sprul 'khor thams cad kyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob:

zla gam e yi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*/ phrin las sprul pa'i sras mchog gis/ dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi gru chad nas: mthu dang drag rtsal bsam mi khyab: phrin las rnam bzhi sgo skyong gis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dur khrod gnas dang phyogs mtshams nas: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: bswe lcags dung gi skyes chen gyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dur khrod g.ya' gangs dben gnas nas: ging chen bco brgyad laṅka'i tshogs: dbang phyug brtan ma'i tshogs bcas kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: sgrub mchog rnams la dbang chen bskur: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ston: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya a be sha ya a āḥ gzhan yang gzhung gi byin 'bebs yang bya/ shar nas byin dbab ste dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas te/ byin dbab pa'i mthar brgyud gsum rol mo la phyag bzhes ltar rkang gling dang bshugs glu gsum gsum btang ba'i tshe lan gcig bskor nas rang gnas su bzhugs la dkyil 'khor brtan par bya ba'i phyir me tog 'thor/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang dge bsngo sogs kyis nyin gnyis pa grub bo/ 'di nyin snga dro phyi dro nam bder rdo rje rgyal theb dpon slob nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ ༈ spyi don gnyis pa la'ang gsum/ phrin las dzap bsnyen dang bcas pa dngos grub sgrub pa/ bar chad kyi rtags bsal ba dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'o/ dang po ni/ spyir 'di la smin slob dang mos slob gnyis las deng skabs su yul dus brtson pa'i dbang gis phyi ma kho na la'ang gsum/ phrin las lag tu len pa'i dbang du byas pa te/ de'ang 'dus pa rnams gral du 'khod nas thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ yan lag bdun pa/ thub bstod/ sogs rang lugs chos spyod ltar gnas ri so dgu ma/

theg chen dgu ldan/ sogs/ 'og m-in chos kyi sogs/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ bla ma sku khams bzang bar sogs bya/ brgyud 'debs mthar/ snyan gsan rol mo byas la/ skyabs sems lan gsum re'i mtshams/ bsang chu byin brlab bya/ las rdor gyis gral mdor stegs ky-i steng du dkar bgegs bshams nas spyi ltar bya/ gzhung gi mtshams gcod la las rdor gyis gu gul dang*/ byin 'bebs spyan 'dren rnams la spos bskor bya/ byin 'bebs la thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes shing gtor mchod thams cad bsang chus bran/ dkar bgegs ma gtogs gzhan rnams de rjes bdud rtsis bran/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs bya/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum mgor ye shes sku mchog 'don/ yig brgya/ lha bskyed skabs bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom/ rang gi mdun du thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya la brten byas te phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor rang gi mdun du bsgom pa yin/ lha bskyed grub zin pa dang*/ yid kyi phur pa rdzas dkyil thams cad la dmigs pas khyab par byas nas bstod pa'i mthar dzap bskul bya/ mthar las rdor gyis dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul zhing pad kor bcas gzung thag blangs te slob dpon dang rgyal tshab la phul te de dag gis kyang de bzhin du blangs te gtso bsnyen grub nye ba dang bsnyen rgyun pa rnams kyis dzap blang*/ rgyal tshab pas gzung thag thun dpon la sprad de/ de nas brtsam sgrub ba'i bsnyen rgyun ma grol gyi bar rgyun mi bcad cing gzung thag stong par ma bor bar bya'o/ dzap kyi dgongs pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshang dgos shing lugs 'di thun mong ma yin pa dang sbyar te gtso bsnyen yang phur rgyud las/ gtso bo la bye ba/ 'khor rnams la khri re re bya bar gsungs kyang thun khong gcig la gtso bo la stong phrag re tsam la chog par rtsis nas bzhi ka rdzogs pa dang*/

stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs rdzogs pa dang*/ hūm̐ sgrub bya/ rigs bzhi dang khro bcu la brgya re/ sgo ma dang dbang phyug la lnga bcu re phyin chad dam can rnams la nyer gcig re bya/ sku gsung thugs la dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs gtso bor bya/ dmigs pa rnams rgyud dang gzhung gi dgongs pa dngos su gsal ba ltar ma 'chol bar bya/ bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsum ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer tshwa tshwa lta bus dgra bgegs rdul du brlags par bsam mo/ staung tshig rjes mar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs nas dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya rten snying lan gsum bzla/ thun gtor gzhung ltar phul/ thun mthar khyab bdag dpal chen karma he ru ka sogs smon lam bya/ thun gnyis pa la skyes rabs gsol 'debs nas bzung*/ phrin las rgyun khyer gzhung ltar btang*/ bsnyen dmigs rgyas bsdus gang bde bya/ mthar staung tshig /mchod bstod mthar/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams sngar ltar bya/ dngos grub bskul/ thun gtor 'bul/ mthar bskang gsol thun gtor 'gugs gzhug nas bzung dbang phyug las bskul/ phur srung bcu drug sde lnga/ lha mo zhi drag /btsan gsol/ gze rgyal gsol kha/ dge bsnyen mthar phrin bcol bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho sogs mthar chags su btang*/ rgyal theb gcig sngags chas bcas gral mdor nyul le'i phyag len rnams spyi ltar bya/ byin 'bebs rgyas bsdus gang bde'i mthar/ dzap dbyangs lan gsum bya/ snga dro'i thun grub bo/ phyi dro gsol 'debs bsam don myur 'grub dang*/ las byang phrin las rgyun khyer tshar gcig bsnyen pa'i bar gong gsal ltar btang*/ de nas las rdor gyis tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad 'du bya la zhing lpags sam gcan gzan pags pa gang rung gi steng du bkram/

tshogs tha ma zur du bzhag /tshogs zhu byed/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang las tshogs byin rlabs gzhung bzhin bya/ zhwa phud la bshags pa 'don/ slar zhwa gsol tshogs tha ma bsgral bstab phyag len rgyal tshab pas mdzad/ gtsang lhag bzhag /zhus len bcas tshogs la rol/ mang lhag rjes mar rdor slob kyi lhag mas non par bsdus la gral mdor zhing lpags kyi steng du bkod pa'i khar rkang gsum la gtsang lhag bzhag las rdor gyis rdo rje rtse gcig rgyas 'don tshig dang bstun/ gtsang lhag nas dman lhag mdun cung zad bzhag cing*/ de'i dum gtsang lhag tu bzhag /mang lhag nas yar bsre/ mthar gtsang lhag phyir bsres rdor slob bam/ rgyal tshab mdun du bzhag ste mkha' gsang rgyas bkab par slob dpon pas rtse gcig gi rgya'am/ de go ldog pas kyang rung ste/ gang ltar nang mchod blugs shing khyab par bran/ slar khyer la gral mdor bkod 'don pa tshar ba'i 'bebs 'og rtse gcig gi rgyas bzung la/ lhag 'cham dang sbyar/ phyir nud kyi tshul bya zhing mthar ci bder khyer la dkyil 'khor lho nub tu snod chen por bsags la kheb kyis bkab bo/ tshogs smon lam bya/ 'gugs gzhug nas/ gzhung bskul btang*/ gtor 'bul rnams rim pa bzhin phrin bcol bcas tshang bar mthar dbyung*/ las byang gi chad mdo gyer ba'i tshe las rdor grogs dan pa sogs zhwa bcas/ chad mdo la me ru btsugs sman raka gis bran te snod thams cad gral mdor bkyag /chad mdo'i mthar rol chen 'og phyir 'bul/ gtor snod rnams sman raka gis bshal ba brtan ma'i gtor ma sgo khang du bzhag la blugs nas gyer mthar phul te snod thams cad gral mdor sbub/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje zhus nas kha phyir phyogs pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis rgya gram du bkod nas 'gugs gzhug bcas/ rta bro'i mthar/ snod gzed la 'bru 'thor/ kun gyis zhwa phud/ rdo rje slar phul/ zhar byung tshe 'gugs bya/

tshe mda' phul la/ hūm̐: rdo rje tshe yi pho brang nas: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: oṃ gu ru ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi hrīḥ de nas gtang rag gi mchod bstod nongs bshags yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum gsum bcas byas la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du/ ras bris yin na/ 'byung ba chen po gzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du de srid du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis bdag bskyed 'od gsal bsdu/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis gnyug ma'i he ru kar ldang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṇa karma kī ya la dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces srung ba'i go bsgo zhing*/ rang gzhung srung zlog 'don/ bkra shis dbu zhwa gyon bzhengs shing gshar gdangs sam rnga 'don gyi mthar rol chen bcas bya'o/ bsngo smon yan brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ dam sri nyams log gi rtags su don med par sems 'khrugs shing 'thab rtsod 'byung ba dkyil 'khor la mar me'i mdangs nyams pa dang*/ chags sdang rang gar skye zhing*/ skyo 'jigs snying mi dga' ba nad dang sdug bsngal slong ba/ bskyed bzlas mi thon pa sogs phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mang na/ gzhung las/ lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul yin:

re dogs 'khrul pa'i bag chags yin: ma rigs blang dor dgag sgrub yin: lha bdud sems kyi rang rtsal las: rang sems mthong ba su yis gnod: zhes gsungs so/ spyir re dogs kyi snyems thag bcad de lta bas zil gyis gnon/ bye brag da lta'i phyag rgyun dkyus su 'byung ba ni/ nyul le bskrod par mtshams pa rnams grabs su tshud pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mdun du rdo rje rgyal po dang rgyal tshab zhwa chos/ rgyal theb bzhi sngags chas kyis brgyan cing khri'u khar bzhugs 'dus pa kun zhwa chos bcas 'khod pa'am/ yang yul dus gnas tshul dang bstun nang du sa 'khos dogs na phyi khyams su ser sbreng ltar bya ba'ang snang*/ gang ltar yang mdun du hom khung du liṅga bzhag la phur thun sogs 'god/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs pa'i nang du dgra bgegs dngos su gsal bar gyur/ zhes brub khung bskyed/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ dgra bgegs gnod byed khyad par sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri nyul le sgab 'dre thams cad gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum ging pa las kyi pho nyar gsal ba'i thugs las mtshon cha'i char phab pas gnod byed rdul du brlags par bsam la phur thun tshom bur bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha:

phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur ston pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: sras mchog sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar gsal: phur pa'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyus 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rang nyid srung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor pad+ma kro dhi shwa rī byad phur bzlog phyir sked la lan gsum bskor badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs sgrol phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril ma hā yak+sha pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su lan gsum phyar kā la rū pa g.yas su lan gsum bsgril karma raṃ raṃ mo rgyud dbang sdud g.yon du lan gsum phyar dz+wa la raṃ g.yon du lan gsum bsgril hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra lag g.yas rdo rje g.yab dar dang bcas pa'i dbye bskrad kyi rgya dang ldan pas ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe khrus dgongs pa dang ldan pas phur bu dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gdab bo/ ces drag sngags phur bskor bcas pa dang*/ sngags kyis gdab/ spu gri'i sngags/

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ ma rak+mo yak+mo kā la rū pa/ snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying rtsa la phril phril/ srog rtsa la chum chum/ tsit+ta srog la dung dung*/ snying khrag shad dzaḥ thuṃ hri li li/ snying tsig tsig 'ur 'ur/ shig shig 'gul 'gul/ myag myag sod sod/ dha dhi ma karma shrī kraṃ ka ra ya/ ma ra se na/ pra mar+dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ ṭāk+ki rnams kyis thun gyis brab/ khyad par gyi pho nya kun thub rgyal mo bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug: bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg: bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs: bgegs la bab na rus pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs:

dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yak+ṣa byin: yak+ṣa byin: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsit+ta rbad nan: oṃ sum bha ni? oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rak+ṣa rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang*/ khyad par gyi dbyug pas brdegs shing thun gyis brab/ 'dir yang gar 'cham rnams kyi 'gros dang cha lugs 'cham yig ltar la/ shar phyogs dkar mo'i mthar/ kun thub ma'i phyag mtshan khyad par gyi dbyug pa dkar po'i mi rkang la zhing lpags kyi lcag 'bras btags pa/ nag po'i gri lag bcas g.yon gyis thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba dang*/ phyi nang kun tu thun brab pa'i tshe slob dpon sogs ting 'dzin ma yengs pas mtshams gcod pa dang mthar srung 'khor gyi dmigs pa brtan por bsgom zhing srung sngags rnams gsung ngo*/ de nas nang du log ste byin dbab pa ni/ slob dpon dang rgyal theb rnams sngags chas kyis dkyil 'khor mdun du g.yab dril thogs pa 'khod/ de'ang rig 'dzin byin 'bebs pa la/ g.yab dar sna lnga dang dmar po gcig /gzhung gi byin 'bebs la slob dpon gyis zhing lpags dang*/ gzhan rnams la g.yab dar nag po kho na g.yab/ las rdor gyis g.yab dar sna lnga'i g.yab mo dang*/ g.yon spos phor tshil chen gu gul sbyar spos kyi dud pa thogs nas mdun bsu/ 'dus pa rnams kyang bzhengs la zhwa chos bstar te/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo:

sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭ kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang : bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : bdag gis byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes sngon du 'gro la byin 'bebs pa ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas dang po ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas bla ma rig 'dzin mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang khyad par yang dag rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par snang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar til gyi gang bu kha phyes pa bzhin spyan drangs nas bdag sgrub pa po'i yo byad thams cad la thim pas dur khrod rol pa'i zhing khams rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bdag nyid du gyur: par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya satwaṃ: dbyangs rol mo'i 'gyur khug dang bcas te/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:

pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ zhes sam skabs su phur pa'i byin 'bebs 'di yang bya'o/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs 'og min chos dbyings nas: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: phyogs bcu dregs pa'i gdan steng nas: khro rgyal yab yum phra men bcas: sras dang sprul 'khor thams cad kyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: zla gam e yi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*/ phrin las sprul pa'i sras mchog gis/ dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi gru chad nas: mthu dang drag rtsal bsam mi khyab: phrin las rnam bzhi sgo skyong gis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dur khrod gnas dang phyogs mtshams nas: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: bswe lcags dung gi skyes chen gyis: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: dur khrod g.ya' gangs dben gnas nas:

ging chen bco brgyad laṅka'i tshogs: dbang phyug brtan ma'i tshogs bcas kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: sgrub mchog rnams la dbang chen bskur: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ston: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya a be sha ya a āḥ gzhan yang gzhung gi byin 'bebs yang bya/ shar nas byin dbab ste dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas te/ byin dbab pa'i mthar brgyud gsum rol mo la phyag bzhes ltar rkang gling dang bshugs glu gsum gsum btang ba'i tshe lan gcig bskor nas rang gnas su 'khod mthar kī la ya yi dzap dbyangs kyis drangs pa'i dzap drag tu bzlas te grol ba thun thams cad la 'gre/ 'dir nyul le bskrad pa mtshams spros bcas dang sbrel sla ba'i dbang du byas nas lag len spyi ltar bkod pa yin gyi 'cham sogs mi spro na/ 'di nyid rang lugs mtshan thun gyi 'jug ltar yin la/ de las kyang spros pa bsdu na thun drug so so'i mthar rnal 'byor pa rnams lha'i nga rgyal bskyed la kī la drag tu bzlas te gu gul gyi dud pa 'grim pa tsam gyis kyang chog par gsungs la/ phur sgrub skabs 'dir rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol ba'i rgyal theb gcig gzhung 'tshogs gral lam gang bder bzhugs nas/ grub na nyin mtshan dus drug tu nyul le bskrad pa bka' brgyad sgos bskul 'drar bya bar gsungs pa bzhin/ spro bar mos na/ gsang zil las byung ba'i gnas nyul rang lugs ltar/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di nas gnas chen bye ba stong dang phrag: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'bar ba yi: zla ba dkar mo khro chu khol ma'i klong : nyi ma dmar ser rak+ta 'khrigs pa'i dbus: ljang nag rlung ri bu yug 'tshubs pa'i dkyil: ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: las kyi ging chen yab yum bcu gnyis te: ye shes ging chen dkar gsal drag tu 'khros: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams:

rdo rje ging mo myur mgyogs chu shel mdog: phyag na g.yang gzhi bhan+dha rlon pa thogs: tho rangs nam langs rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ging chen ser nag mi sdug gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na 'khor lo thod khrag dkrugs: rin chen ging mo gser mdog 'od kyis 'gengs: g.yang gzhi bhan+dha thogs shing stong khams 'grim: nyi shar nyi dros rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sor rtog ging chen dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na me thun bhan dmar thogs: pad+ma ging mo zangs mdog mche ba gtsigs: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing tshogs khang nyul: nyin phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bya grub ging chen ljang nag khrag 'thung gzugs: rdo rje phur pa 'dzin cing nyon mongs bsgral: las kyi ging mo rlung mdog shugs ldan ma: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar rak+ta dkrug cing 'thung : nyi thal mun 'tshub rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos dbyings ging chen mthing nag gtum pa'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri thun gri zor 'dzin: bud+dha ging mo lcags mdog 'khrul snang gzhom: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing stong gsum g.yo: srod dang srod 'khor rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'gyu byed ging chen nag po dug gi gdong : g.yas g.yon phyag na spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin: sha za ging mo mun pa'i zug rngu can: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing dpag tshad khyab: nam phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim phyir gshegs su gsol: sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol:

oṃ ghṛ wa ṣa ṭa kro ta dza dzaḥ hūm̐: bskul lo ging chen pho mo rnams: mdzod cig nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul: rbad do rnal 'byor nyams grib sol: brten no nyon mongs zug rngu sregs: 'bod do dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: rnal 'byor dam tshig chag nyams rnams: bshags so rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: ging chen lha tshogs dus la bab: nyon mongs lhong gsum dgra dar na: ging chen thugs dam dus la bab: dam tshig gnas nas bskul ba'i tshe: ging phos rdo thun sha ra ra: ging mos me zor wa la la: dmar nag ral pa sa la gzhol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: rgyu ma'i zhags pa na ra ra: stag lpags sham thabs khrigs se khrig: rngam rgyug gar stabs lings se lang : rkang gling phaṭ sgra 'u ru ru: bshugs sgra ljags glu kyu ru ru: bgegs bskrad gad mo lhangs se lhang : phyi yi rnam rtog bdud dgra chom: nang gi nyon mongs bdud dgra chom: gsang ba'i na tsha rkyen ngan phrol: dug lnga'i 'khrul pa da shigs la: nga bdag 'gong po dbyings su sgrol: dam sri gnod byed rmang nas phyungs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i bar chad thal bar rlog: oṃ kro ta ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed nyon mongs bdud thams cad gardza gardza phaṭḥ oṃ kro ti shwa rī ghṛ ni bh+yoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel ngan pa thams cad da ha da ha dz+wa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram gu khul gyi+e gsur dud btang*/ de nas sgrub pa ma grol bar bgegs che na/ dus bcu gnyis sam/ drug tu cha bgos pa'am yang na snga dgong re re btang bas gegs sel lo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dus drug bzlas shing dngos 'grul dang yo byad la me thun chu thun brdeg pa sogs mtshams gcod srung 'khor la gtsor bton cing khyad par nang nub tu srung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par bsgom/ mi lcogs na me chu'i thun gyi bya ba tsam las gzhan dkyus 'gror zhugs pas 'thus so/

nyin mor bsnyen rgyun pa ji tsam brje len byas kyang snga ma rnams gral mdor bzhengs nas gsung mi bcad la rjes ma gral la 'khod nas dzab bsnyen dbu tshugs pa'i tshe snga ma rnams kyis kha skong pa dang stong tshig 'bul nas gyes so/ mtshan thun la gsum bya ba'i/ gsum kar rgyal theb re dbu bzhugs kyi slob dpon kha shas nas las byang*/ brgyud 'debs bsnyen pa'i bar btang*/ bsnyen par slebs skabs thun pa snga ma grol zhing rjes mas len tshul nyin mo dang 'dra/ thun rjes ma rnams su las byang pa rnams kyis bsnyen pa nyung tsam dang kha skong stong tshig mthar rgyal theb mdun thun dang liṅga sogs bkod la nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa sogs sngar ltar ram stabs bde byed na/ rdo rje mtshams pas gu gul dud pa dang thun brab ste dkyil 'khor bskor la drag sngags so lnga pa dang*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sder mo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas tshar bcad la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ mthar byin 'bebs rgyas pa'am bsdus pa ni/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod/ oṃ dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃḥ

zhes rol mo'i mthar sngags dbyangs bcas grol/ de yan gyis nyin gsum pa ste sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i nyin dang po song*/ nyin bzhi pa'i phyin chad sgrub pa zhag gang byed la 'don bsgrigs sogs de kho na ltar las 'dor len mi dgos/ nangs re bzhin dge slong bzhi sde tsam gyis rgyal tho dang sgo byang phyi nang kha gso/ 'don bya mchod gtor sngar ltar dang*/ cha gsum btang ba sogs kyang mdzad srol mchis so/ grol ba'i snga nyin pad+ma rgyal theb dpon slob nas dbang gi sbyin sreg bya'o/ gsum pa ni dngos grub kyi ltas la gnas skabs mthar thug dngos dang ltar snang la sogs pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba rnams gzhung spyi dang khyad par rang gzhung las/ rab dngos: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam du yi dam gyi zhal mthong lung ston: khrag 'thung nga yi zhal mthong zhing : phyag mtshan nor bu dag kyang 'khrab: gtor ma rak+ta bdud rtsi khol: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong lung ston sems rtse gcig tu ting 'dzin la gnas pa dang*/ sgrub rdzas 'od 'phro bdud rtsi khol/ rmi lam dang mchod rten dang ri bo'i rtse dang khri la 'dug pa dang khrom la dbang bskur chos 'chad pa gter 'don pa pha rol gyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa sogs mtshan ma spyi ltar 'byung zhing de yang bzang ba la dga' spro dang*/ ngan pa snyems rtog mi bya ba gnad du che'o/ zhes pa ltar ye shes kyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i rtags rnams glo bur du byung na rgyun gyi dngos grub len chog bya zhing*/ ltas bzang gtan la phebs na dngos grub blang ba la 'jug go ༈ spyi don gsum pa la gsum/ bdag don du dngos grub blang ba/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba/ thun mong du mjug bsdu ba'o/ dang po ni sgrub pa chen po'i las rim ni/ dngos sbyor sgrol la brten pa yin yang*/ deng mos slob kyi skabs rdzas la brten nas len pa la gsum/ rdzas bshams pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro/ cho ga dngos so/

dang po sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun nas/ dngos grub gyi rdzas bshams pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du stegs bu kheb gdan dkar po'i steng du 'bru'i g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil du bris pa'i dbus su las bzhi lhun grub kyi 'brang rgyas dkar mngar gyis spras shing oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mdun du mañdza'i khar dbang bzhi brtsegs thabs su byas la g.yas su sgrub thod mtshan ldan du bur chang la chos sman btab pa'i steng tshil chen gyi sprin kheb btang ba'i khar/ dar sna lngas bkab pa'i steng rdo rje bzhag pa/ g.yon du rak+ta'i snod dang mtha' bskor bza' btung dkar mngar zas sna tshogs mchod/ mngar gsum ril bu mched lcam la 'dang nges kyis bskor/ phyogs bzhi las bzhi 'brang rgyas dang*/ steng du dar dkar gyi lding gur bcas bkod pa mdzes par bya'o/ 'di nyin gtor spungs dang chad brtan gsar du bsham mi dgos/ dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags rkyu grang med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos sgrub thams cad sna lnga'i rnams pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags sham du/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzla/ sang nyin thor thun bzlas pa kha skong stong tshig bcas grub nas bsnyen rgyun snga ma grol/ gnyis pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro ni/ sang grol ba'i nyin cung zad snga bar 'tshogs la/ las byang sogs 'don bya nyin snga ma rnams ltar phrin las gzhung bsrang te/ bsnyen pa bsdus tsam skabs/ thun dpon gyis gzung thag rgyal tshab par 'bul/ mthar thun pa rnams dang bcas chabs cig kha skong dang stong tshig byas la gzung thag las rdor gyis bsdu zhing thun pa rnams kyis kī la yar dngos grub blang sngags btags la rgyun bzung*/

gtor bsngos bsdus tsam dang*/ tshogs tha ma'i skabs nyu le'i liṅga mer bsregs la/ de nas tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab yan rgyas par bya ba'i zhal stabs skabs nyul le'i liṅga mer bsregs nas thal ba phyed chos skyong gtor mar btab/ phyed mnan chas su bzhag /yang phyag len phal mo cher/ dngos grub kyi rdzas de nang rang du bshams/ snga nub dmigs bzlas 'di mi byed pa'ang yod pas long khyab dang bstun pas chog /gnyis pa dngos grub la mi dbang ba'i lta nyan gyi bgegs tshar bcad pa'i phyir/ 'dus pa rnams zhwa chos dang bcas las byang gi bgegs gtor btang*/ skabs 'dir las kyi rdo rjes bgegs gtor dang rgyal tshab pas thun gyis brab bzhin dkyil 'khor bskor zhing bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom/ de ma thag las rdor nas spos ring g.yab dar dang*/ rgyal tshab pas g.yab dril thogs la/ 'dus pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor bskor la/ sgrub khog gzhung gi byin 'bebs sogs gong gsal brjod cing byin dbab/ ye shes sku mchog dang yig brgya brjod dngos grub kyi gegs su gyur pa'i nongs pa bshags/ dngos grub rdzas kyi khar gzung thag rdo rje bzhag pas sne rdor slob kyis 'dzin te rdzas rnams dngos grub kyi phung por byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gi sa sbyangs/ dngos grub rdzas kyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo thams cad oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gyur/ rdzas rnams la char babs pa bzhin du rgyun mi 'chad par sib sib thim par gyur/ phyag rgya pad kor byas la/ kī la ya yi sham bur/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzlas la bsnyen rgyun grol/ snyan pa'i gdung dbyangs drag po'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:

yang dag dpal chen phur pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bskul/ dngos grub kyi sman rak+ta bdud rtsi sbar ba thogs la/ hūm̐: 'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud: nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i mchog: dza gad rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: zhes khrag chang mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐: dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di/ so so'i mtshan dang sngags mthar/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: zhes btags pas mchod/ dngos grub bsdu ba'i dzap dbyangs dang bcas pas slob dpon rgyal theb rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing shar du 'khod pas thugs dam bskul te 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐: lhag pa'i ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha: rang bzhin dbyings nas rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang : sngon gyi thugs dam rang bzhin byin brlabs nas: rin chen nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar: dus las mi 'da' thugs rjes dbang gi lha: skyabs las mi g.yel g.yar dam gcig pa'i ngang : mi zad rin chen rgyan gyi 'khor lo nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa: skal ldan bdag la dus 'dir stsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'dzad med gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mi zad nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dngos grub stsal du gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: yang gsang 'dus pa sogs nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bskul nas/ lha gnad dbab pa ni/ spos dang sha chen bsreg /rol mo bsgrag /gdung shug drag pos pad kor thal sbyar bcas/ hūm̐: dgongs shig rdo rje phur pa'i lha:

rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: dpang gyur thams cad dgongs su gsol: dang po bsnyen cing bar du bsgrubs: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud kyang sbyangs: zhag dus grangs dang rtags kyang thems: deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye: 'dod rgu'i dngos grub rin chen gter: da ni 'byung ba'i dus la bab: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dbang dang dngos bdag la stsol: lha dang skal ba mnyam par shog: ces dang las byang gi /lhag pa'i lha sogs kyang brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas dngos grub 'bru gsum tshul du bar ma chad par rang gi gnas gsum thim par bsams la/ gong gi sngags dzap sham bu can dbyangs byas la bgrang ba'i tshe/ las rdor dang rgyal tshab gyis gtso bum dang*/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs slob dpon sar phul la gnas bzhir gtugs te dbang blang*/ lha dang dngos grub 'od du zhu/ bdag gi thugs srog la bsdu zhing dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ 'brang rgyas sogs dngos grub rdzas kyi phur pa dkyil 'khor pa dang rdor slob zung la phul grub pa dang*/ rdor slob kyis gtso phur/ rgyal tshab pas sku gsung thugs rten yum gyis rnam bum gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ rgyal theb las rdor sogs kyis bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bkye/ /tshogs la rol zhing re zhig grol/ gal te dbang bskur na skabs 'dir las rdor sogs kyis dngos grub kyi rdzas bkye ba tsam gyis 'thus so/ skabs 'dir rin chen rgyal theb dpon slob rnams nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya zhing dngos grub kyi phud kyang bsreg /lhag ma bsdus la sngar btson 'dzin byas pa'i lhag ma dang lhan cig gzhung gi lhag chog byas pa'i mthar gnas nyul gtor ma dang gser skyems btegs la/

hūm̐: ging chen bcu gnyis gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: rnal 'byor stangs byed ting 'dzin drod nyul ma: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bya ba mtha' ru phyin: lhag ma dang ni gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: om̐ dzñā na ghṛ wa kro ti satwaṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul nas badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs mthar 'bebs ring rkang gling bshugs pa'i sgras mtshon par ging pa gnyis don la rgyug 'dur gar stabs kyis lhag ma khyer te sgrub khang phyi rol lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i mtshams su bskyal/ de nas bskul pa btang*/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs de dag gi gtor ma yang phyir 'bul/ chad mdo la me sgron bcas thog khar 'bul/ brtan ma rgyun bzhag 'bul/ rta bro'i skabs sgo drung du liṅga bsregs thal dang sngar mnan chas mdor bsdus bkod pa yod na de'am med na zan ling skyer phur btab dong gru gsum brus par bcug /rgya gram sogs kyis mnan rjes cho ga mchod bstod dkyus ltar dang*/ gnyis pa la gzhan don du dbang bskur ba la/ dbang gtso bor byed pa'i lugs ni gzhan du blta zhing*/ skabs 'dir sgrub chen gyi mjug dngos grub len pa'i rjes 'brel sgrub rdzas dngos grub sbyin pa'i tshul tsam yin pas gong gsal des kyang 'thus mod/ spro na dkyil 'khor rang rang gi dbang rgyas bsdus gang rung*/ mched nang ma tsam la bskur ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la: dang po tshe 'gugs pa ni/ skad cig gis tshe 'brang bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs srog hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'phro 'dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tshe'i rang bzhin nṛḥdang āḥdang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du bkrag me re re snod bcud thams cad zhu zhing khengs pa 'ub 'ub bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim par gyur/ zhes mos la/ oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ : g.yu bh+rūm̐ : g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐ : ā yur+dzñā na g.yu tshe

bh+rūm̐ : zhes brgya rtsa bzlas la mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: sku ni nam mkha'i rdul bag med: sku mdog dmar 'tsher 'od zer 'bar: longs spyod mtshan dpe'i rgyan rnams rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: bum pa 'chi med tshe chus bkang : gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar 'khril: phyag g.yas tshe mda' yab la 'khyud: g.yon pas tshe bum snyan thad 'dzin: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: yab yum phyag gi tshe bum dang*/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas: tshe yi 'od zer 'phro 'du gsal: bkrag dang mdangs kyi dpal du shar: phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud bsdus: bkra shis bum pa'i nang du bskyil: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur: skye shi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'gyur ba med pa'i don rtogs shog: ces bskul bas/ gong gi sngags nyer gcig bzlas mthar/ hūm̐: rdo rje tshe yi pho brang dbus: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dzñā na āḥyu sid+dhi hrīḥ tshe bum 'brang rgyas dang bcas pa mched lcam rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ā yuḥṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ zhes dang*/ gnas gsum so sor bzhag ste/ kā ya ā yu ṣe om̐: wāk+ka ā yu ṣe āḥ tsit+ta ā yu ṣe hūm̐: zhes sku gsung thugs kyi tshe'i dngos grub bstim zhing dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi blud/ tshe mar spyi gtsug tu byugs pas/ lus mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ ngag grags stong kī la ya'i rang sgra/ yid gsal stong 'chi med gnyug ma'i rang babs su 'jog tu bcug ste me tog 'thor/ tshe 'brang g.yas bskor dang*/ tshe chang g.yon bskor du rol par bya'o/ gnyis pa gter sbed pa ni/

sngar gzhi rnying du bcug pa'i bum pa rten gtor sogs sgrub rdzas dang dngos grub kyi phud bcug pa/ rgyal tshab pas phyag g.yon du thogs/ g.yas pas me tog gtor/ mched lcam rnams mgrin gcig tu/ hūm̐: chos dbyings bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sa yi lha mo'i mkha' phyes shig: dbang chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: sgrub pa las kyi gter sbed do: khro rgyal yab yum phra thabs bcas: sprul pa yang sprul gter sbed do: dam rdzas gtor ma'i gter sbed do/ mi zad mdzod kyi gter sbed do/ gter chen 'di yi byin rlabs kyis: ye shes lnga la longs spyod cing : mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod spyod shog: ye shes lnga yis mdun bsus nas: bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar phyin shog: ces sgrub khang gi phyogs gang bder sba/ sgo la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis rgyas gdab/ bkra shis gang mos brjod/ gsum pa nongs bshags bsdu rim sogs ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sogs lan gsum gsum bzlas la bskor ba bya/ ye shes lha tshogs gnas 'dir byon pa legs: bdag cag 'gro rnams bsod nams skal bar ldan: dmigs med sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang thugs rjes 'byon par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ āḥ

zhes pas rdul tshon dkyil 'khor yin na slob dpon bsdu rgya dang bcas phyag gis rdo rje re kha rtse gsum pa'i tshul mtha' nas dbus su bris pa dang dbus nas tshom bu mthib srin gis blang la dpral bar thig le bya/ dam tshig pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rang la bsdu/ 'phros ma lus pa las rdor gyis/ oṃ swa bhā dharma laṃ san+ta hoḥ brjod bzhin par 'jam pa'i dar le brgan nam/ sgro phod kyis dkyil 'khor mtha' nas rim bzhin 'jam rol dang bcas tshangs thig gi lam nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar dbye zhing*/ lhag ma gzhan rnams rjes mi mngon par phyags la don du gnyer bar cung zad byin nas gzhan rnams snod gtsang mar blug /de nas dum bu gsum du bgos te/ cha gcig rin po che'i bum par blug /sgrub pa'i sman dri zhim dang bum rdzas nyer lnga/ sman sna tshogs rnams bum chur sbyar/ dar gyis bkab/ ras bris yin na bsdu ba'i tshul tsam bya srol yod do/ ras bris yin na de bor nas nyin ltar gyis brtan bzhugs bya ba spyi ltar shes so/ bzhi pa bdag bskyed bsdu ldang sogs ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams rim gyis gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de dwangs ma'i thugs srog hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs nā da'i thig le yal nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ skad cig gis rang rig byang chub sems kyi sprin las dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang ldan zhing dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rang gi mdangs las shar ba'i khams gsum yang lha yi dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la zhes bdun gyis sku dang*/ bdun gyis gsung*/ bdun gyis thugs gso/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes pas/ lus la rdo rje'i go chas zhu lub tu g.yogs par mos/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ rang gzhung*/ hoḥ ma skyes stong pa'i? sogs bsdu ldang bya/ lnga pa phyi mtshams dkrol ba ni/ rgyal tho bzhi la zlum gtor bzhi/ sgo byang phyi nang dmar gtor re bshams/ ser sbreng bcas shar gyi tho rtsar phyin nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭā raṣ+ṭā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod gser skyems gtong zhing*/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs phyi yi dung sgo phyes: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: zhi ba'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: kyai hoḥ mgon po dam tshig dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis: sngon ston pa 'jig rten na zhal bzhugs: chos kyi gdan chen po 'dzoms te thugs dam bcas pa ltar deng bdag gi sgrub pa'i mtshams kyi bar chod srung zhing sku drin chen po mdzad pa legs so legs so: da ni rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: zhes gshegs su gsol bas 'thus/ lag len kha cig ltar de mthar tho byang dmigs te/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa rab gnas bya ba'ang snang ste snga ma ltar khungs btsun no/ de bzhin thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ lhor/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ oṃ bi ru ḍha kā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi: gsum/

ar+ghaṃ sogs lho ru gser skyems btang*/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha'i tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs phyi yi gser sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: rgyas pa'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: kyai hoḥ mgon po dam tshig dang ldan pa sogs phrin las bcol brtan bzhugs gong ltar bya/ nub tu/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs gser skyems btang*/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs phyi yi zangs sgo phyes: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: dbang gi las rnams mthar phyin shog: kyai ho: mgon po dam tshig sogs phrin las bcol brtan bzhugs bya/ byang du/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs gser skyems btang*/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs phyi yi lcags sgo phyes: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: drag po'i phrin las mthar phyin shog: kyai hoḥ mgon po dam tshig sogs 'dod gsol brtan bzhugs bya/ sgo byang phyi nang dkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor gtor ma bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul: ar+ghaṃ sogs oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis mchod/ hūm̐ khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ

yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar phyin nas: bar gyi sgo mtshams phye ru gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badz+ra mu: zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu/ 'byung ba rnams bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: nyi zla rlung sa 'byung ba bzhi: de ring dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: rgya yis bsdams pa dkrol du gsol: 'byung ba rang byung mkha' la thim: zhes rgya dkrol la gser skyems mchod/ nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes lha gshegs/ gser skyems dang sgo byang bsdu'o/ drug pa phur pa bsdu ba ni/ rgyal tshab pa dkyil 'khor zur du 'khod/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod cing*/ lag gnyis skam pa'i rgya bcas/ dang por gdab rim las ldog phyogs su phyungs te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ de'ang nub kyi nub byang shar/ byang sogs g.yon bskor gyis mthar shar gyi shar phur bar du bsdu'o/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas te/ ā kā ro sogs/ bdun pa nongs bshags bzod gsol sku drin zhu ba ni/ thog mar g.yon gral rnams bzhengs la phyag gsum 'tshal/ tsog pur thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐: thams cad sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: smon lam dag pa'i rdo rje mched lcam rnams: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob mar dam mnos nas: kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la:

mnyam nyid don la legs nyes dbyer med kyang : smon lam dag pa'i rdo rje mched lcam rnams: lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung la rnyogs shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: phyi nang dbye nongs med par mthol lo bshags: kun kyang mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i blo ldan pas: thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i klong yangs nas: gzung dang 'dzin pa med par bzod bzhes nas: nyes byas dag nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes nongs pa bshags/ de bzhin du g.yas gral rnams kyis phyag dang thal mo sbyar ba bcas tshigs bcad de lan gcig brjod de gcig gis gcig la lta spyod 'gal ba bzod par gsol te sri zhu bya'o/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon la bzod par gsol ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis bla gos bsdus dkyil 'khor shul du brtsegs pa'i steng du slob dpon bzhugs pa'am/ yang na gu ru'i sku tshab bzhugs pa la maṇ+ḍal phreng ba sogs 'bul ba'i phyag srol yod 'dug kyang deng sang dkyus kyi phyag len ltar na slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shul du khri'u khar bzhugs/ 'dus pa rnams kyi lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i mtshon byed bgrang phreng bsdus la mdun du spungs/ phyag gsum 'tshal/ thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis med gtso: rgyal ba'i sku mnga' gsung rab rgya mtsho ston: mnyam nyid thugs mnga' ye shes gsal ba'i ngang : thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro kun bde la 'god: sri zhu chung bas thugs 'gal bzod par gsol: 'jig rten 'di nas pha ma'i tshul du gnas: phyi ma'i lam sna thar pa'i zhing du 'dren: sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i sku drin can: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bzod par gsol: zhes bzod par gsol nas sku drin zhu ba ni/ e ma hoḥ yang gsang bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje phur pa'i sku gsung thugs 'thob phyir: bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i tshogs gnyis gzhi bzung nas: sgrub chen zab mo gnang ba sku drin che:

chos nyid mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa la: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i nyi ma shar: sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam rdzas sogs: dkyil 'khor phyi nang bstan pa sku drin che: ma rig mun pa'i nang du 'khyams pa la: 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu zla gam e ru gsal: ma rigs mun dwangs shes bya'i sgrib bsal nas: chos sku rang la bstan pa sku drin che: rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe ring ba dang : mched dang lcam dral sgrub mchog gong du 'phel: dngos grub rnam gnyis gnang ba sku drin che: lha tshogs dgyes pa'i pañtsa a mṛ ta: zhal du bzhes nas dgyes pa bskyed pa dang : lha yi na bza' pañtsa lī ka 'bul: thugs rjes brtse bas dgongs pa sku drin che: zhes brjod la zhabs spyi bor blang*/ bdud rtsi'i skyems drang ngo*/ brgyad pa smon lam bya ba ni/ spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thams cad bzhengs la thal sbyar bcas/ kyai hoḥ mi gnas ye shes chos kyi dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos lhun grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog: 'di lta bu yi dkyil 'khor rtag tu brtson: bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ lu gu rgyud kyis 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshogs par smon: bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob par: sa lam mthar phyin 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis smon lam gdab/ gnyis pa khyad par rten 'brel khyad 'phags mar me smon lam bya ba ni/ thams cad kyis zhwa chos gsol/ g.yas su mar me dang spos ring re thogs/ dar dkar ram phreng ba lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ rgyal tshab pa gral gsham du bzhengs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ las kong bu rin po che chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gyur cig:

āḥlas mar khu 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin rgya mtsho'i klong dang mnyam par gyur cig: hūm̐ las sdong bu ye shes lnga yi me nyi zla chos kyi rang bzhin ltar gsal bar gyur: hrīḥde las mchod pa'i lha tshogs ā lo ke dpag tu med pa spros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'bul bar gyur: oṃ dharma dzñā na ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: de nas mgrin gcig tu/ e ma hoḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye med rnam dag kyang : ma rig dbang gis bdag 'dzin so sor phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: thugs dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: longs sku ye shes ma 'gag 'char ba la: ngar 'dzin dbang gis sna tshogs rtag chad 'dzin: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: gsung dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku rang byung rtsol bral ba: yid dpyod blo yis 'khor 'das ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: sku dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: dkyil 'khor gcig tu dam tshig bka' mnos pas: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral grogs rnams la: log lta skyon gyur ma dag ci mchis pa: deng nas bzung ste mthol bshags bzod par gsol: phyi nang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang : sdom pa bcu dang rang byung theg pa dang : mchod rdzas ma tshang 'byor rdzas chung ba dang : bag med ci mchis mthol bshags bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: bar brjod/ thams cad kyi lag g.yas su mar me dang spos ring re thogs/ rgyal tshab pas stong thun sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len byas te/ e ma hoḥ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa phyi nang bcu: rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me sbar te 'bul: kun gzhi rnam dag skye med kong bu ru: ka dag khregs chod gshis kyi mar khus bkang : lta ba zang thal 'od gsal sgron me 'di:

rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: sna tshogs rang shar ma 'gag kong bu ru: ye shes lnga ldan dran rig mar khus bkang : sna tshogs 'dzin med rang byung sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: rtsa khams rnam dag 'khor lo'i kong bu ru: byang sems bde chen dgyes pa'i mar khus bkang : rlung sems tsit+ta gsal ba'i sgron me sbar: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: rang byung ye shes sgron me sbar ba'i tshe: ma rig mun pa'i stong khams gsal ba dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar nang du mi ltung zhing : nyon mongs las kyi dbang du mi gtong shog: smon lam rten 'brel zhun mar 'di sbar bas: bdag 'dzin gcong rong zab mor mi ltung zhing : rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong shog: bsod nams tshogs chen zhun mar 'di sbar bas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi mchod pa mi nyams shing : zag med nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par shog: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag: shes rab gnyan gyi 'brel ba'i gzungs ma rnams: tshe rabs mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa gsum dkyil 'khor rten la 'tshogs par shog: rdo rje mched lcam 'brel ba'i dam tshig can: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: 'da' ka rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po yi: rgyud dang lung gi 'brel ba'i skal ldan rnams: sa bcu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: yang dag phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe rabs rtag tu bdag gi yi dam lha: 'dzin cing chos kyi sgra chen sgrogs par shog: smon lam bzang po rten 'brel bslu med kyi: bden tshig skad cig dus 'dir 'grub par shog:

ces bya zhing*/ zhi rol ldir la las rdor gyis mar me dang spos ring bsdu'o/ dgu pa bsngo ba dang shis brjod bya ba la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngos la dge 'dun pa rnams kyis mthun 'gyur brjod/ de nas thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes shing dril bsil me tog char du bsnyil/ las byang rjes chog ltar bkra shis rgyas pa brjod la zhi rol ji lta bar bya'o/ bcu pa rdul tshon chu bor gshegs shing dga' ston gnas srung bya ba ni/ rdul tshon gyi bum pa de nyid mtshan ldan rig ma bu mo gtsang ma skyes pas ma bslad pa zhig la rgyan rigs lnga la sogs phyug par byas nas/ lag g.yon du rten kheb bkab nas/ nas kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad sogs gzhung la 'jug /gang du rdul tshon blugs pa'i bum pa de chus bkang nas sngar bzhin khyer te/ zhi ba'i phyir zhes spyan mas sngags bzla bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la sogs gtor bar bya ste/ slar yang bza' bca' dang myang ba ldag pa dang*/ chang la sogs longs spyod chen po dang ldan pas skye bo dam pa 'dus pa dang dga' ston chen po bya zhing*/ bkra shis kyi cho gas phyogs thams cad bde gshegs kyi snang ba chen pos yongs su khyab par bya'o/ spyir stod las kha rkyang byed na sa slong tho 'dzugs sogs nyin gcig /rgyan bkod mnga' gsol sogs la nyin gcig ste sta gon nyin gnyis/ dngos gzhi nyin bdun la lha bskyed gtso bor bton kyang*/ thun mjug tu dam can dang ngan sngags nyer bsnyen kyang cung zad re sbrel ba'i bsnyen sgrub chig chod lugs dang*/ rjes chog nyin gcig bcas nyin bcus rgyas par 'grub la/ nyin bdun las mi byed na dngos bzhi nyin drug bya zhing*/ rgyan bkod grub pa'i nub mo nas dngos gzhi'i dbu 'dzugs te thun bzung*/ rjes chog nyin gcig bcas grub zin pa yin no/ gsum pa de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la spyi dang khyad par gnyis/

spyir chos phung brgyad khri'i yang snying gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lha yi mtshan thos pa tsam gyi phan yon bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab na dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin nyams su len par lta ci smos/ khyad par sgrub chen mtshan tsam sus 'dzin pa: o rgyan nga yi snying khrag gcig tu 'dres: zhes sgrub chen brgyad spyi yi yon tan dang*/ yid gnyis the tshom med par mos byed cing : sgrub pa sna gcig tsam zhig byas pas kyang : yid la ci 'dod rgyas par ma gyur na: o rgyan nga yis phyi rabs 'gro ba bslus: zhes dang*/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ e ma: yang phur 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chad sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': zhes gsungs so/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan par gsungs pa sogs phur pa rol pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i steng du sgrub chen 'di lta bu ni 'khor tshom bu bcas pa btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i gsang lam yin pas/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis 'brel pa thams cad skal ba dang 'tshams par rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa la dbugs chen 'byin par 'gyur la/ rtse gcig tu mos shing brtson pa rnams ni gnas skabs gang las brtsams pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub yi dam gyi lha dang skal pa mnyam/ bar do gsum la lhar snang gi phyag rgya 'grub ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang sbyor bar gsungs pa ni/ yang dag pa mi bslu ba'i tshad ma'o/ smras pa/ rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho'i klong mdzod 'di/

/bde chen 'khyil ba dpal gyi be'u nas/ /bkra ba'i 'od zer rdo rje'i sbu gur 'phros/ /blo gros bum pa'i bcud du rab smin shog /rgyud lung 'o ma'i rgya mtsho mang lags kyang*/ /bcud bsdus mar gyi snying po yang phur 'di/ /mching bu'i gseb nas yid bzhin nor mchog bzhin/ /mdo sngags bstan pa dar ba'i btsas su shog khyad par 'gro drug ma rgan sems can rnams/ /skyabs gcig 'di las gzhan du ma mchis pas/ /bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pas dge 'bras kyis/ /'di don gnad rnams kun gyis rtogs par shog /rang dang gzhan gyis 'di bsgrubs dge ba yis/ /'gro kun 'od gsal rdo rje'i gur chud de/ /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rab bsgral nas/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang tshe 'dir thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang grub pa'i dbang phyug gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'i bstan skyong chen po/ rnam 'dren bstan 'dzin pad+ma phrin las zhes mkhyen gnyis kyi ring lugs la bzang po'i bag chags sad pa sku nyid dang*/ ri pa smad ma'i bla ma mkhan slob zung nas dri med kyi lha rdzas gangs ri'i mdangs ldan rin po che gnyis pa lha rdzas bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ma gnang ba dang blor bcags te/ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi sgrub khog bzhir bzhag /ma tshang pa rnams phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub khog phrin las mngon 'byung ltar kha 'gengs byas pa 'di ni/ gnas chen gze rgyal gyi nye zhol bdud 'dul sngags gling gi gser khang pad+ma'i dga' tshal du/ chos med kyi sprang po skyes thob dang sbyor brtson nyung dben mkhyen rab ye shes grags pa'am/ ming gzhan gsang sngags phrin las dbang phyug gis rang byung bco lnga'i nang tshan/ dbang thang bstun ming lcags mo glang lor tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi 'grub par sbyor ba'i snga dro'i char grub par bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ dza yan+tu// // mkhyen rab ye shes grags pas mdzad pa bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi sgrub khog phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di bzhin rtsa ba'i ma phyi bris ma zhig lag tu son pa la chad lhag mang zhing mchan bu mang po dkyus su 'brel med du tshud pa dang rtsa mchan 'dres nas go don mi gsal bar gyur pa dang*/

gzhan du bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi sgrub khog gzhir bzhag mdzad 'dug par bar skabs 'gar lha mtshan kha bsgyur bya rgyu lus pa dang dkyil 'khor lha bskos gdab skabs bka' brgyad gyi sger chos sor gnas byas pas yang phur dang ma 'brel ba dang*/ de bzhin phyag bzhes dang go rim du ma yul dus gyi gnas tshul dang sbyar ba du ma snang ba dag rang lugs rtsa gsum sgrub khog dang de bzhin rnying lugs khungs ldan smin gling phyag bzhes ma nyams pa zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling gi srol rgyun mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len man ngag gis zur brgyan nas tshig don lag len dang dpyad bsdur rang blos gang dpogs zhus nas phyag len 'khrugs bsdebs dang 'phṛ snon cung zad byas pa 'di yang lugs 'dir mos pa mi phyed pa'i blo can sprul ming gsang sngags nas bgyis pa'o// // phur pa'i sgrub chen gyi stong thun gtum chen khros pa'i gad mo/ byang gter phur pa 'bring po spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kha phral ba'i lhan thabs yang yig 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod/ ༄༅/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ stong thun gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi klad 'gem rdo rje khros pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes yang dag thugs/ /srid gsum bdud bzhi dpung 'joms ku mā ra/ /dbyer med bla ma rang rig phur pa la/ /btud de stong thun mdor bsdus 'di na spro/ de la thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog gi skabs slob dpon nam/ rgyal tshab pas zhwa chos bcas sgra dag cing brjid chags pa'i ngang 'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ kyai skal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las su rung zhing*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams legs par gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs pas gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po dang*/

shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje sdom pa chen po las mi 'da' bas na bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa chen po shākya seṅges kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis bstan pa'i bye brag ser skya'i khab tu rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma chen po 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chags chen rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'dod yon la dgyes dgur rol pa'i tshul gyis thabs kyi brtul zhugs mthar phyin par mdzad pas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir dzam+bu gling gi yul dbus rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i snga rol du mi bsrun pa'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyi g.yo sgyus brid pa la mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bo dang*/ pad+ma'i pho nya sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ stobs bcu'i nus stobs rdo rje'i khro bo mi g.yo ba'i dpung gis bdud dpung mi 'khrugs phrag gcig dpa' bkong bas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po mngon du bstan nas rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sde bsam mi khyab pa rdo rje'i rigs can gyi 'dus pa la bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa rang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar na brda don rtags gsum gyi ru tra bsgral ba ni gsang sngags bstan pa'i chu mgo brdol ba'i gleng gzhi ste/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru tra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang bsgral bya'i ru tra la rnam pa gsum/ lhan skyes don gyi ru tra/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra/ btags pa ming gi ru tra bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/

/dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na/ /gzhi rtsa ngag dang lus sems so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum las/ dang po bdag rtog gzung 'dzin las skyes pa'i dug lnga'i ru tra chen po'i 'khor du nyon mongs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang bcas pas khams gsum gyi grong khyer la dbang byed pa 'khrul pa'i tshang bcas te 'gro kun la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi zad pa bskyed de chos kyi bdag 'dzin ma traṃ ka ru tra sems can gyi lus la gnas/ gnyis pa tshogs brgyad gang zag gi bdag 'dzin kha traṃ ka ru tra sems la gnas/ gsum pa mi bden 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin a kar+ṣa ru tra sems can gyi ngag la gnas so/ gnyis pa mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa 'dul dka' ba rab tu dga' ba la 'jig rten gyi khams sbyang dka' ba zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi sgron mer gyur pas mtha' drug gi tshul gyis chos ston pa la/ log par rtog pa'i sems can zhig gis sbas pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs par gab pa'i gsang ba sgra ji bzhin du spyad pas las kyis/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba'i mthar 'jig rten bdag po lha dbang phyug yab yum gyi bu ma traṃ ru dra zhes bya ba shin tu 'jigs la gtum zhing ma rungs pa zhi ga tu skyes nas gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris gsum pa man chad dbang du bsdus nas khams gsum mtha' dag ngan 'gro'i las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ma bzod cing gdul bya 'dul bar dgongs nas rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa dpal he ru ka nyid 'bar ba chen po'i gzugs skur bzhengs nas rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas ma traṃ ru dra bsgral zhing gnas spar te chos skyong gi srung ma ma hā ka lar dbang bskur/ ma 'ongs thal bas kheb pa'i zhing du bcom ldan 'das thal ba'i dbang po rang 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/

chung ma kro dhi shwa rī ma la ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba mdzad de sras mchog dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu bskrun pas ru dra 'khor dang bcas pa brtul ba'i skabs su ru dra'i snying khrag theb long tsam gnyis yal ba las ru dra'i sras/ dregs byed ma hā dā+e ba dang yum drag mo ral gcig ma zhes bya ba dang*/ drag mo srid pa 'khor byed ma zhes bya ba gnyis dang ldan te/ de gnyis las phyogs bcu dam sri chen po bcu byung ste/ steng phyogs su yab nyi ma 'bar gsal/ yum sgra 'byin ma/ bu nyi ma phag mgo can/ bu mo zla ba rmigs bu'i mgo can sogs nas/ bu mo byi la'am/ byi ba'i mgo can gyi bar byung ste khams gsum gyi srog la rngam pa'i ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs de dag gi gnyen por dpal chen rdo rje srin po yab yum gyis gang la 'dul thugs rje chen po'i cho 'phrul las rang shar ba'i tshul gyis mkha' gsang nas 'od kyi gong bu bcu steng 'og phyogs mtshams su spros pa las/ khro bo bcu yab yum phra thabs dang bcas pa phyogs bcur spros nas gdug pa'i dam sri bcu gdan du byas/ de'i tshe sems can sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*/ bdud bzhi rang sar zhi bar mdzad/ ru dra'i phung po 'dzam bu gling du bor ba la yul chen brgyad dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag rnams su rang byung gi mchod rten/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ phyogs skyong*/ lha/ klu/ sprin/ shing*/ me chu sogs pas brgyan cing*/ skal ldan rnams nyams rtogs spar/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa de dag /sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len yin pas bsgral chog la 'jug pa 'di yang don dang ldan pa ste/ dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba dang*/ ma traṃ bsgral ba'i khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin brlabs pa'i nang du sgrub na bkra shis pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgral bas/

bdud bgegs gzhan gyis bar chad kyi mtshan ma rang sar zhi bar byed cing*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod la/ de yang dbang po rab kyis chos thams cad byang chub sems las gud na med cing bdag med phyogs bral rang byung gi ye shes yul sems gnyis med skye 'gag las 'das par rtogs pas/ gnyis snang la dgag sgrub blang dor med pa rang shar rang grol chos nyid rol pa 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba'am/ dbang po 'bring gis snang srid lha dang lha mor rig pa/ tha mas kyang dam rdzas chen po lnga yi rang bzhin du shes pa ni don chos nyid kyis 'dul ba zhes bya ba 'khrul ba rtsad chod pas bar chod kyi khung brdol ba ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ mthong dang rig dang shes dang sprad: 'di las 'da' bar ma gyur na: log par lta ba 'dul nus shing : sangs rgyas rnams dang nga nyid bgrub: ces gsungs pas de lta bu'i don mtshon pa'i phyir/ rtags cho gas 'dul ba la'ang*/ rgyud las/ shin tu khro zhing gtum pa la: zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te: shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo la: khro bo de bzhin gshegs sprul mdzad: khro bos tshul 'chang khros pas kyang*/ 'jig rten gsum rnams bsregs byed na: sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis: khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams dpal khrag 'thung rol pa'i lha sku phyag rgya'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal rab tu 'bar bas ma traṃ bkug cing bsgral te khog pa gzhan yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang du 'jug pa sogs gzhung las 'byung ba'i tshig gi bsgom don gsal 'debs bzhin pas cho ga'i bya ba la 'jug par zhu/ ༈ sgrub po rnams gnas su 'god pa'am/ mnga' gsol ba'i skabs/ da lam theg pa kun gyi yang rtse/ /mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nying khu/ /snga 'gyur tan+t+ra che po sde bco brgyad las phrin las rol pa'i rgyud/ sgrub pa chen po sde brgyad las phur pa phrin las su sgrub pa'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mo gnang ba la/

mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha yi lung las/ lha zhes bya ba byang chub sems/ /de ni rgyud du rab tu brjod/ tha snyad tsam du phye ba na/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du brjod/ ces sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid du gnas kyang sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pas bral bya'i tshul du sgrib pa nyid/ sbyong byed dpal rdo rje gzhon nus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang dgos pa rjes su 'brel bas phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba la/ de yang*/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis dpal he ru ka'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs/ gtsug lag gi gzhung las bshad pa'i sa'i dpal kha dang*/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dag pa'i gnas lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan phyi yi gnas dang*/ phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pa gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin pa la yin par shes pa nang gi gnas dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid kyi de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pas gang na gnas kyang chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa gsang ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag tshang*/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob dpon lta ba gnyis med gdeng ldan/ sgom pa bskyed rdzogs las rung*/ spyod pa dam tshig rnam dag /dbang lung man ngag gi bka' bab/ theg dgu'i rgyud don rtogs pa/ ngang ring phan sems che ba/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dpung du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bde chen rgyud las skyed pa'i 'khor gzung ma lus ngag yid gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/

rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs kyi gtso bo bzhin/ yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin byan pho mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon song gi skal pa can/ nga rgyal phrag dog chung ba/ dad pa brtson 'grus che ba/ lhag par rgyal thebs rnams kyang dbang dang dam tshig ldan zhing thos bsam gyi rgyud dag /de kho na nyid la blo sbyangs pa sha stag lags pa dang*/ dus phun sum tshogs pa thog mtha' dbyer med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las gdal bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pas sogs/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas sogs/ zla ba'i dkar phyogs sam/ dmar phyogs dus tshes gza' skar sbyor byed dge zhing shis pa/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'tsho ba zas/ nad sel sman/ dgra 'joms mtshon sogs phyi yi yo byad/ rten rdzas/ sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ khyad par sgrub pa'i rdzas/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa/ lha phur dang*/ shel lam/ me long*/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa sgrub pa'i snod thod pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma*/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa las kyi phur pa/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa/ bsnyen pa'i dus su phur pa dang*/ yungs dkar sgrub pa'i dus su 'khor lo dang*/ liṅga/ /de la gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la/ bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor e khrom nyer gcig /bsad pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs drug spyir 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sku yi dkyil 'khor/

gru gsum shel gyi dal/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor rtsibs bcu drug /mā ra ya bsad pa'i dkyil 'khor bang rim gsum te/ de thams cad bsdus na 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur par 'dus pas/ phur pa phrin las kyi rgyud bi to ta ma las rten phur 'dom gang khru mtho gang*/ gdab phur phyag mtshan ci bder bya/ zhes gsungs pa gtso phur/ ging phur/ mgyogs phur/ gdab phur/ las bzhi'i phur bu/ mngags phur/ srung bzlog dang*/ las drug thun gyi phur bu sogs rgyu dang tshad dbyibs grangs bcas gzhung mthun gtso bor gyur pa'i rten sgrub mchod pa'i rdzas gtsang la ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ yo byad kyi bkod pa bag gro ya le snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra ya le/ sbyar byung gi bdug spos dri ngad thu le/ sna tshogs kyi rol mo'i sgra skad di re/ rdo rje mched lcam spro dga' dang byin thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir/ ston pa rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnga' bdag /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzung ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rnams yab kyi g.yon zur/ chos 'chad pa rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub rdzas gter rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur bya ba dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las gzhung bsrang las kyi rgyal thebs rnams phyogs bzhi/ phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje ging ka ra rnams lho nub/ mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rno rdo rje spyan pa dang*/
