dus sbyor dbyu gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzems pa'i rdo rje byan po byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags rnams shar lho/ rin po che lta bu'i mched lcam gang zag rnams gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grub chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra mang bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ sdang sems che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ bag med brjed ngas che ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ gnyid che chang la dga' ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing sgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te skyon drug po spang zhing*/ chos nyid dang mi phyed pa'i rtogs pa che ba/ bla ma dang mi phyed pa'i dad gus che ba/ yi dam dang mi phyed pa'i dam tshig che ba/ mched lcam dang me phyed pa'i brtse gdung che ba/ dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa'i brtul zhugs che ba/ gzung ma dang mi phyed pa'i sbyor sgrol la brtson pa/ sems can dang mi phyed pa'i snying rje che ba/ dngos grub dang mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa'i skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu ste/ yon tan dgu po la rnam kun brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta: sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab pa sogs gang bsgo ba'i las rnams bde blag tu bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs 'dun dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ ༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i sgrub pa rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/

rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad bdud kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs pa dag skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po'i kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug kyang 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod du gnas pa thal ba nag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru dra sde gsum bsgral ba thod pa tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru dra'i chung ma la chags thabs kyi rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba'i zhing chen g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i zhon pa glang po che brtul ba glang chen ko rlon/ gza' nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma brtul bas stag gi sham thabs/ klu rgyal gdug pa can brtul bas sbrul nag gi chun po/ srin mo nyer bzhi sogs pa brtul ba'i thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pas zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda'i rtags sbyor gyi don ni/ dug lnga ye shes lngar dag pa'i rtags su thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ theg pa chen po'i don rtogs pa'i rtags su glang chen gyi ko rlon/ zhe sdang rtsad nas 'joms pa'i rtags su sbrul chun/ mtha' gnyis spangs ba'i rtags su zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/

phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyang ba'i me dpung*/ skye shi rtsad gcod chos skur mtshon pa'i thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug lnga dbang sdus longs sku mtshon pa'i rak+ta'i thig le/ rgyu drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blangs pa sprul sku mtshon phyir zhag chen po'i zo ris/ dug gsum sku gsum mtshon phyir thod pa tshar gsum bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ de dag bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyem pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par/ dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang bsgyur/ gdug pa can zil gyis gnon/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu lha yi tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang 'di yis rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ ༈ dam tshig gi stong thun dang 'brel lam rgyus cung zad bshad pa ni/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ gdul bya'i khams dbang dang 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor mtha' yas pa bskor bas thams cad kyang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ kun byed las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'o/ zhes gsungs shing rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa las kyang khyad par du mas ches 'phags pa ste/ mtshan nyid pa ltar kun rdzob sgyu ma'i chos la blang dor du spyod pa ma yin gyi/ kun rdzob don dam dbyer med par spyod cing sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du sbyor bas ye nas blang dor med par sangs rgyas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu dbyer mi phyed pa'i don dang ldan pa'i theg pa la rdo rje theg pa zhes grags te/

che ba rnam pa drug dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs 'dir bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan bya gtso bor 'chad pa'i dbang gis/ ma hā/ a nu/ a ti gsum du dbye zhing*/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum ka'ang sbyang gzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang gis yo ga skor gsum gyi rtsa ba bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i skor 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas mngon gyur du gtan la phab cing*/ de la'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las/ 'dir sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi bye brag phur pa phrin las kyi lo rgyus cung zad smos pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ 'og min gyi gnas su kun tu bzang po dpal he ru kas yongs su dag pa'i 'khor rnams la rdo rje'i tshig tu gsungs pa rnams sdud pa po rdo rje chos la sogs pas bsdus shing rdzu 'phrul gyi yi ger snang ba rin po che'i sgrom du bcug ste mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs par mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa las gnyer du gtad par mdzad pa dang*/ gang gi tshe dur khrod ro gling bsil ba tshal zhes 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnam brgyad dgongs pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i sgrom bu brgyad la 'od dang 'ja' tshon dkrigs pa sogs ltas dang*/ mkha' 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byed par gzigs pa dang*/ 'dir 'jigs rten phung 'tshengs nus pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'dug snyam du dgongs te/ slob dpon rnams kyis der dgongs pa gtad cing bka' srung rnams la dam rdzas byin nas dam bsgrags shing dbang du bsdus pa'i dus der/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bka' ci zhig bstsal zer nas lhags pa la sgrom bu rnams gtod ces gsungs pas/ sgrom bu rnams so sor phur ba'i tshe/ phur pa'i g.yu sgrom slob dpon pra bha ha sti'i phyag tu gtad nas chos skor rnams rgya bkrol zhing*/

mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bshad dang sgrub par bka' gnang*/ de'i nang nas phur pa rol pa'i rgyud dang*/ rig mchog 'bum sde'am/ bi to ta ma kī la ya'i rgyud/ kī la ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma dam pa'i gsang chen gyi rgyud la sogs pa rab tu mang po bzhugs pa de dag sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis gsan pa'i tshul bstan te bal bod lha 'dre gdug pa can mtha' dag lhag pa'i lha rdo rje phur pa 'di nyid kyi mthu rtsal nus pas brtul ba ste/ ji skad du/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub deng 'dir thob: ces gsungs/ mnga' bdag rje 'bangs rnams la rgyud gdams can man ngag gi rim pa mang du bstsal bas gangs can rig sngags 'chang ba thams cad kyi thugs dam lha gcig mar yongs su grags shing bka' gter ring lugs mtha' yas par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ phrin las phur pa'i bka' bab jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi thugs kyi brnag pa mthar thug pa rten 'brel mthar phyin chos rgyal rat+na gling pa zhes sku tshe gcig la skye ba gsum gyi gter bzhes pa de nyid kyis/ ldang lha khro mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po zhes byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba 'di nyid/ khyab bdag kun tu bzang po nas/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i bar byon pa/ steng nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral ma zhig /sa la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bkrag ma yal/ bar du sman raka bdud rtsi'i ma skam/ dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi bslad ma zhugs/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma chad/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma 'khyor ba/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan/ cho ga lung dang ldan pa/ lung man ngag dang ldan pa/ man ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/

brgyud pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ de lta bu'i sgo nas sgrub pa chen po nyams su len pa la/ 'jug pa'i mtha' bcus gsang sngags kyi chos la zhugs dgos te/ sgo dbang gis phye/ srog dam tshig gis bzung*/ thag lta bas gcod/ la spyod pas dor/ nyams ting 'dzin gyis blangs/ don man ngag zab mo'i sgrub rgyud thos pas grol/ sgo theg pa kun la bsdu/ shes bya phyogs med la bslab/ dgos don du ma ro gcig tu bsdu ba lags/ de las kyang thog mtha' bar gsum du dam tshig la brten nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten nas byung*/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad kyis 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung dgos/ spyir dam tshig ces bya ba'i nges tshig ni/ bslab bya tshul ldan du srung na dam zhing nyams na rdo rje me lce sogs kyis 'tshig pas na tshig ces bya la/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/ dam las 'das na snying dbus su rdo rje gnod byin rab tu khros pas mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra man bcu drug spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/ dran pa dang shes bzhin bag yod par srung dgos shing*/ log rtog 'dul ba'i gnyen po dam tshig gi rnam grangs mang du gsungs kyang*/ lam zhugs rnams kyi gces don mdor bsdus bsrung bya ni/ slob dpon o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig gi rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsum/

yan lag dam tshig nyer lnga/ thun mong sa ma ya 'bum sde'i don bsdus nyer gcig sogs gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bha ba'i lhas/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig bcu bzhir gsungs pa sogs mdor na thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba sku yi dam tshig tu/ shes rab rgyud dam tshig dbang*/ man ngag lung*/ nyams chag skong ba'i slob dpon te rdo rje slob dpon rnam pa bzhi po khog pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rang bzhin gcig pa'i mched/ dam ma 'dris pa ring ba'i mched/ lta spyod mthun pa nye ba'i mched/ dam tshig 'dres pa srog gi mched bzhi po lus dang mig ltar blta/ ku re kyal ka'i phyir yang ngan sems 'phya sems mi bya/ rtsa ba gsung gi dam tshig tu rgyu ma nor rtsa ba/ skyed pa rkyen/ stobs pa mchod pa/ bzlas pa 'dzab/ bskul pa phrin las kyi sngags te snying po rnam pa lnga dang*/ don gsal ba chos kyi rgya/ rtags nye bar sgrub pa lha'i rgya/ mtshon pa bsgyur ba gar stabs kyi rgya ste/ phyag rgya rnam pa gsum la rab rgyun chags/ 'bring dus drug /tha mas kyang nya stong brgyad gsum la ma chags par nyams su len/ rtsa ba thugs kyi dam tshig tu sbyor sgrol/ lha sngags/ grub rtags/ sgrub thabs te spyi gsang bzhi/ sgrub pa'i gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ grogs dang*/ sgrub rdzas te bar gsang bzhi lta ba zab mo gsang bar 'os pa dang*/ spyod pa zab mo gsang bar gnyer gtad pa ste bsgos gyur gnyis bcas gsang bcu rdo rje'i lce yod kyang mi bsgrag bar lus kyi spyod pa'ang sbas la byed/ yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga ni/ sbyor sgrol ma byin len dang rdzun tshig rlung smra spyad bya'i dam tshig lnga/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nga rgyal phrag dog ste mi spang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ dri chen dri chu byang sems rak+ta klad pa ste dwang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ phung po 'byung ba dbang po rnam shes sogs shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga/

gzugs tshor 'dus shes 'du byed rnam shes rnams rigs lngar shes pa bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga bcas lnga tshan lnga po/ le lo snyoms las chang dang gnyid sogs bag med kyi dbang du ya bar mi dor bar srung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la mi smad/ dus rtag tu bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ mched lcam nang mi 'thab/ slob dpon dang mched lcam gyi gzung ma mi spyad/ bzlas brjod bar mi bcad/ slob dpon gyi gdan mi 'gom/ ting 'dzin bying rmugs su mi btang*/ rang rgyud nyon mongs pas mi dkrug /dbang rtags rgya las mi 'da'/ gzhan gyi yon tan mi smad/ mchod rdzas las bsngos pa'i nor mi spyad/ mi dang kha 'phro mi bsre/ thabs shes ya mi 'bral/ gsang sngags blo chung la mi bstan/ mtshan ngan la gzung ma mi bya/ dad pa can gyi tshogs mi bcag /yug mo phyag rgyar mi bsten pa ste/ de dag ltem rkyang med par mi chos lha chos bka' chos gsum gyi sgo nas bsrungs pas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /bsrung bya srung byed thabs te 'khor gsum byang chub sems thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas srung mtshams bral ba'i ye srung chen por rtogs nas lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag dang ldan pa dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur te/ bang mdzod baphrul sde las/ ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo gzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad srung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/ /mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs lta ba mthar phyin ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste rang rgyud bsregs so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog gcod snying phyung na sman ci tsam gtang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub la sogs ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung bar lha rnams kyang rang gshed du babs nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa rdo rje dmyal bar skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar dus med par 'gyur la/

nyams pa'i rgyu yang*/ slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ lung ma mnos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig ched cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bor 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smad cing zur za byed pa/ gtsang rme rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/ spyod pa thod brgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs la dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /srog ni yongs su btang yang bla/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab kyang bla/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ zhes gsungs/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang*/ rab lta ba skye med ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas bshags shing*/ bsdoms te legs par srung ba'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung*/ sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad bskyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rang gzugs dpal he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ 'di la 'gal bar ma byas na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/tshe 'di nyid la thob par nges/ zhes dang*/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/ /rtogs pa mchog ni gong du 'phel/ ces sogs du ma nas gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing de dag mdor bsdu na sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa sgrub/ mi dge ba'i cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po sra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom par rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de'i 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems ma 'dres pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byung ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyi snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma grub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad rnams zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'dab rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtsor bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byong ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlobs 'gyur/

/rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro bran bzhin 'khor bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje mched lcam rnams kyis bag yod dran shes ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan bzung bar mdzod cig ༈ dzap bsgyur ba bzlas dmigs skabs su bshad par bya ba ni/ da lam rdo rje mched lcam rnams la sgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhus na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rang byung 'dus ma byas pa nyid rnam pa gang 'dul rtags kyi phyag rgya gzugs skur bzhengs pa dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu ste/ gsang rgyud las/ kun gyi bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ zhes gsungs pas spyir rigs lnga khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i spyi dpal chen po yin/ bye brag tu thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes nyid rnam pa kun nyon 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa dang des bskyed pa'i ru dra la sogs bdud dang log 'dren 'joms pa la ngang gis khros pa'i bdag nyid karma he ru ka ste phrin las kyi rigs su gtogs pa dang*/ sku dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyang zhi ba'i dus na rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyi kri yog gi dus su rdo rje rnam 'joms/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus su phyag na rdo rje sogs 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi mtshan dang sku yi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bde gshegs thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i sprul pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bi to las/ kun khyab rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ bde bar gshegs pa gar gyi bdag /'dod rgu bsgyur bas gar yang bde/ /gar gyi dbang phyug chen po la/ /mkhas pas phyogs ris mi brtag go /zhes gsungs pas/ gsar rnying rgyud sde zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad rdo rje phur par ma 'dus pa gang yang med pas/

byams dang snying rje'i gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzod de: zhes gsungs pas/ de thams cad 'dul bya'i dbang gis snang ba tsam las don du gcig nyid de/ spros bral thig le chos sku nyag gcig las ma g.yos pas dkyil 'khor gsum sogs kyang rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nur 'dus shing*/ der ma zad snang ba thams cad thabs yab kyi rang bzhin rdo rje gzhon nu/ stong pa thams cad shes rab yum gyi rang bzhin 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ snang stong gnyis med thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med par sras 'bar ba'i khro bo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ srid pa thams cad rdo rje phur bu'i lha: zhes gsungs pas rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di lta bu bsgrub tu yod pa skal ba re bzang snyam du bsams te/ bla mar mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grub brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul mtshon dang ras bris dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ nang a nu yo ga shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rim pa rnams kyang gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing de gsum po re rer yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba ste bskyed rdzogs kyi gung shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi yi dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ phur pa phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ma 'dres pa rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i sgo nas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus bgrang phreng*/ ngag snying po/

yid lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas sngags kyi sgra don shes pas 'phro 'du'i bzlas pa la brtson pa gsung gi sgrub lugs/ phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu thams cad phur bu thal 'byin gyi dgongs par 'dus pa te/ pad+ma thod phreng rgyal po ngas/ /rdo rje phur pa srid gsum mgon/ /srid gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mdor bsdus phur pa bzhi ru bstan/ zhes rig pa ye shes phur pa/ lhag pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ 'dus byas rdzas kyis phur pa bzhi ste/ dang po dbyings spros pa med pa rig pa rang gsal gyi ye shes nyid gnyis su med par rang byung gi ye shes chen po rang shar phyogs ris med pa ni rig pa ye shes phur pa'i ngo bo ste/ des chos thams cad rgyas btab pas 'khrul ba'i snang ba thal 'byin du phug ste gnyis med ye shes chen po chos kyi sku thob pa yin/ gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa ni yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i stobs kyi zhu bdes drang ba'i bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni de'i ngo bo yin la/ des rtsa rlung thig le'i grong khyer la rgyas btab pas ma dag pa'i rlung sems dbyings su nub nas dag pa'i ye shes mngon du 'char bar byed cing lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug longs sku thob par byed/ gsum pa tshad med snying rje'i phur pa ni snying rje chen po'i sems can yongs su mi gtong ba yin la/ de yul rigs drug gi sems can rnams la btab pas thugs rje'i dpyang thag gis zin nas 'khor ba'i gnas nas sgrol zhing sprul pa sku thob par byed/ bzhi pa 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa ni mtshan ma rtags kyi phyag rgya rten dang bcas pa ste 'di'i khongs su bskyed rim kyang 'du bas na/ phur pa'i rgyu gser dngul zangs lcags sam las mthun gyi shing ste dbyibs dang grangs tshad sgrub tshul sogs gzhung las shes par bya ste/

phur pa phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tha mal pa'i rnam rtog la rgyas btab nas bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yi tshul gyis bsgrubs pas bskyed rim snang srid phur ba'i dkyil 'khor du shar bas las rab 'byams mthar phyin te srid pa phur bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa ni thugs kyi sgrub lugs te/ phur pa sgrub cing gdab pa'i dgos ched ni bar chad 'dul zhing phrin las bzhi lhun gyis grub pas 'bras bu sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba'o/ dper na sos ka ljang bu'i dus su sad 'byung ba dkon la/ ston lo thog smin pa na sad ser 'byung ba mang ba bzhin gang zag dam par dngos grub thob la khad la bar chad mang zhing gang zag ma smin pa la bar chad mi 'byung ste/ thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i snga rol tu bdud dmag byung ba bzhin no/ des na bar chad bdud bgegs 'dul bar byed pa la ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa gzhan ma mchis/ yi dam gzhan yod kyang rdo rje phur pa srung ma'i tshul du sgrub dgos te/ yi dam gang sgrub rung theg chen chos gang spyod kyi bar chad rdo rje gzhon nu'i srung bar 'gyur te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ phyag na rdo rje dang po byang chub thugs bskyed pa'i dus su/ theg chen skyong ba'i srung mar zhal gyis bzhes shing sgrub pa po thams cad kyi lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas skyob par gsungs pas/ des na bskul ba tsam gyis phrin las mdzad nges pas bsnyen cing sgrub na bar gcod kun thul mchog dngos grub pa'i dgos pa yod ces o rgyan dus gsum kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa ste shes par bya ba'i rnam gzhag cung zad snyan du gsol nas/ skabs 'dir gal che ba ni gshed rgyud las/ ting 'dzin bsam gtan dag dang mi ldan na/ /gsang sngags bzlas kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /gso dpyad bklag pas nad la mi phan ltar/ /de bas ting 'dzin bsam gtan 'bad par gyis/

zhes dang*/ o rgyan chen pos/ gzhan du g.yeng bar gyur na ni/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ zhes gsungs pas/ cho ga'i gyer dbyangs/ rnga brdung rol mo/ dzap bsnyen sogs spros pa ji tsam byas kyang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin mi ldan na 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ rnal 'byor rab kyis/ rang sems sangs rgyas su shar bas sa lam bsgrod med du shes/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu ye rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang tshad chos nyid du 'khyer/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang rang sar grol/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang gnas kyi don shes pa ste shar ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ rnal 'byor 'bring gis/ stong gsum gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung yang dog med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ phyi snod gtor gzhong du gsal bas mchod gtor bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid rdzas su gsal bas dam can mi bskong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong nyid du gsal bas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams sems la rdzogs pa ste gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ tha mas bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las sgom med kha gyer la bzung bas gsang sngags lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas gtor bshos bu za 'dod du bzung bas brnab sems kyi 'bras bu rnam smin gyi 'dam du tshud/ 'jig rten rtag chad la 'bras bu bzung bas ru dra'i gol sar ltung ba ste/ bzung ba lngas ma bcing ba dgos gal che/ mdor na/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das sems su thag chod/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag nyams su shar/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du long ba zhig dgos shing*/

de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su blos bcos te bsgom pa ni dpe/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni don te sems nyid 'gags med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/ ngo bo stong nyid du khrig gis gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre bslad mi dgos pa 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pas ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni don/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha yi 'khor lor dag pa ni brda/ de nyid mngon du gyur phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du byed pa ni rtags te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes yo ga gsum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa ci yang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/ rgyud las/ dngos grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags ni bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ spyir sngags kyi mtshan nyid/ ngo bo bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung yig 'brur snang ba/ nges tshig byin rlabs mngon du 'byin pas sngags/ dbye na rgyu ma nor rtsa ba'i sngags/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags/ bzlas pa las kyi sngags dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma ste/ sngags bzla ba la/ bum dbang dang mthun pa'i rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun pa lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun pa gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun pa de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun pa nyams su len par gsungs/ rtsol bcas kyi bzlas pa la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ ces ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral bas bzlas brjod byed pa ni bud shing 'dzoms pa rlung gis bskul na lhag par me 'bar ba bzhin bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs mchog yin zhing*/

'dir phur pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni ye shes lha dang sbyar na rigs lnga khrag 'thung lnga*/ zab don thugs dang sbyar na kun bzang thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes lnga/ sku dang sbyar na chos sku'o/ badz+ra ni rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum mnyam sbyor dbyings ye gnyis su rig pa la longs spyod pa spros bral gsal stong dbyer med don gyi rdo rje ste longs sku'o/ kī ni gtso mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sprul pa khro chen yab bcu/ li ni khro mo bcu ste de gnyis thabs shes zung 'jug dbyer med bde ba'i ngang nas sku 'bar ba'i cha lugs sprul pas 'gro don mi dge bcu tshar gcod dge bcu mthar phyin cing dbyings rigs dbyer med du sbyor bas sprul pa'i sku'o/ kī ni yang sprul za byed mche ba can te 'khor ba'i las nyon za zhing stong par byed la/ la ni yang sprul gsod byed ma bcu ste srid gsum yongs sgrol dbyings su sbyor zhing gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas de gnyis ni yang sprul lo/ ya ni sras mchog nyer gcig ste sku gsung thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ dngos snang sku/ grags pa gsung*/ dran rtog thugs/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid du sgrol bar byed do/ sarba ni khro chung sum sprul sgo ma dang bcas pa thams cad de/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'dus/ bigha ni bka' sdod shwa na ma mched bzhi dang ming po dung gi skyes bu/ nān ni ri ti mched bzhi dang bdud kyi skyes bu/ bam̐ ni sa bdag mched bzhi dang bse yi skyes bu ste dam can srung ma'i tshogs so/ hūm̐ ni khro 'dus rig 'dzin te dngos grub thams cad sdud par byed pa/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal yang dag pa'i ye shes 'gyur med thig le nyag gcig go /phaṭ ni dgra bgegs dam sri bar gcod thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa khro bo 'dul ba'i gsung rdo rje'i tshig ste 'khrul pa rtsad nas gcod cing bdag phur 'ben gsum dbyer med chos skur grol ba phur pa thal 'byin gyi dgongs pa'o/

dzaḥni bsgrub bya gang yod thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ hūm̐ ni bsgrub bya thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon pa/ āḥni dngos grub thams cad myur du 'gugs shing bdag la bstim pa ste yig 'bru phyi ma gsum po 'di mkha' 'gros lung bstan 'phyong du btags pa'i snying po zab don yin zhes gser mchan las gsungs/ yang gong 'og gi 'bru dgu po phur pa'i yang snying srog sngags yin pa/ sarba bigha nān bam̐ zhes pa las sngags 'bru lnga ste/ sarba rtog tshogs ma lus dbyings su sgrol ba/ bhigha nān yab yum mkha' gsang ste 'khor 'das dbyer med dbyings su sgrol ba/ bam̐ ni 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa'i sgra ste/ snang srid rtog tshogs thams cad mi rtog chos dbyings ye shes kyi phur pa theb pa ste/ lta ba chos nyid kyis zin te phyir mi ldog pa'i don zhes gser mchan du gsungs so/ de yang ngag bzlas pa'i skabs rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal kha dang : khro dang 'thab dang shag dang 'jug 'dzin dang : zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs: smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad: lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo: zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam yang sngags brjod na: 'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi lce la smra 'gyur pa: de dag bden pa thob par 'gyur: zhes spyir sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas/ bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bye brag phur pa la/ sku gsum thugs kyi rtags bdun tshan gsum ste/ sku yi rtags su/ phur pa 'gul ba/ 'phar ba/ lding ba/ me stag 'byung ba/ 'od 'byung ba/ du ba 'byung ba/ bzhad pa dang bdun/ gsung gi rtags su phur pa las sgra snyan pa/ sngags sgra/ gnam lcags kyi sgra/ 'brug sgra/ rnga sgra/ ce spyang gi sgra/ srin po'i ngur sgra dang bdun/

thugs kyi rtags su/ ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba/ las bzhi 'grub pa/ tshe la dbang ba/ rigs lnga mngon du gyur pa/ lha rnams gsal ba/ srung ma bran du khol ba/ rtogs pa 'char bar gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi chom/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs pa/ snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang nas/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/ ༈ sgrub chen grol skabs phan yon dang 'bral ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga yi gzhi bzung*/ bskyed rdzogs yan lag bzhi yis gzhung bsrangs/ /lag len rtsis mgo tshang bas khrigs la phab nas/ phur pa phrin las rol pa'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen po sngags 'gro dngos gzhi rjes bcas tshang ba mtha' rgyas su grub pa ste/ de yang spyir sangs rgyas gnyis pa gu ru'i gter chos la dad pa thams cad gu ru nyid bod la phebs skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ldan yin par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la mos pa kun/ /deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab/ /thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms/ kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin par yang gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyi yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur ste phu dud 'brel ba zhog: ces gsungs/

khyad par sgrub chen la 'brel ba bzhag pa'i phan yon/ o rgyan rin po ches zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na/ sgrub chen 'di yi mtshan tsam su gang 'dzin/ /o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres/ zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa sgrub na/ phur pa mkhan po bkra shis/ phur pa mkhan po dpal che/ phur pa mkhan po tshe ring*/ phur pa mkhan po nor phyug /phur pa mkhan po 'khor rgyas/ phur pa mkhan po srid 'phel/ phur pa mkhan po mthu che/ phur pa mkhan po mtha' btsan/ phur pa mkhan po yon tan brgyad dang ldan/ ces sogs rgya cher gsungs shing mdor na/ gnas skabs su byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad sogs thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub gzhi 'bras dbyer med sku lnga ye shes dgu ldan dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ sku lnga ni/ rang sems gzhi yi rdo rje gzhon nu nyid/ bgrod pa lam gyi rdo rje gzhon nu thabs shes gnyis med du goms pas mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rdo rje gzhon nu dag pa gnyis ldan du gyur tshe de la sku lnga lhun gyis grub ste/ sems spros pa bral ba chos sku/ de'i rol pa 'gags med du shar ba longs sku/ de la gdul bya gzhan snang du ston pa sprul sku/ de la sdug bsngal med pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ de rnams dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid sku'o/ ye shes dgu ni gsal la rtog med me long ye shes/ ma 'dres gsal ba sor rtog ye shes/ thams cad mnyam pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ don la mi g.yo ba chos dbyings ye shes/ lhun gyis grub pa bya grub ye shes/ snang tshad ye shes su brdal ba rang byung ye shes/ rang rig rig cing rtogs pas rig pa rang byung gi ye shes/ cir snang ye shes su rgyas theb pas sna tshogs gnyes med rgyas 'debs kyi ye shes/ de thams cad don la tha snyad dang bral bas spros bral bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes rnams su 'grel chen 'bum nag tu gsungs pa bzhin las/

de lta bu'i sgrub pa rnal 'byor rang rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam bcas pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos bsgrub gyur na/ mtshams med lnga po'i spyad pas kyang*/ dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas phan yon de ldan gyi/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas/ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ rgyal thebs/ gzung ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad mi gzhug par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du lta dgos pa dang*/ 'di na byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel bas rnam kun 'bral med srog gis bsdus pa'i lha'i tshom bu 'khod cing*/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi dge ba'i las chen po bsags pa'ang don yod pa bgyi ba'i slad du mar me smon lam gdab pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang rdzong phreng las/ sangs rgyas kun gzhi spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /thig le chen po ma bcos lhun grub dang*/ /skye 'gag med pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /ye shes mar me stong rtsar shar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub kyi sems dngos po'i gzugs dang bral ba/ khyad chos drug ldan ye shes kyi 'od phung du 'bar zhing gzhon nu bum sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni mtshon bya don gyi mar me/ gzhi la gzhi snang du g.yos te lhun grub rang snang gi sgo nas shar lugs chen po brgyad kyis 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba mtshon pa brda yi mar me/ rgyu sku dang ye shes/ rkyen 'od dang kha dog /byed las sgron ma bzhir smin te 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su snying po'i 'od gsal thig le chen po dang*/

spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ba ni mtshon byed rtags kyi mar me ste/ de dag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi dbang gis snang gsal mar me 'di yi mtshon byed du byas/ me long ye shes/ sor rtog ye shes/ mnyam nyid ye shes/ chos dbyings ye shes/ bya grub ye shes brdal ba rang byung ye shes/ rig pa rang byung ye shes/ rgyas 'debs ye shes/ bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes te ye shes chen po rnam pa dgu yi snang bas nyon mongs dgu yi mun khang bcom/ rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sgo brtsad nas bcad/ rdo rje khro rgyal rnams kyi zhal mthong*/ rang byung snang ba bzhi yi shul mtshon/ rig stong khyab brdal chen pos rgyab skyor/ rang grol spyod pa cog bzhag gis mtha' brten te/ bgrod bya lam lnga sa bcu bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis dwang srog thig le chen por srid gsum yongs dag gi klong dam par bgrod nas/ chos thams cad bya rtsol gnyis med kyi klong du gdod nas skye 'gag 'pho bral gzhi rdzogs lhun grub chen por gdeng chen thob/ dbugs chen 'byin/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa mdzad nas smon lam gyi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ smras pa/ rgyud rgyal bi to ta ma'i snying po'i bcud/ /pad 'byung mtsho rgyal thugs dam zab don mthil/ /mtshan tsam 'dzin pas bar chad bdud 'joms pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje phur pa 'di rmad byung*/ /sgrub pa gzhan gyi stong thun 'ga' mchis kyang*/ /phur sgrub stong thun gsal byas ma mthong bas/ /tshul 'di kho bo'i skal bar bzhag sam snyam/ /don gnyer a pho dgyes pa'i gsos su 'bul/ /'di na bka' brgyad rtsa ba'i stong thun dang*/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin snga ma'i bzhed gzhung 'ga'/ /bsdus la rang bzos nyes pas ma bslad snyam/ /'on kyang bdag rmongs nongs gyur mchis kun bshags/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med des/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang mchog thob cing*/

/bstan 'gro'i bar chad rgud tshogs kun bcom nas/ /bkra shis snang bas sa gsum kun khyab shog /ces pa 'di ni kaḥ bkra shis thun bstan rab rgyas gling gi dbu mdzad dge slong a pho'am/ ye shes rab rgyas nas don gnyer chen pos bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dkyus ring dang*/ sgor lnga brgya bcas nan bskul byung bas bskul ba po'i don yod pa'i phyir du 'brong pa'i rigs su skyes pa rmongs rgan ban de rā dzas ma hā tsi ni'i gling chung tā pe rdo rje rgyal po'i mdo sngags chos gling du shing phag zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la rnam 'dren thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin grub pa yi ge pa ni rang slob dge slong dkon mchog phrin las so/ dge legs 'phel/ ༈ phyis su glog rdul 'phrul mdzod du mdzub bris dang dag bcos dpe gzugs bcas dus yun ring por bzod brtson gyi mthar grub pa'i 'bras bu 'di'i dge bas ston 'khor la dgongs pa dbyer med pa'i rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing du phyam gcig 'du 'bral med pa'i tshom bu gcig tu gnas par smon lam bcas ka gro sbas lung yangs pa'i gser gzhung du skyes pa'i mkhan ming 'dzin pa dpang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin nyi ma nas so/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// //

༄༅/ byang gter phur pa 'bring po spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kha phral ba'i lhan thabs yang yig 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra ku mā ra pā da ye/ /rgyal kun phrin las ngo bo phur pa'i lha/ /rnam rol dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs kyi/ /rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /deng nas byang chub bar du spyi bor brten/ /lha brag gter byon phur par lugs gsum las/ khyad par gyur pa gong khug jo mo lugs/ /yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i bsnyen sgrub kyi/ /lhan thabs yang yig 'dod rgu'i gtor mdzod 'bri/ /tshul 'dir bla ma lha yis byin rlob cing*/ /zab gnad lhug par bkod la phur srung dang*/ /dam can bka' skyong tshogs kyis 'phreng ma dog /tshul bzhin sgrub por grub gnyis char du phob/ ces mchod par brjod cing brtsam pa dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ /'dir kho bo'i skyabs mchog nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis slob bu tha chung ba dag la brtse ba chen pos byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes legs par stsal ba las/ rgyas pa che mchog dang bsdus pa drag sngags lcags khang ma gnyis rang sor bzhag ste/ 'bring po spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kha phral te nyams su len tshul 'chad par bya'o/ de la yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa las dang por tshad ldan rdo rje slob dpon las smin byed kyi dbang legs par nos shing*/ rgyab rten gyi lung spyi dang*/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa thugs gsang ba sku'i rgyud sogs sgrub thabs man ngag rnams kyi lung thob pas dang po sngon 'gro ni/ gnas grogs yo byad sogs yid dang mthun par 'du byas/ 'bum nag las gza' phur bu mchog tu bsngags pa sogs gza' skar shis pa la gnas khang byi dor dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bris 'bur byin rlabs can bshams/

gzhung las/ rang nyid kha byang du bltas la: zhes 'byung bas go yul 'grig na stan byang bstan du byas pa'i mdun thad du cog tse'i khar sgrub gtor lha tsaka gtor gdugs can gyi mdun du bsnyen phur rang la bstan pa/ g.yas g.yon du sman rag phur srung dang gter srung gi mchod gtor phyi nang gi nyer mchod sogs bkod mdzes su bshams/ rang gi stan 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung chos skor 'bri/ rang gi mdun gyi gdab phur sras mchog gnyis par gsol 'debs dgos pa dang*/ ḍā dril sogs bshams stan la 'dug ste skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag nyid rdo rje srin po'i sku: zhes sogs rgyud las byung ba ltar bdag bskyed blangs te bzlas pa brgya tsam byas la/ rak+ta/ gu gul/ yungs thun rnams la sngags/ nged kyis bris pa'i sgrub chen chog khrigs snying po rab gsal las bshad pa ltar rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la zhes sogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen phur dang rang gi las phur gnyis ka sras mchog tu bskyed dgos pas/ kī la ya tshar gcig brjod/ de nas lag gnyis phur pa sgril tshul bya zhing zhes pa nas bzung sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang*/ brab bdug byugs gsum dang mnga' gsol/ gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar byos: zhes pa'i bar brjod nas bsnyen phur sgrub gtor mdun gyi phur gdan du zhal rang la bstan nas bkod/ dkar dmar gtor ma bshams pa chab kyis bran te/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas sa gzhi brtan zhing bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung sgrub chen chog khrigs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar ltar ram/ yang na snying po rab gsal du thugs sgrub las blangs pa ltar/ hūm̐/ sa 'di rnams la dbang mdzad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ ci bder ba ni gzhan du zur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod pa gang bde bya/ skabs 'dir gu gul bdug cing yungs thun gyis brab ste/

kī la ya dang sum+bha ni rdo rje sder mo'i sngags sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir mtho bzhi brtsigs la spro na rgyal chen so so'i sku bris pa btsugs/ ma 'byor na bris sku med kyang cho ga mchod gtor lag len ltar bshams la shar nas brtsams te tho 'dzugs kyi cho ga dngos grub mtsho dang snying po rab gsal gnyis gang bde bya/ srung 'khor bsgom la sgo drung du mtshams tho dkar po che ba zhig bshams pa ni sngon 'gro'i cho ga'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ srod thun la phrin las gzhung srong*/ bla ma'i gsung las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam ltar bya/ yang na rtsa ba'i gter gzhung dril sgrub kyi phrin las chen po dang*/ 'go skad gnyis shan sbyar dngos po nges bstan sogs dang*/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phur pa bi to ta ma la: 'bum sde'i rgyud la blo sbyangs nas: g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu: mi lo bcu gnyis bar du bsgrubs: de yi phrin las 'di kho na'o: zhes sogs yod pa ltar bya/ dzap la thug pa dang phreng ba byin rlob ni/ oṃ kī ri kī ri ri nu hrīḥni ye swā hā: lan bdun gyis phreng ba la phu 'debs/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wa dha ye swā hā: bdun gyis phreng ba la ha btab ste byin gyis brlabs/ rgyud las/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni: zhes pa nas bzung ste bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa gsungs pa ltar rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' rgyan dang yum med pa mtshon gang tsam gsal ba/ de'i thugs kar thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar ting 'dzin sems dpa' gsung gi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa gser gyi mdog can zhal nang bstan langs pa'i tshul du bskor ba gsal btab/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i mdun du bsnyen phur gyi steng du rang 'dra'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal ba rang dang zhal sprod kyi tshul du byas pa ni mdun bskyed yin pa mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa'i bsnyen yig tu bshad/

bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'od zer gyi rtse las mchod sprin spros te mchod/ sems can rnams kyi don byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma shar ba'i mun pa ltar dwangs par bsam pa ni sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i bsnyen pa zer/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par rong rong gyur pa dang*/ gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon te bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'od bsnyen phur rnams la bstims pa dang*/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha sgra sgrags thams cad sngags sgrar shes par byas la de dag kyang thun mthar bdag gis bsnyen pa'i rten dang brten pa la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam pa ni bdag byin brlabs sam sgrub pa'i dmigs pa thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi 'od zer rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i rwa dbus ma nas thon ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas dang rang lhar gsal ba'i sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros/ bsnyen phur sras mchog tu gsal ba'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i gtso bo yab yum ye shes sems dpa' dang bcas pa gsal ba'i yab kyi shangs g.yon nas zhugs/ ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yon thugs ka'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i rwa dbus ma nas zhugs/ ting 'dzin sems dpa'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las kyang 'od zer sngar ltar rwa dbus ma nas 'thon te ye shes sems dpa' dang gtso bo'i shangs g.yas nas phyir phyungs te/

rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu dang thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i sna g.yon nas rgyud rdo rje'i rwa dbus su zhugs te ting 'dzin sems dpa'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas par phog pa sogs mgal me ltar drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs shing bzlas pa ni nye bsnyen do li'i bzlas pa/ thun mthar dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs las 'od zer dkar po 'phros te bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba dang*/ 'od zer ser po 'phros te snang srid 'khor 'das kyi tshe dpal yon tan thams cad bsdus te rang la bltims pa rgyas pa dang*/ 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du bsdu ba dbang dang*/ 'od zer ljang nag me'i tshwa tshwa dang mtshon cha'i dbyibs lta bu 'phros pas bar gcod dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa drag po ste las bzhi'i dmigs pa 'di la sgrub pa chen por grags/ de ltar dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du rnams re mos dang*/ 'phro 'dus sun na bdag mdun gyi lha skur sems bzung ste bzla ba dang*/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug ldir ba ltar grags pa la sems gtad de bzla ba dang*/ gtso bo gnas lugs kyi lta ba'i ngang nas bzla ba sogs thabs la mkhas par bya/ rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du'i dbang du ma song bar lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i ngang nas sngags bzla ba gal che zhing*/ bzlas pa'i dug skyon brgyad spang ba dang shes pa brgyad kyi sgo nas nyams su blang ngo*/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ bsnyen phur steng gi gtso bo yab yum gyi sku las rang 'dra'i sku zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung nas bsnyen phur la thim/ gtso bo yab yum sems dpa' dang bcas pa de je chung du song nas rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim pas bdag dang phur pa gnyis ka gzi brjid rgyas par bsam la dbyangs gsal gyi mthar rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 'grub par gyur cig swā hā:

zhes dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma lan bdun brjod/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du: kun bzang che mchog he ru kaḥ zhes sogs kyi dzap bskul bya/ skabs 'dir phur srung dang gter srung sogs gtor 'bul dgos rigs rnams byed/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum bya/ 'on kyang tshogs bar pa yan dkyus bzhin la/ rig 'dzin bskul gtong lha tshogs dang phur srung bskul ba phur brgyud gser skyems sogs bzhag /tshogs mtha' ma'i zan la dgug zhugs dang phyag rgya bzhis 'gugs 'ching bsdom myos byas rjes sgo ba bzhi dang lha dbye bzhag /spro na/ dam tshig chen po sogs gdab kha drug btang rjes bsgral te/ dpal chen 'khor bcas kyi zhal stob tsam bya/ gzhan du gter gzhung spu gri'i las gzhung gi nṛ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes sogs dang zhal bstab byas na bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs 'dir rgyas bsdus 'tshams par snang*/ lhag ma gtsang lhag bsags shing lhag chog mi gtong*/ 'bul gtor yod na chad mdo brtan skyong bya/ slar yang bdag mdun la mchod bstod bsdus tsam zhig byas rjes/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya/ zhes sogs bzhi spel sbyar ba'i yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ rten dang brten pa thams cad mi dmigs par ka dag gi ngang du bzhag /slar yang lam gyi lhar snang zhing*/ gzhal yas dkyil 'khor lha rnams gtso bo yi/ zhes sogs nyer bsdu dang*/ khyab bdag dpal ldan karma he ru ka'i/ zhes sogs kyi smon lam dang*/ thugs rje chen pos sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ zhes sogs kyi shis brjod bya/ dzap bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas de'i nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go /nangs par thor thun la/ langs ma thag skyabs sems yan lag bcu pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ las byang rdo rje pha lam ltar bgyis na bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad la gnod pas/ phur pa thugs kyi phrin las lta bu'i gzhung bsrangs te bzlas pa la 'jug khar phreng ba byin rlabs dang*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka kha ga gha nga*/ zhes sogs dang dbyangs yig gi mthar aṃ aḥ zhes pa ste dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma grangs lan bdun brjod de bzlas pa la 'jug /dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du rnams gong ltar ro/ thun mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas te nyer bsdu srod thun ltar dang bsngo smon shis brjod bsdus tsam zhig byas la thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug /zhogs thun nam langs tsam nas skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ phreng ba byin rlabs dang dbyangs gsal mi dgos/ gung tshigs ran khar thun bsdu tshul snga ma ltar ro/ dgong thun yang dgung tshigs thon rjes skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar gong ltar dang nyi nub tsam la sngar bzhin thun bsdu'o/ srod thun la spro na las byang rdo rje pha lam gyi gzhung srong*/ phur srung dang gtor 'bul byed dgos rnams dang*/ bsnyen dus tshogs 'khor nges can ma byung yang 'thus kyang*/ cho ga'i kha skong sogs bgyis na legs pas tshogs 'khor sogs smad las rnams srod thun ltar ro/ de ltar bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngos 'dzin tshul ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug sogs gnas bcur khro bcu yab yum phra phyag /lte bar bya khyung sogs gsal 'debs pa bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su khro bcu yab yum phra phyag sgo ma dam can sogs bsgom pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ bdag dang shar gyi khro bo'i bar du bsnyen phur sras mchog phur par gsal ba mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yin par shes dgos so/ srod thun la srung 'khor drug po byed tshul ni gu ru pad+ma'i gsang sngags lam rim las/ rnal 'byor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa ni: lus can rnams kyi byang chub mchog thob bsgoms: lha mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo mtshon mes bsrung : lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs yig bsgoms:

spyan ras 'jam dpal yi dam gang yin gsal: rdo rje'i sa rwa gur dang mda' me bsgoms: bya byed ngo bo mi dmigs ngang la bzhag: ces gsungs pa ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i steng du bla ma/ g.yas su pha sogs pho rigs/ g.yon du ma sogs mo rigs/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog /'og tu zhing khang nor rdzas sogs mngon sum lta bur gsal ba ni bsrung bya sba ba/ bdag lhar gsal ba las phur bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ bar gcod gdon bgegs bskrad tshur 'dus pas srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du phur pa'i sa gzhi rwa grwa gur bla bre sogs bar mtshams med par gtams pa ni lha mtshan/ yang phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gcig la sogs pa sngar bzhin spros/ bar gcod bskrad tshur 'dus pas phur pa'i gur khang gi phyir rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa drwa gur bla brer gyur pa ni rdo rje/ yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgya stong nas bzhi lnga'i bar mtha' yas spros bar gcod bgegs bskrad/ tshur 'dus rdo rje'i gur khang gi phyir 'khor lo'i gur khang du gyur pa ni 'khor lo/ yang mtshon cha sna tshogs spros gdon bgegs thams cad bsgrad tshur 'dus 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyir mtshon cha'i gur khang du gyur pa ni mtshon cha/ yang me dpung mtha' yas pa spros gdon bgegs rnams bskrad tshur 'dus mtshon cha'i gur gyi phyir 'khor zhing 'phro ba ni me ri ste dang po'o/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad dang khyad par gnod byed rnams la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po bsgom pa ni lus can rnams kyis zhes sogs kyi don/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ yig je cher gyur pa phyir 'thon/ lus kyi phyir gur lta bur phub/ mgrin pa'i āḥyang je cher gyur pa phyir 'thon/ oṃ gyi nang gur lta bur phub/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig kyang je cher gyur pa phyir 'thon mgrin pa nas lte ba'i bar du slebs pa ni sku gsung thugs yig bsgom pa'o/

bzhi pa ni/ de'i nang rang spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa lta bu gang yang rung bar bsam/ de'i thugs kar 'jam dbyangs/ de'i thugs kar rang sems rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du bsam pa ni spyan ras 'jam dpal yi dam gang yin gyi don/ lnga pa ni/ rang lus kyi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur bla bre/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ so dang sen mo me ri 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i sa rwa sogs kyi don/ drug pa ni/ gnod bya gnod byed thams cad mi dmigs pa rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du mnyam par 'jog pa ni bya byed ngo bo mi dmigs ngang la bzhag ces sogs kyi don no/ de ltar srung 'khor drug po 'di srod thun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs su nges par bsgom zhing*/ 'tshub cha 'dra byung na gzhan rnams la yang bsgom pa gces/ thun bzhir las byang ma thub na/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje srin po'i sku: zhes sogs kyi gsal 'debs shing srod thun lta bur las byang che

rdo rje pha lam 'bring spu gri'i las byang chung thugs kyi phrin las gsum gang rigs nges par gtong dgos/ thun mtshams gang 'os su rgyun gyi dge sbyor chags med dgos pa rnams bya zhing*/ gung seng dus phreng ba la mdud pa rgyab ste gdan khar 'jog cing stan drod ma yal ba dang*/ de'i ring khrus dang*/ skra sen 'breg pa/ gzhan la srung mdud ster ba sogs mi byed/ kha zas kyi spang blang yang 'di ltar bya dgos te/ byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi them byang zhal gdams las/ lce sha zos na sngags rnams kyi: nus pa thams cad nyams par 'gyur: de phyir lce sha thams cad spangs: mcher pa dag kyang lce dang mtshungs: lan tshwas nus pa chung ngu 'gro: sgog skyas zhag bdun nus pa nyams: btsong dmar zhag lnga sgog sngon gsum: ri sgog zhag gcig nus pa nyams: la phug zhag dgu'i nus pa nyams: zwa yis zhag ni bco lnga nyams: de rnams spangs na nus pa che: gal te zos na gnyen po'i sngags: ā li kā li ci nus bzlas: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir gzhan yang dug skyon spang ba ni bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs pra khrid spyan rgya can las/ bzlas brjod mi tshig gi sel gyis ma chod par bya zhing*/ sgra ha cang che na gsang ba bsgrags sangs dang*/ sgra chung na ngag tu 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ myur na sgra 'dres pa dang*/ bul na sgra byer ba dang*/ yengs na rgyud chad pa dang*/ sgrib nas dub pa rnams spangs te bzlas brjod byas na rtags myur du 'byin pa ni/ dug bral kha zas sman du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ zhes dang*/ shes pa brgyad ni/ 'dzab bsnyen gang 'dren dmigs byar gsal bas dkyil 'khor du shes pa/ mchod par shes pa/ dbyangs su shes pa/ dngos grub tu shes pa/ phrin las su shes pa/ chos nyid du shes pa/ sgrib sbyong du shes pa/ rin po cher shes pa dang brgyad du bshad pa sogs bshad gzhi mtha' yas pa gzhung de rnams su blta'o/ bsnyen tshad ni phur pa gsang rgyud las/

sa ya drug 'bum bsnyen pa'i tshad: ces gsungs pa/ bka' brgyad them byang zhal gdams las/ sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum bsnyen: 'bum tsho brgya dang drug yin no: zhes bsnyen rkyang gi grangs de ltar yin pas grangs tshad ma song bar bzla dgos pas dus las grangs bsnyen gtso che zhing*/ rtags bsnyen ni gsang rgyud las/ de rdzogs nas ni rtags 'di 'byung : khrag 'thung nga yi zhal mthong zhing : phyag mtshan phur bu dag tu khrab: gtor ma rak+ta bdud rtsi 'phel: zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa mi dgos te/ bsnyen sgrub sbrel ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ de ltar bsnyen pa grub nas sgrub pa la de ma thag 'jug dgos pas dngos grub blang ba sogs gang yang mi dgos so/ sgrub pa ji ltar bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ drag po'i sa la maṇ+ḍal bya: dbus su gru gsum tha ma ru: zla gam gsum gyis bskor ba dang : khyams sgo rta babs la sogs te: dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams rdzogs par bris: zhes gsungs pa de la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ spyi don dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la gnyis las/ dkyil 'khor 'bri shing rdzas dgod pa'o/ dang po dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ni/ dur khrod kyi sa sogs drag po'i rdzas sna bsres pa'i steng ba byung ro sol gyis kha dog nag por byas pa la gri khrag gi chag chag 'debs/ dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ma 'grig na shing gi stegs bur ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'gram dgos par ro sol gri khrag sogs shing stegs de khar cung zad re byugs/ sa brtag bslang sbyangs bzung rgyal tho sgo byang phyi nang ma traṃ bsgral ba/ nang gsang gi mtshams bcad sogs spros pa rnams dor bas chog /'on kyang shin tu spros par 'dod cing lag len byang bar shes na rgyas pa'i yan lag yin pas mi 'gal/ rdul tshon ras bris gang byed kyang*/ lha sta gon med du mi rung pas rdul tshon ltar na/ skabs 'dir thig tshon byin rlabs dngos grub rgya mtshor gsungs pas/

bsnyen dus kyi mchod bshams rnams ma bsdus pa de la brten nas thugs kyi phrin las tshar gcig bdag bskyed kyi tshul du btang*/ bzlas pa brgya tsam byas rjes mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ skabs 'dir dkar chal gyi las thig btab na 'jug pa bde/ thig tshon byin rlabs spro na dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar gyi phyag len ltar bya'o/ bsdu na snying po rab gsal ltar/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon lnga po khrag 'thung kā li ya rigs lnga zhes pa nas thig 'debs par 'jug go /hām̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal hrī hūm̐: zhes lan gsum btab bo zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ye thig sngags rgyas nam mkhar 'degs pa sogs dkyus ltar ro/ lha sta gon ni/ gong du las thig btab pa'i lha gnas rnams su dri bzang gi thig le re bya zhing*/ sur+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal zhes brjod/ de'i steng du 'bras lta bu'i tshom bu re bkod cing*/ lha so so'i sngags brjod na legs shing ma brjod kyang 'thus/ 'di'i lha gnas rnams 'og tu rgyas par bshad pa ltar shes dgos/ mthar phyi mchod g.yas bskor dang*/ sman raka gtor gsum gsar du bsham/ rang dkyil 'khor la phyogs te 'dug pas las byang rdo rje pha lam mam gter gzhung dril sgrub kyi phrin las che ba gang rigs kyi gzhung bsrangs te tshom bur dmigs pa'i mdun bskyed ltar gsal 'debs/ 'dzab bskul mchod bstod rig 'dzin bskul rnams dang*/ rjes chog gi mchod bstod bzod gsol grub rjes sta gon la gnas par gsol ba btab pa ni/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar las/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /nye bar dgongs shig mchod bstod sgrub pa'i mchod/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi na sta gon la/ /gnas te byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rgyal dbang lnga pas gsungs pa ltar ro/ yang na chos dbang gi gter gzhung ltar/ hoḥ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rnams zhes sogs snying po rab gsal ltar gang rigs kyi gsol 'debs lan gsum byas rjes/

hūm̐ badz+ra u taṣ+ṭha'i sngags rgyas sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams nam mkhar brten pa 'od kyi drwa gur du bzhugs par bsam la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas te tshom bu dang mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ ras bris yin na thig tshon byin rlabs dor la maṇ+ḍal lta bur dri bzang gi thig le'i steng du tshom bu bkod cing mchod gtor bshams nas/ lha nam mkhar 'degs shing mchod bstod kyi bar gong ltar ro/ dkyil 'khor ji ltar bri ba ni/ snying po rab gsal las/ dbus su grub gsum mthing nag gi zur mdun bstan zhes pa nas 'bri tshul gsal bar bris yod pa ltar dang*/ dngos grub rgya mtshor rta babs snam bu bcu gcig pa dang snam bu bzhi pa 'dam khar gsungs pas bzhi pa byed na snga 'gyur kho na'i lugs yin pas 'jug pa bde'o/ gnyis pa rdzas dgod pa ni dngos grub rgya mtshor dbang sgrub dang sbrags pa'i dgongs par bum pa dbang rdzas sogs dgod tshul rgyas par gsungs mod kyang 'dir gtso bo phur cha bkod pa kho nas 'thus shing*/ de la yang byugs bdug brab sogs gzi byin bskyed tshul ni snying po rab gsal ltar la/ de la yang byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga bya dgos te spu gri'i dbang gzhung las/ zhes pa nas dam can gyi phur pa tshang bar yod na so so'i sngags kyis rang gnas su dgod do/ zhes pa'i bar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas dkyil 'khor du 'god pa'i bar de bzhin du byas pas chog /dngos grub rgya mtshor/ dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ zhes sogs kyi 'god tshig sa phur ltar gnang ba legs kyang snying po rab gsal du byang gter phur pa che mchog gi gter gzhung ltar bris pa 'brel chags pas so/ /dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams slar sgrub pa thon khar bkod pas 'thus/ de ltar phur cha bkod zin nas/ sman gtor rak+ta bkod tshul ni/ bka' brgyad rang shar dbang gzhung las/ bdud rtsi lho la gtor ma nub:

rak+ta byang gi phyogs su bsham: zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su gtso gtor phur srung gter srung sogs gtor 'bul dgos rigs rnams gsar du rgyas par bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhor chang la chos sman btab pa'i bdud rtsi/ g.yon du chu gtsang dang khrag sbyar ba la rak+ta'i phabs btab pa'i rak+ta/ dkyil 'khor gyi me ri'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin me tog /shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas te phyi mchod dang*/ spro na khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po'i me tog /tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus bsres pa'i zhal zas/ mar me sogs phyi mchod kyi nang du sgor mchod dam sgreng tshar gang bder bkod/ gzhan yang gnam rgyan bla bre dang dar gyi lda ldi/ logs rgyan dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams su rgyal mtshan dang 'phan sogs tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad gang 'byor bkod legs su bshams nas spos dang rol mo bcas te las byang gi byin 'bebs bya zhing*/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar btegs pa rten dang brten par bcas pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi khyad chos yin no/ spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sgrub chen ji ltar bya ba ni/ rang dkyil 'khor la phyogs te 'dug /srod thun nas mgo brtsams te bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar gter gzhung phur pa dril sgrub kyi las byang che ba'am/ de'i dgongs pa bzhin rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i las byang rdo rje'i pha lam gang rigs kyi gzhung srong rgyas par bya/ dmigs pa'i zab gnad bsnyen rkyang dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas nye bar brtsams te 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas gsal btab pa'i ri rab de la ri rab phur pa zhig btab pa'i dbal la ngan song gnas bcu/

rgya mdud 'og mar 'dod khams/ 'chang bzung gi smad zur brgyad la gzugs khams/ steng zur brgyad la gzugs med khams te khams gsum phur pa'i tshul du gnas pas srid pa'i phur bu zhes pa'i don/ phur pa'i rgya mdud gong ma'i nang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs dgos pa de yang gsar ma ltar bdag mdun gyi gsal 'debs so sor brjod mi dgos te gyer bsgom zhes tshig brjod gcig gis bdag mdun me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal 'debs dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang bdag bskyed kyi srung 'khor gzhal yas khang bsgoms pa dang lhan du bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor shar gyi khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i bar du mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gsal 'debs dgos shing*/ de bzhin du lha'i mngon rtogs kyi tshig brjod pa'i skabs su bdag mdun gnyis ka'i lha gsal 'debs/ de yang spyir dkyil 'khor gsum zhes pa rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i lus kyi gnas bcur khro bo bcu phra phyag khro chung bcas gsal 'debs kyi tshig dril sgrub las/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ sngags 'di brjod pa tsam gyis ni: dpal chen gtso bo'i spyi gtsug tu: khro bo'i rgyal po hūm̐ ka ra: yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: 'od dang zer gyi tshul du bsgom: zhes pa nas/ lte ba'i gnas su sprul pa'i khyung : dung mdog lcags kyi gshog pa can: gser mig 'khyil ba rdo rje'i lus: mchu sder lcags kyi sbrul bzung nas: gdug pa can rnams zas su za: de ltar shin tu gsal bar bsgoms: zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig ngag tu brjod cing gsal 'debs pa ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams su khro bo bcu phra phyag rnams gsal 'debs pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/

bdag dang rnam rgyal bar gyi gzhal yas de'i nang du khro bo bcu phra phyag sgo ma bka' srung bcas gsal 'debs pa ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ mdun gyi gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir sras mchog rigs bzhi bsgom pa mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa'i bzhad pa dang*/ phur pa che mchog gi rgyud las sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog gsum shar lho byang gsum du bkod tshul dang*/ chos dbang rin po che'i phur pa spu gri sogs las sras mchog nyer gcig tu bshad pa sogs lugs mang yang skabs 'dir gtso phur gyi mdun dang*/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi gdab phur gnyis la thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya gsal 'debs dgos shing*/ sras mchog 'di rang la mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshang tshul bshad/ de ltar bdag mdun gnyis kyi rtsigs pa'i nang khyams dang*/ phyi rol gyi dur khrod la phur srung dam can rnams gsal 'debs tshul ni/ gter gzhung las/ khyams la dmag nag sde gsum dgod: ces gsungs pa'i bkod tshul ni/ phur pa che mchog gi phrin las gzhung las/ gtso bo'i g.yas su bse'i lha mo bzhi: zhes dang*/ g.yon du shwa na mu kha mched bzhi ni: zhes dang*/ gtso bo'i mdun du dpal ldan lha mo bzhi: zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgom dgos shing*/ de ltar yin pa'i shes byed rdo rje phur pa thugs gsang ba sku'i rgyud las/ g.yas dkar gshin rje gshed po dngos: bswe mo'i klad khrag 'dren par byed: g.yon dmar rta mgrin rgyal po dngos: shwa na'i mgrin srog gcod par byed: dbus mthing bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhal: nag mo'i tsit+ta 'dren par byed: zhes gsungs pas nang khyams la dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang*/ dur khrod la dam can bswe lcags dung gsum bskyed dgos la/ 'di la yang sku phyag mtshan sogs byang gter phur pa'i rang gzhung bstod bskul sogs las rnam grangs mang du yod pa 'dir gter gzhung gi dam can bskul dpe cha 'gar sde mtshan chad pa/

sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams kyi phyag bris ma las mched pa'i khungs thub ma las/ nam gyi tho rengs dam bcas ma: zhes sogs kyi bskul byang ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lho khyams gtso bo'i g.yas zhal dkar po'i mdun ngos su nam gyi tho rengs dam bcas pa'i bse mo bzhi rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ rdo rje ya byin mthing nag lcags phur gyi ral pa can lcags phur 'dril ba bdud rta nag po la bzhon pa/ rdo rje de byin ser mo gser phur gyi ral pa can gser gyi phur pa 'dril ba gza' rta ser po la bzhon pa/ rdo rje bswe byin dmar mo bse phur gyi ral pa can bswe'i phur pa 'dril ba btsan rta dmar zhur la bzhon pa/ rdo rje phag byin ljang mo g.yu phur gyi ral pa can g.yu'i phur pa 'dril ba klu rta sngon po la bzhon pa rnams so/ 'di bzhi la sa bdag chen mo bzhir yang grags shing phur pa che mchog gi rgyud las/ mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma bzhi: dkyil 'khor bar khyams dag tu bzhag: ces gsungs pa ltar sa bdag mo bzhi po 'di mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma'i mtsho bzhir gnas par bshad/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang khyams gtso bo'i g.yon zhal dmar po'i mdun ngos su nam gyi sros la dam bcas pa'i shwa na ma bzhi 'khod pa ni/ shwa na mu kha lcags kyi mgo can sngon mo lcags phur 'dril ba lcags spyang mgo dgu la bzhon pa/ shwa na mu kha nag mo g.yu'i mgo can g.yu phur 'dril ba g.yu'i khyi mo ral pa can la bzhon pa/ shrī ma mu kha'am sri la mu kha ser mo gser gyi mgo can gser phur 'dril ba gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la bzhon pa/ sring ga la mu kha dmar mo zangs phur 'dril ba zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la bzhon pa rnams so/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar khyams gtso bo'i dbus zhal mthing kha'i mdun ngos su nam gyi gung la dam bcas pa'i re ti mched bzhi'am bdag nyid ma bzhi 'khod pa ni/ re ma ti nag mo ral pa can phyag na mchog

zhes mi rkang gi phur pa phur 'dril ba drel rta rkang gsum la bzhon pa/ re ma ti ser nag rma bya'i thul pa can mchog phur 'dril ba chu glang sngon mo la bzhon pa/ re ma dza dmar nag re lde nag po gsol zhing mchog phur 'dril ba sha ba yu mo la bzhon pa/ re ma dzu ljang nag dar nag gi go zu gsol ba mchog phur 'dril ba rnga mong ga pa la bzhon pa rnams so/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyi lho khyams la sa bdag ma bzhi'am bse mo bzhi'i ming po dung gi skyes bu ging chen bzhi'am dmag dpon bzhi'ang rim bzhin du/ pra ma ra dza srin po'i ging dkar po dung phur 'dril ba/ ya ma rā dza gshin rje'i ging sngon po ral gri dang phur pa 'dril/ da sha gh+ri wa bdud kyi ging dmar po ral gri dang phur pa 'dril ba/ yak+sha grī wa gnod sbyin gyi ging ser po phur pa 'dril ba'o/ dur khrod kyi byang khyams su shwa na ma bzhi'i ming po bse'i skyes bu bzhi yang rim pa bzhin du srin po'i skyes bu srin po gyad chen dkar po dung phur 'dril ba/ gshin rje'i skyes bu ya ma nag po lcags phur 'dril ba/ ya bdud kyi skyes bu sog po mig ri dmar po zangs phur 'dril ba/ gnod sbyin gyi skyes bu mon pa mig rwi sngon po g.yu phur 'dril ba'o/ dur khrod kyi shar khyams su bdag nyid ma bzhi'am re ti mched bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skye bu bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du/ shar bdud dkar po mche ba gtsigs pa dung gi phur pa 'dril ba/ lho bdud sngon po ral pa can g.yu phur 'dril ba/ nub bdud nag po zhags pa dang phur pa 'dril ba/ byang bdud ljang gu ral gri dang phur pa 'dril ba'o/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi nang khyams lho byang shar gsum du dam can gyi ma mo bcu gnyis dang*/ de bzhin du dur khrod kyi phyogs gsum po der bswe lcags dung gsum gyi skyes bu bcu gnyis bskyed pa las/

dkyil 'khor dang dur khrod kyi nub phyogs su dam can yab yum gyi lha gnas med pa'i rgyud mtshan gtso bo'i zhal g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyi gdul byar de dag bzhugs pa ma gtogs gtso bor rgyab zhal med pa'i phyir ro/ rgyud don 'di'i tshul ma nges pa 'ga' zhig nub phyogs su lha 'god pa lugs 'dir mi rigs so/ bka' brgyad kyi byang phyogs phrin las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bka' sras 'god tshul dang mi gcig pas 'di gnyis so sor ma 'dres pa dgos/ snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi lugs gong du smos pa ltar bse mo bzhi la sa bdag ma bzhir grags pas/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab: ces 'di bzhi dang*/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: ces pa'i skabs su shwa na ma bzhi dang*/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab: ces pa re ti mched bzhir 'khrul pa med pa gu ru pad+ma'i dgongs pa yin la/ sa phur la sa bdag chen mo gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nur ngos 'dzin pa 'dra bas sa bdag chen mo'i zhal 'bag yin zer khro 'bag cig gis gdab las chen mo'i sgrub 'cham dus 'cham dpon gyi gyon srol 'dug pas/ khyi gdong gi gtso bo byed pa sogs ming don gnyis ka 'khrul pa'i log rtog cig shar ba'i rgyu mtshan gtan tshig 'dra yod na smra ba'i ljags rkyong bar rigs so/ de ltar phur srung dam can bskyed tshul 'di phur bu mkhan po rnams la shin tu gces pa rgyud don man ngag gis gsal bar byas pa yin pas dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ lha mtshan phur pa 'god pa gtso bor bsgoms la 'di bzhin dgos pa legs par bshad pa yin no/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gsum po bskyed nas srog ye shes su bskyed de srog dbang bskur ba ni dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs so/ zhes pa'i bar nged kyis bris pa'i sgrub chen chog khrigs lag len snying po rab gsal du gsal bar bshad yod pas de kho na ltar thun bzhir nyams su blang ngo*/

bzla bya'i sngags ni bsnyen rkyang gi dus su gsang ba'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ skabs 'dir rdo rje phur pa thugs gsang ba sku'i rgyud las/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum: rtags bsnyen rtags byung bar du bzla: zhes gsungs pas bsnyen rkyang dus kyi yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa de la dzaḥhūm̐ āḥgasum bsnan pa'i yig 'bru bcu bdun pa bye ba gsum ste 'bum phrag sum cu bzla dgos pa de ltar yin pa'i shes byed gter kha 'di ga'i man ngag rtsa thung las/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan sngags bshad pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje gzhon nu: badz+ra 'khor lo rgyan 'debs ma: kī li khro bo bcu: kī lā khro mo bcu: ya sras mchog: sarba thams cad 'dus pa: big+nan dgra bgegs gnon pa: baṃ lcags sgrog gis bcings pa: hūm̐ thugs kyi snying po: phaṭ sprul pa 'gyed pa: dza dngos grub 'gugs pa: hūm̐ dngos grub thams cad bdag la bsdu ba: āḥdangos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa: zhes sngags 'grel dang bcas te bshad pa ltar ro/ rtags ni/ gsang rgyud las/ stong gsum zhabs kyis brdzis pa dang : nyi zla khong du mid pa dang : ri rab lag gis bskor ba dang : rgya mtsho 'ub kyis btung ba dang : dngos sam nyams sam rmi lam du: grub pa'i rtags ni nges par 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du spyir bsnyen dus bzhin la/ bsnyen phur steng gi rang 'dra'i rdo rje gzhon nu la do li'i spro bsdu byed pa de 'dir mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso phur rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba la dmigs dgos shing*/ gzhan du dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du spyi dang srung 'khor drug po sogs thams cad bsnyen dus bzhin la rgyas bsdus sogs rig pas spros te bya dgos la thun bzhir gcod lugs kyang de ltar ro/ nub re bzhin tshogs 'khor dang srod thun gyi 'gor/ shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas:

zhes sogs kyi sgo nas kun thub rgyal mo bskul zhing nyul le bskrad pas byin 'bebs sogs bya tshul dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar dang snying po rab gsal ltar bya ba ni dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa'o/ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gnyis te/ dang po las sbyor ji ltar bya ba dang*/ gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba'i rim pa'o/ de la dang po las sbyor ni/ gsang rgyud las/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum rim pa gsum/ zangs lcags mkhar ba'i phyi ma la: khrag rgod bsres la byugs par bya: drag po'i shing la zur gsum rtsang : nyer gcig srin mo'i 'gros su bkod: rnam shes tshang ba'i laṅga bri: zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du stegs gru bzhi pa ji ltar rigs pa ro sol gyi phye ma bkram pa'o/ phung ro gru bzhir bgrad pa'i steng rdza shing gang rigs kyi 'brub khung gru gsum pa bang rim gsum pa la zangs lcags mkhar ba'i phyi ma dang khrag rgod kyis byugs pa'i phyir skyer pa sogs drag po'i shing gi rtsang nyer gcig srin po'i 'gros te bsnol thabs su bkod pa'i nang du phur pa drag sngags spu gri'i ti ka las liṅga 'khor lo la skyon te bsgral bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i don gter kha 'di ga'i phur pa bswe sgrom las/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud gsum pa zhig bya: lte ba la ming rus bris: phyi rol rtsibs drug la lus tshang bar bris: rtsibs shar la mgo bo: lho shar du lag pa g.yon: lho nub tu rkang pa g.yon: nub tu pho mtshan: nub byang du rkang pa g.yas: byang shar du lag pa g.yas: rtsibs shar gyi nang du tshang bar bris: pho mtshan la bla dwags bris: phyi'i mu khyud la dzaḥnyer gcig bris: zhes gsungs pa ltar na 'khor lo bri ba 'thad pa 'dra yang deng sang 'khor lo 'bri ba phyag len du mi byed kyang 'khor lo byas na gzhung dang mthun par 'dug /'on kyang phyag len ltar na dug shog la liṅga skye mched tshang ba tshe bdag yang bzlog king kang sogs spyi ltar bris pa la/

khyad chos phur pa drag sngags kyi rtsa ba las gsungs pa ltar mgo bo'i skra gseb tu/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya snying khrag shad dza la tsi ta a pa ra tsi ta zhes 'bru bcu dgu pa bris rtsibs shar la 'god/ lho shar du lag g.yon/ lho nub tu rkang pa g.yon/ nub tu pho mtshan/ nub byang du rkang pa g.yas pa/ byang shar du lag pa g.yas pa/ rtsibs kyi nang du tshud par bris/ lag pa g.yas pa'i nywa la/ ma rak+mo yak+mo kā la ru pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ thibs thibs zhes 'bru bcu drug pa bris/ lag pa g.yon nywa la/ tsit+ta srog la tung tung srog la yaṃ yaṃ dza ye bi dza ye myags myags sod sod tsakra se na tubs/ 'bru bcu bzhi pa bris/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i byin bar snying la khril khril srog la chum chum ka tang ka te snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying kha rag dun tri: zhes 'bru nyer gcig pa bris/ rkang pa g.yon la ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru dha ti ma ma karma i nan shrī badz+ra ma tang nyag ka ra ye ma ra sa ni pra ma dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces 'bru so gsum pa bris/ gzhan yang mig la long*/ rna ba 'on pa sogs gnad yig rnams dang*/ dpral bar rus snying ga nṛ tri dang dzaḥ kha sprod kyi mthar dgra bgegs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsogs king kang ltar gyi bla 'gugs dang spel tshig mgrin pa nas brtsam 'go phyir bstan du bris rla la bla dwags sogs spyi ltar dbu can gyi yi ge yig spung dang tshag med du bris/ liṅga'i spyi bo nas yig mgo nang bstan dha ti gsum gyi drag sngags 'og nas 'byung ba ltar la dmod tshig 'bri/ yi ge 'di rnams ldog pa dang sdug pa dang 'byams pa gsum gyi rkyon dang lhag chad bris srub med pa gal che zhing mthar dzaḥkhram gyis bskor zan dril gyis phy-is shing*/ lam rgya gram gyi sa 'thor zhing*/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: zhes bzla/ chu mig lkugs pa zhes gar yang mi 'bab pa'am khron pa'i chus me long gi ngos su liṅga shar ba bkru zhing*/

bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: bra ma'i shing ngam ro bsregs pa'i mgal dum gyi me sbar ba la bur shing*/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: rlung la 'phyar ba'am rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing*/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: zhes brjod cing sbyang ba bya/ sngags 'di rnams tshar bdun re tsam bzla dgos shing go rim yang*/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ zhes nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rim pa byas kyang chog pas gang bdes 'thus/ sbyang ba zin nas btsan dug thang khrom sogs dug sna dang*/ gri khrag sogs dug khrag sbyar ba ha cang gar po min pa zhig gis liṅga la byugs/ dmigs gsal la zag rdzas sogs dgos kyang 'dir rig sngags kyis bsgrubs pa'i dug khrag min pa gsar sbyor byas pa dgos/ de ltar grub nas drag sngags kyi gzhung mang por liṅga'i sha khrag rus gsum chags pa'i sngags dmigs sogs mang du bshad kyang de dag lag len du long dka' bas 'di tsam gyis 'thus shing*/ liṅga de ro skra dang tshon skud sngo dmar gyis 'brub khung du sham tshod cig bcings te lus rjen par mthong ba byas te 'brub khung du bcug cing ling khebs lta bu stengs nas dgab bo/ gter gzhung la lar 'brub khung dang liṅga dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du bkod nas tshon skud kyi byad thag sne mo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phur pa la 'dogs par yang bshad/ dmigs bsal med pa dang bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma lta bu ma 'byor na zan ling gis kyang 'thus pa'o/ gdab kha dngos ji ltar bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ lha 'phral gnas nas dgugs pa dang : rnam shes gzugs stims byad du zhugs: smyor zhugs rdul du brlag pa dang : sha khrag zhal du bstabs nas 'gyed: 'di drug shes na las rnams 'grub: ces gsungs pa'i don drug po de la phur pa rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar 'grel chen 'bum nag tu drug cur dbye tshul gsungs te/
