gnyen po stobs kyi lha drug /ngan sngags las kyi phur pa drug /gdab pa gnas kyi gdab pa drug /bskul bar bya ba'i pho nya drug /gdags par bya ba'i 'phyong drug /bsags par bya ba'i rdzas drug /bzlas par bya ba'i sngags drug /bca' bar bya ba'i phyag rgya drug /gdab pa'i smon lam drug /ting nge 'dzin drug ste don tshan bcur gsungs pa ltar shes pa gal che zhing*/ de ltar lha 'phral ba la gnyen po'i lha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang las kyi lha rdor legs/ las phur seng ldeng dmar po gdab gnas spyi gtsug bskul ba'i pho nya dam tshig chen po 'phyongs rtogs shig sogs rdzas dang sngags phyag rgya smon lam ting nge 'dzin rnams 'og tu 'chad pa ltar ro/ de ltar na don tshan re re la yang bcur phye ba'i phra zhib thams cad bris ma langs pas kho bo'i bla ma rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen pos bdag la brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis gzigs te yang rdzong du lo gsum gyi bcad rgya'i dus rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rgyas pa bgyis skabs legs par stsal ba'i man ngag dmar khrid kyi don bzhin lag len du bstar ba la las gzhung tshar cig tshogs bar pa yan grub nas rig 'dzin bskul ba/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskul ba/ phur srung dam can rnams bskul ba sogs snying po rab gsal ltar bya/ gser skyems bshams pa byin gyis brlabs te spyi ltar mkhyen gsol gzu dang dpang sogs bya/ yang na rdo rje pha lam ltar bya/ rtsa brgyud bla ma phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ zhes pa nas/ gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes gzu dpang mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sho lo ka gsum byas na 'jug pa bde/ 'di man chad rdo rje pha lam du phur 'cham sogs spros pa dang sbyar ba yin pas snying po rab gsal ltar bgyis na bde bas 'brub khung dang liṅga bskyed pa sogs spyi ltar bya/ drag sngags spu gri'i ti ka las/ dbye 'gugs spyi dang mthun par bya:

zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di man chad kyi gdab kha rnams la thun bzhir las byang rgyas bsdus gang rigs bzlas pa 'os 'tshams 'dzab bskul mchod bstod dang bcas pa'i rjes su rang gi thugs ka nas e chad pa las 'brub khung me 'bar bar gsal btab ste e raṃ phaṭ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ nṛ tri dzaḥzhes de'i nang du dgra bgegs dngos su gsal btab la/ tshig lhugs pa'i bden bdar dgugs gzhug brgya'am lnga bcu tsam bya/ dmigs gsal lta bur dngos nyams rmi lam gyi rtags dang liṅga snum du song ba dang dngos su 'gul ba sogs byung na khug rtags yin par bshad/ de rjes gdab kha drug gi dang po lha dang dbye ba la don tshan drug tu yod pa'i dang po lha'am pho nya ni/ dgugs gzhug tshar gcig sngon du 'gro bas/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: ces pa nas/ mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab: ces pa'i bar brjod cing bskul/ gnyis pa 'phyong ni/ bskul de las/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis: zhes pa'i tshig gcig po 'di btags/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ dmigs bsal yod na ming 'jug /spyir/ dgra bgegs ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥ daṇ+ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ci nus bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni/ dmigs bsal/ gu gul/ khyi lud/ tshil chen/ lham 'bog /rta bong gi lud rnams 'grel chen 'bum nag las bshad pas sgrub khang min pa'i phyogs gzhan du gtong tshul lag len ltar dang*/ spyir gu gul gyis bdug cing phyag rgya bya 'ug gi sgros byab tshul byed/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ las mkhan sde brgyad rnams bya 'ug gi gzugs su sprul nas dgra yul du song ste skyob byed kyi lha srung dang 'phral ba'i dmigs pa byed/ drug pa dmod pa'am smon lam ni/ thun 'jog khar dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ dang skyob pa'i lha rnams bral bar gyur cig /ces pa'i dmod pa lan mang bar brjod/

'di yang dmigs bsal rtags dang sbyor ba dgos kyang dkyus ma thun gnyis gsum tsam gyis 'thus/ gdab kha gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa la yang don drug gi dang po pho nya ni/ 'gugs 'dren sngon du 'gro bas dam tshig chen po sho lo ka gnyis kyis pho nya btang*/ gnyis pa 'phyongs ni/ gtogs shig sogs kyi 'phyongs snga ma'i tshab tu/ phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis: zhes btags/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ci nus bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni 'bum nag las/ tsher nag yungs dkar rgyal po yugs sa'i zhabs sa rnams bshad/ spyir yungs dkar nag /lcags zangs rdo phye dug sna'i phye ma sogs zam thun la gri khrag sogs khrag rlon pa dang sbyar ba'i bol byas pa'i thun rdzas thod pa'am g.yag ru lta bur blugs pa'i kha g.yag rog gi rtsid pas bkag pa'i steng nas phu btab pas kha rlangs dang mchil ma mi 'chor ba'i gnad yin la/ de ltar gter gzhung nag po dug gi spu gri las/ mon nam rabs chad thod pa ru: pho rdzas dug la mo rdzas khrag: ces gsungs pa'i thun de dag gis liṅgar 'thor/ phyag rgya thal mo gnyis la sbub nas 'bebs pa'i steng ka byed/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ pho nya rnams kyis dgra bo lcags kyus snying ga nas bzung ste bkug nas liṅgar bstims pa'i dmigs pa byed/ drug pa dmod pa ni/ dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo gzugs de nyid la thim par gyur cig gi dmod pa thun 'jog khar byed/ gdab kha gnyis pa dmigs gsal la khug rtags ma byung gi bar du dgos pa zhag gcig gnyis sam thun gsum bzhi skabs dang sbyor dgos kyang spyi 'gror thun gcig gis 'thus/ gdab kha gsum pa byad du zhugs pa la don drug gi dang por 'gugs 'dren sngon du 'gro bas bab brgyad kyi pho nya btang*/

gnyis pa 'phyong snga ma'i tshab tu/ zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: zhes pa btags/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī ghaṃ a na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni 'bum nag las/ bal tshon sna lnga skud pa dkar nag bshad/ phyag len du rang gi dri ma ma song ba'i tshon skud sna lnga dang yugs sa'i skras liṅga cung zad 'khyig pa'i tshul byed/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ lcags sgrog dang zhags pas ri dwags rgyar tshud pa ltar bkyigs par bsam/ drug pa dmod pa ni/ dgra bgegs 'di dru bu thul ba ltar sdoms shig chings shig ces thun 'jog khar byed/ 'di thun gcig gis 'thus/ gdab kha bzhi pa smyor zhugs pa la don drug gi dang po 'gugs 'dren lan gcig gi mthar bab brgyad kyi pho nya btang*/ gnyis pa/ rings par khug la smyo ru chug /ces pa tshig gcig po 'di btags/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni/ dha tu ra thang lo dug chu rnams bshad/ phyag len du chu gtsang khrag gis mdog 'gyur tsam byas pa la thang khrom pas gtsos pa'i dug sna'i phye ma btab pa'i ro skra'i pir lta bus liṅga'i kha mig sna snying kha sogs dbang po'i sgo rnams la cung zad re byugs 'byug bul ches pa dang khrag gar na slar ling lteb byed dus chag 'gro bas sla bar byed cing rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i phyag rgya byed/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ sprul pa'i pho nya rnams kyis dug gi char phab pas dgra bo smyo 'bog rengs par bsam/ drug pa dmod pa ni/ cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo smyo ru chug cig 'bog tu chug c-ig dran pa nyams par gyur cig ces thun 'jog khar byed 'di yang thun gcig gis 'thus/ gdab kha lnga pa rdul du rlog pa 'di'i khog nas dha ti'i drag sngags bzla ba dang las sbyor dngos ston pas las byang che 'bring chung gsum gang rigs dang bzlas pa brgya stong tsam 'dzab bskul mchod bstod sogs sngon du 'gro bas/

'brub khung dang liṅgar dmigs pa gong ltar/ e raṃ phaṭa raṃ dz+wa la raṃ nṛ tri dzaḥ zhes dang dgug gzhug tshar gsum mam gcig dang*/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥsogs phyag rgya bzhis 'gugs 'ching sdom smyos kyi dmigs pa brtan por byas te thun gyi dngos gzhir dha ri'i sngags bzla dgos la de la yang spyir dha ti rnam pa gsum zhes gter gzhung las gsal bar gsungs te/ phur pa che mchog gi rgyud las dha ti rnam gsum gyi rang rtags srog gi snying po dngos su phul bya ba ni phur pa'i gzhung gzhan las/ dha ti chen po dang 'bring dang chung ba dang gsum 'dus par gsungs la/ zhes gsungs pa'i dha ti rnam gsum ni rgyud las/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya ka taṃ ka te ya ye ta ka ra i nan sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dza ye bi dza ye ku ru ka ra i nan sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la tsit+ta badz+ra a tsi ta a pa ra tsi ta ma ma trag ma taṃ nyag ka ra i nan sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭ: ces pa rtsa ba'i snying po gsum: 'bum phrag rtse gcig bzlas par bya: zhes gsungs pa 'di yin la/ gzhan yang rgyud de nyid las/ dha ti rnam pa gsum po dam can ma mo rnams las bkol gyi sngags yin par gsungs pas/ dam can rnam gsum las la bkol: sha ba khyi yi non pa bzhin: 'dar bzhin bka' la nyan par bsam: drag po'i sngags 'di bzla bar bya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ka taṃ ka te ya ye ta ka ra i nan dzā ye bi dzā ye ku ru ka ra i nan a tsi ta a pa ra tsi ta ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru trag ma taṃ myag ka ra i nan dha ti ma ma karma shi kraṃ ka ka nye ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ grangs ni 'di nyid stong phrag gsum: bzlas pas las kyi rtags 'di 'byung : zhes cung zad mi 'dra ba zhig kyang gsungs yang na shin tu bsdus pa yang rgyud de nyid dang spu gri'i rgyud las/ dam can rnam gsum las la bkol: 'dus pa snying po 'di nyid zlos:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma karma shi traṃ kaṃ ka kar nye ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dha ti 'dus pa'i snying po 'di: stong phrag gsum du bzlas par bya: dam can dngos su 'du bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs/ spro na liṅgar bkod pa'i sngags rnams kyang ci rigs su bzla bar gsungs te/ phur pa spu gri'i ti ka las liṅga'i sngags bkod pa kun la ci ran tsam bzla: zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang dha ri rnams gsum gyi sngags de yang spu gri'i sngags 'dus pa yin te/ drag sngags spu gri'i ti ka las/ dha ti rnam pa gsum po de yang spu gri'i sngags 'dir 'dus par bya'o zhes pa'i don ni/ de la spu gri'i sngags ring 'di ni ye shes lha dang srung ma thams cad 'dus par gsungs so/ der ma zad lha srin thams cad kyi sngags 'dus pa yin no/ yang na spu gri'i sngags 'di ni bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyi sngags chig chod yin pas gong gi sngags bcu drug pa de la bsnyen pa bskyel mi dgos par dang po rang gi chig chod 'di nyid rang la bya'o/ zhes gsungs de la spu gri'i sngags ni rtsa ba 'dus pa drag po'i sngags kyi rtsa ba las kī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa'i gsham bur/ ma ma rag+mo yag+mo kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog la yaṃ yaṃ: snying la phril phril: srog la chuṃ chuṃ: tsit+ta srog la tuṃ tuṃ: snying khrag shad dzaḥ

dza yig 'di dkyus ma la ma bshad kyang sde brgyad srung bzlog tu bshad pas byung na legs/ thuṃ ri li li: snying tseg tseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: gul gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha ti ma ma karma shi kraṃ ka ra ya ma ra sa ni pra ma dha ne ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgyad cu rtsa bdun drag sngags 'di: bsgrubs nas las su rung ba'i dus: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rtags rnams 'byung : myur du mngon du 'byung ba yin: zhes dang*/ de'i sngags 'grel yang de nyid las/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i sngags kyi 'grel pa bshad na: oṃ ni rdo rje gzhon nu: badz+ra 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: kī li khro bo bcu: kī lā khro mo bcu: ya sras mchog lnga: sarba thams cad 'dus pa: big+nan dgra bgegs gnon pa: baṃ lcags sgrog gis bcings pa: hūm̐ thugs kyi snying po: phaṭ sprul pa 'gyed pa: ma rag+mo bdag nyid ma bzhi: yag+mo bswe'i lha mo bzhi: ka la ru pa shwa na ma bzhi: snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ bse'i skyes bu bzhi: srog la yaṃ yaṃ bshan pa lag ring : snying la phril phril srog len chen mo: srog la chum chum dgra srog la: tsit+ta srog la tuṃ tuṃ srog bdag: snying khrag shad las mkhan: thuṃ ri li li dgra bo'i gzugs: snying rtsig rtseg 'ur 'ur dgra dang 'od: shig shig gul gul gzas pa po: myags myag sod sod dgra bo: dha ti ma ma nag mo'i tshogs: karma shi kraṃ ka ra ya bse'i lha mo'i tshogs: ma ra sa ni shwa na'i tshogs: pra ma dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ rgyal po dang btsan no: zhes dang*/ spu gri'i gsang rgyud las/ rtsa thung gsang ba'i yang snying 'di: drag sngags srog gi bshan pa yin: sreg par byed pa'i me dpung ste: gnon par byed pa'i ri rab 'dra: gsal bar byed pa'i ti ka'o: zhes gsungs/ yig 'bru grangs mthun min ci rigs snang yang spu gri'i rgyud las/ kī la ya 'bru bcu bdun pa'i sham bu can du gsungs pa dang man ngag rtsa thung gi sngags 'grel du dzaḥdangos grub 'gugs pa:

hūm̐ dngos grub bsdud pa: a dngos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa: zhes gsungs pas yig 'bru bcu bdun pa'i sham bur btags pa 'thad do/ de ltar dha ri rnam gsum 'dus pa'i spu gri'i drag sngags bzla ba'i skabs kyi ting 'dzin ji ltar bya ba ni/ gter gzhung phur pa drag po'i bzlas pa'i dgongs don bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa 'di ltar bya ste/ rang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi nga rgyal brtan pos mdun gyi 'brub khung du dgugs stim byas pa'i dgra bgegs rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i ngang nas dam can rnams phung gis byung*/ sgrol ba'i las la zhugs bdag rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i phyag gis phur pa 'dril bas phur bu las phur chung dpag tu med pa 'phros dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan de'i spyi bo nas zhugs rkang mthil gyi rtsar bton te lus bsgral/ lce steng nas zhugs ti lkog mar btaun ngag bsgral/ snying gar btab ste yid bsgral/ phur pa'i rtse mo mgar gyi sol mal nas bton ma thag tu des dgra bgegs kyi lus la rigs drug gi sa bon gnas pa bsregs kun gzhi'i rnam shes byi'u ka lan+ta ka'i mgo bo tsam zhig 'dug pa de yang bsregs rnam shes phur bu'i khong seng la yar drangs te phur pa'i rgya mdud 'og ma la khro mo bcu gong ma la khro bo bcu rtsib gzhogs la phra thabs nyi shu gnas pa'i phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas spar te tshe lhag gi nṛ ljang khu de phur pa'i rtse la blangs te lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rang la thim par bsams pa'i dmigs pa 'di ga yang yang bskyar zhing sngags bzla'o/ thun bzhi'i rjes su liṅgar thun brdeg pa'i skabs skam thun rnams mtshon cha dang rlon thun rnams dug dang nad kyi rlangs pa 'phro bar bsam dgos te/ gter gzhung nag po dug gi spu gri las/ dug khrag mtshon cha bu yug 'thib: srog la me 'bar 'tshigs nas kyang : thal ba bzhin du gyur par bsam:

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir thun brdeg pa'i dus ni gter gzhung de nyid las/ grib so byung dang skya rengs la: drag tu bskul zhing thun gyis brab: ces dang*/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i drag sngags thun: stag skya kha rlangs 'don dus brdeg: ces tho rengs dang*/ dam can rnam gsum dril ba'i thun: srin po lto la rub dus brdeg: ces dgongs kyi grib so byung dus brdeg par gsungs zhing*/ de ltar las sbyor gyi sngags dha ri rnam pa gsum sgrol ba'i drag sngags phur pa che mchog gi rgyud don ltar na 'bum phrag gcig tu bzla bar gsungs pa dang*/ che mchog gi rgyud las dha ri chung ba stong phrag gsum du bzla bar bshad pa dang*/ spu gri'i rgyud las kyang de ltar bshad pas phyag bzhes su spu gri'i sngags ring 'di stong phrag gsum du bzla dgos shing grangs de bzhin dang rtags kyang spu gri'i gsang rgyud las/ 'gor dang lings byas sems can bsad: grong khyer me yis bcom pa dang : ha ha gad mo 'debs gyur na: nges par sgrol ba'i rtags yin pas: liṅga dum bu gsum du bgos: cha gcig dug shing me la bsregs: cha gcig gtor stegs 'og tu mnan: cha gcig klu la gtad par bya: zhes gsungs pa'i 'gor zhes pa lings byas pa'i skad yin pas deng sang bstod pa rnams kyang lings byed pa la 'gor zer bar snang*/ gzhan yang khug rtags dang bsad rtags sogs drag sngags spyi dang gter kha 'di ga'i phur pa srog gi spu gri sogs las shes par bya'o/ rtags rdzogs pa'am grangs stong phrag gsum song nas las sbyor gyi gdab las bya ba ni las gzhung gyer zhing tshogs tha ma'i gdab las kyi dus su 'brub khung nas liṅga bton pa lcags lhang du bzhag cing zan ling zhig kyang de'i lte bar bkod/ mgyogs phur dang gdab phur gong gi skam thun dang rlon thun dug khrag sbyar ba'i gri gug tho ba hom gzar sogs kyang dgos/ rig 'dzin dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can bskul ba gser skyems gzu dpang bden bdar sogs gong ltar la khyad par 'gugs 'dren yid ches pa gsum tsam byos/

hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : zhes sogs kyi drag po'i phrin las nan tan gyi bskul ba nas rlon thun brdeg pa'i sngags 'jug ta tha ya ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭ kyi bar snying po rang gsal ltar byas na 'jug pa bde/ sras mchog gi phur pa lag tu bzung ste bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: sku stod khro bo chen po la: zhes sogs nas mā ra ya rbad: ces pa'i bar brjod: skabs 'dir tshe lung khrus lung bya dgos pa'i dang po khrus lung ni/ rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo lnga rigs lnga yab lnga dang*/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga rigs kyi yum lngar gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas sras mchog phur pa stod khro bo la smad phur pa'i dbal las me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bar bsam la lag gnyis thal sbyar thabs shes kyi rang bzhin nyi zlas mtshan pa'i bar du phur pa 'dril zhing*/ dam tshig chen po saugs bab brgyad kyi bskul btang*/ de yang 'bum nag las/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas mthar dbyung ba la bzhi ste/ gzas pa po'i khrus lung*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe lung ngo*/ dang po kho'i khrus lung la gsum ste/ gsal ba rnam pa gsum/ ldog sdug 'byams gsum/ dgongs pa rnam pa gsum mo/ zhes gsungs pa'i don bsdus te bshad na khrus lung gi gsal ba gsum ni/ bdag rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba/ phur pa sras mchog tu gsal ba/ gzas pa po dngos su gsal ba yin pas de'i dgongs don gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ ldog sdug 'byams gsum ni/ bdag lhar ma gsal na ldog /phur pa sras mchog tu ma gsal na sdug /gzas pa po dngos su ma gsal na 'byams 'gro ba dang gsum mo/ de la dgongs pa gsum ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge a dkar po re gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad a dkar po bya dkar po gdangs la bsgrig pa lta bu'i rnam par gyur te byon nas dkyil 'khor gsum la thim par bsam pa ni/

dang po a dkar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa des bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs te bde stong gi ngang du gsal ba ni bdag rnal 'byor pa'i khrus lung*/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gnas gsum gyi a dkar las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod pas sems can kyi don byas 'od zer tshur 'dus dgra bgegs kyi gnas gsum du thim pas kho bo'i sdig sgrib dag nas bsgral ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur ba ni dgra'i khrus lung*/ dkyil 'khor gsum ni gong du rgyas par bshad pa ltar ro/ de ltar bdag dang phur pa gzas po dgra bgegs gsum dgongs pa gcig gis 'brel/ dam tshig gcig gis 'brel/ chos nyid gcig gi 'brel bas gnyis pa thugs rje'i 'brel thag gi dgongs pa/ de yang*/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: zhes spyir sems can thams cad dang khyad par bsgral zhing gi dgra bgegs gang yin pa de snying rje chen pos rtsis zin pas 'khor bar mi gtong ba ni gsum pa gdung ba lu gu rgyud kyi dgongs pa ste dgongs pa rnam pa gsum mo/ 'bum nag las/ sngags bzlas shing yun bsring ngo*/ zhes gsungs pas dmigs pa ma yengs par rgyun bsring la sngags ni/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ staṃ bha naṃ mo haṃ gha ra ya ga wan hrī tri bi tri badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+naṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ a phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags brjod cing dmigs pa gsal btab bo/ 'di la bdag rnal 'byor pa'i khrus lung*/ khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung*/ gzas pa po'i khrus lung ste gsum du grags so/ gnyis pa tshe lung ni 'bum nag las/ gnyis pa tshe lung la gsum ste dang po byung tshor gyi sgo bkag pa/ gnyis pa sems kyi spyis dbyung ba/ gsum pa kun gzhi rtsad nas gcad pa'o/ zhes dang*/ de la yang nang gses mang du yod kyang dgongs don mdor bsdus te srid pa'i gter khyim dang*/

bla ma'i man ngag sogs sbyar nas bshad na liṅga'i snying khar srog gi ngo bo che bal rgya 'dra ba khrag sbal byi'u len pa'i mgo bo tsam gyi nang du kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge a dkar po 'di dbus su thig le 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dkyil na yi ge dud kha yod par bsam mo/ nṛ yig 'di na ra btags gi gu phyir log tu bris bsgom gnyis kar dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mig sgor mos zhe sdang sbrul mtshon zhing ra btags bya pho gdangs la 'dzegs pa 'dra bas 'dod chags bya dang*/ gi gu phyir log phag rna 'dra bas gti mug phag ste dug gsum gyi rang bzhin mtshon no/ de ltar gsal ba la dmigs nas snying khar phur pa 'debs shing*/ dha ri gsum 'dus spu gri'i drag sngags ring mo ka la ru pa'i mtshams su dgra bgegs spyi sgos gang yin gyi ming spel bcug pa bzlas te btab pas phur pa'i rtse mo tshe srog gi ngo bo bal rgya 'dra ba de dbral nas mar me la phu btab pa ltar bsad nṛ thig le a dang bcas pa bdag gi snying gar thim pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam pa ni bdag rnal 'byor pa'i tshe lung*/ phur pa che mchog gi phrin las gzhung las/ drag po'i stang stabs byas te phur pa gdab: dkar nag mtshams na yid kyi rnam shes rten: tshe bzung bal rgya lta bu dbral cing bsgral: rnam shes na bun rlung gis gtor ba bzhin: nyon mongs yid kyi rten gnas khrag gi mtsho: byi'u ka lan+ta'i mgo tsam gnas pa de'i: rdo tshan rtsa bur mi chags bzhin du btang : ngan song rigs drug sa bon drug po bsreg: kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i rten byed pa'i: 'od zer nya mig tsam zhig 'ub kyi 'dus: phur pa'i rtse la blangs te bdag la bstim: zhes gsungs pa dang dgongs pa mthun/ phur pa'i dbal nas bzung ste rang gi klad la lan gsum bskor te snang srid thams cad phur pas gang zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam ste kī la ya brgya rtsa brjod/

bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod pa dang bcas pa 'phros snang srid thams cad phur pas gang ba la phog mchod pa phul bas mnyes te sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bdag la thim par bsam/ de nas hūm̐ drag po lan gsum brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer ba thag lta bu'i sne la dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes kyi ngo bo a dkar po de bskyon nas 'og min du 'phros/ phaṭ drag po gsum brjod pa'i rkyen gyis kho'i rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su 'phangs pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sras su skye bar bsam mo/ de ni bdag gso ba phur pa gso ba gzas pa gso ba zhes pa'i don yin no/ 'bum nag las/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pa ma shes na ngan sngags dang khyad med gnas spar ba'i cho ga ma shes na gshan pa dang khyad ces slob dpon pad+mas gsungs pa'i don med do/ zhes gsungs pas tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa rnam par dag pa 'di la brten nas sngags pa phur 'og nas sangs rgya ba zhes don la gnas so/ gong gi spu gri'i sngags ring 'dren dus kyi dmigs pa de yang bya zhing bsdu na tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa rgyas pa de ma 'grub na des kyang 'thus par sems so/ des dgra bgegs bsgral zin kyang slar 'khor ba la mi ldog pa'i phyir khro bo bcu'i phur pa lus la 'debs shing thun rdzas rnams kyang brdegs dgos pas khro bcu'i phur pa dkyil 'khor rang nas blangs te 'debs pa'o/ mi bde na sras mchog rang la khro bcu tshang bas gnas so sor btab pas 'thus shing*/ 'debs tshul ni gter kha 'di ga'i sde brgyad srung bzlog gi gzhung las/ spyi bor rgyob cig hūm̐ ka ra: dpral bar rgyob cig rnam par rgyal: kha la rgyob cig rta mchog dpal: snying khar rgyob cig bdud rtsi 'khyil: lte bar rgyob cig gshin rje gshed: gsang bar rgyob cig stobs po che:

lag g.yas rgyob cing khams gsum rgyal: lag g.yon rgyob cig dbyug sngon can: rkang g.yas rgyob cig gzhan mi thub: rkang g.yon rgyob gcig mi g.yo mgon: khyad par rgyob cig phra men tshogs: zhes gsungs pa ltar so so'i rang sngags brjod cing gnas de rnams su 'debs/ khro bo bcu re re la yang phra phyag dang bcas pas na/ khyab par rgyob cig phra men tshogs: zhes gsungs pa yin no/ 'bum nag tu gdab tshul mi 'dra ba dang phur pa yang mang du gsungs mod kyi don 'dir 'dus so/ phur pa btab zin nas phur shul thun rdzas kyis brab bo/ tshe khrus bka' gter gyi dgongs pa mdor bsdus pa gter kha 'di ga'i phur pa srog gi spu gri las/ de yang 'debs pa'i gnas lnga yod pa las mgo bo dang rkang lag bzhi ste lnga ru bstanakyang lus sems 'brel ba'i rten snying kho na yin pas gdab bo/ phur pa byin gyis brlab pa'i 'od zer dang bcas pa btab pa'i sems nyon mongs pa can gyi yid phyir bltas de bsgyur bar dka' zhing bdag tu 'dzin pa de dang nang du bltas shing rten byed pa dngos sam bdag 'dzin gyi kha bsgyur ba yi ge nṛ'i rang bzhin du grub pa gcig snying dkar nag gi mtshams na gnas shing khrag rgyu ba zhig yod pas gdab bo/ nṛ de 'od kyi tshul gyis phur pa la 'dus par 'od zer a zhes pas bdag la bstim pa ni kho bo'i tshe srog dbrog pa'o/ de yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nṛ 'od du zhu ba de thim pas bdag bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par bsam/ khong stong khog 'gyel ba ltar song ba ni dgra bsad pa zhes bya'o/ de nas gso ba'i cho ga dgos te kho ma shi'i bar byar mi rung ngo*/ shi ba dang bdag gi thugs kar kho'i rnam par shes pa nṛ'od dang bcas pa thim/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ slar lhar phru gu ltar bskyed pa ni gso ba'o/ de'i dus kun gzhi dran pa med de gsal stong du lhang nge gnas pas kun gzhi rtsad bcad pa zhes bya ba sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa 'dzin pa can de dag pas sems kyi spyi dbyung ba zhes bya skye ba'i sgo rang bzhin gyis dag pa yin no/

zhes gsungs pa sogs dgongs don mtha' dag gcig tu shes dgos pa gnad yin no/ gdab kha lnga pa rdul du rlog pa rang gi ngo bo la don drug gi dang po bab brgyad kyi pho nya btang*/ gnyis pa/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog /ces pa'i 'phyong dang snying po rab gsal gyi gdab kha'i 'phros/ hūm̐: brdung shig rdo rje 'bar bas brdungs: zhes pa nas/ phaṭ gsum gyi bar brjod/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ da dha ya da dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni/ tho ba dang hom gzar spyir bshad kyang*/ 'bum nag las/ rdzas mi'i rje ngar chu ba rang 'khrung rdo rje/ rdo rje'i tho ba mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis smin phrag nas brdung ngo*/ zhes gsungs/ gter kha rnams las gru sogs dpyi mig ces gsungs pas mi'am dud 'gro gang yang rung ba'i dpyi mig dang gru sogs las tho ba dang gtun khung bya bar bshad cing gzhan dur khrod shing gi tho ba gtun kyang bshad pas gang 'byor gyis bya/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ rdo rje ri rab kyi tho bas rdul du brlag par bsam mo/ drug pa dmod pa ni/ dgra bo 'di rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig ces brjod/ skabs 'dir gri gug gam sgrol gris liṅga dum bur gtub pa thod pa lta bur blugs par bdud rtsi bran/ gdab kha drug pa zhal du btab pa la yang don drug gi dang po pho nya ni bab brgyad kyi bskul/ gnyis pa 'phyong ni tshogs tha ma'i zhal btab gter gzhung ltar na/ hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes zhig: ces sogs dang*/ rdo rje pha lam ltar na/ dpal chen 'khor bcas gnam sa lta bu zhal/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra yak+sha kro ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pa'i 'phyong dang*/ gsum pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ bhin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces pa bdun tsam bzla/ bzhi pa rdzas ni/ ling ro bdud rtsi bran pa de zhal du 'debs tshul bya'o/ lnga pa ting 'dzin ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa thams cad dgyes bzhin du gsol bar bsam/ drug pa dmod pa ni/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag lhag ma med par rol cig ces pa'o/ de ltar liṅga'i mgo bo logs shig tu bzhag cing gzhan rnams gtor ma dang gnam phud dang lhag ma bsags pa sogs thams cad la sbran cing sman raka kyang bran no/ des gdab kha drug tshar ro/ dmigs gsal yod na gsang rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar liṅga cha gsum du bgos pa'i cha gcig la sbyin bsreg /cha gnyis po de cha gcig gtor stegs 'og tu mnan pa dang*/ cha gcig rlon gtad bya bar gsungs kyang spyir mnan pa'i rigs 'di dgos pa chung zhing*/ khyad par rlon gtad nyen che zhing man ngag zur pa mang du dgos pas mi bya/ mnan pa skam gtad byed na shog ling de mnan rtsis byas te mnan thod du 'jug cing mnon pa sogs kiṅka lta bu'i rgyas bkab nas byed/ de ltar na shog ling snying po rab gsal ltar bris pa zhig thog ma nas tshags su tshud par byas nas gdab kha'i shog ling dang mnyam du gdab kha drug sogs byed/ mnan pa mi byed na gdab kha'i liṅga de sbyin sreg tu 'debs/ gdab kha tshar nas mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyi dod tsam zhig bya dgos pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul chog khrigs snying po rab gsal du bris yod pa ltar byas pas 'thus/ mnan pa'i dod bro brdung gis 'thus shing*/ de'i skabs su gong gi gdab kha byas pa'i liṅga'i mgo bo bzhag pa de gtor gzhong kha sbub pa'i 'og tu mnan dgos te/ 'bum nag las/ liṅga de'i mgo bo la mnan pa bya/ ro stod la sbyin sreg bya/ yan lag gtun khang du brdungs nang khro lha'i zhal du btab pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ rjes kyi gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba'i rim pa ni/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang lnga pa'i gsung dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar las/

rdzas bshams pa/ bgegs bskrad pa/ dngos grub bsdu ba'i bzlas pa/ lha gnad la dbab pa/ gtor tshogs kyi mchod pa bya zhing dngos grub bsdu zhing bstim pa dang drug tu bshad pa ltar bya/ 'on kyang phyag bzhes 'di bka' brgyad bde 'dus ltar snang bas rung zhing legs kyang*/ gu ru pad+ma'i bka' las/ dbang dang cho ga kha skong sogs/ /rgyas par 'dod na rigs mthun pa'i/ /rgyud dang man ngag gzhan las blang*/ zhes gsungs pas rigs mthun gyi dbang du byas te/ chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter phur pa spu gri las blangs pa snying po rab gsal du nag 'gros su bris yod pa ltar 'jug pa bde bas de ltar bya/ shin tu rgyas par 'dod na phur pa'i 'grel chen 'bum nag gi dngos grub blang ba'i lugs ltar byas kyang legs so/ de ltar dngos grub blangs zin nas rjes chog dang mtshams grol tshul rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsung bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba las/ mtshams grol rgyu'i zhogs pa las byang rgyas pa tshogs mchod dang bcas pa 'bul zhes pa nas bsnyen sgrub kyi dam tshig la gnas pa shin tu gces so/ zhes pa'i bar rtogs sla bas de kho na ltar bya zhing de'i don bsdu snying po rab gsal las/ bzhi pa rjes chog gi rim pa ni/ zhes pa nas gnas srung gi cho ga'ang zhag gsum tsam mam ci rigs rjes su dpag go zhes pa'i bar mthar chags su bris yod pa ltar bya'o/ skabs 'dir bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang lnga pa'i gsung phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar ltar bya la/ de yang gzhung de nyid las bsnyen pa kha skong gi sgos chos sngags gcig rdzas gcig la chig sgril du bya ba'i tshul gyi mtshon te las gang sgrub kyang de ga gtsor 'don gyi gnad 'gag zhal las shes dgos so/ zhes gsungs pa'i don gtso bor rdzas rnams phul ba'i rjes sngags kī la ya rdzas til kho na 'bul/

de yang bsnyen chen ltar na sa ya drug 'bum kha bskong rdzas sngags gnyis khri tsho dang gcig stong drug dgos pa 'grub dka' bas sgrub sngags bye ba gsum gyi kha skong khro tsho sum cu dgos par sngags yig 'bru bcu bdun pa dang rdzas til kho nar gsog dgos so/ las gang sgrub kyang de ga gtsor 'don/ zhes gsungs pa dper na bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong min pa'i tshe 'dod na sngags a yu ṣe dang rdzas dur wa lta bu yin no/ de ltar bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir yi dam gyi lha gang sgrub kyang byin rlabs che mod 'on kyang rdo rje phur pa 'di bar gcod 'dul ba la ched kyis bsngags shing gu ru pad+mas yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar gcod kyi rnam pa byung bas/ rdo gdan na rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba ltar phur pa'i glegs bam 'debs pa tsam gyis bar gcod kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul phur pa bka' gter gyi lo rgyu rnams su gsal ba dang*/ khyad par sgrub skor 'di ga'i drag sngags kyi lo rgyus las/ rdo rje khros pa spu gri'i sgrub pa ni/ rdo rje phur pa rig pa mchog gi rgyud bi to ta ma la phur pa'i yang snying ste rdo rje phur pa thams cad kyi yang snying gsang ba drag sngags su bsdebs pa 'di kho na'o/ zab pa'o/ de'i phyir rtsa ba spu grir 'brel ba mtshan che la dngos grub myur ba bkra shis dam can 'dus pa'i spog chog mi dgos par thebs pa'o/ tshur mi ldog 'khrugs pa sdebs pas shes sla/ dngos grub myur de'i phyir pad+ma'i gong khug ma zhes bya bar grags so/ zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ nor phyugs dang chos kyi bar gcod byed pa thams cad bdud kyi bar gcod yin pas bar gcod 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag par med pas rdo rje phur pa yi dam du gyur na rab/ yi dam gzhan yod na yang rdo rje phur pa srung ma'i tshul du bsgrub ste srung ma ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis ka yin pas so/

yi dam gang sgrub rung dang theg pa chen po'i chos gang sgrub kyang bar gcod thams cad rdo rje phur pas srung bar 'gyur te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ phyag na rdo rjes dang po bya chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i dus su theg pa chen po skyong mdzad kyi srung mar zhal gyis bzhes pas sgrub pa po thams cad kyi lus dang grib ma ltar grogs nas srung zhing skyabs pas de'i phyir bskul ba tsam gyi phrin las mdzad nges pa la srung ma ltar bsnyen sgrub bskul bas bar gcod thul nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ zhes dang gzhan yang dga' rab dbang phyug khyo shug blon po bzhi dang bcas pa'i gnyen por rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sgrub rgyal chen bzhir mchod gtor phul bas blon po bzhi'i bar gcod thul ba sogs byang gter gyi gzhung rnams las legs par bshad pas spro ba dang bcas te nyams su len pa gces so/ rdo rje phur pa yi dam du brten pas byang gter sogs bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams la legs par thos bsam bsgom pas dpyad na gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa'i nges shes skyed cing spro ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro zhes gdams so/ gu ru pad+ma'i khyad chos gong khug ma'i/ lam srol bka' gter rgya mtsho ches mang yang*/ /snying por gyur pa lha brag zab gter lugs/ /nor bu mching bu'i khrod na bsam 'phel bzhin/ /'on te gab dkrugs sbas pa'i man ngag rnams/ /'thor ba nyams su len pa dka' mod kyang*/ kho bo'i bla ma rgyal dbang mchog de yis/ /man ngag gab sbas med par lhug par gnang*/ /tshul bzhin nyams blangs yid ches gdeng thob pas/ /sngags 'chang rgyu skar dbus na zla ba bzhin/ bshad sgrub tshul la the tshom yongs bral bas/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsre bslad med par bkod/ /spyir yang mdo sngags bka' gter chos mang po/ /snang la ma nges zin bris mang po yis/

/tshong dus 'o ma bzhin du mang gyur bas/ /zab don 'khrul par 'gyur zhes gu ru'i gsungs/ /de phyir bsnyen yig yang yig bshad sgron sogs/ /legs par bshad kyang mgo rlung 'khrug pa'i rgyu/ /lhag par rgyal dbang mchog de'i rdo rje'i gsung*/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar de'i gsal byed/ kho bos snying po rab gsal bris pa las/ /gzhan du yig sna mang po dgos pa chung*/ /'di la dam can tshogs rnams bzod par mdzod/ /tshul 'di dge bshes blo gros phun tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnal 'byor mchog sgrub phyir/ /'di ltar gyis zhes nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /bya bral rgan pos mi mthong bzhin du bris/ /lcags yos snron zla'i dbang phyogs nyer bzhi la/ /phur bu tha skar me rlung 'khrug pa yi/ /'phrod sbyor bzang por rang gnas thub bstan gyi/ /kun bzang yangs rtser bris pa'i dge ba des/ /bdag gzhan lam gyi bar du gcod pa kun/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nus tshar bcad nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub yid bzhin gter/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang thob par shog /thub bstan spyi dang snga 'gyur ring lugs mchog /lha brag thugs gter bstan pa rin po che/ /bshad sgrub dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel ba dang*/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas smin grol shog /bkra shis theg mchog chos kyi rnga bo che/ /dad pa'i dbyug gus bskul ba'i sgra snyan pos/ /yongs su khyab te skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs/ /legs bsdus smin grol 'bras bu thob gyur cig /de ltar byang gter phur pa spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kha phral ba'i lhan thab yang yig 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di yang dge bshes blo gros phun tshogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mtshams khang du phur pa'i bsnyen chen skabs nan tan gyis bskul ba ltar dge slong bya bral ba pad+ma phrin las kyis rang lo don gcig tu sleb cing mig kyang mi gsal ba bcas dka' tshegs che bar byung yang bstan par bsam ste 'bad nas bris pa las sbyor gyi zhib cha mtha' dag lhug par bkod pas dam med kyi lag tu shor na bka' srung dam can rnams kyis snying khrag dga' ston du rol cig

/lam sgrub pa rnams kyi bar gcod zhi zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig ces sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong pad+ma phan bdes bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// //

sngon 'das pa'i dus dpag tu med pa na bskal pa kun tu dga' bya bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i gsang ba'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi lta ba ma rtogs par/ sbas pa'i gsang ba sbyor sgrol brlang por spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bskal pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lha sngags rang rgyud du bzlas sgom byas pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yi dwags srin po chen po'i gzugs su bskal pa brgyad du skyes nas gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun man chad dbang du byas shing gdug pa can mtha' dag bran du bkol bas dpal chen pos bsgral 'os kyi skal ldan du gyur pa dang*/ gsum pa btags pa ming gi ru tra ni gzhir gnas rang byung gi ye shes rang ngo ma rig pas khams gsum du 'khyams pa'i dug gsum gyi rang gzugs mtshan rtog gis bcings pa'i gdug can 'byung po'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams bsgral bya ru tra'i mtshan nyid do/ dbyings ye gnyis med du rtogs pa ni/ srid zhi'i spyi dpal chen po khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dgongs pa tshad du 'khrol ba'i ye shes klong dgu mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i khyab bdag tu bzhengs pa dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka yab yum sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams sgrol byed yin la/ de yang dpa' bo chen po de rnams kyis sngon gyi dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad tshad med pa'i thugs rje skyes te mi gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po'i phrin las drag po'i mngon spyod kyis/ ru tra gdug pa can 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral zhing gnas spar te chos skyong ba'i ma hā kā lar dbang bskur/ ma 'ongs par thal bas khebs pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang por 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/

de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i pho thams cad thugs rje'i thabs kyis bsgral zhing bstan pa srung ba'i las bsgos/ slas kyi 'khor bdud kyi bu mo myos byed ma sogs ma chags thabs kyi sbyor bas yid 'phrog ste gnas yul sgo ma dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs su sprul te bran du byas/ ru tra'i phung po 'dzam gling du bor bas yul chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dur khrod chen po brgyad du byin brlabs/ de dag rnams su rang byung gi ma mo mchod rten zhing skyong klu dang sprin legs pas brgyan zhing skal ldan la nyams rtogs spel ba/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs te ru tra'i 'dod chags bzhi la dgongs pa'i rgyud sde bzhi/ rnam shes brgyad la dgongs pa'i sgrub chen bka' brgyad/ nyon mongs lnga la dgongs pa'i rigs lnga he ru kaḥ gdul bya rtsa ba'i dngos po smin pa'i phyir sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sprul nas khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang*/ ltas chen po bco lnga spros te sgrol byed cho 'phrul chen pos srid rtsa bcad de rdo rje theg pa'i skal ldan yongs su smin pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa ni sgrol ba'i tshul te de ltar sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar bzhin rjes 'jug gdul byas nyams len du sbyor dgos pa'i tshul/ shing rta chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ phyi nang gsang ba bsrung bya ste/ /srin po'i rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi brtag bslang sbyang bzung dang*/ phyi nang bar gyi mtshams bcad dang*/ nang mtshams ma traṃ bsgral ba'i las rim dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug pa dang*/ ma traṃ bsgral ba'i khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang sgrub na bkra shis pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi rgyal po rnams bsgral bas bgegs gzhan gyis bar chad mi nus shing dngos grub gnyis myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod pas rnal 'byor pa rnams pad+ma khrag 'thung rol pa'i lha yi gsal snang dang nga rgyal brtan pos ma traṃ bkug bsgral sogs gzhung chen po'i sgom don gsal 'debs bzhin pas cho ga'i bya ba la 'jug par zhu/

༈ sgrub pa po rnams gnas su bkod pa'i skabs/ da lam theg pa kun gyi yang rtse/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nying khu/ ngo bo gu ru rin po che'i thugs sgrub bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung zhes dmar nag khyung zhon gyi rnam par sgrub pas/ sku yi go cha la drag po lha lnga sogs dpal chen yongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor tshom bu tshogs sgrub bya ba yin la/ de yang sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas kyang*/ sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pa bral bya'i tshul du bsgribs pa nyid/ sbyong byed zhi khro dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang mthar thug gi theg pa gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dgongs pa rjes su 'brel bas gsang ba yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ rgyud don gsal ba'i sgrub chen la/ /bzhi ste phun sum tshogs gzhi bzung*/ /sta gon rim pas sgrom du gzhug /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrang ste/ /mtha' rgyas cho gas rjes bskyang ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung dgos pas/ de yang gzhung las/ drag po bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod dam mam rang byung phug: shing gcig drung ngam dben pa'i yul: bkra shis rgyud dang mthun pa'i sar: dmar smug sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor las rim gzhung bzhin gdab: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ༈ phyi yi gnas phun sum tshogs pa rang byung grub pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis dpal he ru ka'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs shing*/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dge ba'i gnas/ lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan du/ nang gi gnas phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pas gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa yin par shes pas dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lha'i rang bzhin du shes pa dang*/

gsang ba'i gnas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang na gnas kyang chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa dang*/ ༈ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob dpon lta ba gnyis su med pa'i gdeng dang ldan/ sgom pa bskyed rdzogs las su rung zhing spyod pa sa ma ya 'bum sde rnam par dag /dbang dang man ngag gi bka' bab/ theg pa rim dgu'i don thugs su chud/ ngang rgyud ring zhing phan sems che ba/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na zhes bya ba dang*/ ༈ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bde chen rgyud la bskyed pa'i gzungs ma lus ngag yid gsum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi gtso bo bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin/ byan pho byan mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon du song ba'i skal ba can/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog chung ba/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus che ba/ lhag par rgyal thebs rnams kyang dbang dang dam tshig ldan zhing thos bsam gyis rgyud dag pa/ de kho na nyid la blo sbyang ba sha stag lags pa dang*/ ༈ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ thog mtha' dbus med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las/ zla ba dgu pa la dpes mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du yum la drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs nas slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis babs pa dang*/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas bal yul yang le shod du thugs dam yang phur gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad de dus chen tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gza' skar sbyor byed sogs lta bu kha bsgyur/ dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ ༈ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'tsho ba zas/ nad zlog sman/ dgra zlog mtshon sogs phyi'i yo byad/ rten rdzas sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang gi rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na/ shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ pho brang nang rten thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dbus su bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : drag po'i sman rdzas rnams kyang blugs: dar dmar kha bcad dar nag gdugs: bum pa cha tshang tsa ka li: sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod: spyan gzigs la sogs tshang bar bshams: zhes gsungs so/ spros bcas rten sgrub pa'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra yal le/ snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /bdug spos gyi dri bzang ngad thul le/ rdo rje'i mched lcam spro dga' dang byin rlabs thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzungs ma kun tu bzang mo rnams yab kyi g.yon tu/ chos 'chad pa'i rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur ba'i bya ba byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyang phyogs bzhi/

phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje'i king ka ra rnams lho nub/ g.yo sgyu med par mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rnon rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ dus sbyor dbyug gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzem pa'i rdo rje byan pho byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa rnams shar lho/ mched lcam snod dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyang gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grus chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra ba mang zhing bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ zhe sdang che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ brjed nges che zhing bag zon chung ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ chang la dga' zhing gnyid che ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing bsgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te drug po rnam pa thams cad du spang zhing*/ rtogs pa che bas chos nyid dang mi phyed pa/ dad gus che bas bla ma dang mi phyed pa/ dam tshig che bas yi dam dang mi phyed pa/ brtse gdung che bas mched lcam dang mi phyed pa/ brtul zhugs che bas dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa/ sbyor sgrol brtson pas gzungs ma dang mi phyed pa/ snying rje che bas sems can dang mi phyed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas dngos grub dang mi phyed pa/ skyon dang bral bas 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa ste yon tan dgu po la rnam pa kun tu brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta:

sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab pa sogs bka' bsgo ba'i las rnams bde blag tu bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs 'dun dang ldan pas 'dis rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang?gsol dgyes par bzhugs: bar brjod/ ༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams kyis sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs dus na skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug cing 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas na/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod bdag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' ba'i rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru tra sde gsum bsgral bas tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru tra'i chung ma ma chags thabs kyis rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i bzhon pa glang po che btul ba glang chen gyi ko rlon/ gza' chen nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma btul ba stag gi sham thabs/ klu gdug pa can btul ba sbrul nag gi chun pa/

srin mo nyer bzhi btul ba thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pa zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda'i dag sbyor gyi don ni/ ye shes lnga po don dam spros bral gyi dbyings su gcig pas thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ thugs rje ci yang 'byung ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad pa'i glang ko /phyin ci log bzhi dang bral ba'i sbrul chun/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang tshad med bzhi lhun la rdzogs pa'i g.yang gzhi/ khams gsum rtog pa 'joms pa'i stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs pa'i me dpung*/ dug lnga dbang du sdud pa'i khrag chen gyi thig le/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blang ba zhag chen gyi zo ris/ skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug gsum sku gsum du rdzogs pa thod phreng tshar gsum/ stong pa nyid la bdud bzhi bskyod du med pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ rang rang gi rigs dang mthun par dpal chen po pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyems pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la dbang bskur/ gdug pa can zil gyis mnan/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa pad+ma he ru ka'i lha'i tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder?sku la rgyan du bzhes: bar brjod/ ༈ bsre bsnan gyi skabs su dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes/ slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pas/ 'o skal pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs ma yengs par snyan lhan ner gsan 'tshal/

de yang gsang sngags dbang gi mtha' can/ dbang dam tshig gi mtha' can zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thog mtha' bar gsum dam tshig la brten nas bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten te byung*/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung 'tshal te gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dbang srog dam tshig rjes su bzung*/ dbye na sa ya 'bum sde las/ bsdu na nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs la 'du/ /nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir mig 'bras lta bur bzung*/ /nyams na slar la bshags par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang sngon du nod cing dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pas grol byed kyi lam la 'jug dgos/ dam tshig ni srog gi dbang po dang mtshungs la/ lam gyi rim pa gzhan rnams dbang po yan lag gzhan dang mtshungs pas 'dir yang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa: dam tshig nyid la brten gyur kyang : zhes gsungs pas dam tshig kho na la gces spras su 'bad 'tshal/ dam tshig gi lha ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sems can kun gyi sems gang zhig /rdo rje zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /rdo rje stong pa nyid du gnas/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ zhes gzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig mi phyed pa de nyid lam du ma nyams par ston par byed pa dang*/ nyams na bshags pa'i yul du grub la/ 'bras bu'ang de'i go 'phang grub pa spyi dpal chen po zhi ba'i skur bstan pa las gnyis su med de/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/

dam las 'das na snying dbus rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros pas mi zad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra men ma bcu drug /spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis kyang legs nyes kyis stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/ dran pa dang shes bzhin pa'i bag yod par bsrung dgos shing*/ gang bsrung bar bya ba ni sa ma ya 'bum sde gsungs pa'ang thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba'i sku'i dam tshig tu slob dpon rnam ba bzhi khong pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rdo rje'i mched bzhi po lus dang mig ltar blta/ gsung gi dam tshig tu sngags kyi snying po lnga dang phyag brgya bzhi rgyun ma chad par nyams su len/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu spyi dang bar gsang gsang 'os gnyer du gtad pa'i gsang bcu sbas/ yan lag gi spyad bya/ mi spang ba/ dwang du blang ba/ shes bya/ bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga tshan lnga yal bar mi 'dor ba bsrung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gcig ltem rkyang med par lha chos mi chos bka' chos gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /'khor gsum byang chub sems kyi thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas bsrung mtshams bral ba'i ye bsrungs chen por rtogs pa lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag ldan pas dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur ro/ bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ spyir ni gsang sngags dam tshig ni/ /bsrung na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sa ma ya ni 'bum sde yod/ /ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo bzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/

/mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs/ lta ba mthar phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste 'tshig /so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung*/ dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ snying phyung na sman ci tsam btang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub legs pa ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lha rnams kyang rang gshed du dbab nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing*/ phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad thams cad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa'i rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar pa'i dus med par 'gyur la/ nyams pa'i rgyud kyang slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ /lung ma nos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bo 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal dang rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi zur za byed pa/ gtsang dme dang rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/ spyod pa thod rgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas/ srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams pa bsrung zhing*/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang rab kyis lta ba skye med kyi ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas 'chags shing phyin chad bsdoms te legs par bsrungs pa'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dra bar dgos 'dod 'byung*/

sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad skyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po sgrub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/ /rtogs pa mchog gis gong du 'phel/ zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ zhing gzhan bskal mang sdom la gnas pa bas/ /skad cig 'dir gnas 'bras bu rdzogs par byed/ ces gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing*/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po phra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom pa rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de yi 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems la 'dris pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyis snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma bsgrub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong 'dir/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad med zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/

/rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'bangs rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong ba dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlab 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bran bzhin khol bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan du bzung bar mdzod cig ༈ bzlas dmigs skabs su 'di ltar bshad par bya'o/ da lam/ mched lcam rnams bsnyen pa mi bcad par shub bur bzla bzhin du bsgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba la gsan 'tshal/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pas chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin/ rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi dang sgo drug la sogs pa'i dbye na du ma yod pa rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la 'dus te/ de'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las phyi ma yin la/ de la'ang bka' gter gyi bab so gnyis las nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod du phebs nas gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgyal srid dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ de mthun dam rdzas bcas gu ru la phul nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas dbang bskur bas so so'i me tog ji ltar phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal mthong zhing thun mong gi sprul bsgyur nyi zla gdan du bting ba brag la phur pa 'debs pa sogs/

sku tshe de nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pas thog drangs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ yer pa'i grub thob brgya rtsa/ shel brag gi sngags pa sum cu/ yang rdzong rtogs ldan nga lnga/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma nyer lnga sogs grub thob kyi tshang chen po brdol ba yin la/ de lta bu gu ru pad+ma dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i rnam 'phrul gter ston brgya rtsa bcas mang du byon pa/ so sor yang bka' dgongs phur gsum bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs mang du bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku yi skye ba bcu gsum pa pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi nang gses byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma sgrub pa yin la/ de la'ang zhi drag gnyis las/ bla ma drag po dmar nag khyung zhon zhes bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du sgrub pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub lhag par du che ba yin te/ gzhung las/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags 'dzin tsam: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yis rkyen byas stong khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya can: bla ma drag po sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i lam: tshig nyung don che myur zab snying gi byang : yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: mtshan skar mang yang nyin mo'i skar ma gcig: me tog mang yang u dum+ba ra gcig: sems can mang yang sa bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig: sgrub skor mang yang snying gi thig le gcig: zab rgya mang yang gnad kyi gzer bu gcig:

de phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma gtogs par: yang zab gcig dril 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu'i lha sngags la bsten pa skal ba re bzang snyam pas/ bla ma la mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs/ le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grus brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ nang a nu yo ga ltar shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen thams cad kyi rim pa rnams gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing*/ de gsum po re re la yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba gsum bskyed rdzogs gung shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ bsnyen sgrub brtson pa yongs kyi rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa'i sgo nas yul gsum rab tu gsal nas lha gyad du gyur pa'i sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus kyis phreng ba/ ngag gis snying po/ yid kyis lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas/ sngags dang sngags kyi gzhi/ gzungs dang gzungs kyi sgo/ rig pa dang rigs sngags kyi don shes pas 'phro 'du'i phreng ba dang bcas gsung gi sgrub lugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dgongs pa thig le nyag gcig ngang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin la ma yengs pa'i gnad med na 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sems sangs rgyas su shar bas lam la bgrod du med par shes/

snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu rang byung lhun rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang ba sna tshogs chos nyid du khyer shes/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang dgag sgrub rang sar grol ba'i gnad shes/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang la ye nas gnas pa'i don shes pa ste shes pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor 'bring rnams/ stong gsum lha'i gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung dang yangs dogs med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod du gsal bas mchod gtor la bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid thams cad rdzas su gsal bas srung ma dam can mi dgyes pa'am mi skong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal ba la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa rang sems su rdzogs pa ste/ gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las gyer la sgom med du bzung bas gsang sngags dam med lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs dang nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung zhing za 'dod dang brnab sems kyi 'bras bu'i dkor dang rnam smin gyi 'dam du chud/ 'bras bus 'jig rten rtag chad du bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar ltung ba ste sngags pa tha ma bzung ba lngas ma bcings ba ni gal che/ mdor na gsang sngags bla med la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das rang sems su thag chod pa/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ spyod pa brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du longs pa zhig dgos shing*/ de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su yang blos bcos nas bsgom pa ni dpe/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni don te/

sems nyid 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/ ngo bo stong nyid du khrig ger gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre ma dgos pa/ gdod nas tsan+dan dang dri/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pa/ ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni don/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha'i 'khor lor dag pa'i brda/ de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du phyed pa gzhi rtags te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs su rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes mngon sum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/ rgyud las/ don grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa gtso cher sngags bzla ba la'ang*/ bum dbang dang mthun par phyi rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun par nang lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun par gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun par de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun par nyams su len par gsungs shing*/ rtsol bcas kyi sngags la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral ba'i bzlas brjod byed pa ni rlung gi dper mdzad pas me dang bud shing 'dzoms par rlung gis bskul na lhag par 'bar ba bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang sngags bzla ba 'dzoms pas bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin zhing*/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal ka dang*/

khro dang 'thab dang shags dang 'jug 'dzin dang*/ /zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs/ /smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad/ /lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo/ zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon kyang de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam la sngags brjod na/ /'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi lce la smra 'gyur ba/ /de dbang bden pa thob par 'gyur/ zhes sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi choms/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs par/ snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/ ༈ sgrub pa grol skabs phan yon dang 'brel ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi spros bcas sgrub chen gyi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin tshang la bar chad med par mtha' rgyas su grub ste/ de yang spyir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying po gter gyi chos la dad pa thams cad/ gu ru nyid bod du phebs pa'i skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la dad pa kun: deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab: thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms: kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon: zhes gsungs pas gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin pa'ang gsungs te/

dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur bsti phu dud 'brel pa zhog: ces dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na: sgrub chen 'di yi ming tsam su gang 'dzin: o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres: zhes dang*/ pad+ma nga yi srog gi dwangs ma ste: dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog snying 'di kho na: dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub 'di ka zab: 'di 'chang o rgyan nga dang 'bral ba med: rig 'dzin brgyad 'dus dam can bran du khol: yang zab snying po mar gyi nying khu dang : dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa: thams cad thams cad ma lus 'dis 'grub ste: de la dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub yin: tshig tshogs mang bas mi zab don la 'di: o rgyan nga yis thugs bcud min re kan: zhes dang*/ yang gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*/ /nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ zhes gsungs pas na the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par bsgrubs na smos ci/ tha na glegs bam tsam dad pa'i rten du bzung yang*/ gsang ba'i rgyud chen sgrub yig gang sus 'dzin/ /de phyogs thams cad bde gshegs kun 'dus te/ /sha rul dag la sbrang ma ji bzhin no/ zhes gsungs la/ der ma zad yang dag /gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ phyag rdor/ rig 'dzin bla ma sogs re re'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor 'di la 'dus shing*/ de thams cad go cha'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs tshul yang*/ dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar:

gsang bar yak+sha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badz+ra kī la ya: phyag g.yon rat+na kī la ya: zhabs g.yas pad+ma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin yi dam sgrub sde brgyad sogs thams cad 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing bla ma yi dam kun 'dus 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam du bcad pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/ rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos sgrub gyur na/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pas kyang*/ /dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ /dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i phan yon 'byung ba mi bden sogs bsam mi rung ste/ 'di phyogs the tshom za ba'i mi gang su/ /tshe 'dir yid du mi 'ong kun 'dus nas/ /mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal te der 'gro bas/ /kun gyi thun mong ma yin gsang dam srungs/ zhes kyang gdams par mdzad cing*/ mdor na mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i thabs su lan gcig ma yin par rdo rje'i lung gis yang yang bsngags pa yin la/ phan yon de ldan gyi sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas slad nas kyang rdo rje rgyal po dang rgyal thebs/ gzungs ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad ma zhugs par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du blta dgos pa dang*/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel ba rnam kun 'du 'bral med pa srog gis bsdus pa'i lha'i tshom bu 'khod cing*/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi dge ba'i las chen po bsags pa'ang don yod par bgyi ba'i slad mar me'i smon lam bgyid pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/

de yang rdzong 'phrang las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /thig le chen po ma bcos lhun grub ngang*/ /skye 'gag med pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /ye shes mar me'i sdong rtsar shar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dngos po'i gzugs dang bral ba/ khyad chos drug ldan ye shes kyi 'od phung du 'bar zhing gzhon nu bum pa sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni mtshon bya don gyi mar me/ gzhi las gzhi snang du g.yos te/ lhun grub rang snang gi sgo nas shar lugs chen po brgyad kyis 'khor 'das sna tshogs su snang ba mtshon pa brda yi mar me/ 'di la dbye ba snang tshul snod kun gzhi'i kong bu ru/ bcud rnams shes kyi phung po'i sdong bu la/ gnas lugs chos dbyings ye shes kyi mar khus gtams nas rig pa rang gsal gyi sgron me sbar bas lam gzhi snang sku dang ye shes kyi 'od snang 'phro bas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod dbyings rig dbyer med kyi kong bur/ bcud gzugs phung ma dag gi sdong bu la/ me long ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te shes rab rang byung gi sgron me sbar bas lam chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang bas/ 'bras bu rnam snang gi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod ka ti shel gyi kong bu ru/ bcud tshor phung rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgron mes gtams te/ lam rgyang zhags 'od gsal gyi mar me sbar bas lam nyams snang gong 'phel gyis/ 'bras bu rin chen gyi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod 'ja' zer thig le'i kong bur/ bcud 'du shes rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ sor rtog ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te/ dag pa dbyings kyi sgron me sbar bas/ lam rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang bas/ 'bras bu gsung pad+ma'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod gzhon nu'i bum sku'i kong bur bcud 'du byed rnam dag gi sdong bu btsugs te/ bya grub ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te thig le stong pa'i sgron me sbar bas/

lam chos nyid zad pa'i snang bas/ 'bras bu las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam bskangs pas/ rgyu sku dang ye shes/ rkyen 'od dang kha dog /byed las sgron ma bzhir smin te 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su 'od gsal thig le chen po dang*/ spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ba ni mtshon byed rtags kyi mar me ste/ de dag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi dbang las snang gsal mar me 'di yis mtshon byed du byas/ ye shes chen po'i snang bas nyon mongs kyi mun khang bcom/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sgo rtsad nas bcad/ rdo rje khro rgyal rnams kyi zhal mthong*/ rang rgyud snang ba bzhi yi shul mtshon/ rig stong khyab brdal chen pos rgyab skyor/ rang grol spyod pa cog bzhag gis mtha' brten te bgrod par bya ba'i lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis dwangs srog thig le chen por srid pa gsum po yongs su dag pa 'od zer 'phrul bzhad kyi klong dam par bgrod nas chos thams cad bya rtsol gnyis med kyi klong du gdod nas skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur bral ba gzhi rdzogs lhun grub chen por gdeng chen thob/ dbugs chen 'byin/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa mdzad nas smon lam gyi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog sogs shis brjod rgyas par spel bas las mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /spros bcas tshogs sgrub chen po'i phyag bzhes kun/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag kho na'i don/ /mtshon byed stong thun snying po 'di tsam yang*/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i mdun sar gser ltar brim/ /de phyir gong ma'i gsung gi snang ba la/ /brten nas gsar spros tshig gi me tog 'dis/ /dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar 'bum 'jo bas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus mang zung 'jug mngon gyur shog /ces bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi /spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rab 'jigs khro bo rol pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang tshul 'dir mi 'phrog pa'i dad mos rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i 'brong smad bla ma karma lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/

'brong pa rdo shul du skyes pa'i sgrub bla gi li o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul zung nas 'di ltar dgos zhes nan bskul ngor/ gnam lcags bstan 'dzin ming pas rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dpal chen 'dus pa'i stong thun la gzhi byas nas 'phros don kha bsgyur bcas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu mo lug gi lo rgyal zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang snying po'i bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

༄༅/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ stong thun gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi klad 'gem rdo rje khros pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes yang dag thugs/ /srid gsum bdud bzhi dpung 'joms ku mā ra/ /dbyer med bla ma rang rig phur pa la/ mngon sum rang ngo mjal ba'i phyag bgyis nas/ dpal chen sgrub pa'i cha lag stong thun ni/ gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi klad pa 'gem mdzad pa/ rdo rje khros pa'i gad rgyangs 'dir sgrog bya/ de la thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog gi skabs slob dpon nam/ rgyal tshab pas zhwa chos bcas sgra dag cing brjid chags pa'i ngang 'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ kyai skal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las su rung zhing*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams legs par gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs pas gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje sdom pa chen po las mi 'da' bas na bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa chen po shākya seṅges kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis bstan pa'i bye brag ser skya'i khab tu rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma chen po 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chags chen rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'dod yon la dgyes dgur rol pa'i tshul gyis thabs kyi brtul zhugs mthar phyin par mdzad pas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir dzam+bu gling gi yul dbus rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i snga rol du mi bsrun pa'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyi g.yo sgyus brid pa la mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bo dang*/

pad+ma'i pho nya sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ stobs bcu'i nus stobs rdo rje'i khro bo mi g.yo ba'i dpung gis bdud dpung mi 'khrugs phrag gcig dpa' bkong bas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po mngon du bstan nas rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sde bsam mi khyab pa rdo rje'i rigs can gyi 'dus pa la bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa rang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar na brda don rtags gsum gyi ru tra bsgral ba ni gsang sngags bstan pa'i chu mgo brdol ba'i gleng gzhi ste/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru tra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang bsgral bya'i ru tra la rnam pa gsum/ lhan skyes don gyi ru tra/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra/ btags pa ming gi ru tra bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na/ /gzhi rtsa ngag dang lus sems so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum las/ dang po bdag rtog gzung 'dzin las skyes pa'i dug lnga'i ru tra chen po'i 'khor du nyon mongs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang bcas pas khams gsum gyi grong khyer la dbang byed par 'khrul pa'i tshang bcas te 'gro kun la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi zad pa bskyed de chos kyi bdag 'dzin ma traṃ ka ru tra sems can gyi lus la gnas/ gnyis pa tshogs brgyad gang zag gi bdag 'dzin kha traṃ ka ru tra sems la gnas/ gsum pa mi bden 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin a kar+ṣa ru tra sems can gyi ngag la gnas so/ gnyis pa mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa 'dul dka' ba rab tu dga' ba la 'jig rten gyi khams sbyang dka' ba zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi sgron mer gyur pas mtha' drug gi tshul gyis chos ston pa la/

log par rtog pa'i sems can zhig gis sbas pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs par gab pa'i gsang ba sgra ji bzhin du spyad pas las kyis/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba'i mthar 'jig rten bdag po lha dbang phyug yab yum gyi bu ma traṃ ru dra zhes bya ba shin tu 'jigs la gtum zhing ma rungs pa zhig tu skyes nas gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris gsum pa man chad dbang du bsdus nas khams gsum mtha' dag ngan 'gro'i las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ma bzod cing sngon rten cing 'brel ba'i stobs kyi bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs nas/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa dpal yang dag che mchog he ru ka rnam par bstan nas ru tra'i gnas su byon ste gnas gzhal yas khang du rlob/ yum 'khor rnams dbang du bsdus/ ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba'i sras rdo rje gzhon nu bskrun/ ru tra'i 'khor ma bdun sogs rang gnas su 'ong bas gzhal yas su gyur ba mthong bas skrag te rang gi snying po ru lu bzlas pa'i tshe na de dag dpal chen po nyid gyi sngags su byin gyis brlab nas bzlas pa'i ru tra'i 'khor kun dpal chen po'i 'khor du gyur nas ru tra gzi byin nyams pa na/ sras la ru tra bsgral cig pa'i lung bstsal ba'i ru tra nyid dang mtshungs pa'i sras zhal gsum phyag drug par sprul nas ru tra la 'thab pas khos ma thub nas/ ru tra mgo dgu lag pa bco brgyad par sprul pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par sprul nas 'thab bo/ mthar rdo rje gzhon nu dbu brgya phyag stong ldan pa'i 'bar ba chen po'i gzugs skur bzhengs nas rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas ma traṃ ru tra bsgral zhing gnas spar te chos skyong gi srung ma ma hā ka la legs ldan mgon por dbang bskur/ ma 'ongs thal bas kheb pa'i zhing du bcom ldan 'das thal ba'i dbang po rang 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/
