ru tra 'khor dang bcas pa btul ba'i skabs su ru tra'i snying khrag theb long tsam gnyis yal ba las ru tra'i sras/ dregs byed ma hā dā+e ba dang yum drag mo ral gcig ma zhes bya ba dang*/ drag mo srid pa 'khor byed ma zhes bya ba gnyis dang ldan te/ de gnyis las phyogs bcu dam sri chen po bcu byung ste/ steng phyogs su yab nyi ma 'bar gsal/ yum sgra 'byin ma/ bu nyi ma phag mgo can/ bu mo zla ba rmigs bu'i mgo can sogs nas/ bu mo byi la'am/ byi ba'i mgo can gyi bar byung ste khams gsum gyi srog la rngam pa'i ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs de dag gi gnyen por dpal chen rdo rje srin po yab yum gyis gang la 'dul thugs rje chen po'i cho 'phrul las rang shar ba'i tshul gyis mkha' gsang nas 'od kyi gong bu bcu steng 'og phyogs mtshams su spros pa las/ khro bo bcu yab yum phra thabs dang bcas pa phyogs bcur spros nas gdug pa'i dam sri bcu gdan du byas/ de'i tshe sems can sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*/ bdud bzhi rang sar zhi bar mdzad/ ru tra'i phung po 'dzam bu gling du bor ba la dur khrod chen po brgyad du gyur zhing srung ma kau ri ma sogs brgyad bzhag de yi khog pa gzhal yas khang*/ chas rnams ye shes kyi chas/ 'khor rnams srung mar dbang bskur bar mdzad pa ni/ sngon tshe dpal chen po'i ru tra btul ba'i tshul te da lta rnal 'byor lam dus su de dang rnam pa mtshungs par byas pa'i skal ldan rnams nyams rtogs spar/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa sogs/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len yin pas bsgral chog la 'jug pa 'di yang don dang ldan pa ste/ dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba dang*/ ma traṃ bsgral ba'i khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin brlabs pa'i nang du sgrub na bkra shis pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgral bas/

bdud bgegs gzhan gyis bar chad kyi mtshan ma rang sar zhi bar byed cing*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod la/ de yang dbang po rab kyis chos thams cad byang chub sems las gud na med cing bdag med phyogs bral rang byung gi ye shes yul sems gnyis med skye 'gag las 'das par rtogs pas/ gnyis snang la dgag sgrub blang dor med pa rang shar rang grol chos nyid rol pa 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba'am/ dbang po 'bring gis snang srid lha dang lha mor rig pa/ tha mas kyang dam rdzas chen po lnga yi rang bzhin du shes pa ni don chos nyid kyis 'dul ba zhes bya ba 'khrul ba rtsad chod pas bar chod kyi khung brdol ba ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ mthong dang rig dang shes dang sprad: 'di las 'da' bar ma gyur na: log par lta ba 'dul nus shing : sangs rgyas rnams dang nga nyid grub: ces gsungs pas de lta bu'i don mtshon pa'i phyir/ rtags cho gas 'dul ba la'ang*/ rgyud las/ shin tu khro zhing gtum pa la: zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te: shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo la: khro bo de bzhin gshegs sprul mdzad: khro bos tshul 'chang khros pas kyang*/ 'jig rten gsum rnams bsregs byed na: sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis: khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams dpal khrag 'thung rol pa'i lha sku phyag rgya'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal rab tu 'bar bas ma traṃ bkug cing bsgral te khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang du 'jug pa sogs gzhung las 'byung ba'i tshig gi bsgom don gsal 'debs bzhin pas cho ga'i bya ba la 'jug par zhu/ ༈ sgrub po rnams gnas su 'god pa'am/ mnga' gsol ba'i skabs/ da lam theg pa kun gyi yang rtse/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nying khu/ snga 'gyur tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad las/ gal po sogs 'jig rten nas mdo sogs yang dag thugs kyi rgyud dang bid+yot+ta ma la sogs phrin las phur pa'i rgyud zung du 'brel ba'i yang phur ga'u dmar nag gi tshoms bu tshogs sgrub chen mo la/

mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha yi lung las/ lha zhes bya ba byang chub sems/ /de ni rgyud du rab tu brjod/ /tha snyad tsam du phye ba na/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du brjod/ ces sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid du gnas kyang sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pas bral bya'i tshul du sgrib pa nyid/ sbyong byed dpal yang dag rdo rje phur bus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang dgos pa rjes su 'brel bas phun sum tshogs pa bzhi'am lnga sogs bshad srol mang yang/ phyi ma ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba la/ de yang*/ ༈ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis dpal he ru ka'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dag pa'i gnas lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan phyi yi gnas dang*/ phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pa gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin pa la yin par shes pa nang gi gnas dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid kyi de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pas gang na gnas kyang chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa gsang ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag tshang*/ ༈ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ yang dag gsang 'grel las/ rgyal po sgom shes pa/ rgyal thebs 'chad shes pa/ karma las shes pa/ ging sgrol shes pa zhes shes pa bzhi ldan du gsungs pa bzhin/ rdo rje slob dpon lta ba gnyis med gyi gdeng ldan/ sgom pa bskyed rdzogs las rung*/ spyod pa dam tshig rnam dag /dbang lung man ngag gi bka' bab/ theg dgu'i rgyud don rtogs pa/ ngang ring phan sems che ba/

tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dpung du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ ༈ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bde chen rgyud las skyed pa'i 'khor gzung ma lus ngag yid gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs kyi gtso bo bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin byan pho mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon song gi skal pa can/ nga rgyal phrag dog chung ba/ dad pa brtson 'grus che ba/ lhag par rgyal thebs rnams kyang dbang dang dam tshig ldan zhing thos bsam gyi rgyud dag /de kho na nyid la blo sbyangs pa sha stag lags pa dang*/ ༈ dus phun gsum tshogs pa ni/ spyir thog mtha' dbus med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las/ bye brag zla ba dgu pa la dpes mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du yum la drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs nas slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis babs pa dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas bal yul yang le shod du thugs dam yang phur gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad de dus chen tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gza' skar sbyor byed sogs lta bu kha bsgyur/ dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ ༈ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'tsho ba zas/

nad sel sman/ dgra 'joms mtshon sogs phyi yi yo byad/ rten rdzas/ sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ khyad par sgrub pa'i rdzas/ snang ba'i 'od dang bcas pa'i rdzas mar me/ sgrub pa zhing gi rdzas bam mtshan ldan nam bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor thod pa kha sbyor/ rig pa ye shes phur pa la/ lha phur dang*/ shel lam/ me long*/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa sgrub pa'i snod thod pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa las kyi phur pa/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa/ bsnyen pa'i dus su phur pa dang*/ yungs dkar sgrub pa'i dus su 'khor lo dang*/ liṅga/ de la gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la/ bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor e khrom nyer gcig /bsad pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs drug spyir 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sku yi dkyil 'khor/ gru gsum shel gyi dal/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor rtsibs bcu drug /mā ra ya bsad pa'i dkyil 'khor bang rim gsum te/ de thams cad bsdus na 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur par 'dus pas/ phur pa phrin las kyi rgyud bid+yot+ta ma las rten phur 'dom gang khru mtho gang*/ gdab phur phyag mtshan ci bder bya/ zhes gsungs pa gtso phur/ ging phur/ mgyogs phur/ gdab phur/ las bzhi'i phur bu/ mngags phur/ srung bzlog dang*/ las drug thun gyi phur bu sogs rgyu dang tshad dbyibs grangs bcas gzhung mthun gtso bor gyur pa'i rten sgrub mchod pa'i rdzas gtsang la ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ yo byad kyi bkod pa bag gro ya le snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra ya le/ sbyar byung gi bdug spos ngad thu le/ sna tshogs kyi rol mo'i sgra skad 'ur di re/ rdo rje mched lcam spro dga' dang byin thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir/

ston pa rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnga' bdag /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzung ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rnams yab kyi g.yon zur/ chos 'chad pa rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub rdzas gter rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur bya ba dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las gzhung bsrang las kyi rgyal thebs rnams phyogs bzhi/ phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje ging ka ra rnams lho nub/ mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rno rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ dus sbyor dbyu gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzems pa'i rdo rje byan po byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags rnams shar lho/ rin po che lta bu'i mched lcam gang zag rnams gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grub chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra mang bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ sdang sems che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ bag med brjed ngas che ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ gnyid che chang la dga' ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing sgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te skyon drug po spang zhing*/ chos nyid dang mi phyed pa'i rtogs pa che ba/

bla ma dang mi phyed pa'i dad gus che ba/ yi dam dang mi phyed pa'i dam tshig che ba/ mched lcam dang mi phyed pa'i brtse gdung che ba/ dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa'i brtul zhugs che ba/ gzung ma dang mi phyed pa'i sbyor sgrol la brtson pa/ sems can dang mi phyed pa'i snying rje che ba/ dngos grub dang mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa'i skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu ste/ yon tan dgu po la rnam kun brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta: sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab pa sogs gang bsgo ba'i las rnams bde blag tu bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs 'dun dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/

༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i sgrub pa rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad bdud kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs pa dag skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po'i kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug kyang 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod du gnas pa thal ba nag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru dra sde gsum bsgral ba thod pa tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru tra'i chung ma la chags thabs kyi rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba'i zhing chen g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i zhon pa glang po che brtul ba glang chen ko rlon/ gza' nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma brtul bas stag gi sham thabs/ klu rgyal gdug pa can brtul bas sbrul nag gi chun po/ srin mo nyer bzhi sogs pa brtul ba'i thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pas zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda'i rtags sbyor gyi don ni/ dug lnga ye shes lngar dag pa'i rtags su thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ theg pa chen po'i don rtogs pa'i rtags su glang chen gyi ko rlon/

zhe sdang rtsad nas 'joms pa'i rtags su sbrul chun/ mtha' gnyis spangs ba'i rtags su zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyang ba'i me dpung*/ skye shi rtsad gcod chos skur mtshon pa'i thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug lnga dbang sdus longs sku mtshon pa'i rak+ta'i thig le/ rgyu drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blangs pa sprul sku mtshon phyir zhag chen po'i zo ris/ dug gsum sku gsum mtshon phyir thod pa tshar gsum bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ de dag bcom ldan 'das dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyem pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par/ dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang bsgyur/ gdug pa can zil gyis gnon/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa dpal chen che mchog yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu lha yi tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang 'di yis rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ ༈ dam tshig gi stong thun dang 'brel lam rgyus cung zad bshad pa ni/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ gdul bya'i khams dbang dang 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor mtha' yas pa bskor bas thams cad kyang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ kun byed las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'o/ zhes gsungs shing rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa las kyang khyad par du mas ches 'phags pa ste/ mtshan nyid pa ltar kun rdzob sgyu ma'i chos la blang dor du spyod pa ma yin gyi/ kun rdzob don dam dbyer med par spyod cing sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du sbyor bas ye nas blang dor med par sangs rgyas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu dbyer mi phyed pa'i don dang ldan pa'i theg pa la rdo rje theg pa zhes grags te/

che ba rnam pa drug dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs 'dir bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan bya gtso bor 'chad pa'i dbang gis/ ma hā/ a nu/ a ti gsum du dbye zhing*/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum ka'ang sbyang gzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang gis yo ga skor gsum gyi rtsa ba bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i skor 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas mngon gyur du gtan la phab cing*/ de la'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las/ 'dir sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi bye brag phur pa phrin las kyi lo rgyus cung zad smos pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ 'og min gyi gnas su kun tu bzang po dpal he ru kas yongs su dag pa'i 'khor rnams la rdo rje'i tshig tu gsungs pa rnams sdud pa po rdo rje chos la sogs pas bsdus shing rdzu 'phrul gyi yi ger snang ba rin po che'i sgrom du bcug ste mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs par mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa las gnyer du gtad par mdzad pa dang*/ gang gi tshe dur khrod ro gling bsil ba tshal zhes 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnam brgyad dgongs pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i sgrom bu brgyad la 'od dang 'ja' tshon dkrigs pa sogs ltas dang*/ mkha' 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byed par gzigs pa dang*/ 'dir 'jigs rten phung 'tshengs nus pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'dug snyam du dgongs te/ slob dpon rnams kyis der dgongs pa gtad cing bka' srung rnams la dam rdzas byin nas dam bsgrags shing dbang du bsdus pa'i dus der/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bka' ci zhig bstsal zer nas lhags pa la sgrom bu rnams gtod ces gsungs pas/ sgrom bu rnams so sor phul ba'i tshe/ gtso bo sgrub sde brgyad 'dus che mchog gi gser sgrom bi ma la dang/

yang dag gi dngul sgrom slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra dang/ phur pa'i g.yu sgrom slob dpon pra bha ha sti'i phyag tu gtad nas chos skor rnams rgya bkrol zhing*/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bshad dang sgrub par bka' gnang*/ de thams cad las/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis gsan pa'i tshul bstan te/ de'i nang nas dpal yang dag gi rgyud rngam glog dang*/ 'jig rten 'das mdo he ru kaḥgal po che chung sogs dang*/ phur pa rol pa'i rgyud dang*/ rig mchog 'bum sde'am/ bid+yot+ta ma kī la ya'i rgyud/ kī la ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma dam pa'i gsang chen gyi rgyud la sogs pa rab tu mang po bzhugs pa de lta bu'i sgrub sde re re'i khongs su'ang gzhan brgyad po mtha' dag 'dus par gsungs la/ de yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi sgrub sde brgyad so so'i dgongs don gshin rje'i 'khor lo bzhir 'dus la de yi mthar thug bskyed rdzogs chen gsum la 'dus par bzhed/ slob dpon klus ni rta skad theng gsum gyi dgongs par 'du la mthar thug rnal 'byor gsum la bzhed/ de bzhin du hūm̐ ka ras lta spyod sgrub pa gsum dang*/ dha nas lta spyod gnyis dang*/ gu h+yas rdzong 'phrang gnyis/ shan+tiṃ gar+bha'i bka' brgyad kyi mtha' srog dang srog 'phrog pa gnyis la thugs par bzhed la slob dpon bi ma'i rgyud lung man ngag gsum du bsdus pa sogs/ don du sgrub pa dang sgrub lugs kyi rnam bzhag ji ltar gsungs pa thams cad dgongs gnad mthun zhing*/ thabs mkhas gang 'dul gyi rol pa ye shes klong dgu rnam par shar ba'i sgrub sde brgyad dang sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga sogs dbye bsdu mang yang*/ don la rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs yang dag pa spros bral thig le nyag gcig chos dbyings ye shes klong gcig tu 'du ba bzhin sgrub sde brgyad thugs yang dag la 'dus te de yang spyi dpal chen po che mchog he ru ka la 'dus par bshad cing chos nyid don la tha dad ma mchis so/

de dag nang nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis thugs dam gyi mthil yang phur la mdzad de bal yul yang le shod du yang dag la brten nas mchog bsgrub pas grub la nye bar lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis tho 'tshams pas bar chad mtha' dag lhag pa'i lha rdo rje phur pa 'di nyid kyi mthu rtsal nus pas btul ba ste/ ji skad du/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub deng 'dir thob: ces gsungs shing*/ mnga' bdag rje 'bangs rnams la rgyud gdams can man ngag gi rim pa mang du bstsal bas gangs can rig sngags 'chang ba thams cad kyi thugs dam lha gcig mar yongs su grags shing bka' gter ring lugs mtha' yas par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ phrin las phur pa'i bka' bab jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi thugs kyi brnag pa mthar thug pa 'di nyid yin te/ yang phur rgyud las jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': gdams pa sgrub thabs rin chen gter du sbas: rje yi bka' bzhin bdag gis lhur blangs pa: ma ning gter bcu sbas pa'i gnas su 'os: bal bod mon kha phur pa bsten pa'i gnas: yang phur gcig dril gdams ngag zab mo'i chos: ma 'ongs 'di 'byin rjes 'brangs grogs lnga 'byung : sa rtags mtha' bzhi'i so kha mngon du mtshungs: dus rtags ru bzhi chu ltar khol bar byed: 'dul zhing 'gro don rong chen bzhi la 'byung : bka' yi chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lngar spel:

gnubs ston mthu chen yid la de ltar bcag: zhal gdams thams cad mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhir ltos: man ngag phal cher lung byang gong ma yin: gdams ngag them med rgyud byang so sor yod: yang mtha'i don du rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum 'byung : rgyas par lta ba klong yangs nam mkha'i mdzod: 'bring po don rdzogs bye brag lde mig gnad: gcig sgril yang phur sbrags ma 'di kho na: de phyir kho mo bdag gis legs par gdams: sa ma ya: gsung pa bzhin o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas spyan drangs pa'i yang phur ga'u dmar nag ces byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba 'di nyid/ khyab bdag kun tu bzang po nas/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i bar byon pa/ steng nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral ma zhig /sa la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bkrag ma yal/ bar du sman raka bdud rtsi'i mtsho ma skam/ dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi bslad ma zhugs/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan/ cho ga lung dang ldan pa/ lung man ngag dang ldan pa/ man ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ brgyud pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ de lta bu'i sgo nas sgrub pa chen po nyams su len pa la/ 'jug pa'i mtha' bcus gsang sngags kyi chos la zhugs dgos te/ sgo dbang gis phye/ srog dam tshig gis bzung*/ thag lta bas gcod/ la spyod pas dor/ nyams ting 'dzin gyis blangs/ don man ngag zab mo'i sgrub rgyud thos pas grol/ sgo theg pa kun la bsdu/ shes bya phyogs med la bslab/ dgos don du ma ro gcig tu bsdu ba lags/ de las kyang thog mtha' bar gsum du dam tshig la brten nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten nas byung*/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/

/dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad kyis 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung dgos/ spyir dam tshig ces bya ba'i nges tshig ni/ bslab bya tshul ldan du srung na dam zhing nyams na rdo rje me lce sogs kyis 'tshig pas na tshig ces bya la/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/ dam las 'das na snying dbus su rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros pas mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra man bcu drug spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/ dran pa dang shes bzhin bag yod par srung dgos shing*/ log rtog 'dul ba'i gnyen po dam tshig gi rnam grangs mang du gsungs kyang*/ lam zhugs rnams kyi gces don mdor bsdus bsrung bya ni/ slob dpon o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig gi rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsum/ yan lag dam tshig nyer lnga/ thun mong sa ma ya 'bum sde'i don bsdus nyer gcig sogs gsungs pa sogs mdor na thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba sku yi dam tshig tu/ shes rab rgyud/ dam tshig dbang*/ man ngag lung*/ nyams chag skong ba'i slob dpon te rdo rje slob dpon rnam pa bzhi po khog pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rang bzhin gzhi yi bsdus pa spyi yi mched/ ston pa gcig gi chos sgor zhug pa ring ba'i mched/ gsang chen snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa sgor zhug pa lta bu lta spyod mthun pa nye ba'i mched/ bla ma gcig dang dkyil 'khor gcig la brten pa dam tshig nang 'dres pa srog gi mched bzhi po lus dang mig dang srog ltar blta/

ku re kyal ka'i phyir yang ngan sems 'phya sems mi bya/ rtsa ba gsung gi dam tshig tu rgyu ma nor rtsa ba/ skyed pa rkyen/ stobs pa mchod pa/ bzlas pa 'dzab/ bskul pa phrin las kyi sngags te snying po rnam pa lnga dang*/ don gsal ba chos kyi rgya/ rtags nye bar sgrub pa lha'i rgya/ mtshon pa bsgyur ba gar stabs kyi rgya ste/ phyag rgya rnam pa gsum la rab rgyun chags/ 'bring dus drug /tha mas kyang nya stong brgyad gsum la ma chags par nyams su len/ rtsa ba thugs kyi dam tshig tu sbyor sgrol/ lha sngags/ grub rtags/ sgrub thabs te spyi gsang bzhi/ sgrub pa'i gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ grogs dang*/ sgrub rdzas te bar gsang bzhi lta ba zab mo gsang bar 'os pa dang*/ spyod pa zab mo gsang bar gnyer gtad pa ste bsgos gyur gnyis bcas gsang bcu rdo rje'i lce yod kyang mi bsgrag bar lus kyi spyod pa'ang sbas la byed/ yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga ni/ sbyor sgrol ma byin len dang rdzun tshig rlung smra spyad bya'i dam tshig lnga/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nga rgyal phrag dog ste mi spang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ dri chen dri chu byang sems rak+ta klad pa ste dwang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ phung po 'byung ba dbang po rnam shes sogs shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga/ gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes rnams rigs lngar shes pa bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga bcas lnga tshan lnga po/ le lo snyoms las chang dang gnyid sogs bag med kyi dbang du ya bar mi dor bar srung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la mi smad/ dus rtag tu bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ mched lcam nang mi 'thab/ slob dpon dang mched lcam gyi gzung ma mi spyad/ bzlas brjod bar mi bcad/ slob dpon gyi gdan mi 'gom/ ting 'dzin bying rmugs su mi btang*/ rang rgyud nyon mongs pas mi dkrug /dbang rtags rgya las mi 'da' ba sogs ste/

de dag ltem rkyang med par bsrungs pas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /bsrung bya srung byed thabs te 'khor gsum byang chub sems thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas srung mtshams bral ba'i ye srung chen por rtogs nas lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag dang ldan pa dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur te/ bang mdzod 'phrul sde las/ ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo bzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad srung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/ /mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs lta ba mthar phyin ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste rang rgyud bsregs/ so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung*/ dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog gcod/ snying phyung na sman ci tsam btang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub la sogs ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung bar lha rnams kyang rang gshed du babs nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa rdo rje dmyal bar skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar dus med par 'gyur la/ nyams pa'i rgyu yang*/ slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ lung ma mnos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig ched cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bor 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smad cing zur za byed pa/ gtsang rme rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/

spyod pa thod brgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs la dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /srog ni yongs su btang yang bla/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab kyang bla/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ zhes gsungs/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang*/ rab lta ba skye med ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas bshags shing*/ bsdoms te legs par srung ba'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung*/ sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad bskyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dpal yang dag che mchog he ru ka /gnyis med rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ 'di la 'gal bar ma byas na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par nges/ zhes dang*/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/ /rtogs pa mchog ni gong du 'phel/ ces sogs du ma nas gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing de dag mdor bsdu na sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa sgrub/ mi dge ba'i cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po sra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom par rnam bshad pa/

/kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de'i 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems ma 'dres pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byung ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyi snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma grub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad rnams zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'dab rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtsor bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byong ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlobs 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro bran bzhin 'khor bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje mched lcam rnams kyis bag yod dran shes ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan bzung bar mdzod cig

༈ dzap bsgyur ba bzlas dmigs skabs su bshad par bya ba ni/ da lam rdo rje mched lcam rnams la sgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhus na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rang byung 'dus ma byas pa nyid rnam pa gang 'dul rtags kyi phyag rgya gzugs skur bzhengs pa/ yang dag rdo rje sems pa'am dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu ste/ gsang rgyud las/ kun gyi bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ zhes gsungs pas spyir rigs lnga khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i spyi dpal chen po thugs yang dag /yon tan che mchog /phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu sogs ji ltar bshad kyang*/ don la thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes nyid rnam pa kun nyon 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa dang des bskyed pa'i ru tra la sogs bdud dang log 'dren 'joms pa la ngang gis khros pa'i gang 'dul gyi rol pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ rgyud las/ bde bar gshegs pa gar gyi bdag /'dod rgu bsgyur bas gar yang bde/ /gar gyi dbang phyug chen po la/ /mkhas pas phyogs ris mi brtag go /zhes gsungs pas/ gsar rnying rgyud sde zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad rdo rje phur par ma 'dus pa gang yang med pas/ sku dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyang zhi ba'i dus na rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyi kri yog gi dus su rdo rje rnam 'joms/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus su phyag na rdo rje sogs 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi mtshan dang sku yi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ byams dang snying rje'i gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzod de: zhes gsungs pas/ de thams cad gdul bya'i dbang gis snang ba tsam las don du gcig nyid de/ spros bral thig le chos sku nyag gcig las ma g.yos pas dkyil 'khor gsum sogs kyang rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nur 'dus shing*/ der ma zad snang ba thams cad thabs yab kyi rang bzhin rdo rje gzhon nu/

stong pa thams cad shes rab yum gyi rang bzhin 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ snang stong gnyis med thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med par sras 'bar ba'i khro bo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ srid pa thams cad rdo rje phur bu'i lha: zhes gsungs pas rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di lta bu bsgrub tu yod pa skal ba re bzang snyam du bsams te/ bla mar mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grus brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul mtshon dang ras bris dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ nang a nu yo ga shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rim pa rnams kyang gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing de gsum po re rer yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba ste bskyed rdzogs kyi gung shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi yi dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ yang dag rdo rje phur pa phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ma 'dres pa rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i sgo nas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus bgrang phreng*/ ngag snying po/ yid lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas sngags kyi sgra don shes pas 'phro 'du'i bzlas pa la brtson pa gsung gi sgrub lugs/ phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu thams cad phur bu thal 'byin gyi dgongs par 'dus pa te/ pad+ma thod phreng rgyal po ngas/ /rdo rje phur pa srid gsum mgon/ /srid gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mdor bsdus phur pa bzhi ru bstan/

zhes dang rang gzhung las/ rdzas kyi phur bu'i ma rig gdon bgegs bskrad/ /thugs rje'i phur bus rig drug gnas nas 'dren/ /byang sems phur bu zung 'jug mkha' dbyings sbyor/ /chos dbyings phur bu'i phyir mi bzlog pa'i dpal/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rig pa ye shes phur pa/ lhag pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ 'dus byas rdzas kyis phur pa bzhi ste/ dang po dbyings spros pa med pa rig pa rang byung gi ye shes 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa de kho na nyid rig pa ye shes phur pa'i ngo bo ste/ des chos thams cad rgyas btab pas 'khrul ba'i snang ba thal 'byin du phug ste gnyis med ye shes chen po chos kyi sku thob pa yin/ gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa ni yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i stobs kyi zhu bdes drang ba'i bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni de'i ngo bo yin la/ des rtsa rlung thig le'i grong khyer la rgyas btab pas ma dag pa'i rlung sems dbyings su nub nas dag pa'i ye shes mngon du 'char bar byed cing lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug longs sku thob par byed/ gsum pa tshad med snying rje'i phur pa ni snying rje chen po'i sems can yongs su mi gtong ba yin la/ de yul rigs drug gi sems can rnams la btab pas thugs rje'i dpyang thag gis zin nas 'khor ba'i gnas nas sgrol zhing sprul pa sku thob par byed/ bzhi pa 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa ni mtshan ma rtags kyi phyag rgya rten dang bcas pa ste 'di'i khongs su bskyed rim kyang 'du bas na/ phur pa'i rgyu gser dngul zangs lcags sam las mthun gyi shing ste dbyibs dang grangs tshad sgrub tshul sogs gzhung las shes par bya ste/ phur pa phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tha mal pa'i rnam rtog la rgyas btab nas bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yi tshul gyis bsgrubs pas bskyed rim snang srid phur ba'i dkyil 'khor du shar bas las rab 'byams mthar phyin te srid pa phur bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa ni thugs kyi sgrub lugs te/

phur pa sgrub cing gdab pa'i dgos ched ni bar chad 'dul zhing phrin las bzhi lhun gyis grub pas 'bras bu sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba'o/ dper na sos ka ljang bu'i dus su sad 'byung ba dkon la/ ston lo thog smin pa na sad ser 'byung ba mang ba bzhin gang zag dam par dngos grub thob la khad la bar chad mang zhing gang zag ma smin pa la bar chad mi 'byung ste/ thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i snga rol tu bdud dmag byung ba dang/ gu ru rin po che bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu bal mo shākya dā+e wi la sgrub brten byas yang dag gi sgo nas mchog sgrub pa'i grub pa thob la nye ba'i tshe/ klu gyong po dang*/ bar snang gi glog ma sprin/ gnod sbyin rgod ma kha sogs kyis cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas srid gsum gyi bdud dmag bskul zhing lha 'dre mi gsum gyi khengs log byung ba'i tshe bar chad sel ba'i chos zhu ched bal po ji la ji sa dang ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du gser phye bre bdun dang bcas brdzangs pas bid+yot+ta ma'i rgyud 'bum sde las phur pa'i glegs bam mi khur gnyis tsam dang khyad par hūm̐ ka ra'i yang phur gong khug ma nyi zla kha sbyor 'di nyid phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnams su gsal ba ltar gu ru pad+ma nyid kyis kyang thugs dam lhag pa'i lha 'di kho na yin la zhal gsung las/ dngos grub che ba yang dag dang*/ bdud dang bar chod 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa med par gsungs nas yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa mdzad pa yin la/ de yang gter gzhung las/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag bya ba ste: bla med ces pa ni: theg pa thams cad kyi gong ma yin pa'i bla med do: yang phur ces pa yang dag pa'i lta ba ma nor zhing khong du chud pa'i rdzong chen te: nyi ma'i snying po ltar grags shing rang bzhin gyi don thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba'o:

phur pa bya ba ni: yang dag ye shes rol pa'i sgrub khog gis bar chod bsal phyir phur pa sku gsum skye med kī la yar grags pa'o: gwa'u dmar nag ces pa ni: rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa yin pa'i thabs shes tsam du mtshon pa'o: sbas pa'i yul sha 'ug stag sgo dgos pa ni: sha 'ug stag sgor ma ning gter kha sbas: zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan no: ma ning zhes ni: yang dag rdzogs pa chen po: phur pa bdud bzhi g.yul rgyal: phur skyong dgra bgegs tshar gcod de: lha gcig la don gsum tshang pa ma ning gi mtshan nyid do: zhes dang yi dam gzhan yod kyang rdo rje phur pa srung ma'i tshul du sgrub dgos te/ yi dam gang sgrub rung theg chen chos gang spyod kyi bar chad rdo rje gzhon nu'i srung bar 'gyur te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ phyag na rdo rje dang po byang chub thugs bskyed pa'i dus su/ theg chen skyong ba'i srung mar zhal gyis bzhes shing sgrub pa po thams cad kyi lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas skyob par gsungs pas/ des na bskul ba tsam gyis phrin las mdzad nges pas bsnyen cing sgrub na bar gcod kun thul mchog dngos grub pa'i dgos pa yod par o rgyan dus gsum kun mkhyen pas bka' tshad ma'i gsungs so/ skabs 'dir gal che ba ni gshed rgyud las/ ting 'dzin bsam gtan dag dang mi ldan na/ /gsang sngags bzlas kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /gso dpyad bklag pas nad la mi phan ltar/ /de bas ting 'dzin bsam gtan 'bad par gyis/ zhes dang*/ o rgyan chen pos/ gzhan du g.yeng bar gyur na ni/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ zhes dang rdza dpal sprul o rgyan 'jig med chos kyi dbang po'i zhal nas/ dag dran med pa'i rnga rdung 'ur chems dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs med pa'i zlas brjod 'bag 'bug de/ /thar pa'i lam la phyogs tsam phyin re kan/ zhes gsungs pas/ cho ga'i gyer dbyangs/

rnga rdung rol mo/ dzap bsnyen sogs spros pa ji tsam byas kyang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin mi ldan na 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ rnal 'byor rab kyis/ rang sems sangs rgyas su shar bas sa lam bgrod med du shes/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu ye rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang tshad chos nyid du 'khyer/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang rang sar grol/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang gnas kyi don shes pa ste shar ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ rnal 'byor 'bring gis/ stong gsum gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung yang dog med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ phyi snod gtor gzhong du gsal bas mchod gtor bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid rdzas su gsal bas dam can mi bskong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong nyid du gsal bas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams sems la rdzogs pa ste gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ tha mas bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las sgom med kha gyer la bzung bas gsang sngags lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas gtor bshos bu za 'dod du bzung bas brnab sems kyi 'bras bu rnam smin gyi 'dam du tshud/ 'jig rten rtag chad la 'bras bu bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar ltung ba ste/ bzung ba lngas ma bcing ba dgos gal che/ mdor na/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das sems su thag chod/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag nyams su shar/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du long ba zhig dgos shing*/ de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su blos bcos te bsgom pa ni dpe/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni don te sems nyid 'gags med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/

ngo bo stong nyid du khrig ger gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre bslad mi dgos pa 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pas ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni don/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha yi 'khor lor dag pa ni brda/ de nyid mngon du gyur phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du byed pa ni rtags te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes yo ga gsum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa ci yang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/ rgyud las/ dngos grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags ni bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ spyir sngags kyi mtshan nyid/ ngo bo bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung yig 'brur snang ba/ nges tshig byin rlabs mngon du 'byin pas sngags/ dbye na rgyu ma nor rtsa ba'i sngags/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags/ bzlas pa las kyi sngags dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma ste/ sngags bzla ba la/ bum dbang dang mthun pa'i rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun pa lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun pa gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun pa de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun pa nyams su len par gsungs/ rtsol bcas kyi bzlas pa la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ ces ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral bas bzlas brjod byed pa ni bud shing 'dzoms pa rlung gis bskul na lhag par me 'bar ba bzhin bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs mchog yin zhing*/ de yang ngag bzlas kyi skabs rin chen phreng ba las/

bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal kha dang : khro dang 'thab dang shag dang 'jug 'dzin dang : zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs: smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad: lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo: zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam yang sngags brjod na: 'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin: gang gi lce la smra 'gyur pa: de dag bden pa thob par 'gyur: zhes spyir sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas/ bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bye brag phur pa la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rtags bdun tshan gsum ste/ sku yi rtags su/ phur pa 'gul ba/ 'phar ba/ lding ba/ me stag 'byung ba/ 'od 'byung ba/ du ba 'byung ba/ bzhad pa dang bdun/ gsung gi rtags su phur pa las sgra snyan pa/ sngags sgra/ gnam lcags kyi sgra/ 'brug sgra/ rnga sgra/ ce spyang gi sgra/ srin po'i ngur sgra dang bdun/ thugs kyi rtags su/ ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba/ las bzhi 'grub pa/ tshe la dbang ba/ rigs lnga mngon du gyur pa/ lha rnams gsal ba/ srung ma bran du khol ba/ rtogs pa 'char bar gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi chom/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs pa/ snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang nas/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/

༈ sgrub chen grol skabs phan yon dang 'brel ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga yi gzhi bzung*/ bskyed rdzogs yan lag bzhi yis gzhung bsrangs/ /lag len rtsis mgo tshang bas khrigs la phab nas/ yang phur ga'u dmar nag gi tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen po sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes bcas tshang ba mtha' rgyas su grub pa ste/ de yang spyir sangs rgyas gnyis pa gu ru'i gter chos la dad pa thams cad gu ru nyid bod la phebs skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ldan yin par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la mos pa kun/ /deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab/ /thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms/ kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin par yang gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyi yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur ste phu dud 'brel ba zhog: ces gsungs/ khyad par sgrub chen la 'brel ba bzhag pa'i phan yon/ o rgyan rin po ches zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na/ sgrub chen 'di yi mtshan tsam su gang 'dzin/ /o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres/ zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa sgrub na/ phur pa mkhan po bkra shis/ phur pa mkhan po dpal che/ phur pa mkhan po tshe ring*/ phur pa mkhan po nor phyug /phur pa mkhan po 'khor rgyas/ phur pa mkhan po srid 'phel/ phur pa mkhan po mthu che/ phur pa mkhan po mtha' btsan/ phur pa mkhan po yon tan brgyad dang ldan/ ces dang yang phur lo rgyus las/ e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril:

phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la gtad: sogs rgya cher gsungs shing mdor na/ gnas skabs su byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad sogs thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub gzhi 'bras dbyer med sku lnga ye shes dgu ldan dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ sku lnga ni/ rang sems gzhi yi rdo rje gzhon nu nyid/ bgrod pa lam gyi rdo rje gzhon nu thabs shes gnyis med du goms pas mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rdo rje gzhon nu dag pa gnyis ldan du gyur tshe de la sku lnga lhun gyis grub ste/ sems spros pa bral ba chos sku/ de'i rol pa 'gags med du shar ba longs sku/ de la gdul bya gzhan snang du ston pa sprul sku/ de la sdug bsngal med pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ de rnams dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid sku'o/ ye shes dgu ni gsal la rtog med me long ye shes/ ma 'dres gsal ba sor rtog ye shes/ thams cad mnyam pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ don la mi g.yo ba chos dbyings ye shes/ lhun gyis grub pa bya grub ye shes/ snang tshad ye shes su brdal ba rang byung ye shes/ rang rig rig cing rtogs pas rig pa rang byung gi ye shes/ cir snang ye shes su rgyas theb pas sna tshogs gnyes med rgyas 'debs kyi ye shes/ de thams cad don la tha snyad dang bral bas spros bral bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes rnams su 'grel chen 'bum nag tu gsungs pa bzhin las/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa rnal 'byor rang rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam bcas pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/

rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos bsgrub gyur na/ mtshams med lnga po'i spyad pas kyang*/ dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas phan yon de ldan gyi/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas/ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ rgyal thebs/ gzung ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad mi gzhug par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du lta dgos pa dang*/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel bas rnam kun 'bral med srog gis bsdus pa'i lha'i tshom bu 'khod cing*/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi dge ba'i las chen po bsags pa'ang don yod par bgyi ba'i slad du mar me smon lam gdab pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang rdzong phrang las/ sangs rgyas kun gzhi spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /thig le chen po ma bcos lhun grub dang*/ /skye 'gag med pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /ye shes mar me stong rtsar shar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub kyi sems dngos po'i gzugs dang bral ba/ khyad chos drug ldan ye shes kyi 'od phung du 'bar zhing gzhon nu bum sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni mtshon bya don gyi mar me/ gzhi la gzhi snang du g.yos te lhun grub rang snang gi sgo nas shar lugs chen po brgyad kyis 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba mtshon pa brda yi mar me/ rgyu sku dang ye shes/ rkyen 'od dang kha dog /byed las sgron ma bzhir smin te 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su snying po'i 'od gsal thig le chen po dang*/ spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ba ni mtshon byed rtags kyi mar me ste/ de dag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi dbang gis snang gsal mar me 'di yi mtshon byed du byas/

me long ye shes/ sor rtog ye shes/ mnyam nyid ye shes/ chos dbyings ye shes/ bya grub ye shes brdal ba rang byung ye shes/ rig pa rang byung ye shes/ rgyas 'debs ye shes/ bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes te ye shes chen po rnam pa dgu yi snang bas nyon mongs dgu yi mun khang bcom/ rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sgo rtsad nas bcad/ rdo rje khro rgyal rnams kyi zhal mthong*/ rang byung snang ba bzhi yi shul mtshon/ rig stong khyab brdal chen pos rgyab skyor/ rang grol spyod pa cog bzhag gis mtha' brten te/ bgrod bya lam lnga sa bcu bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis dwang srog thig le chen por srid gsum yongs dag gi klong dam par bgrod nas/ chos thams cad bya rtsol gnyis med kyi klong du gdod nas skye 'gag 'pho bral gzhi rdzogs lhun grub chen por gdeng chen thob/ dbugs chen 'byin/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa mdzad nas smon lam gyi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog sogs shis brjod rgyas par spel bas las mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ slar smras pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen po'i kyang/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /phur pas bar chad g.yul rgyal don gnyis grub/ /gsung phyir thugs dam lha gcig 'di nyid nges/ /bsam yas sa btul bstan pa'i sgron me sbar/ /mtsho rgyal la sogs gang gi rjes 'jug phal/ /thugs dam 'dir mdzad mchog thun grub pa mang*/ /de phyir 'di nyid zhal dro byin chen rmad/ khyad par yang phur sbrag sgrub brgya rtsa brgyad/ mdzad cing sbas par bka' gter lung mang yang*/ /gwa'u dmar nag nyi zla kha sbyor ba/ /'di las sa steng thon pa nyung bar snyam/ /'di bzhin bsnyen cing tshogs su sgrub pa yi/ /skal bzang 'di'ang tshe sngon legs byas dang*/ /smon lam dag 'bras gdon mi za ba'i phyir/ /tshul 'di bsam bzhin spro dga' mi skye su/

/de slad phur sgrub nyer mkho'i stong thun zhig /bri 'dun yang yang shar yang le lo'i g.yeng*/ /'on kyang 'phen sprul bstan 'dzin 'gyur med dang*/ /dam pa'i grogs kyis bskul ngor 'di nyid bris/ /de yang sngon byon gong ma'i bzhed pa'i srol/ /tshad ldan stong thun rnams las btus byas nas/ /rang gzhung khyad chos phyag len sdeb khul kyang*/ /ma 'brel nor 'khrul mchis na snying nas 'chag /'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs sil ma'i chab/ /rgyal sras sems dpa'i legs sngos gaṅga'i rgyun/ /sdebs nas sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho dang 'dres te/ /don gnyis mthar phyin sku gnyis mngon gyur shog /sgo gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i gdengs dang ldan/ /skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba'i gzhon nu dpal/ /thob nas rnam bzhi thabs mkhas phrin las kyis/ /bstan 'gro'i don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ stong thun gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi klad 'gem rdo rje khros pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di bzhin bris 'dun gyi sngar lan gnyis bris pa glog klad rgya mtshor dim pa la rjes gcod pa'i rkyal rtsal gyi 'phongs te re zhig btang snyoms su lus par yang phur yongs rjogs dpe skrun byed pa'i bshol 'debs su gyur yod tshul dang 'phral du bris nas bskur rogs zhes 'phen sprul bstan 'dzin 'gyur med dang gnam lcags mkhan po gcung ngag dbang dge legs nas drag bskul gnang bas sngar kho bo'i byas pa'i bla ma drag po'i stong thun dang 'bri gung lam mkhyen rgyal po'i mdzad pa phur pa'i stong thun bcas la gzhi bcol rang gzhung khyad chos rtsal 'don gyis a ri mang sde gcig dril gi mnga' sde mong kran na zhes pa'i nang gnas e wam̐ gsang sngags gling chos tshogs su rang gnas spyil bur rab byung ri zla'i shing pho bya yi lo/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes gsum la grub par bgyis pa'i dge bas gnam lcags rdo rje'i ring lugs dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
